en.s: The naval Battle of Sapienza, also known as the Battle of Porto Longo or Battle of Zonklon, took place on 4 November 1354, during the Third Genoese–Venetian War.

zh.s: 萨皮恩扎海战又称波尔托隆戈海战或宗克隆海战，是第三次热那亚—威尼斯战争期间的一场海战，发生于1354年11月4日。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Živohošť took place on 4 November 1419 during the Hussite Wars. Hussite pilgrims from Alttabor (Czech: Sezimovo Ústí) came to the countrywide congress in Prague, where they fought the Czech Catholic nobility following King Sigismund of Luxembourg and under the command of Peter Konopišťský of Sternberg.

zh.s: 日沃霍什季战役发生于1419年11月4日，是胡斯战争的一场战斗。塔博尔派朝圣者从阿尔塔博尔（捷克语：塞济莫沃乌斯季）前往布拉格参加全国大会，途中与效忠卢森堡国王西吉斯蒙德、由彼得·科诺皮什季的施滕贝格指挥的捷克天主教贵族交战。

en.s: The siege of Saint-Pierre-le-Moûtier was a venture of the so-called Lancastrian War. The small town was, however, heavily fortified and surrounded by a deep moat. According to Joan of Arc's bodyguard, Jean d'Aulon, the initial assault failed and the retreat was sounded. Joan managed to initiate a second assault, which, according to d'Aulon, was met 'without much resistance'. d'Aulon had been wounded in the heel during the initial assault and was, therefore, probably mounted on his horse during the second assault. As the aim to take all enemy strongholds on the Loire banks was put forward, the besieging of Saint-Pierre-le-Moûtier was adopted. Joan and Charles d'Albret united the forces at Bourges and proceeded to Saint-Pierre-le-Moutier. The defenders put up a vigorous defence. Nonetheless, the town was eventually taken by assault on November 4, 1429.

zh.t: 圣皮埃尔勒穆捷围城战
zh.s: 圣皮埃尔勒穆捷围城战是所谓兰开斯特战争中的一次行动。这座小城防御坚固，四周有深壕沟。据圣女贞德的护卫让·多隆记述，第一次进攻失败后，守军吹响了撤退号。贞德随后发起第二次进攻；按多隆的说法，这次进攻几乎没有遇到抵抗。多隆在第一次进攻中脚跟受伤，因此第二次进攻时很可能骑在马上。围攻圣皮埃尔勒穆捷的决定，是在提出攻取卢瓦尔河沿岸所有敌方据点后作出的。贞德和夏尔·达尔布雷在布尔日会合部队，随后前往圣皮埃尔勒穆捷。守军进行了顽强抵抗，但该城最终于1429年11月4日被攻占。

en.s: The Battle of Mstislavl took place on 4 November 1501 between the forces of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the forces of the Grand Duchy of Moscow and Principality of Novgorod-Seversk. The Lithuanian forces were defeated. The Muscovite–Lithuanian Wars renewed in 1500. In 1501, Ivan III of Russia sent a new force under the command of Semyon Mozhayskiy towards Mstislavl.

zh.s: 姆斯季斯拉夫尔战役于1501年11月4日举行，交战双方是立陶宛大公国军队，以及莫斯科大公国和诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基公国的军队。立陶宛军队战败。1500年，俄波战争重启；1501年，俄罗斯大公伊凡三世派遣谢苗·莫扎伊斯基率领一支新军前往姆斯季斯拉夫尔。

en.s: The Battle of Kanōguchi (加納口の戦い, Kanōguchi no Tatakai) was a battle during the Sengoku period (16th century) of Japan. As part of the very long rivalry between Oda Nobuhide and Saitō Dōsan, along with Dōsan's defense of his position in Mino Province. Nobuhide and Dōsan fought each other on the battlefield in Kanōguchi. Nobuhide, who was the father of the famous Oda Nobunaga, ended in defeat, with the loss of two of his very close relatives.

zh.s: 这是日本战国时代（16世纪）的一场战役，发生在织田信秀与斋藤道三长期争斗期间。织田信秀和道三在加纳口交锋，道三为保卫自己在美浓国的地位而战。织田信秀最终战败，两名亲近的亲属也在战斗中丧生。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Middelburg (1572–1574) lasted over a year during the Eighty Years' War. A Dutch rebel army besieged Middelburg, which was being held by Spanish forces under Cristóbal de Mondragón, on 4 November 1572. The Spanish held out and only capitulated on 18 February 1574, when news arrived that a relief effort to save Middelburg was defeated at Rimmerswiel.

zh.s: 米德尔堡围城战（1572—1574年）是八十年战争中的一次围城，持续了一年多。1572年11月4日，荷兰起义军开始围攻米德尔堡，当时该城由克里斯托瓦尔·德·蒙德拉贡率领的西班牙军队驻守。西班牙军队坚守到1574年2月18日才投降，当时他们得知前来解围的军队已在里默斯维尔被击败。

en.s: The sack of Antwerp, often known as the Spanish Fury at Antwerp, was an episode of the Eighty Years' War. It is the greatest massacre in the history of the Low Countries. On 4 November 1576, mutinying Spanish tercios of the Army of Flanders began the sack of Antwerp, leading to three days of horror among the population of the city, which was the cultural, economic and financial center of the Low Countries.

zh.s: 安特卫普劫掠也常被称为“西班牙暴行”，是八十年战争中的一次事件。它是低地国家历史上伤亡最惨重的屠杀。1576年11月4日，佛兰德斯军团中哗变的西班牙方阵步兵开始劫掠安特卫普。这座城市当时是低地国家的文化、经济和金融中心，劫掠使当地居民经历了三天的恐怖。

en.s: The Battle of Carrickfergus took place in November 1597, in the province of Ulster in what is now County Antrim, Northern Ireland, during the Nine Years War. It was fought between the crown forces of Queen Elizabeth I and the Gaelic clan of MacDonnell, with military support from Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone, and resulted in a defeat for the English.

zh.s: 卡里克弗格斯战役于1597年11月在阿尔斯特省、今北爱尔兰安特里姆郡发生，是九年战争的一场战斗。交战双方为伊丽莎白一世的王室军队和盖尔氏族麦克唐纳家族；泰隆伯爵休·奥尼尔也提供了军事支持。英军战败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Cape St Vincent of 1641 took place on 4 November 1641 between a Spanish fleet commanded by Don Juan Alonso de Idiáquez y Robles and a Dutch fleet led by Artus Gijsels during the Eighty Years' War. Two Dutch ships were lost and more than a hundred of their men were killed, but the cost was higher: 2 Spanish ships with over a thousand Spanish dead. The remaining Spanish fleet was forced to abandon the town to the Dutch and retreat to Cádiz.

zh.s: 1641年圣文森特角海战于11月4日爆发，西班牙舰队由唐·胡安·阿隆索·德·伊迪亚克斯·伊·罗布莱斯指挥，荷兰舰队由阿图斯·海塞尔斯率领，双方在八十年战争期间交战。荷兰损失两艘舰船，百余人阵亡；西班牙损失更重，两艘舰船被毁，阵亡人数超过一千。其余西班牙舰队被迫放弃该镇，交由荷兰人控制，并撤退至加的斯。

en.s: The siege of Perpignan was a siege during the Catalan Revolt.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 佩皮尼昂围城战是加泰罗尼亚起义期间的一场围城战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Olney Bridge was a skirmish that occurred on 4 November 1643 during the First English Civil War just outside the town of Olney, Buckinghamshire. In the engagement, Royalist forces attacked Parliamentarian forces holding the Olney bridge, but were driven off by a counter-attack.

zh.s: 奥尔尼桥战役是第一次英国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，于1643年11月4日在白金汉郡奥尔尼镇郊外发生。保王党军队袭击了驻守奥尔尼桥的议会军，但被对方反击击退。

en.s: The siege of Hulst (1645) was the last major siege of the Eighty Years' War. Dutch troops commanded by Frederick Henry conquered the heavily fortified town of Hulst after only 28 days.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 胡尔斯特围城战是八十年战争中的最后一场大型围城战。腓特烈·亨德里克率领的荷兰军队只用28天就攻下了防守严密的胡尔斯特镇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kushliki on 4 November 1661 between a Polish–Lithuanian force and a Russian Tsardom force was one of the battles of the Russo-Polish War (1654–67). A Lithuanian force of about 14,000 under pułkownik Kazimierz Żeromski made a fortified camp on the right bank of Daugava River (near the village of Kushliki (Kuszliki) in Polotsk Voivodeship) and defeated the first assault of Ivan Andreyevich Khovansky on 24 September.

zh.s: 1661年11月4日，波兰立陶宛联邦军与俄罗斯沙皇国军在俄波战争（1654—1667年）期间于库什利基交战。卡齐米日·热罗姆斯基率领约1.4万名立陶宛军队，在道加瓦河右岸、波洛茨克省库什利基村附近扎营并筑起防御工事，击退了伊万·安德烈耶维奇·霍万斯基于9月24日发动的首次进攻。

en.t: The Teatro di San Carlo, the oldest working opera house in Europe, is inaugurated in Naples, Italy
en.s: The Real Teatro di San Carlo ("Royal Theatre of Saint Charles"), as originally named by the Bourbon monarchy but today known simply as the Teatro (di) San Carlo, is a historic opera house in Naples, Italy, connected to the Royal Palace and adjacent to the Piazza del Plebiscito. It is the oldest continuously active venue for opera in the world, having opened in 1737, decades before either Milan's La Scala or Venice's La Fenice.

zh.t: 那不勒斯圣卡洛剧院落成，成为欧洲历史最悠久的仍在运营的歌剧院
zh.s: 圣卡洛皇家剧院最初由波旁王朝命名为“圣查理皇家剧院”，如今通常称为圣卡洛剧院，位于意大利那不勒斯，毗邻王宫和全民公决广场。它是世界上持续运营时间最长的歌剧院，1737年开幕，比米兰斯卡拉歌剧院和威尼斯凤凰剧院早几十年。

en.s: The Rebellion of Túpac Amaru II was an uprising by kuraka-led Aymara, Quechua, and mestizo rebels aimed at overthrowing Spanish colonial rule in Peru, from 1780 to 1783. The causes of the rebellion included opposition to the Bourbon Reforms, an economic downturn in colonial Peru, and a grassroots revival of Inca cultural identity led by Túpac Amaru II, an indigenous kuraka and the leader of the rebellion.
en.n: The Rebellion of Túpac Amaru II against Spanish rule in the Viceroyalty of Peru begins.

zh.t: 图帕克·阿马鲁二世起义
zh.s: 图帕克·阿马鲁二世起义是1780年至1783年间的一场起义。艾马拉人、克丘亚人和混血人组成的反叛者由库拉卡领袖带领，目标是推翻西班牙在秘鲁的殖民统治。起义原因包括反对波旁改革、秘鲁殖民地经济衰退，以及由原住民库拉卡、起义领袖图帕克·阿马鲁二世带动的印加文化复兴。
zh.n: 图帕克·阿马鲁二世领导的秘鲁总督辖区反西班牙起义开始。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: St. Clair's defeat, also known as the Battle of the Wabash, the Battle of Wabash River or the Battle of a Thousand Slain, was a battle fought on 4 November 1791 in the Northwest Territory of the United States. The U.S. Army faced the Northwestern Confederacy of Native Americans as part of the Northwest Indian War.

zh.s: 圣克莱尔惨败也称瓦巴什战役、瓦巴什河战役或千人阵亡之战，于1791年11月4日在美国西北领地发生。美国陆军与美洲原住民西北邦联交战，这是西北印第安战争的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Maastricht (22 September – 4 November 1794) was a successful siege of the city of Maastricht by the forces of the French First Republic led by General of Division (GD) Jean-Baptiste Kléber. The War of the First Coalition action resulted in the surrender of the Coalition garrison commanded by Lieutenant General Prince Frederick of Hesse-Kassel.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 马斯特里赫特围城战（1794年）
zh.s: 马斯特里赫特围城战发生于1794年9月22日至11月4日。法兰西第一共和国军队在师级将军让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔率领下成功围攻马斯特里赫特。第一次反法同盟战争中的这场行动以联军驻军投降告终；驻军由黑森-卡塞尔亲王、陆军中将弗里德里希指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 1796 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: A presidential election was held in Georgia on November 4, 1796, as part of the 1796 United States presidential election. The voters chose four representatives, or electors, through plurality block voting to the Electoral College. These electors then voted for president and vice president. Out of 51 elector candidates, four Democratic-Republican electors were elected who then voted for Thomas Jefferson over the Federalist candidate and incumbent Vice President John Adams.

zh.s: 1796年美国总统选举期间，佐治亚州于1796年11月4日举行总统选举。选民通过区块投票制，以相对多数选出4名选举人，组成选举人团。选举人随后投票选出总统和副总统。51名选举人候选人中，有4名民主共和党候选人当选；他们随后投票支持托马斯·杰斐逊，对手是联邦党候选人、时任副总统约翰·亚当斯。

en.s: The Siege of Corfu (November 1798 – March 1799) was a military operation by a joint Russian and Turkish fleet against French troops occupying the fortified island of Corfu; ended in Coalition victory. Corfu fortifications had a strong reputation, but by the siege time they were in a parlous state.
en.n: On 4 November 1798, Ushakov's Russo-Turkish detachment under Captain 1st rank , consisting of three ships of the line, three frigates, and several small ships, began the siege of Corfu.

zh.s: 科孚岛围城战（1798年11月至1799年3月）是俄土联合舰队对法国军队占领的科孚岛要塞发起的军事行动，最终由反法同盟获胜。科孚岛的防御工事曾声名坚固，但围城战开始时已年久失修。
zh.n: 1798年11月4日，乌沙科夫的俄土联军分队在一名海军上校指挥下开始围攻科孚岛。该分队由3艘战列舰、3艘护卫舰和数艘小型舰艇组成。

loc: 意大利皮埃蒙特大区杰诺拉

en.s: The Battle of Genola or Battle of Fossano (4 November 1799) was a meeting engagement between a Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Michael von Melas and a Republican French army under Jean Étienne Championnet. Melas directed his troops with more skill and his army drove the French off the field, inflicting heavy losses. The War of the Second Coalition action represented the last major French effort in Italy during 1799. The municipality of Genola is located in the region of Piedmont in northwest Italy a distance of 27 kilometres (17 mi) north of Cuneo and 58 kilometres (36 mi) south of Turin.

zh.s: 杰诺拉战役，又称福萨诺战役，发生于1799年11月4日，是哈布斯堡奥地利军队与共和派法国军队的一次遭遇战。奥军由迈克尔·冯·梅拉斯指挥，法军由让·艾蒂安·尚皮奥内指挥。梅拉斯指挥得当，奥军将法军赶出战场并造成重大伤亡。这是第二次反法同盟战争期间法国1799年在意大利发动的最后一次重大攻势。杰诺拉镇位于意大利西北部皮埃蒙特大区，距库内奥以北27公里，距都灵以南58公里。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Cape Ortegal was the final action of the Trafalgar Campaign, and was fought between a squadron of the Royal Navy and a remnant of the fleet that had been destroyed earlier at the Battle of Trafalgar. It took place on 4 November 1805 off Cape Ortegal, in north-west Spain and saw Captain Sir Richard Strachan defeat and capture a French squadron under Rear-Admiral Pierre Dumanoir le Pelley. It is sometimes known as Strachan's Action. Dumanoir had commanded the van of the line at Trafalgar, and had managed to escape the battle having suffered relatively little damage.

zh.s: 奥特加尔角海战是特拉法加战役行动的最后一战，交战双方是英国皇家海军分舰队与特拉法加海战中被击溃的舰队残部。战斗于1805年11月4日在西班牙西北部奥特加尔角附近进行。理查德·斯特拉坎爵士击败并俘获皮埃尔·杜马努瓦·勒佩利海军少将率领的法国舰队。此战有时也称斯特拉坎海战。杜马努瓦曾在特拉法加海战中指挥前锋舰队，并在损失较小的情况下脱身。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Battle of Steyr (French: Bataille de Steyr; German: Schlacht bei Steyr) was fought on 4 November 1805 between the French army under the command of Louis-Nicolas Davout and the Austrian army under the command of General Maximilian, Count of Merveldt during the War of the Third Coalition. It ended in French victory.

zh.s: 施泰尔战役（法语：Bataille de Steyr；德语：Schlacht bei Steyr）于1805年11月4日举行，是第三次反法同盟战争中的一场战役。交战双方为路易-尼古拉·达武指挥的法国军队和马克西米利安·梅尔维尔德伯爵将军指挥的奥地利军队。法国获胜。

en.s: The 1805 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1805, in order to elect the governor of Georgia. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor John Milledge won re-election in a Georgia General Assembly vote as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1805年佐治亚州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出州长。民主共和党现任州长约翰·米利奇在佐治亚州议会投票中无人挑战，成功连任。

en.s: The 1808 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1808, in order to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Joseph Bloomfield was unanimously re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1808年新泽西州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出新泽西州州长。现任民主共和党州长约瑟夫·布卢姆菲尔德没有对手，随后由新泽西州议会一致投票选出，成功连任。

en.s: In the Battle of Baza on 4 November 1810 an Imperial French force commanded by General Milhaud fought a Spanish corps led by General Blake. When the Spanish commander allowed his forces to get spread out, Milhaud attacked with his cavalry and crushed Blake's vanguard with heavy losses. The Spanish force retreated into the province of Murcia. Baza is located on Route 342 about 80 kilometres (50 mi) north of Almería.

zh.s: 1810年11月4日，米约将军率领的法兰西帝国军队与布莱克将军率领的西班牙军团在巴萨交战。西班牙指挥官让部队分散开来后，米约派骑兵进攻，重创了布莱克军队的前锋。西班牙军队撤退到穆尔西亚省。巴萨位于342号公路上，距阿尔梅里亚以北约80公里（50英里）。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Virginia
en.s: A presidential election was held in Virginia on November 4, 1816, as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins defeated the Federalist ticket. The Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1816年11月4日举行总统选举，是1816年美国总统选举的一部分。由美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗和纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的民主共和党组合击败了联邦党组合。联邦党当时没有提名候选人。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: A presidential election was held in New Hampshire on November 4, 1816, as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of U.S. Secretary of State James Monroe and Governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins defeated the Federalist ticket. Whereas nationally the Federalist Party failed to nominate a candidate, and most state parties effectively conceded the election, in New Hampshire a serious effort was mounted to defeat the Democratic-Republican ticket.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1816年11月4日举行总统选举，是1816年美国总统选举的一部分。由美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗和纽约州州长丹尼尔·D·汤普金斯组成的民主共和党组合击败了联邦党组合。在全国范围内，联邦党没有提名候选人，大多数州的联邦党都实际上放弃了竞争，但在新罕布什尔州，联邦党人认真组织了挑战，试图击败民主共和党组合。

en.s: The Attack on Selarong was a series of Dutch military expeditions in 1825 to storm Javanese Prince Diponegoro's primary base at Selarong Cave, at the start of the Java War. The expedition was divided into three phases. All of the expeditions resulted in Dutch failure and were ineffective in relieving pressure on Dutch forces during the siege of Yogyakarta.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞拉隆袭击是1825年荷兰军队为攻占爪哇王子迪波内戈罗在塞拉隆洞穴的主要基地而发起的一系列军事行动，也是爪哇战争初期的战事。这些行动分为三个阶段，均以荷兰军队失败告终，也未能减轻日惹围城战期间荷兰军队承受的压力。

en.t: 1828 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: The 1828 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 4, 1828, as part of the 1828 United States presidential election. Voters chose 36 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. For this election, New York used the congressional district method of choosing electors, with 34 of its electors being chosen by the winner in each of the state's congressional districts, and the remaining two being chosen by the first 34 electors.

zh.s: 1828年纽约州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1828年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了36名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。纽约州当时采用按联邦众议院选区选举选举人的办法：34名选举人分别由各选区得票最高者选出，剩余两名则由前述34名选举人选出。

en.s: The Battle of La Ciudadela (Battle of the Citadel) was a fight during the Argentine Civil Wars between Federalist troops commanded by Facundo Quiroga and Unitarian troops of Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid on the outskirts of San Miguel de Tucumán, Argentina, on 4 November 1831.It resulted in a decisive victory by the Federalists.

zh.s: 拉西塔德拉战役（城堡战役）是阿根廷内战期间的一场战斗，于1831年11月4日在阿根廷圣米格尔-德图库曼郊外爆发。法昆多·基罗加指挥的联邦派军队与格雷戈里奥·阿劳斯·德·拉马德里德指挥的中央集权派军队交战。联邦派取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Lipantitlán, also known as the Battle of Nueces Crossing, was fought along the Nueces River on November 4, 1835 between the Mexican Army and Texian insurgents, as part of the Texas Revolution. After the Texian victory at the Battle of Goliad, only two Mexican garrisons remained in Texas, Fort Lipantitlán near San Patricio and the Alamo Mission at San Antonio de Béxar (modern-day San Antonio in the U.S. state of Texas).

zh.s: 利潘蒂特兰战役又称努埃塞斯渡口战役，于1835年11月4日在努埃塞斯河畔爆发，交战双方为墨西哥军队和德克萨斯起义军，是德克萨斯革命的一部分。德克萨斯起义军在戈利亚德战役获胜后，德克萨斯境内只剩两处墨西哥驻军：圣帕特里西奥附近的利潘蒂特兰堡，以及贝克萨尔圣安东尼奥的阿拉莫传教站（今美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥）。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: A presidential election was held in Ohio on November 4, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose twenty-one representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio voted for Whig candidate William Henry Harrison over Democratic candidate Martin Van Buren. Harrison won Ohio by a narrow margin of 4.31%. Ohio was the home state of William Henry Harrison.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1836年11月4日举行总统选举，是1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了21名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。俄亥俄州投票支持辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森，击败民主党候选人马丁·范布伦。哈里森以4.31%的微弱优势赢得俄亥俄州。他的家乡就是俄亥俄州。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania
en.s: A presidential election was held in Pennsylvania on November 4, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose 30 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over the Whig candidate, William Henry Harrison. Van Buren won Pennsylvania by a narrow margin of 2.36%.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于1836年11月4日举行总统选举，是1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了30名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州投票支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，击败辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森。范布伦以2.36%的微弱优势赢得宾夕法尼亚州。

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain in October 1836. At stake were all 149 seats in the Congress of Deputies, in order to adopt a new constitution to replace the Royal Statute of 1834. The Cortes eventually enacted the Constitution of 1837.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1836年10月，西班牙举行议会大选，选出西班牙议会两院中的众议院全部149个席位，以制定新宪法，取代1834年《王室章程》。西班牙议会最终通过了1837年宪法。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 4 November 1837. Only citizens paying taxes were eligible to vote. 151,720 of the 198,836 registered voters voted.

zh.s: 法国于1837年11月4日举行立法选举。只有纳税公民才有投票资格。198,836名登记选民中有151,720人投了票。

en.s: The 1839 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1839, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Alexander G. McNutt, an incumbent Democrat won against Whig candidate Edward Turner.

zh.s: 1839年密西西比州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出密西西比州州长。民主党现任州长亚历山大·G·麦克纳特击败辉格党候选人爱德华·特纳。

en.s: The Newport Rising was the last large-scale armed rising in Wales, by Chartists whose demands included democracy and the right to vote with a secret ballot. On Monday 4 November 1839, approximately 4,000 Chartist sympathisers, under the leadership of John Frost, marched on the town of Newport, Monmouthshire. En route, some Newport chartists were arrested by police and held prisoner at the Westgate Hotel in central Newport.

zh.s: 纽波特起义是威尔士规模最大的最后一次武装起义，宪章派提出了民主和无记名投票权等诉求。1839年11月4日（星期一），约4,000名宪章派支持者在约翰·弗罗斯特带领下向蒙茅斯郡纽波特镇进发。途中，一些纽波特宪章派被警方逮捕，并被关押在纽波特市中心的韦斯特盖特酒店。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: A presidential election was held in New Hampshire on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Hampshire voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay and Liberty candidate James G. Birney. Polk won New Hampshire by a margin of 18.9%.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱和自由党候选人詹姆斯·G·伯尼。波尔克以18.9%的优势赢得新罕布什尔州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: A presidential election was held in Connecticut on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk. Clay won Connecticut by a narrow margin of 4.63%.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州投票支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。克莱以4.63%的微弱优势赢得康涅狄格州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1844 United States presidential election in Kentucky was held on November 4, 1844, as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kentucky voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk. Clay won his home state by a margin of 8.18%.

zh.s: 1844年肯塔基州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了12名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。肯塔基州投票支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。克莱以8.18%的优势赢得家乡肯塔基州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: A presidential election was held in Mississippi on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Mississippi voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Mississippi by a margin of 14.86%.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。密西西比州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以14.86%的优势赢得密西西比州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the former governor of Tennessee James K. Polk and the former U.S. minister to Russia George M. Dallas defeated the Whig ticket of the former U.S. senator from Kentucky Henry Clay and the chancellor of New York University Theodore Frelinghuysen.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。由田纳西州前州长詹姆斯·K·波尔克和美国前驻俄公使乔治·M·达拉斯组成的民主党组合击败了辉格党组合；辉格党组合成员是肯塔基州前联邦参议员亨利·克莱和纽约大学校监西奥多·弗里林海森。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Virginia
en.s: A presidential election was held in Virginia on November 4, 1844, as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 17 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Virginia by a margin of 6.10%.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了17名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以6.10%的优势赢得弗吉尼亚州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: A presidential election was held in Illinois on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Illinois voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Illinois by a margin of 11.86%. Boone County would not vote Democratic again until 2008.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以11.86%的优势赢得伊利诺伊州。布恩县直到2008年才再次投票支持民主党。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: A presidential election was held in Michigan on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Michigan voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay and Liberty candidate James G. Birney. Polk won Michigan by a margin of 6.03%.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了5名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。密歇根州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱和自由党候选人詹姆斯·G·伯尼。波尔克以6.03%的优势赢得密歇根州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: A presidential election was held in Arkansas on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Arkansas voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Arkansas by a margin of 26.02%.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了3名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以26.02%的优势赢得阿肯色州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: A presidential election was held in Missouri on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Missouri by a margin of 13.96%.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了7名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。密苏里州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以13.96%的优势赢得密苏里州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: A presidential election was held in Georgia on November 4, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Georgia voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Georgia by a margin of 2.38%.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于1844年11月4日举行总统选举，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。佐治亚州支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以2.38个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1845 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1845. Democratic nominee Alpheus Felch defeated Whig nominee Stephen Vickery with 50.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1845年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人阿尔菲厄斯·费尔奇击败辉格党候选人斯蒂芬·维克里，得票率为50.83%。

en.s: The 1851 gubernatorial election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1851. Whig candidate Leonard J. Farwell won the election with 56% of the vote, winning his first term as Governor of Wisconsin. Farwell defeated Democratic candidate Don Alonzo Joshua Upham.

zh.s: 1851年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。辉格党候选人伦纳德·J·法威尔以56%的得票率获胜，首次当选州长。他击败了民主党候选人唐·阿朗佐·约书亚·厄珀姆。

en.s: The 1851 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1851. Democratic nominee Robert McClelland defeated Whig nominee Townsend E. Gidley with 58.28% of the vote.

en.s: The 1851 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1851, in order to elect the Governor of the U.S. state of Mississippi. Democratic US Senator for Mississippi Henry S. Foote, who ran on a Unionist platform, defeated the Southern Rights Party nominee and fellow Democratic US Senator for Mississippi before resigning on September 23, 1851, to run in the gubernatorial election, Jefferson Davis.

zh.s: 1851年密西西比州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出密西西比州州长。民主党联邦参议员亨利·S·富特以统一主义立场参选，击败南方权利党候选人杰斐逊·戴维斯。戴维斯也是密西西比州民主党联邦参议员，曾于1851年9月23日辞职，随后竞选州长。

en.t: Accession of Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour
en.s: Camillo Paolo Filippo Giulio Benso, Count of Cavour, Isolabella and Leri (Italian: [kaˈmillo ˈbɛnso]; 10 August 1810 – 6 June 1861), generally known as the Count of Cavour ( kə-VOOR; Italian: Conte di Cavour [ˈkonte di kaˈvur]) or simply Cavour, was an Italian politician, statesman, businessman, economist, and noble, and a leading figure in the movement towards Italian unification.

zh.s: 卡米洛·保罗·菲利波·朱利奥·本索伯爵（意大利语：Camillo Benso；1810年8月10日—1861年6月6日），通常称卡富尔伯爵，或简称卡富尔，是意大利政治家、国务家、商人、经济学家和贵族，也是意大利统一运动的重要人物。

en.s: The Battle of Oltenița (or Oltenitza) was fought on 4 November 1853 and was the first engagement of the Crimean War. In this battle an Ottoman army under the command of Omar Pasha was defending its fortified positions from the Russian forces led by General Peter Dannenberg, until the Russians were ordered to withdraw.

zh.s: 奥尔泰尼察战役于1853年11月4日爆发，是克里米亚战争的第一场战斗。奥马尔帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队在战斗中守卫坚固阵地，抵御彼得·丹嫩贝格将军率领的俄罗斯军队，直到俄军接到命令撤退。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1856 was the 18th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 4, 1856. Incumbent president Franklin Pierce was defeated in his effort to be re-nominated by the Democratic Party. James Buchanan, an experienced politician who had held a variety of political offices, was serving as the United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom and won the nomination instead. Slavery was the omnipresent issue, and the Whig Party, which had since the 1830s been one of the two major parties in the U.S., had disintegrated.

zh.s: 1856年美国总统选举是美国第18次四年一度的总统选举，于1856年11月4日（星期二）举行。现任总统富兰克林·皮尔斯未能获得民主党再次提名。曾担任多项公职、当时出任美国驻英国大使的詹姆斯·布坎南赢得民主党提名。奴隶制是当时无处不在的核心议题；辉格党曾自19世纪30年代起与另一大党并列，但此时已瓦解。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1856

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举，是1856年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了10名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南，击败辉格党候选人米勒德·菲尔莫尔。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in Missouri was held on November 4, 1856. Voters chose nine electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the president and vice president. Missouri voted for the Democratic nominee James Buchanan, who received 54% of the vote. Republican Party nominee John C. Frémont was not on the ballot.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举。选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南赢得密苏里州，得票率为54%。共和党候选人约翰·C·弗雷蒙没有列入选票。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 4, 1856, as part of the 1856 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois voted for the Democratic candidate, James Buchanan, over Republican candidate John C. Frémont and American Party candidate Millard Fillmore. Buchanan won Illinois by a narrow margin of 3.86%.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举，是1856年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了11名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州投票支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南，击败共和党候选人约翰·C·弗雷蒙和美国党候选人米勒德·菲尔莫尔。布坎南以3.86%的微弱优势赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 1856, as part of the 1856 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina cast 8 electoral votes for the Democratic candidate James Buchanan. These electors were chosen by the South Carolina General Assembly, the state legislature, rather than by popular vote.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举。州议会选出了8名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州投下的8张选举人票都支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南。该州选举人由南卡罗来纳州议会选出，而非由选民直接投票选出。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 1856, as part of the 1856 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican candidate, John C. Frémont, over the Democratic candidate, James Buchanan, and the Know Nothing candidate, Millard Fillmore.

zh.s: 缅因州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举，是1856年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了8名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。缅因州投票支持共和党候选人约翰·C·弗雷蒙，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南和一无所知党候选人米勒德·菲尔莫尔。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 1856, as part of the 1856 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Republican candidate, John C. Frémont, over the Democratic candidate, James Buchanan, and the Know Nothing candidate, Millard Fillmore.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1856年11月4日举行总统选举，是1856年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州投票支持共和党候选人约翰·C·弗雷蒙，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南和一无所知党候选人米勒德·菲尔莫尔。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 4, 1856. Incumbent mayor Fernando Wood re-elected to a second term in office in a four-way race. He defeated American Party nominee Isaac O. Barker, Republican Anthony J. Bleecker, and Whig nominee John J. Herrick. Although Wood was easily re-elected by an increased plurality over his 1854 performance, he ran behind presidential candidate James Buchanan and failed to win support for his reform proposals on the Common Council.

zh.s: 纽约市于1856年11月4日举行市长选举。现任市长费尔南多·伍德在四人角逐中连任第二个任期，击败美国党候选人艾萨克·O·巴克、共和党人安东尼·J·布利克和辉格党候选人约翰·J·赫里克。尽管伍德以比1854年更大的相对多数轻松连任，他的得票仍低于总统候选人詹姆斯·布坎南，也未能推动其市议会改革方案获得支持。

en.t: 1856 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1856 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 1856, as part of the 1856 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia voted for the Democratic candidate, James Buchanan, over American Party candidate Millard Fillmore. Buchanan won Georgia by a margin of 14.28%. Republican Party candidate John C.

zh.s: 1856年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。佐治亚州支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·布坎南，击败美国党候选人米勒德·菲尔莫尔。布坎南以14.28个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1856 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1856. Incumbent Governor Myron Clark did not run for re-election to a second term in office. In the race to succeed him, John A. King defeated Amasa J. Parker and Erastus Brooks to become the first Republican elected Governor of New York.

zh.s: 1856年纽约州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长迈伦·克拉克没有竞选连任第二个任期。共和党人约翰·A·金击败阿马萨·J·帕克和埃拉斯图斯·布鲁克斯，成为首位当选纽约州州长的共和党人。

en.s: The 1856 New York state election was held on November 4, 1856, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a Canal Commissioner, an Inspector of State Prisons and the Clerk of the Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly.

zh.s: 1856年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、运河专员、州监狱监察员、上诉法院书记员，以及纽约州众议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1856 Illinois gubernatorial election was the eleventh election for this office. Democratic governor Joel Aldrich Matteson did not seek re-election. Former Democratic Congressman William Henry Bissell was nominated by the newly formed Republican Party at the Bloomington Convention. Former Whig Mayor of Chicago Buckner S. Morris was nominated on the Know-Nothing Party ticket.

zh.t: 1856年美国伊利诺伊州州长选举
zh.s: 1856年伊利诺伊州州长选举是该职位的第十一次选举。民主党籍州长乔尔·奥尔德里奇·马特森没有寻求连任。新成立的共和党在布卢明顿大会上提名了前民主党籍国会议员威廉·亨利·比塞尔。前辉格党籍芝加哥市长巴克纳·S·莫里斯则获一无所知党提名。

en.s: The 1856 Massachusetts gubernatorial election on November 4. Incumbent Know-Nothing governor Henry J. Gardner was re-elected to a third term. He benefited greatly from a deal with the state's new Republican Party, which agreed not to field a candidate in exchange for Gardner's support of presidential nominee John C. Frémont. With no serious challenger in the field against him, Gardner easily defeated Democrat Erasmus Beach and George W.

zh.t: 1856年美国马萨诸塞州州长选举
zh.s: 1856年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。无知党籍州长亨利·J·加德纳连任，开始第三个任期。他与新成立的共和党达成协议，获益颇多：共和党同意不派候选人参选，以换取加德纳支持总统候选人约翰·C·弗里蒙特。由于没有强劲对手，加德纳轻松击败民主党人伊拉斯谟·比奇和乔治·W。

en.s: The 1857 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1857, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. American Party nominee and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates Thomas Holliday Hicks defeated Democratic nominee and former Secretary of State of Maryland John Charles Groome.

zh.s: 1857年马里兰州州长选举于11月4日举行。美国党候选人、曾任马里兰州众议员的托马斯·霍利迪·希克斯击败民主党候选人、马里兰州前州务卿约翰·查尔斯·格鲁姆。

en.s: The University of Washington (UW, and informally U-Dub or U Dub) is a public research university in Seattle, Washington, United States. Founded in 1861, it is one of the oldest universities on the West Coast of the United States. The university has a 700-acre (2.8 km2) main campus in the city's University District, with satellite campuses in nearby cities of Tacoma and Bothell.

zh.s: 华盛顿大学（UW，非正式简称U-Dub）是一所公立研究型大学，位于美国华盛顿州西雅图。学校创立于1861年，是美国西海岸历史最悠久的大学之一。主校区占地700英亩（约2.8平方公里），位于西雅图大学区；学校还在附近的塔科马和博瑟尔设有分校区。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1862 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 4, 1862. Democrat Joel Parker defeated Republican nominee Marcus Lawrence Ward with 56.8% of the vote.

zh.s: 1862年新泽西州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人乔尔·帕克以56.8%的得票率击败共和党候选人马库斯·劳伦斯·沃德。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1862 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1862. Incumbent Democratic Governor William Burton was unable to seek re-election. Samuel Jefferson ran to succeed him as the Democratic nominee, and he faced National Union candidate William Cannon, the former State Treasurer. Cannon narrowly defeated Jefferson, and in so doing, was the last Republican-affiliated candidate to be elected Governor until 1894.

zh.s: 1862年特拉华州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党州长威廉·伯顿无法竞选连任。民主党提名塞缪尔·杰斐逊接替他，他的对手是国家联盟党候选人、前州财政部长威廉·坎农。坎农以微弱优势击败杰斐逊，并成为直到1894年才有共和党相关候选人当选州长之前，最后一位当选州长的共和党相关候选人。

en.s: The 1862 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1862. Incumbent Republican Austin Blair defeated Democratic nominee Byron G. Stout with 52.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1862年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长奥斯汀·布莱尔击败民主党候选人拜伦·G·斯托特，得票率为52.51%。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Kansas on November 4, 1862. The Republican state representative Thomas Carney defeated the Union state representative William R. Wagstaff. The Kansas Republican Party nominated Carney in their state convention held at Topeka from September 17–18, 1862. Carney was an ally of the senior U.S. senator from Kansas and brigadier general Jim Lane, who by 1862 had emerged as the leader of the state Republican Party.

zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1862年11月4日举行州长选举。共和党州众议员托马斯·卡尼击败了联盟党州众议员威廉·R·瓦格斯塔夫。堪萨斯州共和党于1862年9月17日至18日在托皮卡举行州代表大会，并提名卡尼。卡尼是堪萨斯州资深联邦参议员、准将吉姆·莱恩的盟友。到1862年，莱恩已成为州共和党的领袖。

en.s: The 1862 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1862. Incumbent Governor Edwin D. Morgan did not run for a third consecutive term in office. Democratic former Governor Horatio Seymour was elected over Union candidate James S. Wadsworth.

zh.s: 1862年纽约州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长埃德温·D·摩根没有竞选连续第三个任期。民主党前州长霍雷肖·西摩击败联邦党候选人詹姆斯·S·沃兹沃思，当选州长。

en.s: The 1862 New York state election was held on November 4, 1862, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a Canal Commissioner, an Inspector of State Prisons and the Clerk of the Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly.

zh.s: 1862年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、运河专员、州监狱监察员、上诉法院书记员，以及纽约州众议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1862 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Governor John Albion Andrew was re-elected to a third term in office over People's General Charles Devens.

zh.s: 1862年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。州长约翰·阿尔比恩·安德鲁再次当选第三个任期，击败人民党将军查尔斯·德文斯。

en.t: 1863 Confederate States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 1863 Confederate States House of Representatives election in Florida was held on Wednesday, November 4, 1863, to elect the two Confederate States Representatives from the state of Florida, one from each of the state's congressional districts, to represent Florida in the 2nd Confederate States Congress. The election coincided with the elections of other offices, including various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1863年佛罗里达州邦联众议院选举
zh.s: 1863年佛罗里达州邦联众议院选举于11月4日（星期三）举行，选出该州两名邦联众议员，分别代表两个联邦选区，在第二届美利坚邦联国会中代表佛罗里达州。此次选举与其他职位选举同期举行，包括多个州级和地方职位选举。

en.s: The Battle of Johnsonville was fought November 4–5, 1864, in Benton County, Tennessee and Humphreys County, Tennessee, during the American Civil War. Confederate cavalry commander Major General Nathan Bedford Forrest culminated a 23-day raid through western Tennessee by attacking the Union supply base at Johnsonville. Forrest's attack destroyed numerous boats in the Tennessee River and millions of dollars of supplies, disrupting the logistical operations of Union Major General George H. Thomas in Nashville. As a result, Thomas's army was hampered in its (eventually successful) plan to defeat Confederate Lieutenant General John Bell Hood's invasion of Tennessee, the Franklin-Nashville Campaign.

zh.s: 约翰逊维尔战役于1864年11月4日至5日在田纳西州本顿县和汉弗莱斯县爆发，属于美国内战的一部分。南方邦联骑兵指挥官、少将内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特在田纳西州西部进行了为期23天的袭击后，进攻了约翰逊维尔的联邦军补给基地。福雷斯特的攻击摧毁了田纳西河上的多艘船只和价值数百万美元的物资，扰乱了乔治·H·托马斯少将驻纳什维尔部队的后勤行动。因此，托马斯的军队在击败约翰·贝尔·胡德中将入侵田纳西州的计划中受到影响；该计划最终成功，这场战役属于富兰克林—纳什维尔战役的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Las Clavellinas Uprising was a military engagement of the Ten Years' War. It took place on November 4, 1868, at the Las Clavellinas estate, near Puerto Príncipe (now Camagüey) in Cuba. It was the initial armed uprising in the Camagüey Province against the Spanish colonial government.

zh.t: 拉斯克拉韦利纳斯起义
zh.s: 拉斯克拉韦利纳斯起义是十年战争期间的一场军事行动，发生于1868年11月4日，地点在古巴拉斯克拉韦利纳斯庄园，靠近普林西比港（今卡马圭）。这是卡马圭省反抗西班牙殖民政府的首次武装起义。

en.s: The 1872 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1872. This was the second election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1868, which established universal manhood suffrage in Louisiana as required by the Reconstruction Acts. The campaign was marred by terrorist and paramilitary action in support of the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1872年路易斯安那州州长选举于11月4日举行。这是该州在1868年宪法下举行的第二次选举。该宪法根据重建法案的要求，在路易斯安那州确立了成年男子普选权。竞选期间，支持民主党的恐怖主义活动和准军事行动频繁发生。

en.s: The 1873 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1873, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Samuel P. Jennison defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate John H. Stevens.

zh.s: 1873年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿塞缪尔·P·詹尼森击败了民主党候选人、前明尼苏达州参议员约翰·H·史蒂文斯。

en.s: The 1873 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1873, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from the 8th District George P. Wilson defeated Democratic nominee William Clough.

zh.t: 1873年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1873年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任明尼苏达州众议院第8选区议员乔治·P·威尔逊击败民主党候选人威廉·克劳。

en.s: The 1873 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1873, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from the 31st district Alphonso Barto defeated Democratic nominee Ebenezer Ayres.

zh.s: 1873年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任明尼苏达州众议院第31选区议员阿方索·巴托击败民主党候选人埃比尼泽·艾尔斯。

en.s: The 1873 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1873. Democratic Party candidate William Robert Taylor was elected with 55% of the vote, defeating incumbent Republican governor Cadwallader C. Washburn. Taylor was the first Democrat elected Governor of Wisconsin since William A. Barstow in 1853. He was nominated as the consensus candidate of the "Reform Party,"—a coalition of Democrats, Liberal Republicans, and Grangers, on a platform of political and economy reform.

zh.s: 1873年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人威廉·罗伯特·泰勒以55%的得票率当选，击败现任共和党州长卡德沃拉德·C·沃什伯恩。泰勒是自1853年威廉·A·巴斯托以来，首位当选威斯康星州州长的民主党人。他作为“改革党”的共识候选人获提名；该党由民主党人、自由共和党人和农民组织成员组成，主张政治和经济改革。

en.s: The 1873 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1873. Republican Governor William B. Washburn was re-elected to a third term in office over Democrat William Gaston.

zh.s: 1873年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党州长威廉·B·沃什伯恩击败民主党人威廉·加斯顿，赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 1873 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1873, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Republican Horace Austin did not seek a third term.

zh.t: 1873年美国明尼苏达州州长选举
zh.s: 1873年美国明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行，选举州长。共和党籍时任州长霍勒斯·奥斯汀没有竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 1873 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1873, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. This election marked the last time a Republican was elected Governor of Mississippi until 1991, 118 years later.

zh.t: 1873年美国密西西比州州长选举
zh.s: 1873年美国密西西比州州长选举于11月4日举行，选举州长。这是共和党人直到1991年才再次赢得密西西比州州长职位之前，最后一次当选该州州长；两次共和党籍州长当选相隔118年。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1873 saw People's Party (campaigning under the label "Democratic People's Union") candidate Harvey Doolittle Colvin defeated Citizen's Union (campaigning under the label "Law and Order") candidate Lester Legrant Bond by a landslide nearly 34-point margin. Bond was the incumbent acting mayor, having taken office due to the extended absence of Joseph Medill. The election took place on November 7.

zh.s: 1873年芝加哥市长选举中，人民党候选人哈维·杜利特尔·科尔文（以“民主人民联盟”名义竞选）以近34个百分点的优势击败公民联盟候选人莱斯特·勒格朗·邦德（以“法律与秩序”名义竞选）。邦德此前因约瑟夫·梅迪尔长期缺席而接任代理市长。选举于11月7日举行。

en.s: The 1879 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1879, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee Charles M. Start defeated Democratic nominee P.M. Babcock, Greenback Labor nominee Oscar Stephenson and Prohibition nominee Alfred W. Bangs.

zh.t: 1879年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1879年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·M·斯塔特击败民主党候选人P·M·巴布科克、绿背工党候选人奥斯卡·史蒂芬森和禁酒党候选人阿尔弗雷德·W·班格斯。

en.s: The 1879 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1879, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from the 31st district Charles A. Gilman defeated Democratic nominee Edward P. Barnum, Greenback Labor nominee Isaac M. Westfall and Prohibition nominee S.B. Williams.

zh.s: 1879年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任明尼苏达州众议院第31选区议员查尔斯·A·吉尔曼击败了民主党候选人爱德华·P·巴纳姆、绿背工党候选人艾萨克·M·韦斯特福尔和禁酒党候选人S·B·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1879 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1879. Incumbent Republican Governor William E. Smith ran for re-election to a second term. The Democratic convention initially nominated Alexander Mitchell for Governor, but Mitchell declined the nomination; in his place, Milwaukee attorney James Graham Jenkins received the nomination. Smith and Jenkins also faced a Greenback candidate and a nominee from the nascent Prohibition Party in the general election.

zh.s: 1879年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长威廉·E·史密斯竞选连任第二个任期。民主党大会最初提名亚历山大·米切尔为州长候选人，但米切尔拒绝接受提名，随后由密尔沃基律师詹姆斯·格雷厄姆·詹金斯接替。大选中，史密斯和詹金斯还将面对一名绿背党候选人和一名新兴禁酒党的候选人。

en.s: The 1879 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1879, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Frederick Von Baumbach defeated Democratic nominee Felix A. Borer, Greenback nominee Alexander P. Lane and Prohibition nominee Isaac C. Stearns.

zh.s: 1879年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德里克·冯·鲍姆巴赫击败了民主党候选人菲利克斯·A·博雷尔、绿背党候选人亚历山大·P·莱恩和禁酒党候选人艾萨克·C·斯特恩斯。

en.s: The 1879 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1879, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent John S. Pillsbury was reelected to a third term. Ara Barton was the initial Greenback nominee, but he declined the nomination and was replaced by William Meighen.

zh.s: 1879年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长约翰·S·皮尔斯伯里再次当选，赢得第三个任期。阿拉·巴顿最初获绿钞党提名，但拒绝接受提名，随后由威廉·米根接替。

en.s: The 1879 New York state election was held on November 4, 1879, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the secretary state, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer and the state engineer, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1879年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长和州工程师，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1879 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Incumbent governor Thomas Talbot did not seek re-election to a second term in office; he was succeeded by lieutenant governor John Davis Long, who defeated Henry L. Pierce for the Republican nomination and Benjamin Butler in the general election.

zh.s: 1879年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长托马斯·塔尔博特没有竞选连任第二个任期。副州长约翰·戴维斯·朗接替他当选州长。朗在共和党初选中击败亨利·L·皮尔斯，随后在大选中击败本杰明·巴特勒。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1884 was the 25th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 4, 1884. It saw the first election of a Democrat as President of the United States since the election of 1856. The campaign was marred by exceptional political acrimony and personal invective. New York Governor Grover Cleveland narrowly defeated Republican former United States Senator James G. Blaine of Maine to break the longest losing streak for any major party in American political history: six consecutive presidential elections. New York decided the election, awarding Governor Cleveland the state's 36 electors by a margin of just 1,047 votes out of 1,171,312 cast.

zh.s: 1884年美国总统选举是美国第25次四年一度的总统选举，于1884年11月4日（星期二）举行。民主党候选人首次自1856年以来当选美国总统。竞选期间充斥激烈的政治攻讦和人身攻击。纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰以微弱优势击败共和党候选人、前联邦参议员詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，打破了美国主要政党连续六次总统选举失利的纪录。纽约州决定了选举结果：克利夫兰以仅1,047票的优势拿下该州36名选举人，总票数为1,171,312票。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1884
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 4, 1884. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1884 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 36 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Democratic nominees, Governor Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate former Senator and Governor Thomas A. Hendricks of Indiana. Cleveland and Hendricks defeated the Republican nominees, former Secretary of State and Senator James G. Blaine of Maine and his running mate Senator John A. Logan of Illinois.

zh.s: 1884年纽约州总统选举于1884年11月4日举行。美国当时的38个州都参加了1884年总统选举。纽约州选民选出36名选举人，进入选举人团投票。民主党候选人、纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼州长托马斯·A·亨德里克斯赢得该州。他们击败共和党候选人、前国务卿兼联邦参议员詹姆斯·G·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、联邦参议员约翰·A·洛根。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1884
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose 30 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won Pennsylvania by a margin of 9.51%.

zh.s: 1884年宾夕法尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出30名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，击败民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰。布莱恩在该州领先9.51个百分点。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1884
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1884 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1884. Republicans won both newly created districts and three of the four existing districts.

zh.t: 1884年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1884年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。共和党赢得两个新设选区和四个原有选区中的三个。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1884
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, New York Governor Grover Cleveland over the Republican candidate, former Secretary of State James G. Blaine.

zh.s: 1884年弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出12名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人、前国务卿詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1884
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1884. Wisconsin voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate James G. Blaine won the state with 50% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's eleven electoral votes.

zh.s: 1884年威斯康星州总统选举于11月4日举行。该州选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩以50%的普选票赢得该州及其11张选举人票。

en.s: The 1884 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. Governor Hugh Smith Thompson was renominated by the Democrats and was reelected for a second two-year term.

zh.s: 1884年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。州长休·史密斯·汤普森再次获得民主党提名，并成功连任第二个两年任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1884
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida were held November 4, 1884 for the 49th Congress. These elections were held at the same time as the 1884 Presidential election and election for Governor.

zh.t: 1884年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1884年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出第49届国会议员。此次选举与1884年总统选举和州长选举同期举行。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine. by a margin of 5.98%.

zh.s: 1884年马里兰州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了8名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。马里兰州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，领先幅度为5.98%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 4, 1884. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Arkansas voters chose seven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Arkansas voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine by a margin of 17.12%.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。当时全美38个州都参加了总统选举。阿肯色州选民选出了7名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，领先幅度为17.12%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 4, 1884. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Oregon was won by Secretary of State James G. Blaine (R-Maine), running with Senator John A.

zh.s: 1884年美国俄勒冈州总统选举于11月4日举行。当时美国38个州均参加了总统选举。选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。俄勒冈州支持缅因州国务卿詹姆斯·G·布莱恩（共和党），其竞选搭档是联邦参议员约翰·A·……。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by Grover Cleveland, the 28th governor of New York, (D–New York), running with the former governor of Indiana Thomas A.

zh.t: 1884年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1884年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持纽约州第28任州长格罗弗·克利夫兰（民主党），其竞选搭档是印第安纳州前州长托马斯·A·……。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the governor of New York Grover Cleveland and the former governor of Indiana Thomas A. Hendricks defeated the Republican ticket of the former U.S. secretary of state James G. Blaine and the senior U.S. senator from Illinois John A. Logan.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。由纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰和印第安纳州前州长托马斯·A·亨德里克斯组成的民主党组合击败了共和党组合；共和党组合成员是美国前国务卿詹姆斯·G·布莱恩和伊利诺伊州资深联邦参议员约翰·A·洛根。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 1884. All contemporary thirty-eight states were part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirteen electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举。当时全美38个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出了13名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 4, 1884. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1884 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Louisiana voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine by a margin of 14.85%.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举。当时全美38个州都参加了总统选举。该州选民选出了8名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。路易斯安那州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，领先幅度为14.85%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won his home state by a margin of 15.37%.

zh.s: 缅因州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。缅因州投票支持共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，击败民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰。布莱恩以15.37%的优势赢得家乡缅因州。

en.s: The 1884 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1884, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former speaker of the Missouri House of Representatives Banton G. Boone defeated Republican nominee Dan Murphy. The exact results of the election are unknown.

zh.s: 1884年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、密苏里州众议院前议长班顿·G·布恩击败共和党候选人丹·墨菲。选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1884 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Henry Baldwin Harrison defeated Democratic incumbent Thomas M. Waller with 48.12% of the vote. According to the law at the time, if no candidate received a majority, the state legislature would choose between the top two candidates. As the legislature was controlled by Republicans, they voted for fellow Republican Harrison, even though Waller received more votes.

zh.s: 1884年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人亨利·鲍德温·哈里森击败现任民主党州长托马斯·M·沃勒，得票率为48.12%。按照当时的法律，如果没有候选人获得过半数选票，州议会将在得票最高的两名候选人中作出选择。由于州议会由共和党控制，议员投票支持共和党人哈里森，尽管沃勒获得的票数更多。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado voted for the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won the state by a margin of 12.57 points.

zh.s: 科罗拉多州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了3名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。科罗拉多州投票支持共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，击败民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰。布莱恩以12.57个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1884 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Richard J. Oglesby defeated Democratic nominee Carter Harrison Sr. with 49.63% of the vote. Oglesby's victory was the eighth consecutive victory for the Republican Party. Republican John C. Smith was elected Lieutenant Governor of Illinois. At this time in Illinois history, the Lieutenant Governor was elected on a separate ballot from the governor.

zh.s: 1884年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人理查德·J·奥格尔斯比击败民主党候选人卡特·哈里森，得票率为49.63%。这是共和党连续第八次获胜。共和党人约翰·C·史密斯当选为伊利诺伊州副州长。当时，该州州长和副州长通过不同的选票分别选出。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine. Cleveland won the state by a wide margin of 51.84%.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。克利夫兰以51.84%的巨大优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Rhode Island occurred on November 4, 1884. This election was part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters in Rhode Island selected four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, which elects the president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland.

zh.s: 1884年罗得岛州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了4名选举人，组成负责选出总统和副总统的选举人团。罗得岛州投票支持共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，击败民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰。

en.s: The 1884 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1884, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Michael Knowles McGrath won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1884年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、现任州务卿迈克尔·诺尔斯·麦格拉思没有对手，赢得连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1884 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Benjamin Harrison Eaton defeated Democratic nominee Alva Adams with 50.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森·伊顿击败民主党候选人阿尔瓦·亚当斯，得票率为50.74%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Benjamin Butler received the nominations of both the Greenback and Anti-Monopoly parties in Michigan.

en.s: The 1884 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Albert P. Morehouse defeated Republican nominee H. M. Starkloff and People's nominee Henry Eshbaugh.

zh.s: 1884年密苏里州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人阿尔伯特·P·莫尔豪斯击败共和党候选人H·M·斯塔克洛夫和人民党候选人亨利·埃什博。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Florida was won by Grover Cleveland, the 28th governor of New York, (D–New York), running with the former governor of Indiana Thomas A.

zh.t: 1884年美国佛罗里达州总统选举
zh.s: 1884年美国佛罗里达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持纽约州第28任州长格罗弗·克利夫兰（民主党），其竞选搭档是印第安纳州前州长托马斯·A·……。

en.s: The 1884 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee John Martin defeated Democratic incumbent George Washington Glick with 55.34% of the vote.

en.s: In the 1884 Florida gubernatorial election held on November 4, 1884, Democratic nominee Edward A. Perry defeated Republican nominee Frank W. Pope, securing 53.53% of the vote. Republicans did not carry Jefferson in a gubernatorial election again until 2018. As of 2022, this is the last time that a Republican gubernatorial nominee has carried Alachua and Leon.

zh.s: 1884年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人爱德华·A·佩里击败共和党候选人弗兰克·W·波普，得票率为53.53%。共和党直到2018年才再次在杰斐逊县赢得州长选举。截至2022年，这是共和党州长候选人最后一次在阿拉楚阿县和莱昂县胜出。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won the state by a margin of 16.78%.

zh.t: 1884年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1884年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·赛伯特没有对手，赢得选举。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The 1884 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884, in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Illinois. Republican nominee John Corson Smith defeated Democratic nominee Henry Seiter as well as two other third-party candidates.

zh.s: 1884年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·科森·史密斯击败民主党候选人亨利·塞特以及另外两名第三党候选人。

en.s: The 1884 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884, and featured Republican nominee Hibbard H. Shedd defeating fusion Democratic and Greenback (Anti-Monopoly) nominee Lewis C. Pace. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Alfred W. Agee was renominated at the Nebraska Republican state convention, but he was defeated for the nomination by Shedd by a vote of 292 to 153 of the delegates.

zh.t: 1884年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1884年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人希伯德·H·谢德击败了由民主党和绿背党（反垄断党）联合提名的刘易斯·C·佩斯。现任副州长阿尔弗雷德·W·阿吉在内布拉斯加州共和党代表大会上再次参选，但以292票对153票败给谢德，未能获得提名。

Hendricks of Indiana, with 53.49% of the vote, against former Secretary of State and Senator James G.

en.s: The 1884 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884, and featured incumbent Governor James W. Dawes, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee J. Sterling Morton for a second time after the 1882 election.

zh.s: 1884年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长詹姆斯·W·道斯击败民主党候选人J·斯特林·莫顿；这已是他继1882年之后第二次击败莫顿。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after Civil War, Tennessee's white citizenry was divided according to partisan loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了12名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州白人选民的党派立场一直受到内战时期政治分野的影响。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 4 November 1884, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 8 of the corporation's 25 seats were up for election. This election was the first time labour-affiliated candidates won seats in Aberdeen's municipal elections. The candidates, James Forbes and George Maconnachie, were supported by the Aberdeen United Trades Council.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市政机构选举于1884年11月4日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同期举行。市政机构25个席位中有8席改选。这是阿伯丁市政选举中首次有劳工运动背景的候选人赢得席位。詹姆斯·福布斯和乔治·麦康纳奇是候选人，得到阿伯丁联合行业委员会支持。

en.s: The 1884 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Moody Currier defeated Democratic nominee John M. Hill with 50.33% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人穆迪·柯里尔击败民主党候选人约翰·M·希尔，得票率为50.33%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was narrowly won by the Republican Party candidate, James G. Blaine, with 50.99% of the popular vote. The Democratic Party candidate, Grover Cleveland, garnered 46.94% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了23名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩以微弱优势赢得俄亥俄州，获得50.99%的普选票。民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰获得46.94%的普选票。

en.t: 1884 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1884 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 4, 1884, with four states holding theirs early between June and October. They coincided with the election of President Grover Cleveland. Elections were held for 325 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 38 states, to serve in the 49th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1884年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月4日举行，有4个州在6月至10月期间提前选举。这些选举与格罗弗·克利夫兰当选总统同期举行。共有38个州的325个联邦众议院席位进行选举，胜出者将在第49届美国国会任职。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the nationwide presidential election. Alabama voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Alabama was won by Grover Cleveland, the 28th governor of New York, (D–New York), running with the former governor of Indiana Thomas A.

zh.s: 1884年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持纽约州第28任州长格罗弗·克利夫兰（民主党），其竞选搭档是印第安纳州前州长托马斯·A·……。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. State voters chose 13 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the president and vice president. Texas voted for the Democratic nominee Grover Cleveland, who received 69.3% of the vote.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了13名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰赢得得克萨斯州，得票率为69.3%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Mississippi voted for the Democratic candidate, New York Governor Grover Cleveland over the Republican candidate, former Secretary of State James G. Blaine.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。密西西比州投票支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人、前国务卿詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1884 Michigan gubernatorial election was a state election held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Russell A. Alger defeated incumbent Josiah W. Begole, who ran on a fusion ticket, representing both the Democratic and Greenback parties, with 47.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人拉塞尔·A·阿尔杰击败了以民主党和绿背党联合候选人身份参选的现任州长约西亚·W·贝戈尔，得票率为47.67%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Delaware voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 13.41%.

zh.s: 特拉华州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了3名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。特拉华州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。克利夫兰以13.41%的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1884 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Republican nominee Jeremiah McLain Rusk defeated Democratic nominee Nicholas D. Fratt and two other nominees with 51.00% of the vote. This was the first Wisconsin gubernatorial election held in an even-numbered year. In 1882, a constitutional amendment was carried moving gubernatorial elections from odd-numbered to even-numbered years.

zh.s: 1884年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人杰里迈亚·麦克莱恩·拉斯克以51.00%的得票率击败民主党候选人尼古拉斯·D·弗拉特和另外两名候选人。这是威斯康星州首次在偶数年份举行州长选举。1882年通过的一项宪法修正案规定，州长选举从奇数年改为偶数年。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Minnesota

Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won the state by a margin of 21.91%.

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Illinois

Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won the state by a narrow margin of 3.74%.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。新泽西州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。克利夫兰以仅1.67个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1884 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Democratic nominee Alfred Moore Scales defeated Republican nominee Tyre York with 53.80% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人阿尔弗雷德·摩尔·斯凯尔斯击败共和党候选人泰尔·约克，得票率为53.80%。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine. Cleveland won the state by a very narrow margin of 0.94%.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州投票支持民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩。克利夫兰以仅0.94%的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, James G. Blaine, over the Democratic nominee, Grover Cleveland. Blaine won the state by a narrow margin of 4.80%.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州于1884年11月4日举行总统选举，是1884年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了4名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州投票支持共和党候选人詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，击败民主党候选人格罗弗·克利夫兰。布莱恩以4.80%的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the 1884 United States presidential election. Nevada voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by Secretary of State James G. Blaine (R-Maine), running with Senator John A.

zh.s: 1884年美国内华达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。内华达州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党候选人、缅因州国务卿詹姆斯·G·布莱恩，其竞选搭档是联邦参议员约翰·A·……。

en.s: The 1884 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Democratic former Governor Isaac P. Gray defeated Republican nominee William H. Calkins with 49.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年印第安纳州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党前州长艾萨克·P·格雷击败共和党候选人威廉·H·卡尔金斯，得票率为49.51%。

en.s: The 1884 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1884, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor John Walker won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1884年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、现任州审计长约翰·沃克没有对手，赢得连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.t: 1884 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1884 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 1884, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen and many poor whites, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1884年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州成为第一个大幅剥夺新近获得选举权的获释奴隶及许多贫困白人选举权的前邦联州；这一做法始于19世纪70年代初。

en.s: The 1884 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884. Incumbent Democratic governor William B. Bate defeated Republican nominee Frank T. Reid with 51.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1884年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长威廉·B·贝特以51.24%的得票率击败共和党候选人弗兰克·T·里德。

en.s: The 1884 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1884, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, former Confederate general John S. Marmaduke, over the Republican candidate, former Congressman David Patterson Dyer, and Populist nominee John A. Brooks. Marmaduke died in 1887 and was replaced for the remainder of this term by Lt. Gov. Albert P. Morehouse.

zh.s: 1884年密苏里州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、前邦联军将领约翰·S·马马杜克击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员戴维·帕特森·戴尔和民粹党候选人约翰·A·布鲁克斯，当选州长。马马杜克于1887年去世，副州长艾伯特·P·莫尔豪斯接替他完成剩余任期。

en.s: The 1884 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Incumbent Republican governor George D. Robinson was re-elected to a second term in office over Democrat William Crowninshield Endicott.

zh.s: 1884年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长乔治·D·罗宾逊击败民主党人威廉·克朗因希尔德·恩迪科特，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1884 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. The incumbent Democratic John Ireland was re-elected over former U.S. Representative George Washington "Wash" Jones, an independent with Greenback support, and Republican newspaper publisher Anthony Banning Norton.

zh.s: 1884年得克萨斯州州长选举旨在选出州长。民主党现任州长约翰·爱尔兰成功连任，击败联邦众议员前任乔治·华盛顿“沃什”·琼斯；琼斯以获得绿钞党支持的独立候选人身份参选。此外，他还击败共和党报纸出版人安东尼·班宁·诺顿。

en.t: Establishment of Hong Kong Jockey Club
en.s: The Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC) was founded in 1884 and is one of the oldest institutions in Hong Kong. In 1960, it was granted a royal charter and renamed the Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club. The institution reverted to its original name in 1996 in anticipation of the handover of Hong Kong in 1997. Membership of the club is by nomination and election.

zh.s: 香港赛马会（HKJC）于1884年成立，是香港历史最悠久的机构之一。1960年，赛马会获颁皇家特许状，并更名为皇家香港赛马会。为配合1997年香港回归，赛马会于1996年恢复原名。会员通过提名和选举产生。

en.s: The Battle of Kula (Bulgarian: бой при Кула) was a military engagement between the Principality of Bulgaria and the Kingdom of Serbia which took place on 4 November 1885. It was part of the Serbo–Bulgarian War, provoked by a Serbian invasion of Bulgaria. Bulgarian troops counterattacked the Serbs after they captured the town of Kula but suffered a defeat.

zh.s: 库拉战役（保加利亚语：бой при Кула）是保加利亚公国与塞尔维亚王国之间的一场战斗，于1885年11月4日爆发。该战役是由塞尔维亚入侵保加利亚引发的塞保战争的一部分。塞尔维亚军队攻占库拉镇后，保加利亚军队发起反击，但最终战败。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1890
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida for the 52nd Congress were held November 4, 1890.

zh.t: 1890年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1890年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出第52届国会议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1890
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1890 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1890. Republicans picked up one Democratic-held district.

zh.t: 1890年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1890年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。共和党从民主党手中赢得一个选区。
