en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1890 occurred on November 4, 1890. Democratic candidate and former Governor Robert E. Pattison defeated Republican candidate George W. Delamater to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1890年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、前州长罗伯特·E·帕蒂森击败共和党候选人乔治·W·德拉马特，再次当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1890 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890, to elect the second Governor of South Dakota. Republican Arthur C. Mellette was re-elected, defeating Independent H. L. Loucks and Democrat Maris Taylor.

zh.s: 1890年南达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州第二任州长。共和党人阿瑟·C·梅莱特成功连任，击败独立候选人H·L·卢克斯和民主党候选人马里斯·泰勒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1890 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. Ben Tillman was nominated by the Democrats and easily won the general election against A.C. Haskell to become the 84th governor of South Carolina.

zh.s: 1890年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党提名本·蒂尔曼，他在大选中轻松获胜，成为南卡罗来纳州第84任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1890 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Democratic nominee Luzon B. Morris defeated Republican nominee Samuel E. Merwin with 50.01% of the vote. The law at the time specified that if no candidate received a majority, the state legislature would decide the election. Morris received 50.01% of the vote, a mere 26 votes more than the majority needed to win.

zh.s: 1890年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人卢松·B·莫里斯击败共和党候选人塞缪尔·E·默温，得票率为50.01%。当时法律规定，如果没有候选人获得过半数选票，由州议会决定选举结果。莫里斯获得了50.01%的选票，仅比过半数所需票数多26票。

en.s: The 1890 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Republican nominee Andrew H. Burke defeated Democratic nominee William N. Roach with 52.23% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人安德鲁·H·伯克击败民主党候选人威廉·N·罗奇，得票率为52.23%。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota Senate from the 27th district Gideon S. Ives defeated Democratic nominee Eggert G. Pahl and Prohibition nominee J.O. Barrett.

zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任明尼苏达州参议院第27选区议员吉迪恩·S·艾夫斯击败了民主党候选人埃格特·G·帕尔和禁酒党候选人J·O·巴雷特。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1890, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Moses E. Clapp defeated Democratic nominee David Calhoun and Prohibition nominee Robert Taylor.

zh.t: 1890年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任总检察长摩西·E·克拉普击败民主党候选人大卫·卡尔霍恩和禁酒党候选人罗伯特·泰勒。

en.s: The 1890 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Republican Lyman U. Humphrey defeated People's Party nominee John F. Willits with 39.05% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长莱曼·U·汉弗莱击败人民党候选人约翰·F·威利茨，得票率为39.05%。

en.s: The 1890 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Republican governor John Q. A. Brackett ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Democratic mayor of Cambridge William Russell.

zh.s: 1890年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长约翰·Q·A·布拉克特竞选连任第二个任期，但败给了民主党人、剑桥市市长威廉·罗素。

en.s: The 1890 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Republican nominee Hiram A. Tuttle defeated Democratic nominee Charles H. Amsden with 49.26% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人海勒姆·A·塔特尔击败民主党候选人查尔斯·H·阿姆斯登，得票率为49.26%。

en.s: The 1890 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Democratic nominee Edwin B. Winans defeated Republican candidate James M. Turner with 46.18% of the vote. As of 2026, this is the most recent election in which Ottawa County has voted Democratic.

zh.s: 1890年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人埃德温·B·威南斯击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·M·特纳，得票率为46.18%。截至2026年，这是渥太华县最近一次投票支持民主党候选人当选州长。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 4, 1890, to elect members to the Senate of the 27th and 28th Minnesota Legislatures. The Minnesota Republican Party won a plurality of seats, followed by the Minnesota Democratic Party and the Minnesota Farmers' Alliance. The new Legislature convened on January 6, 1891.

zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出明尼苏达州第27届和第28届州议会的参议员。明尼苏达州共和党赢得最多席位，其后是明尼苏达州民主党和明尼苏达州农民联盟。新一届州议会于1891年1月6日开会。

en.s: The 1890 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Republican nominee Roswell K. Colcord defeated Democratic nominee Theodore Winters with 53.27% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年内华达州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人罗斯韦尔·K·科尔科德击败民主党候选人西奥多·温特斯，得票率为53.27%。

en.s: The 1890 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890, and featured Republican nominee Thomas Jefferson Majors defeating Populist nominee William H. Dech and Democratic nominee Alex Bear as well as Prohibition Party nominee George W. Woodbey. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor George D. Meiklejohn did not seek reelection as lieutenant governor in order to seek the Republican nomination for the US House of Representatives in Nebraska's 3rd congressional district, but he was unsuccessful.

zh.t: 1890年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1890年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人托马斯·杰斐逊·梅杰斯击败民粹党候选人威廉·H·德奇、民主党候选人亚历克斯·贝尔和禁酒党候选人乔治·W·伍德比。现任副州长乔治·D·迈克尔约翰没有竞选连任，而是争取共和党提名，竞选内布拉斯加州联邦众议院第3选区席位，但未能成功。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1890, in 27 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 4, 1890 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Idaho, Maine, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont and Wyoming, which held early elections). In New Hampshire, the newly elected Governor's term began in the January following the election for the first time, rather than in the following June as previously.

zh.s: 1890年美国有27个州举行州长选举，大多于11月4日与联邦众议院和参议院选举同期举行。阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佐治亚州、爱达荷州、缅因州、俄勒冈州、罗得岛州、佛蒙特州和怀俄明州提前举行选举。新罕布什尔州新当选州长的任期首次从选举次年1月开始；此前则从次年6月开始。

en.s: The 1890 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Democratic Governor Benjamin T. Biggs was unable to seek a second consecutive term in office. Former State Treasurer Robert J. Reynolds won the Democratic nomination to succeed Biggs, and in the general election, he faced banker Harry A. Richardson, the Republican nominee. In stark contrast to the 1886 election, the Republican Party fully contested the state's elections and a close contest ensued.

zh.s: 1890年特拉华州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党州长本杰明·T·比格斯无法竞选连任第二个连续任期。曾任州财政部长的罗伯特·J·雷诺兹赢得民主党提名，接替比格斯；他在大选中的对手是共和党候选人、银行家哈里·A·理查森。与1886年选举形成鲜明对比的是，共和党全面参与了该州各项选举，双方竞争激烈。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1890, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Democratic nominee and former nominee for governor of Minnesota Adolph Biermann defeated Republican nominee Peter J. McGuire and Prohibition nominee Ole Kron.

zh.t: 1890年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、明尼苏达州州长前候选人阿道夫·比尔曼击败共和党候选人彼得·J·麦奎尔和禁酒党候选人奥勒·克隆。

en.s: The 1890 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Republican Governor John Milton Thayer did not seek reelection. In a four-way race, James E. Boyd, the Democratic nominee, defeated the Populist nominee John H. Powers, the Republican nominee Lucius D. Richards, and the Prohibition nominee Bartlett L. Paine. Boyd thus became the first Democratic candidate to be elected governor of Nebraska.

zh.s: 1890年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长约翰·米尔顿·塞耶没有竞选连任。在四人竞争中，民主党候选人詹姆斯·E·博伊德击败民粹党候选人约翰·H·鲍尔斯、共和党候选人卢修斯·D·理查兹和禁酒党候选人巴特利特·L·佩恩。博伊德因此成为首位当选内布拉斯加州州长的民主党人。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1890, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Frederick P. Brown defeated Democratic nominee Axel T. Lindholm, Farmers' Alliance nominee Michael F. Wesenberg and Prohibition nominee Hans S. Hilleboe.

zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德里克·P·布朗击败民主党候选人阿克塞尔·T·林德霍尔姆、农民联盟候选人迈克尔·F·韦森伯格和禁酒党候选人汉斯·S·希勒博。

en.s: The 1890 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Republican Governor William D. Hoard was defeated by Democratic nominee George Wilbur Peck. Peck became the first Democratic Governor of Wisconsin since William Robert Taylor in 1876.

zh.s: 1890年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长威廉·D·霍德败给民主党候选人乔治·威尔伯·佩克。佩克成为自1876年威廉·罗伯特·泰勒以来首位民主党籍威斯康星州州长。

en.s: The 1890 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Republican nominee John Long Routt defeated Democratic nominee Caldwell Yeaman with 50.11% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·朗·劳特击败民主党候选人考德威尔·耶曼，得票率为50.11%。

en.s: The 1890 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Republican State Assemblyman John B. Reddick defeated Democratic State Senator Reginaldo Francisco del Valle with 50.05% of the vote.

zh.t: 1890年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1890年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党州众议员约翰·B·雷迪克击败民主党州参议员雷吉纳尔多·弗朗西斯科·德尔瓦列，得票率为50.05%。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent mayor Hugh J. Grant was re-elected to a second term in office over Aqueduct Commissioner Francis M. Scott, running on the New York County Democracy and People's Municipal League lines with Republican support.

zh.s: 纽约市于1890年11月4日举行市长选举。现任市长休·J·格兰特击败弗朗西斯·M·斯科特，再次当选第二个任期。斯科特以纽约县民主党和人民市政联盟候选人身份参选，并得到共和党支持。

en.s: The 1890 California gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890, to elect the governor of California. Incumbent governor Robert Waterman, who had succeeded Washington Bartlett after the latter's death only eight months into his term in 1887, declined to seek a full term due to his own health issues. Republican former Congressman Henry Markham defeated Democratic Mayor of San Francisco Edward B.

zh.t: 1890年美国加利福尼亚州州长选举
zh.s: 1890年美国加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行，选举州长。前州长罗伯特·沃特曼在华盛顿·巴特利特于1887年任职仅8个月后去世、由他接任后，因健康问题决定不竞选完整任期。共和党籍前联邦众议员亨利·马卡姆击败民主党候选人、旧金山市长爱德华·B·庞德，当选州长。

en.s: The 1890 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1890. Incumbent Democratic Governor Robert Love Taylor did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee John P. Buchanan defeated Republican nominee Lewis T. Baxter and Prohibition nominee D. C. Kelley with 56.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1890年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长罗伯特·洛夫·泰勒决定不竞选连任。民主党候选人约翰·P·布坎南以56.57%的得票率击败共和党候选人刘易斯·T·巴克斯特和禁酒党候选人D·C·凯利。

en.s: The 1890 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1890. Republican Party of Minnesota incumbent William Rush Merriam defeated Democratic Party of Minnesota challenger Thomas Wilson and Farmers' Alliance candidate Sidney M. Owen.

zh.s: 1890年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。明尼苏达州共和党现任州长威廉·拉什·梅里亚姆击败明尼苏达州民主党挑战者托马斯·威尔逊和农民联盟候选人西德尼·M·欧文。

en.s: The 1890 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Attorney General Jim Hogg was elected over Republican Webster Flanagan. Hogg was the first governor of Texas to be born in the state.

zh.s: 1890年得克萨斯州州长选举旨在选出州长。总检察长吉姆·霍格击败共和党人韦伯斯特·弗拉纳根，当选州长。他是首位出生于得克萨斯州的州长。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary between 29 October and 4 November 1896 . The result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 290 of the 413 seats.

zh.s: 匈牙利议会选举于1896年10月29日至11月4日举行。自由党获胜，赢得413个席位中的290席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1898 North-West Territories general election took place on 4 November 1898. This was the fourth general election in the history of the North-West Territories, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the North-West Territories. In 1897 Responsible Government had been secured, and this was the first election where voters elected an assembly that would control the executive members that would conduct the business of the NWT government.

zh.s: 加拿大西北地区于1898年11月4日举行大选。这是西北地区历史上的第四次大选，选出该地区立法议会成员。1897年，西北地区取得责任政府地位；这是选民首次选举能够掌管西北地区政府行政事务的议会。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1902 occurred on November 4, 1902. Republican candidate Samuel W. Pennypacker defeated Democratic candidate and former Governor Robert E. Pattison to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1902年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人塞缪尔·W·佩尼帕克击败民主党候选人、前州长罗伯特·E·帕蒂森，当选宾夕法尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1902. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Samuel Rinnah Van Sant defeated Democratic Party of Minnesota challenger Leonard A. Rosing.

zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人塞缪尔·里纳·范桑特击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人伦纳德·A·罗辛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1902 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. Republican incumbent Governor of South Dakota Charles N. Herreid was re-elected, defeating Democratic nominee John W. Martin, Socialist Party candidate John C. Crawford, and Prohibition Party candidate H. H. Curtis.

zh.s: 1902年南达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出一名任期两年的州长。共和党籍现任州长查尔斯·N·赫雷德成功连任，击败民主党候选人约翰·W·马丁、社会党候选人约翰·C·克劳福德和禁酒党候选人H·H·柯蒂斯。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1902
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1902 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1902. California gained one seat as a result of the 1900 Census, which Republicans won. However, of the existing districts, Democrats won three Republican-held districts.

zh.t: 1902年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1902年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。根据1900年人口普查，加利福尼亚州新增一个席位，该席位由共和党赢得。不过，在原有选区中，民主党从共和党手中赢得三个选区。

en.s: The 1902 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Democratic governor Benton McMillin did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee James B. Frazier defeated Republican nominee Henry Tyler Campbell with 61.77% of the vote. The 1902 gubernatorial campaign is remembered as the last in which the candidates canvassed the state via horse-drawn carriages. The general election was marked by low turnout, which benefitted Democrats.

zh.s: 1902年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党州长本顿·麦克米林没有竞选连任。民主党候选人詹姆斯·B·弗雷泽以61.77%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨利·泰勒·坎贝尔。人们记得1902年的州长竞选是最后一次由候选人乘坐马车巡回全州拉票。大选投票率较低，使民主党受益。

en.s: The 1902 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican State Assemblyman Alden Anderson defeated Democratic Los Angeles Public Library President Isidore B. Dockweiler with 50.83% of the vote.

zh.t: 1902年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1902年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党州众议员奥尔登·安德森击败民主党候选人、洛杉矶公共图书馆馆长伊西多尔·B·多克韦勒，得票率为50.83%。

en.s: The 1902 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902, and featured Republican nominee Edmund G. McGilton defeating Edward A. Gilbert, the Populist and Democratic fusion nominee, as well as Prohibition nominee Isaiah Lightner and Socialist nominee Andrew D. Peugh. On May 1, 1901, after serving only four months as Governor of Nebraska, Charles H.

zh.t: 1902年美国内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1902年美国内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人埃德蒙·G·麦吉尔顿击败民粹党与民主党联合提名的爱德华·A·吉尔伯特、禁酒党候选人以赛亚·莱特纳和社会党候选人安德鲁·D·皮尤。

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1902, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Wallace B. Douglas defeated Democratic nominee Frank D. Larrabee.

zh.t: 1902年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任总检察长华莱士·B·道格拉斯击败民主党候选人弗兰克·D·拉腊比。

en.s: The 1902 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Republican Frank White defeated Democratic nominee J. Cronan with 62.68% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长弗兰克·怀特击败民主党候选人J·克罗南，得票率为62.68%。

en.s: The 1902 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. The Silver Party nominee "Honest" John Sparks defeated Republican nominee Abner Coburn Cleveland, with 6,540 votes to his opponents 4,778. He succeeded fellow Silver Party Governor Reinhold Sadler in office.

zh.s: 1902年内华达州州长选举于11月4日举行。银党候选人、“诚实的”约翰·斯帕克斯以6,540票击败共和党候选人阿布纳·科伯恩·克利夫兰，后者获得4,778票。斯帕克斯接替了同为银党成员的州长莱因霍尔德·萨德勒。

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1902. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Ray W. Jones of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Robert A. Smith.

zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月4日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人雷·W·琼斯击败了明尼苏达州民主党挑战者罗伯特·A·史密斯。

en.s: The 1902 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee James Hamilton Peabody defeated Democratic nominee E. C. Stimson with 46.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人詹姆斯·汉密尔顿·皮博迪击败民主党候选人E·C·斯廷森，得票率为46.92%。

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 4, 1902, to elect members to the Senate of the 33rd and 34th Minnesota Legislatures. Two years after Democrat John Lind lost the governorship to Republican Samuel Rinnah Van Sant, the Minnesota Democratic Party was set to lose seats in the Senate. Without Lind, the Party lost the third party support that they had consolidated in 1898.

zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出明尼苏达州第33届和第34届州议会的参议员。两年前，民主党人约翰·林德在州长选举中败给共和党人塞缪尔·林纳·范桑特。此后，明尼苏达州民主党原先在林德带领下凝聚起来的第三党支持者逐渐流失，预计将在这次参议院选举中失去席位。

en.s: The 1902 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Republican Aaron T. Bliss defeated Democratic candidate Lorenzo T. Durand with 52.52% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长亚伦·T·布利斯击败民主党候选人洛伦佐·T·杜兰德，得票率为52.52%。

en.s: The 1902 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Republican Governor DeForest Richards ran for re-election. He was once again nominated by the Republican Party, and faced Cody Mayor George T. Beck, the Democratic nominee, and Socialist Party nominee Henry Breitenstein in the general election. Richards won re-election in a landslide, becoming the first Governor of Wyoming to win re-election.

zh.s: 1902年怀俄明州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长德福雷斯特·理查兹竞选连任，并再次获得共和党提名。他在大选中面对民主党候选人、科迪市市长乔治·T·贝克，以及社会党候选人亨利·布赖滕斯坦。理查兹以压倒性优势当选，成为首位成功连任的怀俄明州州长。

en.t: 1902 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory
en.s: The 1902 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory was held on November 4, 1902 to elect the state's non-voting delegate. Republican Jonah Kūhiō Kalanianaʻole defeated incumbent Robert William Wilcox with 58.5% of the vote.

zh.t: 1902年夏威夷领地联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 1902年夏威夷领地联邦众议院代表选举于11月4日举行，选出该领地一名没有投票权的代表。共和党人约拿·库希奥·卡拉尼亚纳奥莱以58.5%的得票率击败现任代表罗伯特·威廉·威尔科克斯。

en.s: The 1902 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1902, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Connecticut House of Representatives William A. King defeated Democratic nominee Noble E. Pierce.

zh.t: 1902年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1902年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任康涅狄格州众议员威廉·A·金击败民主党候选人诺布尔·E·皮尔斯。

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1902, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Peter E. Hanson defeated Democratic nominee Spurgeon Odell, People's nominee Charles T. Lanman, Prohibition nominee William W. Loveless and Socialist nominee Bircham F. Morledge.

zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿彼得·E·汉森击败了民主党候选人斯普金·奥德尔、人民党候选人查尔斯·T·兰曼、禁酒党候选人威廉·W·洛夫莱斯和社会党候选人伯查姆·F·莫利奇。

en.s: The 1902 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1902, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Samuel G. Iverson defeated Democratic nominee Albert G. Leick and Socialist nominee J. Edward Carlson.

zh.t: 1902年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1902年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、明尼苏达州众议院前议员塞缪尔·G·艾弗森击败了民主党候选人阿尔伯特·G·莱克和社会党候选人J·爱德华·卡尔森。

en.t: 1902 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1902 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 4, 1902, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They occurred in the middle of President Theodore Roosevelt's first term, about a year after the assassination of William McKinley in September 1901.

zh.s: 1902年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月4日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则在6月或9月提前举行选举。这些选举在西奥多·罗斯福总统第一个任期中期举行，距离威廉·麦金莱于1901年9月遇刺约一年。

en.s: The 1902 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee Nahum J. Bachelder defeated Democratic nominee Henry F. Hollis with 53.19% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人纳胡姆·J·巴切尔德以53.19%的得票率击败民主党候选人亨利·F·霍利斯。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1902, in 27 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 4, 1902 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Maine, Oregon and Vermont, which held early elections). In Alabama, the governor was elected to a four-year term for the first time, instead of a two-year term. The election was held on the same day as federal elections for the first time, having previously been held in August.

zh.s: 1902年美国有27个州举行州长选举，大多于11月4日与联邦众议院和参议院选举同期举行。阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州、俄勒冈州和佛蒙特州提前举行选举。阿拉巴马州的州长任期首次从两年改为四年。这也是阿拉巴马州首次在联邦选举的同一天举行州长选举；此前州长选举一直在8月举行。

en.s: The 1902 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Republican Governor W. Murray Crane did not run for re-election. Lt. Governor John L. Bates was elected to succeed him, defeating Democratic nominee William A. Gaston and Socialist John C. Chase. This election was the first in which the newly formed Socialist Party of America fielded a candidate and Chase's 8.44% remains the largest vote any Socialist candidate for Governor has received as of 2026.

zh.s: 1902年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长W·默里·克兰没有竞选连任。副州长约翰·L·贝茨当选接替他，击败民主党候选人威廉·A·加斯顿和社会党候选人约翰·C·蔡斯。这是美国社会党成立后首次派人竞选州长。蔡斯获得的8.44%选票，截至2026年仍是社会党州长候选人所得的最高比例。

en.s: The 1902 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Democratic nominee Lucius F. C. Garvin defeated incumbent Republican Charles D. Kimball with 53.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人卢修斯·F·C·加文以53.99%的得票率击败现任共和党州长查尔斯·D·金博尔。

en.s: The 1902 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee Willis J. Bailey defeated Democratic nominee W. H. Craddock with 55.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人威利斯·J·贝利以55.45%的得票率击败民主党候选人W·H·克拉多克。

en.s: The 1902 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee Abiram Chamberlain defeated Democratic nominee Melbert B. Cary with 53.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人阿比拉姆·张伯伦以53.44%的得票率击败民主党候选人梅尔伯特·B·凯里。

en.s: The 1902 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee John T. Morrison defeated Democratic incumbent Frank W. Hunt with 52.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1902年爱达荷州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·T·莫里森以52.90%的得票率击败现任民主党州长弗兰克·W·亨特。

en.s: The 1902 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Incumbent Republican Governor Robert M. La Follette defeated Democratic nominee David Stuart Rose with 52.89% of the vote. Conservative Republican party leaders attempted to deny La Follette renomination in 1902, but La Follette's energized supporters overcame the conservatives and took control of the state convention, implementing a progressive party platform.

zh.s: 1902年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长罗伯特·M·拉福莱特以52.89%的得票率击败民主党候选人大卫·斯图尔特·罗斯。1902年，共和党内的保守派领导人试图阻止拉福莱特再次获得提名，但拉福莱特的支持者积极动员，击败保守派并控制州代表大会，推动大会通过进步主义政纲。

en.s: The 1902 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902. Republican nominee John H. Mickey defeated Democratic and Populist fusion nominee William Henry Thompson with 49.69% of the vote. Incumbent Republican Governor Ezra P. Savage did not stand for re-election. Savage originally intended to run for a second term as governor, but the criticism which was caused by his parole and pardon of former State Treasurer Bartley, who was serving a prison sentence for embezzlement, influenced his decision to step down from the race.

zh.s: 1902年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·H·米奇以49.69%的得票率击败民主党和民粹党联合候选人威廉·亨利·汤普森。现任共和党州长埃兹拉·P·萨维奇没有竞选连任。萨维奇原本打算竞选第二个州长任期，但他赦免并假释了因侵吞公款而入狱的前州财政部长巴特利，这引发批评，影响了他退出竞选的决定。

en.s: The 1902 New York state election was held on November 4, 1902, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer, the state engineer and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1902年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师和纽约州上诉法院法官，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1902 California gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1902, to elect the governor of California. George Pardee won the election with 48.06% percent of the popular vote and was the Governor of California until 1907. This was the first time since 1863 that the Republican Party retained control of the governorship in California.

en.s: Elections to the Massachusetts Senate were held on November 4, 1908, to elect 40 State Senators to the 130th Massachusetts General Court. Candidates were elected at the district level, with many districts covering multiple towns or counties.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1908年11月4日举行参议院选举，选出40名州参议员，组成第130届马萨诸塞州议会。候选人按选区选举，许多选区涵盖多个城镇或县。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Maryland, 1913
en.s: A Special Election to the United States Senate was held in Maryland on November 4, 1913 to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Sen. Isidor Rayner (a Democrat). The election was historic in that it was the first Senate election held under the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, which required direct election of senators. Blair Lee I, a Democrat and former state senator, became the first U.S. Senator directly elected by the people of a state under the Constitution's provisions (although other states had previously elected senators indirectly through party primaries and popular elections, which were then ratified by the state legislature).

zh.t: 1913年马里兰州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1913年11月4日，马里兰州举行联邦参议院特别选举，填补民主党籍参议员伊西多·雷纳去世后留下的空缺。这是美国宪法第十七修正案生效后举行的首场参议院选举。该修正案规定，联邦参议员由选民直接选出。民主党人、前州参议员布莱尔·李一世当选，成为首位依照宪法规定由州民直接选出的联邦参议员（此前其他州也曾通过党内初选和普选间接选出参议员，再由州议会批准）。

en.s: The 1913 Massachusetts gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1913. Democratic Lieutenant Governor David I. Walsh defeated the Progressive, Republican and independent candidates Charles S. Bird, Representative Augustus Peabody Gardner and incumbent Governor Eugene Foss with 39.77% of the vote. Suffolk County was the only county to give more than 50% of its vote to a candidate, giving Walsh 53.98% of its vote.

zh.s: 1913年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党副州长戴维·I·沃尔什击败进步党候选人查尔斯·S·伯德、共和党候选人兼联邦众议员奥古斯都·皮博迪·加德纳，以及现任州长尤金·福斯，得票率为39.77%。萨福克县是唯一有候选人获得过半数选票的县，沃尔什在该县获得53.98%的选票。

en.s: The 1913 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 4, 1913, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Emerson Harrington defeated Republican nominee Oliver Metzerott, Progressive nominee Joseph B. Baldwin, Socialist nominee Charles B. Backman and Prohibition nominee Richard Henry Holme.

zh.s: 1913年马里兰州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、现任州审计长埃默森·哈灵顿击败共和党候选人奥利弗·梅策罗特、进步党候选人约瑟夫·B·鲍德温、社会党候选人查尔斯·B·巴克曼和禁酒党候选人理查德·亨利·霍姆。

en.s: The 1913 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 1913, in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Joseph G. Armstrong was elected mayor of Pittsburgh over Stephen G. Porter in a nonpartisan election.

zh.s: 1913年匹兹堡市长选举于11月4日（星期二）在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行。约瑟夫·G·阿姆斯特朗在一场无党派选举中击败斯蒂芬·G·波特，当选匹兹堡市长。

en.s: The Raid on Yarmouth, on 3 November 1914, was an attack by the Imperial German Navy on the British North Sea port and town of Great Yarmouth. German shells landed on the beach causing little damage to the town, after German ships laying mines offshore were interrupted by British destroyers. The British submarine HMS D5 was sunk on a mine as it was leaving harbour to attack the German ships.

en.s: The Third Battle of Artois (25 September – 4 November 1915, also the Loos–Artois Offensive) was fought by the French Tenth Army against the German 6th Army on the Western Front of the First World War. The battle included the Battle of Loos by the British First Army. The offensive, meant to complement the Second Battle of Champagne, was the last attempt that year by Joseph Joffre, the French commander-in-chief, to exploit an Allied numerical advantage over Germany.

zh.s: 阿图瓦第三次战役（1915年9月25日至11月4日，也称洛斯—阿图瓦攻势）是第一次世界大战西线战场上法国第十集团军与德国第六集团军之间的战斗。英国第一集团军参加了这场战役，其中包括洛斯战役。这次攻势原本是为了配合香槟第二次战役，也是约瑟夫·霞飞当年最后一次试图利用协约国在兵力上对德国的优势发动进攻。

Including a triumvirate of battles launched after the Italians' successful seizure of Gorizia in August 1916 to extend their bridgehead to the left of the town, it ended in further failure for the Italian Chief of Staff Luigi Cadorna.

zh.s: 第二次桑布尔河战役于1918年11月4日爆发，是第一次世界大战欧洲战场盟军最后阶段攻势的一部分。这场战役包括第二次吉斯战役（法语：2ème Bataille de Guise）和蒂耶拉什战役（法语：Bataille de Thiérache）。

en.s: The Battle of Vittorio Veneto was fought from 24 October to 4 November 1918 near Vittorio Veneto on the Italian Front during World War I. After having defeated Austro-Hungarian troops during the Second Battle of the Piave River and recognizing the dire internal situation of Austria-Hungary caused by the course of the war and the blockade of the Adriatic at sea, the Royal Italian Army launched a major offensive: the Italian victory marked the end of the war on the Italian Front and the dissolution of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, contributing to the end of the First World War just one week later.

zh.s: 维托里奥·威尼托战役于1918年10月24日至11月4日在第一次世界大战意大利战线、维托里奥·威尼托附近进行。意大利王家军队此前在皮亚韦河第二次战役中击败奥匈军队。鉴于战争造成的奥匈帝国内部局势危急，以及亚得里亚海封锁，意军随后发动大规模攻势。意大利获胜，结束了意大利战线上的战争，并促成奥匈帝国解体；一周后，第一次世界大战也随之结束。

en.s: The 1919 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1919. This was the last gubernatorial election before the governor's term was extended to two years and the first election following the passage of the Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, which granted women the right to vote. Governor Calvin Coolidge was re-elected over Framingham businessman Richard Long in a landslide.

zh.s: 1919年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。这是该州州长任期延长到两年之前的最后一次选举，也是美国宪法第十九修正案通过后的首次选举，该修正案赋予女性投票权。州长卡尔文·柯立芝以压倒性优势击败弗雷明汉商人理查德·朗，赢得连任。

en.s: The 1919 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 4, 1919, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee E. Brooke Lee defeated Republican nominee Amos W. W. Woodcock, Socialist nominee John L. Weaver and Labor nominee Louis F. Guillotte.

zh.s: 1919年马里兰州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人E·布鲁克·李击败共和党候选人阿莫斯·W·W·伍德科克、社会党候选人约翰·L·韦弗和劳工党候选人路易·F·吉洛特。

en.s: The 1919 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1919. Democratic nominee Albert Ritchie defeated Republican nominee Harry Nice, receiving 49.06% of the vote. With a margin of 0.07%, this remains the closest gubernatorial election in Maryland history.

zh.s: 1919年马里兰州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人阿尔伯特·里奇击败共和党候选人哈里·尼斯，得票率为49.06%。两人仅相差0.07个百分点，这是马里兰州历史上差距最小的州长选举。

en.s: The 1919 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1919. Republican nominee Edwin P. Morrow defeated Democratic incumbent James D. Black with 53.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1919年肯塔基州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人埃德温·P·莫罗以53.82%的得票率击败现任民主党州长詹姆斯·D·布莱克。

en.s: The 1919 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 4, 1919. Incumbent James Rolph Jr. was re-elected with 64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1919年旧金山市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长小詹姆斯·罗尔夫以64%的得票率再次当选。

en.s: The Battle of Ballinalee took place during the Irish War of Independence on 4 November 1920. Members of the Irish Republican Army (IRA), led by Seán Mac Eoin, drove a mixed group of Crown forces consisting of Black and Tans and Auxiliary Division personnel from the village of Ballinalee in County Longford. Crown forces hoped to burn the town as a reprisal for the deaths of several RIC personnel in the preceding days.

zh.s: 巴利纳利战役发生于1920年11月4日，是爱尔兰独立战争的一场战斗。肖恩·麦克伊恩率领的爱尔兰共和军成员，将一支由“黑棕部队”和辅助师人员组成的混合王室部队赶出了朗福德郡的巴利纳利村。王室部队原本希望以烧毁该镇报复此前几天多名爱尔兰皇家警察人员死亡一事。

en.s: Hara Takashi (原 敬; 15 March 1856 – 4 November 1921), informally known as Hara Kei, was a Japanese politician who served as the Prime Minister of Japan from 1918 until his assassination. Hara was the first commoner and first Christian appointed to be Prime Minister of Japan, and was given the moniker of "commoner prime minister" (平民宰相, heimin saishō).

zh.s: 原敬（原 敬，1856年3月15日—1921年11月4日），非正式称原圭，是日本政治家，1918年至遇刺身亡期间担任日本首相。他是首位出身平民、也是首位信奉基督教的日本首相，并获称“平民宰相”。

en.s: The Valley of the Kings, also known as the Valley of the Gates of the Kings, is an area in Egypt where, for a period of nearly 500 years from the Eighteenth Dynasty to the Twentieth Dynasty, rock-cut tombs were excavated for pharaohs and powerful nobles under the New Kingdom of ancient Egypt.

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 4, 1924 as part of the 1924 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts was won in a landslide by incumbent Republican President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, who was running against Democratic Ambassador John W. Davis of West Virginia and the Progressive Party's Senator Robert M. La Follette of Wisconsin. Coolidge's running mate was former Budget Director Charles G. Dawes of Illinois and Davis ran with Governor Charles W.

zh.t: 1924年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举
zh.s: 1924年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。马萨诸塞州选民选出18名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝以压倒性优势赢得该州，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·戴维斯和进步党候选人、联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特。柯立芝的竞选搭档是前预算局长查尔斯·G·道斯。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 4, 1924, throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted for the Republican nominee, President Calvin Coolidge, over the liberal third party candidate Robert La Follette who ran as a Progressive and the Democratic nominee, former United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom John W. zh.s: 1924年蒙大拿州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行。全美当时的48个州均参与总统选举。选民选出4名代表，进入选举人团投票。蒙大拿州投票支持共和党候选人、总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败进步党候选人罗伯特·拉福莱特和民主党候选人、前美国驻英国大使约翰·W·戴维斯。柯立芝以4.59个百分点的优势赢下该州。

en.s: The 1924 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1924. Despite being a Republican year nationally, President Coolidge's election in Arizona was rather close. He only took Arizona with 40% of the vote against Davis's 35% and La Follette's 23%. The closest Arizona gubernatorial election since 1916, Hunt's lead in votes would continue to decline. With barely a percent separating the two, Hunt narrowly beat owner of the Arizona Republican newsletter, Dwight Heard. Heard had in fact previously backed 1914 Progressive nominee George Young against Hunt over the Republican, Ralph Cameron, and had been an enemy of Hunt for over a decade at this point.

zh.t: 1924年美国亚利桑那州州长选举
zh.s: 1924年美国亚利桑那州州长选举于11月4日举行。尽管全国整体有利于共和党，柯立芝在亚利桑那州的胜选仍相当接近：他仅以40%的得票率赢得该州，戴维斯和拉福莱特分别获得35%和23%。这是1916年以来竞争最激烈的一次亚利桑那州州长选举，亨特的领先优势不断缩小，最终仅以不到一个百分点的差距险胜《亚利桑那共和党人报》老板德怀特·赫德。赫德此前曾支持1914年进步党候选人乔治·扬，反对亨特和共和党候选人拉尔夫·卡梅伦；当时他与亨特已是十多年的政敌。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1924 was the 35th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 4, 1924. Incumbent President Calvin Coolidge, the Republican candidate, was elected to a full term. Coolidge had been vice-president under Warren G. Harding and became president in 1923 when Harding died during his term in office. Coolidge was given credit for a booming economy at home and no visible crises abroad. His candidacy was aided by a split within the Democratic Party. The regular Democratic candidate was John W. Davis, a little-known former congressman and diplomat from West Virginia.

zh.s: 1924年美国总统选举是美国第35次四年一度的总统选举，于1924年11月4日（星期二）举行。共和党候选人、现任总统卡尔文·柯立芝当选完整任期。此前，柯立芝曾任沃伦·G·哈定的副总统；哈定于1923年任内去世后，柯立芝接任总统。柯立芝因国内经济繁荣、海外局势平稳而获得认可。民主党内部的分裂也有利于柯立芝竞选。民主党的正式候选人是约翰·W·戴维斯，他曾任联邦众议员和外交官，当时并不知名。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 4, 1924. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1924 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won in a landslide by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts and his running mate Budget Director Charles G. Dawes of Illinois. Coolidge and Dawes defeated the Democratic nominees, Ambassador John W. Davis of West Virginia and his running mate Governor Charles W. Bryan of Nebraska.

zh.s: 1924年新泽西州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行。美国当时的48个州都参加了总统选举。新泽西州选民选出14名选举人，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人、现任总统卡尔文·柯立芝及其竞选搭档、预算局局长查尔斯·G·道斯以明显优势赢下该州。他们击败民主党候选人、驻英国大使约翰·W·戴维斯及其竞选搭档、内布拉斯加州州长查尔斯·W·布赖恩。

en.s: The 1924 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Governor of Montana Joseph M. Dixon, who was first elected governor in 1920, ran for re-election. Dixon won a competitive Republican primary, and moved on to the general election, where he faced John E. Erickson, a former district court judge and the Democratic nominee; and Frank J. Edwards, the 1916 Republican nominee for governor and the Farmer–Labor Party nominee. Ultimately, Erickson managed to defeat Dixon in his bid for re-election, winning what would be the first of three terms as governor.

zh.s: 1924年蒙大拿州州长选举于1924年11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长约瑟夫·M·迪克森竞选连任。他先在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，随后在大选中对阵民主党候选人、前地区法院法官约翰·E·埃里克森，以及1916年共和党州长候选人、此次获农民—劳工党提名的弗兰克·J·爱德华兹。最终，埃里克森击败迪克森，首次当选州长；此后他又连任两届。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 4, 1924 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 38 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Calvin Coolidge, over the Democratic nominee, former United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom John W. Davis. Coolidge won Pennsylvania by a landslide margin of 46.26%. Coolidge was credited for the booming economy while the Democratic electorate was divided between the conservative Davis and the liberal third party candidate Robert La Follette who ran as a Progressive.

zh.s: 1924年宾夕法尼亚州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行。美国当时的48个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出38名代表，进入选举人团投票。宾夕法尼亚州以明显优势支持共和党候选人、总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、前美国驻英国大使约翰·W·戴维斯。柯立芝以46.26个百分点的优势赢下该州。民主党选民分裂，一部分支持保守派戴维斯，另一部分支持自由派第三党候选人、进步党人罗伯特·拉福莱特；这也有助于柯立芝获胜。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 4, 1924 as part of the 1924 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted overwhelmingly for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W. Davis of West Virginia. Coolidge ran with former Budget Director Charles G. Dawes of Illinois, while Davis ran with Governor Charles W. Bryan of Nebraska.

zh.s: 1924年佛蒙特州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分，全美当时的48个州均参与投票。选民选出4名代表，进入选举人团投票。佛蒙特州以明显优势支持共和党候选人、现任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、驻英国大使约翰·W·戴维斯。柯立芝的竞选搭档是前预算局局长查尔斯·G·道斯；戴维斯的竞选搭档是内布拉斯加州州长查尔斯·W·布赖恩。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 4, 1924. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1924 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 45 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Republican President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, who was running against Democratic Ambassador John W. Davis of West Virginia and the Progressive Party's Senator Robert M. La Follette of Wisconsin. Coolidge's running mate was former Budget Director Charles G. Dawes of Illinois and Davis ran with Governor Charles W.

zh.s: 1924年美国纽约州总统选举于11月4日举行。当时美国48个州都参加了总统选举。纽约州选民选出45名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝赢得纽约州，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·戴维斯和进步党候选人、联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特。柯立芝的竞选搭档是前预算局长查尔斯·G·道斯。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 4, 1924. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Calvin Coolidge, who ran against West Virginia Congressman John W. Davis, and Progressive Party icon Robert La Follette. That Coolidage won New Mexico with less than half of the electorate is telling of the critical split in the rapidly liberalizing Democratic Party, which was occurring at this time between the traditional Democrats and the more radical Progressive Party.

zh.s: 1924年新墨西哥州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行。全美48个州均参加了总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出3名选举人，进入选举人团投票。共和党籍现任总统卡尔文·柯立芝赢下该州，击败来自西弗吉尼亚州的联邦众议员约翰·W·戴维斯和进步党代表人物罗伯特·拉福莱特。柯立芝获得的选票不足半数，反映出民主党内部正在迅速自由化并出现分裂：传统派与更激进的进步党之间意见不合。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 1924 in Minnesota as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. The Republican candidate, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge won the state over Progressive U.S. Senator Robert M. La Follette Sr. of Wisconsin by a margin of 81,567 votes, or 9.92%. Nationally, Coolidge, who had succeeded to the presidency following the death of President Warren G. Harding, won the election, with 382 electoral votes and a landslide 25.22% lead over the Democratic nominee, former Congressman John W. Davis of West Virginia, in the popular vote.

zh.s: 1924年明尼苏达州总统选举于1924年11月4日举行，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、现任总统卡尔文·柯立芝以81,567票、9.92个百分点的优势击败进步党候选人、威斯康星州联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特。柯立芝此前在沃伦·G·哈定去世后接任总统，此次最终以382张选举人票胜出，普选票领先民主党候选人、前联邦众议员约翰·W·戴维斯25.22个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1924. Wisconsin voters chose thirteen electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Progressive Party candidate, Senator Robert M. La Follette Sr., won his home state with 54% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's thirteen electoral votes. The 1924 election marks the last time a Democratic candidate failed to win any of Wisconsin's counties.

zh.s: 1924年威斯康星州总统选举于11月4日举行。威斯康星州选民选出13名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。进步党候选人、联邦参议员罗伯特·M·拉福莱特以54%的普选票赢得该州及其13张选举人票。这是最后一次有民主党候选人未能赢得威斯康星州任何一个县的总统选举。

en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1924 was Missouri's thirty-first gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 4, 1924 and resulted in a victory for the Republican nominee, former Missouri Superintendent of Schools Sam Aaron Baker, over the Democratic candidate, Arthur W. Nelson, Socialist candidate William M. Brandt, and Socialist Labor nominee William Wesley Cox.

zh.s: 1924年密苏里州州长选举是该州第31次州长选举，于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、前密苏里州教育总监萨姆·亚伦·贝克击败民主党候选人阿瑟·W·纳尔逊、社会党候选人威廉·M·布兰特和社会劳工党候选人威廉·韦斯利·考克斯，赢得选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 4, 1924 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic nominee, former United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom John W. Davis, over the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge.

zh.s: 1924年弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，与当时美国48个相连州的选举同期举行。选民选出12名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、美国前驻英国大使约翰·W·戴维斯，击败共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝。

en.s: The 1924 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1924. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Theodore Christianson defeated Farmer–Labor Party challenger Floyd B. Olson.

zh.s: 1924年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人西奥多·克里斯蒂安森击败农民—劳工党候选人弗洛伊德·B·奥尔森。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent United States Senator Thomas J. Walsh, who was first elected to the Senate in 1912, and re-elected in 1918, ran for re-election. He won the Democratic primary uncontested, and faced former State Representative Frank Bird Linderman and several independent opponents in the general election, and he ultimately won re-election to his third term by a solid margin.

zh.t: 1924年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1924年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。现任联邦参议员托马斯·J·沃尔什于1912年首次当选，并于1918年连任，此次竞选连任。他在民主党初选中没有对手，之后在大选中面对前州众议员弗兰克·伯德·林德曼和几名独立候选人。沃尔什最终以明显优势赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1924
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Democratic Senator Carter Glass defeated Republican W. N. Doak and was elected to his second term in office.

zh.t: 1924年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1924年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任参议员卡特·格拉斯击败共和党人W·N·多克，成功当选第二个任期。

en.s: The 1924 West Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1924
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1924 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1924. California's delegation remained unchanged at 9 Republicans and 2 Democrats.

zh.t: 1924年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1924年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。该州代表团构成未变，仍为九名共和党人和两名民主党人。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1924 took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Redfield Proctor, Jr., per the "Mountain Rule", did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Franklin S. Billings defeated Democratic candidate Fred C. Martin to succeed him.

zh.s: 1924年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月4日举行。根据“山脉规则”，共和党籍现任州长雷德菲尔德·普罗克特二世没有竞选连任第二个任期。共和党候选人富兰克林·S·比林斯击败民主党候选人弗雷德·C·马丁，接替他担任州长。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1924
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1924 in Massachusetts was held on November 4, 1924 with Republican Frederick H. Gillett defeating incumbent David I. Walsh.

zh.s: 1924年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党人弗雷德里克·H·吉列击败民主党籍现任参议员戴维·I·沃尔什。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose 29 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1924年伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了29名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1924, in 36 states (including 1 special election), concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 4, 1924. Elections took place on October 7, 1924, in Arkansas, and September 8, 1924, in Maine. This was the last time South Carolina elected its governors to two-year terms. It switched to four-years-terms from the 1926 election.

zh.s: 1924年美国有36个州举行州长选举，其中包括一场特别选举。这些选举与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同期举行，日期为1924年11月4日。阿肯色州于1924年10月7日举行选举，缅因州则于9月8日举行。南卡罗来纳州最后一次采用两年一届的州长任期制度也是在这次选举中；从1926年选举起，该州改为四年一届。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate elections in Michigan
en.s: Two 1924 United States Senate elections in Michigan were held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James J. Couzens, who was appointed following the resignation of Truman Newberry, was elected to a full term in a landslide. He also won the concurrent special election to serve out the remainder of Newberry's term (for the remainder of the 68th Congress), defeating the same candidates by roughly the same margin.

zh.t: 1924年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年密歇根州举行了两场联邦参议员选举，日期均为11月4日。现任共和党联邦参议员詹姆斯·J·库赞斯在杜鲁门·纽伯里辞职后受任填补席位，此次以压倒性优势当选完整任期。他还赢得了同日举行的特别选举，接替纽伯里剩余任期，任期截至第68届国会结束。库赞斯在两场选举中都以大致相同的优势击败了同一批对手。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W.

zh.s: 1924年美国缅因州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出6名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.s: The 1924 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Clifford L. Hilton defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Thomas V. Sullivan and Democratic nominee Robert C. Bell.

zh.t: 1924年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1924年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任总检察长克利福德·L·希尔顿击败农民—劳工党候选人托马斯·V·沙利文和民主党候选人罗伯特·C·贝尔。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Senator Smith W. Brookhart ran for re-election to a full term in office against Democrat Daniel F. Steck. In the initial vote, Brookhart was certified as the victor over Steck. However, Steck became the first person to successfully challenge a popular election to the Senate in 1926, when the Senate voted to remove Brookhart from office and seat Steck in his place.

zh.t: 1924年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员史密斯·W·布鲁克哈特竞选完整任期，对手是民主党人丹尼尔·F·斯特克。最初公布的投票结果认证布鲁克哈特获胜。但1926年，斯特克成为首位成功挑战通过普选产生的联邦参议员的人；参议院投票罢免布鲁克哈特，并让斯特克接替其席位。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Senator Thomas Sterling ran for re-election to a third term, but he was defeated in the Republican primary by Governor William H. McMaster. In the general election, McMaster was opposed by attorney Ulysses Simpson Grant Cherry, the Democratic nominee, and several independent candidates.

zh.t: 1924年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员托马斯·斯特林竞选第三个任期，但在共和党初选中败给了州长威廉·H·麦克马斯特。大选中，麦克马斯特的对手包括民主党候选人、律师尤利西斯·辛普森·格兰特·切里和几名独立候选人。

en.t: 1924 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1924 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on November 4, 1924, to elect the state's at-large representative. Incumbent Democrat John Morrow won re-election by 3.5 percentage points. This election coincided with a Governor election and other state and local offices. John Morrow out performed Democrat John W. Davis in the concurrent presidential election by 9 points, making this the first time this district voted differently on the presidential level.

zh.t: 1924年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1924年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出该州的单一众议院席位。现任民主党人约翰·莫罗赢得连任，领先3.5个百分点。此次选举与州长及其他州级、地方职位选举同期举行。约翰·莫罗在该选区的得票表现比民主党总统候选人约翰·W·戴维斯高出9个百分点，这是该选区首次在总统选举中投票支持与其他层级选举不同的政党。

en.s: The 1924 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee Hiram Bingham III defeated Democratic nominee Charles G. Morris with 66.18% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人海勒姆·宾厄姆三世以66.18%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·G·莫里斯。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Alabama occurred on November 4, 1924, as a part of the nationwide presidential election, which took place throughout all 48 contemporary states. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Since the 1890s, Alabama had been effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是当年全美48个州总统选举的一部分。选民选出了12名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。从19世纪90年代起，阿拉巴马州实际上已成为由民主党控制的一党制州。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Democratic Senator Augustus Owsley Stanley ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Republican Frederic M. Sackett. This was the first election that Republicans won this seat, and the first time that Republicans simultaneously held both Senate seats.

zh.t: 1924年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党参议员奥古斯都·奥斯利·斯坦利竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党人弗雷德里克·M·萨克特。共和党人此前从未赢得过该席位，这是他们首次获胜，也是共和党首次同时占有该州的两个联邦参议员席位。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了12名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州一直因内战时期形成的政治立场而分裂。

en.s: The 1924 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Charles C. Moore defeated Progressive nominee H. F. Samuels with 43.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年爱达荷州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长查尔斯·C·摩尔击败进步党候选人H·F·塞缪尔斯，得票率为43.94%。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是当年全美48个州总统选举的一部分。选民选出了10名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州一直由民主党主导，实际上是一个一党制州。

The election took place concurrently with the 1924 United States elections that saw Republicans hold the White House and increase their majorities in both houses of Congress.

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Mississippi

zh.s: 1924年美国密西西比州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州民主党人约翰·W·戴维斯轻松赢得密西西比州，击败共和党籍时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝和进步党候选人罗伯特·M·……。
