New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W.

zh.t: 1924年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举
zh.s: 1924年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Calvin Coolidge narrowly won Missouri by 5.79 points against John W. Davis, winning all 18 of the electoral votes in the state.

zh.s: 密苏里州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了18名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人卡尔文·柯立芝以5.79个百分点的微弱优势击败约翰·W·戴维斯，赢得密苏里州全部18张选举人票。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是当年全美48个州总统选举的一部分。选民选出了12名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州曾是邦联州，历史上实行吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，民主党长期主导该州政坛。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. Voters chose fifteen representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the Panic of 1893 and the Populist movement, Michigan had been rigidly one-party polity dominated by the Republican Party.

zh.s: 密歇根州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了15名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。自1893年恐慌和民粹主义运动以来，共和党一直主导密歇根州，该州实际上成为一党制州。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 4, 1924. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maryland was won by the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W.

zh.s: 1924年美国马里兰州总统选举于11月4日举行。当时美国48个州均参加总统选举。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。马里兰州支持共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.s: The 1924 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Primary elections were held on September 2, 1924. Incumbent Republican Governor John J. Blaine won re-election to a third term, defeating Democratic nominee Martin L. Lueck and Socialist nominee William F. Quick. As of 2022, this is the most recent instance of Walworth County voting Democratic in a gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1924年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。初选于1924年9月2日举行。现任共和党州长约翰·J·布莱恩击败民主党候选人马丁·L·卢克和社会党候选人威廉·F·奎克，赢得第三个任期。截至2022年，这是沃尔沃思县最近一次在州长选举中投票支持民主党候选人。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent Republican President Calvin Coolidge, and his running mate Charles G. Dawes, winning 41.26% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 亚利桑那州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了3名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。现任共和党总统卡尔文·柯立芝与竞选搭档查尔斯·G·道斯赢得亚利桑那州，获得41.26%的普选票。

en.s: The 1924 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Alvan T. Fuller was elected over Boston mayor James Michael Curley.

zh.s: 1924年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党副州长阿尔万·T·富勒击败波士顿市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利，当选州长。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Senator Arthur Capper ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by State Senator James Malone, the Democratic nominee. Capper won re-election in a landslide, winning 70% of the vote and outperforming Republican President Calvin Coolidge, who also won the state in the 1924 presidential election.

zh.t: 1924年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员阿瑟·卡珀竞选连任第二个任期，对手是民主党候选人、州参议员詹姆斯·马龙。卡珀以压倒性优势赢得连任，得票率为70%，超过同样赢得堪萨斯州的共和党总统候选人卡尔文·柯立芝。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the 30th president of the United States Calvin Coolidge (R–Massachusetts), running with Director of the Bureau of the Budget Charles G.

zh.s: 1924年美国怀俄明州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。美国第30任总统、来自马萨诸塞州的共和党人卡尔文·柯立芝赢得怀俄明州。他的竞选搭档是预算局局长查尔斯·G·……。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Morris Sheppard was re-elected to a third term in office, easily dispatching his challengers.

zh.t: 1924年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员莫里斯·谢泼德赢得连任，开始第三个任期，轻松击败对手。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Kansas was held on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. A rapid recovery from the depression of 1920 and 1921, despite major Republican losses during the 1922 House elections placed the Republican Party – who gained a record popular-vote majority in the 1920 election – in a secure position despite the death of President Warren G.

zh.s: 1924年美国堪萨斯州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。尽管共和党在1922年联邦众议院选举中损失惨重，但美国经济迅速走出1920至1921年的衰退；共和党在1920年总统选举中创下普选票多数纪录，因此当时胜算稳固。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over Independent nominee, Senator Robert M.

zh.t: 1924年美国南达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1924年美国南达科他州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南达科他州支持共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败独立候选人、联邦参议员罗伯特·M·……。

en.s: The 1924 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee Benjamin S. Paulen defeated Democratic incumbent Jonathan M. Davis with 49.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人本杰明·S·保伦以49.02%的得票率击败现任民主党州长乔纳森·M·戴维斯。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. State voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Outside a few Presidential and gubernatorial elections, Oregon was a virtually one-party Republican state during the “System of 1896”, where the only competition was via Republican primaries.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是当年全美48个州总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了5名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。在1896年政治格局形成后的时期里，除少数总统和州长选举外，俄勒冈州几乎一直由共和党主导，唯一的竞争来自共和党初选。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over Progressive nominee, Wisconsin Senator Robert M.

zh.s: 1924年美国艾奥瓦州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出13名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人、时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败进步党候选人、威斯康星州联邦参议员罗伯特·M·……。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Arkansas was held on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. Except for the Unionist Ozark counties of Newton and Searcy where Republicans controlled local government, Arkansas since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic one-party Democratic “Solid South” state.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了9名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，除纽顿县和塞尔西县这两个由统一党派控制地方政府的奥扎克山区县外，阿肯色州一直是由民主党主导的典型“南方铁票州”。

en.s: The 1924 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Democratic nominee and former First Lady of Texas Miriam A. Ferguson defeated Republican nominee George C. Butte. With her victory, she became the first female governor of Texas and the second to be governor of any U.S. state, after Nellie Tayloe Ross, although Ferguson was the first to be elected to the office.

zh.s: 1924年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党候选人、得克萨斯州前第一夫人米丽娅姆·A·弗格森击败共和党候选人乔治·C·巴特。她成为首位得克萨斯州女州长，也是继内莉·泰洛·罗斯之后第二位担任州长的女性；不过，弗格森是首位通过选举当选州长的女性。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W.

zh.t: 1924年美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1924年美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出9名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.s: The 1924 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Democratic nominee Angus Wilton McLean defeated Republican nominee Isaac Melson Meekins with 61.33% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人安格斯·威尔顿·麦克莱恩以61.33%的得票率击败共和党候选人艾萨克·梅尔森·米金斯。

en.s: The 1924 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee C. Eugene Stephens defeated Democratic nominee John H. Stone, Socialist nominee Edith E. Garver and Socialist Labor nominee John J. Ernst.

zh.t: 1924年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1924年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人C·尤金·斯蒂芬斯击败民主党候选人约翰·H·斯通、社会党候选人伊迪丝·E·加弗和社会主义工党候选人约翰·J·恩斯特。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee and West Virginia native, Ambassador John W.

zh.t: 1924年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1924年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、出生于西弗吉尼亚州的驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.s: The 1924 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the Governor of Arkansas. Democratic nominee and former Arkansas Secretary of State Tom Terral defeated Republican nominee John W. Grabiel.

zh.s: 1924年阿肯色州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党候选人、阿肯色州前州务卿汤姆·特拉尔击败共和党候选人约翰·W·格拉比尔。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Nevada was held on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by President Calvin Coolidge (R–Massachusetts), running with Senator Charles G. Dawes, with 41.76% of the popular vote, against Senator Robert M.

zh.s: 1924年美国内华达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝与联邦参议员查尔斯·G·道斯组成的组合赢得内华达州，获得41.76%的普选票；对手是联邦参议员罗伯特·M·……。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1924. The incumbent Republican, George W. Norris, was re-elected by a wide margin to a third term. He defeated John J. Thomas. Norris overperformed Calvin Coolidge, who won the state with 47.09% in the presidential election.

zh.t: 1924年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员乔治·W·诺里斯以较大优势赢得连任，开始第三个任期。他击败约翰·J·托马斯。诺里斯的表现超过了卡尔文·柯立芝；柯立芝赢得该州时的得票率为47.09%。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 4, 1924. Republican Senator Lawrence C. Phipps ran for re-election to a second term. Senator Alva B. Adams, who held the other Senate seat, opted not to run for re-election in the special election, and instead decided to challenge Phipps for re-election.

zh.t: 1924年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党参议员劳伦斯·C·菲普斯竞选连任第二个任期。占有该州另一个参议员席位的阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯没有参加特别选举，竞选填补空缺，而是决定挑战菲普斯竞选连任。

en.s: The 1924 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee Robert William Otto defeated Democratic nominee Elmer O. Jones and Socialist Labor nominee Edward G. Middlecoff.

zh.s: 1924年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人罗伯特·威廉·奥托击败民主党候选人埃尔默·O·琼斯和社会主义工党候选人爱德华·G·米德尔科夫。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Medill McCormick was unseated in the Republican primary by Charles S. Deneen, who went on to win the general election. The primaries and general election coincided with those for other federal elections (president and House) and those for state elections. The primaries were held April 8, 1924.

zh.t: 1924年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员梅迪尔·麦考密克在共和党初选中败给查尔斯·S·丹宁，后者随后赢得大选。初选和大选与其他联邦选举（总统和联邦众议院）及州级选举同期举行。初选于1924年4月8日举行。

en.s: The 1924 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee John Hammill defeated Democratic nominee James C. Murtagh with 72.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·哈米尔以72.72%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·C·默塔。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 4, 1924. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominee, incumbent President Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts, over the Democratic nominee, Ambassador John W.

zh.s: 1924年美国特拉华州总统选举于11月4日举行。当时美国48个州均参加总统选举。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。特拉华州支持共和党候选人、来自马萨诸塞州的时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝，击败民主党候选人、驻英大使约翰·W·……。

en.s: The 1924 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Alex J. Groesbeck defeated Democratic nominee Edward Frensdorf with 68.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长亚历克斯·J·格罗斯贝克以68.84%的得票率击败民主党候选人爱德华·弗伦斯多夫。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry W. Keyes ran for re-election to a second term. He faced no opposition in the primary, and was challenged by State Treasurer George Farrand, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Keyes won re-election to his second term in a landslide as President Calvin Coolidge won the state convincingly in the presidential election.

zh.t: 1924年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员亨利·W·凯斯竞选连任第二个任期。初选中无人挑战他；大选中，他的对手是民主党候选人、州财政部长乔治·法兰德。凯斯以压倒性优势赢得连任，卡尔文·柯立芝也在同日的总统选举中明显赢得新罕布什尔州。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent Republican president, Calvin Coolidge with a margin of 18.49%.

zh.s: 内布拉斯加州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出了8名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。现任共和党总统卡尔文·柯立芝以18.49%的优势赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part, and state voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rapid recovery of the economy from a sharp recession following World War I transformed the 1920s into a strongly Republican decade.

zh.s: 犹他州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。当时全美48个州都参加了选举，犹他州选民选出了4名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。第一次世界大战后经济从严重衰退中迅速复苏，使整个20世纪20年代成为共和党占明显优势的时期。

en.s: The 1924 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Democratic Governor James F. Hinkle did not run for a second term. Democratic nominee Arthur T. Hannett defeated Republican nominee Manuel B. Otero by 199 votes, or 0.17%, making this the closest gubernatorial election in New Mexico's history to date.

zh.s: 1924年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党州长詹姆斯·F·欣克尔没有竞选第二个任期。民主党候选人亚瑟·T·汉尼特以199票、即0.17%的微弱优势击败共和党候选人曼努埃尔·B·奥特罗，是当时新墨西哥州历史上差距最小的州长选举。

en.s: The 1924 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Incumbent first-term Republican Governor Len Small defeated Democratic nominee Norman L. Jones with 56.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长伦·斯莫尔在首个任期结束后，以56.72%的得票率击败民主党候选人诺曼·L·琼斯。

en.t: 1924 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1924 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 69th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 4, 1924, while Maine held theirs on September 8. They coincided with the election to a full term of President Calvin Coolidge, who had replaced Warren Harding following his death.

zh.s: 1924年美国联邦众议院选举选出了第69届国会的议员。选举大多于1924年11月4日举行，缅因州则提前于9月8日举行。此次选举与卡尔文·柯立芝赢得总统完整任期的选举同期举行。柯立芝在沃伦·哈丁去世后接任总统。

en.s: The 1924 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state treasurer of Missouri Lorenzo Dow Thompson defeated Democratic nominee and former state treasurer of Missouri George H. Middelkamp, Socialist nominee A. B. Griep and Socialist Labor nominee Henry Knobel.

zh.s: 1924年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任密苏里州财政部长洛伦佐·道·汤普森击败民主党候选人、州财政部长前任乔治·H·米德尔坎普、社会党候选人A·B·格里普和社会主义工党候选人亨利·克诺贝尔。

en.s: The 1924 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Susie W. Stageberg and Democratic nominee Ole C. Halverson.

zh.s: 1924年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农民—劳工党候选人苏西·W·斯泰格伯格和民主党候选人奥勒·C·哈尔弗森。

en.s: The 1924 Wyoming gubernatorial special election took place on November 4, 1924. William B. Ross, the Democratic Governor of Wyoming, died in office on October 2, 1924, temporarily elevating Republican Secretary of State Frank Lucas to the governorship. A special election was held to fill the remainder of Ross's term and his widow, Nellie Tayloe Ross, defeated Republican nominee E. J.

zh.t: 1924年美国怀俄明州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1924年美国怀俄明州州长特别选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍州长威廉·B·罗斯于1924年10月2日在任内去世，共和党籍州务卿弗兰克·卢卡斯暂代州长。此次特别选举用于填补罗斯剩余任期；他的遗孀内莉·泰洛·罗斯击败共和党候选人E·J·……。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. At state level, Idaho had begun in 1902 to be very much a one-party Republican state, which it has largely remained since apart from the New Deal era of the 1930s and 1940s.

zh.s: 爱达荷州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了4名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。1902年后，共和党开始长期主导爱达荷州；除20世纪30年代和40年代的新政时期外，该州大体上一直如此。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election. State voters chose 20 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since statehood, Texas had been very nearly the strongest state for the Democratic Party owing to its initial history being as a Deep South state based around slavery.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了20名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。自加入联邦以来，得克萨斯州一直几乎是民主党支持率最高的州，这与该州早期作为深南部蓄奴州的历史有关。

en.s: The 1924 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee John Gilbert Winant defeated Democratic incumbent Fred H. Brown with 53.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·吉尔伯特·维南特以53.94%的得票率击败现任民主党州长弗雷德·H·布朗。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 4, 1924. All contemporary forty-eight states took part of the 1924 United States presidential election, and Washington's voters selected seven voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rapid recovery of the economy from a sharp recession following World War I transformed the 1920s into a strongly Republican decade.

zh.s: 华盛顿州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。当时全美48个州都参加了选举，华盛顿州选民选出了7名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。第一次世界大战后经济从严重衰退中迅速复苏，使整个20世纪20年代成为共和党占明显优势的时期。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Republican Senator Francis E. Warren ran for re-election to his sixth consecutive term in the Senate. He was challenged by Judge Robert Rose of the Eighth Judicial District of Wyoming, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 1924年怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党参议员弗朗西斯·E·沃伦竞选第六个连续任期。他的对手是怀俄明州第八司法区法官、民主党候选人罗伯特·罗斯。

en.t: 1924 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1924 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 4, 1924. Incumbent Democratic Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican Charles F. Cole.

zh.t: 1924年阿肯色州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1924年阿肯色州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊击败共和党人查尔斯·F·科尔，赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 4, 1924. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the disfranchisement of blacks at the beginning of the 1890s, Florida had effectively been a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举。选民选出了6名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。自19世纪90年代初剥夺非裔美国人选举权以来，佛罗里达州实际上已成为由民主党控制的一党制州。

en.s: The 1924 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee Philip Allen Bennett defeated Democratic nominee Carter M. Buford with 51.46% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年密苏里州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人菲利普·艾伦·贝内特以51.46%的得票率击败民主党候选人卡特·M·布福德。

en.s: The 1924 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Democratic nominee George Dern defeated incumbent Republican Charles R. Mabey with 52.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 1924年犹他州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人乔治·德恩以52.99%的得票率击败现任共和党州长查尔斯·R·梅比。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the 1924 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 北达科他州于1924年11月4日举行总统选举，是1924年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出了5名选举人，组成选举人团，负责选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1924 Georgia gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1924, in order to elect the governor of Georgia. Incumbent Democratic governor Clifford Walker was unopposed in the Democratic primary. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1924年佐治亚州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州长。民主党现任州长克利福德·沃克在民主党初选中没有对手。按当时惯例，民主党候选人在大选中也没有对手，因此真正的竞争发生在民主党初选中，赢得初选就意味着当选。

en.t: 1924 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1924 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 1924, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1924年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。除佐治亚州北部少数几个历史上倾向联邦一方的县（主要是范宁县，皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县的倾向稍弱）外，自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州一直由民主党主导，是一党制州。

en.s: The 1924 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1924. Republican nominee Roland H. Hartley defeated Democratic nominee Ben F. Hill with 56.41% of the vote. This was the last gubernatorial election until 2016 in which Grays Harbor County voted for a Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1924年华盛顿州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人罗兰·H·哈特利以56.41%的得票率击败民主党候选人本·F·希尔。这是直到2016年，格雷斯港县在州长选举中最后一次投票支持共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1924 New York state election was held on November 4, 1924, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer and the state engineer, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1924年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长和州工程师，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1924 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1924 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1924 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1924年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是每两年一度的1924年美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的29个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1924年选举所用的全州50个参议院选区地图。

en.s: The 1924 United States Senate elections were elections for the United States Senate which coincided with the election of Republican President Calvin Coolidge to a full term. The 32 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. The strong economy and Coolidge's popularity helped Republican candidates increase their majority by three.

zh.s: 1924年美国联邦参议员选举与共和党总统卡尔文·柯立芝当选完整任期的总统选举同时举行。联邦参议院第二类席位中的32席举行常规选举，另举行特别选举以填补空缺。经济强劲、柯立芝广受欢迎，帮助共和党候选人将多数席位增加了3席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The plot of Prats de Molló, better known in Catalan historiography as the events of Prats de Molló, (fets de Prats de Molló) (by the place name in Catalan of the town of French Roussillon Prats-de-Mollo-la-Preste), was an attempted military invasion of Catalonia carried out from France to achieve its independence planned by Francesc Macià and the leadership of the Estat Català party, discovered and aborted in 1926.

zh.s: 普拉茨-德莫洛密谋案在加泰罗尼亚史学中也称为“普拉茨-德莫洛事件”（加泰罗尼亚语：fets de Prats de Molló）。这一名称来自鲁西永地区法国城镇普拉茨德莫洛拉普雷斯特的加泰罗尼亚语地名。该计划由弗朗塞斯克·马西亚和加泰罗尼亚国家党领导层策划，意图从法国发动军事入侵，以实现加泰罗尼亚独立；计划于1926年被发现并挫败。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1930
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent United States Senator Thomas J. Walsh, who was first elected to the Senate in 1912, and re-elected in 1918 and 1924, ran for re-election. He won the Democratic primary unopposed, and faced Montana Supreme Court Associate Justice Albert J. Galen, the Republican nominee, and several independent opponents in the general election. Ultimately, Walsh defeated his opponents in a landslide and won his fourth and final term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1930年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1930年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于1930年11月4日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员托马斯·J·沃尔什竞选连任。他曾于1912年首次当选，并于1918年和1924年连任。沃尔什在民主党初选中无人挑战，随后在大选中对阵蒙大拿州最高法院副法官、共和党候选人阿尔伯特·J·盖伦以及数名独立候选人。最终，沃尔什以明显优势击败对手，赢得第四个也是最后一个参议员任期。

en.s: The 1930 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The Oregon Republican Party, at the time dominant in Oregon politics, initially nominated George W. Joseph, but the nominee died prior to the general election. Joseph's former law partner Julius Meier entered the race as an independent, and defeated replacement Republican nominee Phil Metschan, Jr., Democrat Ed F. Murphy, and Socialist Albert Scheiff to become the first and only independent politician to be elected Governor of Oregon.

zh.s: 1930年俄勒冈州州长选举于1930年11月4日举行。俄勒冈州共和党当时在州内政坛占主导地位，最初提名乔治·W·约瑟夫，但他在大选前去世。约瑟夫的前法律合伙人朱利叶斯·迈耶以独立候选人身份参选，击败共和党替补候选人菲尔·梅茨坎、民主党候选人埃德·F·墨菲和社会党候选人阿尔伯特·谢夫，成为俄勒冈州历史上首位、也是唯一一位当选州长的独立候选人。

en.t: United States Senate election in Alabama, 1930
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Independent U.S. Senator James Thomas Heflin, who was expelled from the Democratic Party for supporting Herbert Hoover, lost re-election to John H. Bankhead II.

zh.t: 1930年阿拉巴马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1930年阿拉巴马州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。独立候选人、联邦参议员詹姆斯·托马斯·赫夫林因支持赫伯特·胡佛而被民主党开除，之后竞选连任失败，败给约翰·H·班克黑德二世。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1930 took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican John E. Weeks did not run for re-election to a third term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Stanley C. Wilson defeated Democratic candidate Park H. Pollard to succeed him.

zh.s: 1930年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·E·威克斯没有竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人斯坦利·C·威尔逊击败民主党候选人帕克·H·波拉德，接替他担任州长。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania, 1930
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania was held on November 4, 1930. Joseph R. Grundy, incumbent Republican appointed to fill the vacancy created by the unseating of William Scott Vare, was defeated for re-nomination. The Republican nominee, James J. Davis, defeated Democratic nominee Sedgwick Kistler to win the election.

zh.t: 1930年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1930年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍参议员约瑟夫·R·格伦迪受任命填补威廉·斯科特·瓦尔被撤销当选资格后留下的空缺，但在共和党提名竞争中落败。共和党候选人詹姆斯·J·戴维斯击败民主党候选人塞奇威克·基斯特勒，赢得选举。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1930
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democratic Senator Carter Glass defeated Independent Democrat J. Cloyd Byars and Socialist Joe C. Morgan, and was elected to his third term in office.

zh.t: 1930年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1930年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任参议员卡特·格拉斯击败独立民主党人J·克洛伊德·拜尔斯和社会党人乔·C·摩根，成功当选第三个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1930 occurred on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican governor John Stuchell Fisher was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate and former governor Gifford Pinchot defeated Democratic candidate John M. Hemphill to win a second, non-consecutive term as Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1930年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·斯图切尔·费舍尔没有竞选连任。共和党候选人、前州长吉福德·平肖击败民主党候选人约翰·M·亨菲尔，当选州长，开始第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1930 was held on November 4, 1930.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州州长选举于1930年11月4日举行。

en.s: The 1930 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930. It was the first gubernatorial race to start in Minnesota since the beginning of the Great Depression, which contributed to the meteoric rise of the Farmer–Labor Party in the state. Farmer–Labor Party candidate Floyd B. Olson decisively defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Raymond P. Chase.

zh.s: 1930年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。这是明尼苏达州大萧条开始以来首次举行州长选举。大萧条推动了农民—劳工党在该州迅速崛起。农民—劳工党候选人弗洛伊德·B·奥尔森以明显优势击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人雷蒙德·P·蔡斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1930
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1930 in Massachusetts was held on November 4, 1930 with Democrat Marcus A. Coolidge defeating his challengers.

zh.t: 1930年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1930年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党人马库斯·A·柯立芝击败对手，赢得选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1930
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1930 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1930. California's delegation remained unchanged at 10 Republicans and 1 Democrat.

zh.t: 1930年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1930年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。该州代表团构成未变，仍为十名共和党人和一名民主党人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1930, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 4, 1930. Elections took place on September 8 in Maine.

zh.s: 1930年美国有33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同期举行，日期为1930年11月4日。缅因州于9月8日举行选举。

en.s: The 1930 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Republican nominee Wilber M. Brucker defeated Democratic nominee William Comstock with 56.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人威尔伯·M·布鲁克击败民主党候选人威廉·康斯托克，得票率为56.88%。

en.s: The 1930 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930, to elect the governor of Texas. Democratic nominee Ross S. Sterling defeated Republican nominee William E. Talbot.

zh.s: 1930年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党候选人罗斯·S·斯特林击败共和党候选人威廉·E·塔尔博特。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Senator William B. Pine ran for re-election to a second term. In the Democratic primary, former U.S. Senator Thomas Gore emerged victorious in a crowded Democratic primary that included three former governors and one of the first female candidates for statewide office. Gore won a slim plurality in the initial election, and defeated C.

zh.t: 1930年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍时任参议员威廉·B·派恩竞选连任，争取第二个任期。民主党初选竞争激烈，前联邦参议员托马斯·戈尔胜出；其他参选者包括3名前州长和一位最早竞选全州公职的女性候选人之一。戈尔在首轮投票中以微弱相对多数获胜，随后击败C·……。

en.s: The 1930 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democratic governor Henry Hollis Horton defeated Republican nominee C. Arthur Bruce with 63.8% of the vote. During Horton's second term, he and Luke Lea, the publisher of the Nashville Tennessean, began using state patronage to distribute jobs in Memphis in an attempt to weaken E. H. Crump's influence there.

zh.s: 1930年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党州长亨利·霍利斯·霍顿以63.8%的得票率击败共和党候选人C·阿瑟·布鲁斯。霍顿的第二个任期内，他和《纳什维尔田纳西人报》出版人卢克·利利用州政府职位安排在孟菲斯安插人事，试图削弱E·H·克朗普在当地的影响力。

en.s: The 1930 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Governor Frank Emerson ran for re-election. As was the case with Emerson's first election in 1926, he faced a tight race. He was opposed by State Senator Leslie A. Miller, the Democratic nominee. Ultimately, Emerson narrowly won re-election over Miller, winning 51-49%, and by a margin of just 870 votes.

zh.s: 1930年怀俄明州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长弗兰克·埃默森竞选连任。与他1926年首次当选时一样，这次竞争也很激烈。他的对手是民主党候选人、州参议员莱斯利·A·米勒。最终，埃默森以51%对49%的得票率险胜米勒，连任成功，领先仅870票。

en.s: The 1930 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930, and featured former governor Charles W. Bryan, a Democrat, narrowly defeating incumbent Republican governor Arthur J. Weaver to win a second two-year, non-consecutive term in office.

zh.s: 1930年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党人、前州长查尔斯·W·布莱恩以微弱优势击败现任共和党州长阿瑟·J·韦弗，赢得第二个非连续的两年任期。

en.s: The 1930 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Henry N. Benson defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Joseph B. Himsl and Democratic nominee Walter F. Dacey.

zh.t: 1930年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1930年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任代理总检察长亨利·N·本森击败农民—劳工党候选人约瑟夫·B·希姆斯和民主党候选人沃尔特·F·戴西。

en.s: The 1930 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat William H. 'Alfalfa Bill' Murray defeated Republican Ira A. Hill. Also on the ballot were Independent candidates B. G. Bingham and John Franing.

zh.s: 1930年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党人威廉·H·“苜蓿比尔”·默里击败共和党人艾拉·A·希尔。独立候选人B·G·宾厄姆和约翰·弗雷宁也参加了选举。

en.s: The 1930 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Primary elections were held on September 16, 1930. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter J. Kohler Sr. was defeated in the Republican primary. Republican nominee Philip La Follette defeated Democratic nominee Charles E. Hammersley with 64.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。初选于1930年9月16日举行。现任共和党州长沃尔特·J·科勒（老）在共和党初选中落败。共和党候选人菲利普·拉福莱特以64.76%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·E·哈默斯利。

en.s: The 1930 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee William Preston Lane Jr. defeated Republican nominee David A. Robb, Socialist nominee William A. Toole, Labor nominee Word H. Mills and Communist nominee Isidore Samuelson. Incumbent attorney general Thomas H. Robinson had initially been nominated on the Democratic ticket to run for a third term, but died on October 12, 1930.

zh.s: 1930年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人威廉·普雷斯顿·莱恩二世击败共和党候选人大卫·A·罗布、社会党候选人威廉·A·图尔、劳工党候选人沃德·H·米尔斯和共产党候选人伊西多尔·塞缪尔森。现任总检察长托马斯·H·罗宾逊最初获得民主党提名，竞选第三个任期，但于1930年10月12日去世。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James J. Couzens was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic former U.S. Representative Thomas A. E. Weadock. Despite the national wave favoring Democrats, Couzens won by a landslide even larger than his 1924 landslide.

zh.t: 1930年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党联邦参议员詹姆斯·J·库赞斯击败民主党前联邦众议员托马斯·A·E·威多克，赢得第二个任期。尽管全国大选形势有利于民主党，库赞斯仍以比1924年更大的优势胜出。

en.s: The 1930 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Anna Olson Determan, Democratic nominee Mary MacGregor and Communist nominee Henry Bartlett.

zh.s: 1930年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农民—劳工党候选人安娜·奥尔森·德特曼、民主党候选人玛丽·麦格雷戈和共产党候选人亨利·巴特利特。

en.s: The 1930 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican governor Frank G. Allen was defeated by Democrat Joseph B. Ely. This election marked the beginning of a new era for the Massachusetts Democratic Party, starting a string of eight consecutive years of Democratic governors, a streak later surpassed from 1974 until 1986.

zh.s: 1930年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党州长弗兰克·G·艾伦败给民主党人约瑟夫·B·伊利。这次选举开启了马萨诸塞州民主党的新时代：民主党州长连续执政8年，后来又在1974年至1986年创下更长的连续执政纪录。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Senator George W. Norris ran for re-election to a fourth term. He was challenged by former Senator Gilbert Hitchcock, the Democratic nominee, whom he handily defeated.

zh.t: 1930年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。寻求连任、竞逐第四个任期的共和党现任参议员乔治·W·诺里斯，面对民主党候选人、前参议员吉尔伯特·希区柯克，轻松获胜。

en.s: The 1930 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Democratic nominee George White defeated incumbent Republican Myers Y. Cooper with 52.80% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人乔治·怀特以52.80%的得票率击败共和党现任州长迈尔斯·Y·库珀。

en.s: The 1930 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and former Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Connecticut Warren Booth Burrows defeated Democratic nominee and future state party chairman David A. Wilson.

zh.t: 1930年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1930年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人沃伦·布斯·伯罗斯曾任美国康涅狄格联邦地区法院法官，他击败了民主党候选人大卫·A·威尔逊。威尔逊后来成为州民主党主席。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 4, 1930. Republican Senator Lawrence C. Phipps declined to run for re-election, resulting in an open race to replace him. Edward P. Costigan, one of the founding members of the Progressive Party in Colorado and a former member of the United States Tariff Commission, won the Democratic nomination and faced attorney George H.

zh.t: 1930年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍参议员劳伦斯·C·菲普斯拒绝竞选连任，因此该席位成为开放席位。科罗拉多州进步党创始人之一、前美国关税委员会成员爱德华·P·科斯蒂根赢得民主党提名，随后将面对律师乔治·H·……。

en.s: The 1930 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Richard C. Dillon was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a third consecutive term. Democrat Arthur Seligman defeated Republican Clarence M. Botts by about 6.5 points. Seligman was the first Democratic gubernatorial candidate to ever win Santa Fe County and Taos County, and the first Democratic candidate to carry Guadalupe County since 1916.

zh.s: 1930年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出新墨西哥州州长。共和党现任州长理查德·C·狄龙受连续任职两届的限制，不能竞选连任。民主党人亚瑟·塞利格曼以约6.5个百分点的优势击败共和党人克拉伦斯·M·博茨。塞利格曼是首位赢得圣菲县和陶斯县的民主党州长候选人，也是自1916年以来首位赢得瓜达卢佩县的民主党候选人。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 4, 1930. Following the death of Republican Senator Francis E. Warren, former Casper Mayor Patrick J. Sullivan was appointed to replace him. Sullivan did not seek re-election, however. Following a contested Republican primary, former Governor Robert D. Carey emerged as the nominee, and faced Democrat Harry Schwartz, an attorney from Casper and a local school board member, in the general election.

zh.t: 1930年怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党参议员弗朗西斯·E·沃伦去世后，前卡斯珀市长帕特里克·J·沙利文获任命接替他，但没有竞选连任。共和党初选竞争激烈，前州长罗伯特·D·凯里胜出，随后在大选中面对民主党候选人哈里·施瓦茨。施瓦茨是卡斯珀的律师，也在当地学区董事会任职。

en.s: The 1930 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Democratic nominee Wilbur Lucius Cross defeated Republican nominee Ernest E. Rogers with 49.91% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人威尔伯·卢修斯·克罗斯以49.91%的得票率击败共和党候选人欧内斯特·E·罗杰斯。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 1930, alongside a special election to the same seat. Incumbent Senator Frederic M. Sackett resigned on January 9, 1930, to become Ambassador to Germany. Governor Flem D. Sampson appointed U.S. Representative John M. Robsion to fill Sackett's seat until a successor could be duly elected.

zh.t: 1930年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，同时该席位还举行了一次特别选举。现任参议员弗雷德里克·M·萨克特于1930年1月9日辞职，出任驻德国大使。州长弗莱姆·D·桑普森任命联邦众议员约翰·M·罗布西恩接替萨克特，直至选出继任者。

en.s: The 1930 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democrat Billy Adams defeated Republican nominee Robert F. Rockwell with 60.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长比利·亚当斯以60.41%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·F·洛克韦尔。

en.s: The 1930 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930. Harry H. Woodring was elected Governor of Kansas, becoming only the fourth member of the Democratic Party to hold the position in state history. He won with only 34.96% of the vote, with the remainder being split between Republican candidate Frank Haucke and independent write-in candidate John R. Brinkley.

zh.s: 1930年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。哈里·H·伍德林当选堪萨斯州州长，成为该州历史上第四位担任州长的民主党人。他仅获得34.96%的选票；其余选票由共和党候选人弗兰克·豪克和独立参选的写入候选人约翰·R·布林克利分得。

en.s: The 1930 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Stafford King defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Henry Teigan and Democratic nominee Benjamin M. Loeffler.

zh.s: 1930年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人斯塔福德·金击败农民—劳工党候选人亨利·蒂根和民主党候选人本杰明·M·勒夫勒。

en.s: The 1930 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican George F. Shafer defeated Democratic nominee Pierce Blewett with 73.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长乔治·F·谢弗以73.62%的得票率击败民主党候选人皮尔斯·布卢伊特。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Morris Sheppard was re-elected to a fourth term in office, easily dispatching his challengers.

zh.t: 1930年德克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年德克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员莫里斯·谢泼德再次当选，开始第四个任期，轻松击败对手。

en.s: The 1930 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Republican nominee John Gilbert Winant defeated Democratic nominee Albert W. Noone with 57.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·吉尔伯特·温南特以57.98%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿尔伯特·W·努恩。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Senator Arthur Capper ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by former Governor Jonathan M. Davis, the Democratic nominee. Despite the nationwide Democratic landslide, Capper easily defeated Davis, winning 61% of the vote.

zh.t: 1930年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员阿瑟·卡珀竞选连任第三个任期，对手是民主党候选人、前州长乔纳森·M·戴维斯。尽管民主党在全国大选中大胜，卡珀仍轻松击败戴维斯，获得61%的选票。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Senator William H. McMaster ran for re-election to a second term. After beating back a challenge in the Republican primary from former State Senator George J. Danforth, McMaster faced Democratic nominee William J. Bulow, the incumbent Governor, in the general election. As the Democratic Party performed well nationwide, Bulow narrowly defeated McMaster.

zh.t: 1930年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员威廉·H·麦克马斯特竞选连任第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击退前州参议员乔治·J·丹佛斯的挑战，随后在大选中面对民主党候选人、时任州长威廉·J·布洛。民主党在全国表现出色，布洛最终以微弱优势击败麦克马斯特。

en.s: The 1930 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democrat Albert Ritchie defeated Republican nominee William Frederick Broening with 55.96% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年马里兰州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长阿尔伯特·里奇以55.96%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·弗雷德里克·布罗宁。

en.s: The 1930 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller William S. Gordy Jr. defeated Republican nominee W. Newton Jackson, Socialist nominee Charles L. Myers, Labor nominee Samuel Einhorn and Communist nominee Lena Lipman.

zh.s: 1930年马里兰州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长小威廉·S·戈迪击败共和党候选人W·牛顿·杰克逊、社会党候选人查尔斯·L·迈尔斯、劳工党候选人塞缪尔·艾因霍恩和共产党候选人莉娜·利普曼。

en.s: The 1930 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent Bibb Graves was term-limited and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1930年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出阿拉巴马州州长。民主党现任州长比布·格雷夫斯任期届满，不能连续竞选第二个任期。

en.s: The 1930 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Republican nominee Dan W. Turner defeated Democratic nominee Fred P. Hagemann with 65.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人丹·W·特纳以65.74%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗雷德·P·哈格曼。

en.s: The 1930 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Republican State Senator Frank Merriam defeated Democratic Sacramento Mayor Martin I. Welsh with 66.38% of the vote.

zh.t: 1930年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1930年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党州参议员弗兰克·梅里亚姆以66.38%的得票率击败民主党候选人、萨克拉门托市长马丁·I·韦尔什。

en.s: The 1930 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Norman S. Case defeated Democratic nominee Theodore F. Green with 50.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长诺曼·S·凯斯以50.53%的得票率击败民主党候选人西奥多·F·格林。

en.s: The 1930 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930, to elect the governor of Arkansas, concurrently with the election to Arkansas's Class II U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic governor Harvey Parnell had won office in 1928, and was seeking reelection in 1930.

zh.s: 1930年阿肯色州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出阿肯色州州长，同时还举行了该州联邦参议员选举以及其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举和各类州及地方选举。民主党现任州长哈维·帕内尔于1928年当选，正在竞选连任。

en.t: 1930 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1930 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 4, 1930, to elect the states at-large representative. This election coincided with other house elections and the states Governor election. Democrat challenger Dennis Chávez defeated incumbent Albert G. Simms by a double digit margin of 11.6 percentage points.

zh.t: 1930年新墨西哥州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1930年新墨西哥州联邦众议员选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州唯一的联邦众议员。选举与其他州的众议员选举及新墨西哥州州长选举同时举行。民主党挑战者丹尼斯·查韦斯以两位数优势击败现任议员艾伯特·G·西姆斯，领先11.6个百分点。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate special election in Kansas
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate special election in Kansas was held on November 4, 1930. After Republican Senator Charles Curtis was re-elected in 1926, he was elected Vice President on a ticket with Herbert Hoover in 1928 and resigned his seat in the Senate. Governor Clyde M. Reed, a Republican, appointed former Governor Henry J. Allen to the seat.

zh.t: 1930年堪萨斯州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1930年堪萨斯州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行。共和党参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯于1926年连任，随后在1928年与赫伯特·胡佛搭档当选副总统，并辞去参议员职务。共和党州长克莱德·M·里德任命前州长亨利·J·艾伦接任。

en.s: The 1930 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democratic Governor William J. Bulow declined to run for re-election to a third term, instead opting to successfully run for the U.S. Senate. The Republican nomination was hard-fought and the primary was crowded; because no candidate received 35% of the vote, state law required that the nomination be decided at a state party convention.

zh.s: 1930年南达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长威廉·J·布洛不再竞选第三个任期，转而竞选联邦参议员并成功当选。共和党提名竞争激烈，初选候选人众多；由于没有候选人获得35%的选票，州法律要求由州党代表大会决定提名人选。

en.s: The 1930 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Fred B. Balzar defeated Democratic nominee Charles L. Richards with 53.25% of the vote.

zh.s: 1930年内华达州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长弗雷德·B·巴尔扎以53.25%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·L·理查兹。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Democratic Senator Daniel F. Steck ran for re-election to a full term in office, but was defeated by U.S. Representative Lester J. Dickinson. This was the only Senate seat Republicans gained in the 1930 elections.

zh.t: 1930年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员丹尼尔·F·斯特克竞选完整任期，但败给联邦众议员莱斯特·J·迪金森。这是共和党在1930年选举中赢得的唯一一个参议院席位。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate elections of 1930 in New Jersey was held on November 4, 1930. Walter Evans Edge, the Senator elected in 1924, resigned in 1929 to take office as U.S. Ambassador to France. Interim appointee David Baird Jr. chose not to seek re-election and Republican Dwight Morrow won a landslide victory to succeed him.

zh.t: 1930年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。1924年当选的参议员沃尔特·埃文斯·埃奇于1929年辞职，出任美国驻法国大使。临时接任的戴维·贝尔德二世不再竞选连任，共和党人德怀特·莫罗以压倒性优势胜出，接替该席位。

en.s: The 1930 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1930. George W. P. Hunt narrowly won the general election in 1930, defeating incumbent governor John Calhoun Phillips, who had defeated Hunt in his bid for reelection in the previous election year in 1928. George W. P. Hunt was sworn in for his seventh, and final, term as governor on January 5, 1931.

zh.s: 1930年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月4日举行。乔治·W·P·亨特在大选中以微弱优势获胜，击败了曾在1928年连任竞选中击败亨特的现任州长约翰·卡尔霍恩·菲利普斯。亨特于1931年1月5日宣誓就任第七个、也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate special election in Tennessee took place on November 4, 1930, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The special election came upon the death of incumbent Democratic Senator Lawrence D. Tyson. Democratic Governor Henry Hollis Horton appointed William E. Brock.

zh.t: 1930年美国田纳西州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1930年美国田纳西州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举及各级州和地方选举同期举行。民主党籍时任参议员劳伦斯·D·泰森去世后，民主党籍州长亨利·霍利斯·霍顿任命威廉·E·布罗克接任。

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 4, 1930. Incumbent Republican Charles S. Deneen was unseated in the Republican Party's primary election. Democrat J. Hamilton Lewis, who previously held this Senate seat from 1913 to 1919, won a second nonconsecutive term.

zh.t: 1930年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1930年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员查尔斯·S·迪宁在共和党初选中失利。曾于1913年至1919年担任该席位参议员的民主党人J·汉密尔顿·刘易斯再次当选，这是他非连续的第二个任期。

en.t: 1930 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1930 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 72nd United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 4, 1930, while Maine held theirs on September 8. They occurred in the middle of President Herbert Hoover's term.

zh.s: 1930年美国联邦众议员选举旨在选出第72届联邦国会众议员，大部分于1930年11月4日举行，缅因州则于9月8日举行。这些选举在赫伯特·胡佛总统任期中期举行。

en.s: The 1930 New York state election was held on November 4, 1930, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1930年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长和纽约州上诉法院法官，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1930 United States Senate elections occurred in the middle of Republican President Herbert Hoover's term. The 32 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. With the Great Depression beginning to take hold, Republican incumbents became unpopular, and Democrats picked up a net of eight seats, erasing the Republican gains from the previous election cycle, however, Republicans retained control of the chamber.

zh.s: 1930年美国联邦参议院选举在共和党总统赫伯特·胡佛任期中举行。常规选举改选第二类的32个席位，另举行特别选举填补空缺。随着大萧条开始加剧，共和党现任议员失去民心，民主党净增8席，扳回上届选举的席位增幅；不过，共和党仍控制参议院。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1930 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1930 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 21 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1930 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1930年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的21个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期为四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1930年选举所用的全州50个参议院选区地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1930 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on Tuesday November 4, Incumbent Senator Thomas D. Schal defeated Einar Hoidale of the Minnesota Democratic Party and Forner United States Representative Ernest Lundeen of the Farmer–Labor Party of Minnesota to win a second term.

zh.t: 1930年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1930年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。现任参议员托马斯·D·沙尔击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人埃纳尔·霍伊达尔和农工党候选人、前联邦众议员欧内斯特·伦丁，赢得第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1930 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Democratic nominee C. Ben Ross, mayor of Pocatello, defeated Republican nominee John McMurray with 56.03% of the vote. Ross' victory broke a streak of six consecutive election wins (1918–28) by Republicans; he was re-elected in 1932 and 1934.

zh.s: 1930年爱达荷州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、波卡特洛市长C·本·罗斯以56.03%的选票击败共和党候选人约翰·麦克默里。罗斯的胜利结束了共和党从1918年至1928年连续六次赢得州长选举的纪录；他后来又在1932年和1934年连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1930 United States Senate special election in Ohio
en.s: The 1930 United States Senate special election in Ohio was held on Tuesday November 4, to elect a successor to Senator Theodore E. Burton, who died in office in October 1929. United States Representative Roscoe C. McCulloch, who was appointed to fill the vacant seat, was to complete the term but was defeated by United States Representative Robert J. Bulkley.

zh.t: 1930年俄亥俄州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1930年俄亥俄州联邦参议院特别选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，以选出西奥多·E·伯顿参议员的继任者。伯顿于1929年10月在任内去世。获任填补空缺的联邦众议员罗斯科·C·麦卡洛克原本将完成剩余任期，但在选举中败给联邦众议员罗伯特·J·布尔克利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Resistance at Nenjiang Bridge was a small battle fought between forces of the Chinese National Revolutionary Army against the Imperial Japanese Army and collaborationist forces, after the Mukden Incident during the Invasion of Manchuria in 1931, prior to the start of the Second Sino-Japanese War. It marked the start of the Jiangqiao Campaign.

zh.s: 嫩江桥抗战是1931年九一八事变后、中国第二次世界大战（抗日战争）全面爆发前，中华民国国民革命军与日本帝国陆军及其协从部队之间的一场小规模战斗。这场战斗拉开了江桥战役的序幕。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1941 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1941, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia Senate William M. Tuck defeated Republican nominee I. C. Wagner and Independent candidate Stephen A. Moore.

zh.s: 1941年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州参议员威廉·M·塔克击败共和党候选人I·C·瓦格纳和独立候选人斯蒂芬·A·摩尔。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1941 occurred on Tuesday, November 4, 1941. Incumbent Mayor Maurice J. Tobin defeated former Mayor James Michael Curley and two others. This was the first election held following a 1939 referendum that repealed a 1918 law, which had prevented an incumbent Mayor of Boston from serving consecutive terms. Inaugural exercises were held Monday, January 5, 1942.

zh.s: 1941年波士顿市长选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。现任市长莫里斯·J·托宾击败前市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利和另外两名候选人。这是1939年公投废除1918年法律后的首次选举；该法律曾禁止波士顿市长连续任职。就职仪式于1942年1月5日举行。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1941 took place on November 4, 1941, in New York City. Incumbent mayor Fiorello La Guardia was re-elected to a third term in office over Kings County District Attorney William O'Dwyer. La Guardia, a Republican, was also the nominee of the American Labor Party, and additionally ran on the City Fusion and United City ballot lines.

zh.s: 1941年纽约市市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长菲奥雷洛·拉瓜迪亚再次当选，开始第三个任期，击败金斯县地方检察官威廉·奥德怀尔。拉瓜迪亚是共和党候选人，也获美国工党提名，并以城市融合党和联合城市党的候选人身份参选。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1941 saw the election of Frank Lausche, who defeated incumbent mayor Edward J. Blythin, who had assumed the office when Harold Hitz Burton resigned as mayor to take a seat in the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1941年克利夫兰市长选举中，弗兰克·劳舍当选。他击败了现任市长爱德华·J·布莱辛；布莱辛是在哈罗德·希茨·伯顿辞去市长职务、转任美国联邦参议员后接任市长的。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1941, in the state of Virginia. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year.

zh.s: 1941年美国州长选举在弗吉尼亚州举行。弗吉尼亚州每四年在奇数年举行一次州长选举，时间安排在美国总统选举年之后。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 1941 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor James H. Price, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. U.S. Representative Colgate Darden was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against Republican former Virginia State Senator Benjamin Muse.

zh.s: 1941年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长詹姆斯·H·普莱斯因任期限制无法竞选连任。民主党提名联邦众议员科尔盖特·达登参选，对阵共和党候选人、前弗吉尼亚州参议员本杰明·缪斯。

en.t: Bombing of Gorky in World War II
en.s: The bombing of Gorky by the German Luftwaffe was the most destructive attack on Soviet war production on the Eastern Front of World War II. It lasted intermittently from October 1941 to June 1943, with 43 raids carried out. The main target was the Gorky Automobile Plant (GAZ), which was manufacturing T-60 light infantry tanks.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 二战期间高尔基市遭轰炸
zh.s: 德国空军对高尔基市的轰炸，是二战东线对苏联军工生产造成破坏最严重的一次袭击。轰炸从1941年10月至1943年6月间断进行，共发动43次空袭。主要目标是生产T-60轻型步兵坦克的高尔基汽车厂（GAZ）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Donbas Operation (September 29 – November 4, 1941) was a frontline defensive operation of the Soviet Red Army in the territory of Donbas on the Eastern Front of the Second World War in Europe. It was an integral part of the Donbas–Rostov Strategic Defensive Operation.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 顿巴斯战役于1941年9月29日至11月4日进行，是第二次世界大战欧洲战场东线的一场苏联红军前线防御战，也是顿巴斯—罗斯托夫战略防御行动的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Second Battle of El Alamein (23 October – 4 November 1942) was a battle of the Second World War that took place near the Egyptian railway halt of El Alamein. The First Battle of El Alamein and the Battle of Alam el Halfa had prevented the Axis from advancing further into Egypt. In October 1942 Lieutenant-General Bernard Montgomery, commander of Eighth Army, opened his offensive against the Axis forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿拉曼第二次战役于1942年10月23日至11月4日举行，是第二次世界大战期间在埃及阿拉曼铁路站附近进行的一场战役。阿拉曼第一次战役和阿拉姆哈勒法战役阻止了轴心国军队继续向埃及推进。1942年10月，英国第八集团军司令伯纳德·蒙哥马利中将向轴心国军队发起攻势。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Matanikau Offensive, from 1–4 November 1942, sometimes referred to as the Fourth Battle of the Matanikau, was an engagement between United States (U.S.) Marine and Army and Imperial Japanese Army forces around the Matanikau River and Point Cruz area on Guadalcanal during the Guadalcanal campaign of World War II. The action was one of the last of a series of engagements between U.S. and Japanese forces near the Matanikau River during the campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马塔尼考攻势于1942年11月1日至4日进行，有时也称马塔尼考第四次战役。第二次世界大战瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间，美国海军陆战队和陆军部队与日本帝国陆军在马塔尼考河和克鲁兹角附近交战。这是战役期间美日两军在马塔尼考河一带一系列战斗中的最后几场之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Convoy SC 107 was the 107th of the numbered series of World War II slow convoys of merchant ships from Sydney, Cape Breton Island to Liverpool. The ships departed New York City on 24 October 1942 and were found and engaged by a wolfpack of U-boats which sank fifteen ships. It was the heaviest loss of ships from any trans-Atlantic convoy through the winter of 1942–43.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: SC 107号船队是第二次世界大战期间从布雷顿角岛悉尼港前往利物浦的编号慢速商船船队系列中的第107支。船队于1942年10月24日从纽约市出发，随后被德国潜艇群发现并袭击，15艘船被击沉。这是1942至1943年冬季以来，大西洋船队单次遭受的最惨重船只损失。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Kilkis was an armed conflict between communist resistance organisation ELAS and a coalition of collaborationist Security Battalions, nationalist resistance organisations EDES and the National Greek Army (EES). On 4 November 1944, ELAS captured Kilkis after nine hours of fighting. The nationalists suffered many casualties during the battle and in prisoner killings afterwards.

zh.s: 基尔基斯战役是共产主义抵抗组织ELAS与一支由合作者安全营、民族主义抵抗组织EDES和希腊国民军组成的联盟之间的武装冲突。1944年11月4日，ELAS经过9小时战斗攻占基尔基斯。民族主义一方在战斗中和之后处决战俘时均有大量人员伤亡。

en.s: Operation Pheasant, also known as the Liberation of North Brabant, was a major operation to clear German troops from the province of North Brabant in the Netherlands during the fighting on the Western Front in the Second World War. This offensive was conceived as a result of the failure of Operation Market Garden and the allied effort to capture the important port of Antwerp.
en.n: World War II: Operation Pheasant, an Allied offensive to liberate North Brabant in the Netherlands, ends successfully.

zh.s: 野鸡行动又称解放北布拉班特行动，是第二次世界大战西线战场上的一项大型军事行动，目标是清除荷兰北布拉班特省的德军。市场花园行动失败，以及盟军试图夺取重要港口安特卫普的行动受阻，促成了这次进攻行动。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军解放荷兰北布拉班特省的野鸡行动成功结束。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 4 November 1945. They came at a turbulent moment in the country's history: World War II had had a devastating impact; the Soviet Union was occupying it, with the Hungarian Communist Party growing in numbers; a land reform that March had radically altered the property structure; and inflation was rampant. The Independent Smallholders Party won a sweeping victory, but its gains were gradually whittled away by Communist salami tactics, fulfilling the prediction of their leader Mátyás Rákosi that the defeat would "not play an important role in Communist plans".

zh.s: 匈牙利于1945年11月4日举行议会选举。当时该国正处于动荡时期：第二次世界大战造成严重破坏；苏联正在占领匈牙利；匈牙利共产党不断壮大；同年3月的土地改革彻底改变了土地所有权结构；通货膨胀也十分严重。独立小农党以压倒性优势获胜，但随着共产党采取“香肠切片”策略，其所得逐渐被削弱。这印证了该党领袖马加什·拉科西的预言：这场失败“不会在共产党的计划中发挥重要作用”。

en.t: Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Navigation between the United States of America and the Republic of China
en.s: The Treaty of Friendship, Commerce and Navigation between the United States of America and the Republic of China was a bilateral treaty signed by the United States and China on November 4, 1946. It became effective on November 30, 1948, following the mutual exchange of ratifications, pursuant to Article XXX. It fulfilled the desires of both countries to establish such a treaty as previously expressed in Article XII of the Treaty for Relinquishment of Extraterritorial Rights in China.

zh.t: 《美利坚合众国与中华民国友好通商航海条约》
zh.s: 《美利坚合众国与中华民国友好通商航海条约》是美国和中国于1946年11月4日签署的一项双边条约。双方根据第XXX条互换批准书后，条约于1948年11月30日生效。该条约实现了两国此前在《中美关于取消在华治外法权及处理有关问题条约》第十二条中表达的缔约愿望。

en.s: The 1947 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1947. Democratic nominee Earle Clements defeated Republican nominee Eldon S. Dummit with 57.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1947年肯塔基州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人厄尔·克莱门茨以57.24%的得票率击败共和党候选人埃尔登·S·杜米特。

en.s: The 1947 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1947, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Fielding L. Wright, who had succeeded to the governorship a year prior following the death of Thomas L. Bailey, ran for election to a first full term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate won in a landslide, so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1947年密西西比州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出密西西比州州长。民主党现任州长菲尔丁·L·赖特在托马斯·L·贝利去世后于前一年接任州长，此次竞选并当选首个完整任期。按当时惯例，民主党候选人以压倒性优势获胜，因此真正的竞争发生在民主党初选中，赢得初选也就意味着当选。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1947 took place on November 4, 1947, and saw the election of Democrat Al Feeney, who defeated Republican William Wemmer. Democrats swept city offices in the coinciding elections. Ahead of the election, a high level of Democratic voter registration caused it to be anticipated that Fenney would have a strong chance of winning.

zh.t: 1947年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1947年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月4日举行，民主党人阿尔·菲尼击败共和党人威廉·韦默尔，当选市长。民主党人在同期举行的市政职位选举中全面获胜。选举前，民主党选民登记人数大幅增加，因此外界预计菲尼很有胜算。

en.t: 1947 United States Senate special election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1947 United States Senate special election in Mississippi was held on November 4, 1947. John C. Stennis was elected to fill the seat vacated by the death of Theodore G. Bilbo. This is the most recent open seat won by a Democrat in Mississippi, as Stennis and his fellow senator James Eastland would continue to be reelected until both being succeeded by Republicans.

zh.t: 1947年密西西比州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1947年密西西比州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行。约翰·C·斯坦尼斯当选，接替去世的西奥多·G·比尔博。此后密西西比州民主党人在特别选举中获得的联邦参议员席位，再没有开放席位由民主党人赢得；斯坦尼斯和另一位参议员詹姆斯·伊斯特兰一直连任，直到后来分别由共和党人接替。

en.s: The Battle of Rawalakot, was a battle fought by the Azad Kashmir Regular Force against the State of Jammu and Kashmir which took place in the city of Rawalakot and surrounding areas between November 4–14, 1947 during the First Kashmir War, which was initiated by Muslim Sudhan ex-servicemen to fight for the accession of Jammu and Kashmir to the Dominion of Pakistan.

zh.s: 第一次克什米尔战争期间，阿扎德克什米尔正规军与查谟和克什米尔邦军队于1947年11月4日至14日在拉瓦拉科特市及周边地区交战。这场战争由穆斯林苏丹退役军人发起，旨在推动查谟和克什米尔并入巴基斯坦自治领。

en.s: The 1947 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 4, 1947. Elmer Robinson was elected with 41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1947年旧金山市长选举于11月4日举行。埃尔默·罗宾逊以41%的得票率当选。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1947 saw the election of Thomas A. Burke as Mayor of Cleveland, defeating Republican challenger Eliot Ness.

zh.s: 1947年克利夫兰市长选举中，托马斯·A·伯克击败共和党挑战者埃利奥特·内斯，当选克利夫兰市长。

en.s: The Battle of Unsan (Korean: 운산 전투; Hanja: 雲山戰鬪; MR: Unsan chŏnt'u), also known as the Battle of Yunshan (Chinese: 云山战斗; pinyin: Yúnshān zhàndòu), was a series of engagements of the Korean War that took place from 25 October to 4 November 1950 near Unsan, North Pyongan province in present-day North Korea.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 云山战役（朝鲜语：운산 전투；汉字：雲山戰鬪；麦克une—赖肖尔式：Unsan chŏnt’u），又称云山战斗（中文：云山战斗；拼音：Yúnshān zhàndòu），是朝鲜战争期间一系列交战，发生于1950年10月25日至11月4日，地点在云山附近、今朝鲜平安北道境内。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 4, 1952. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1952 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 45 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by former Supreme Allied Commander and World War II hero, Republican Dwight D. Eisenhower, who was running against Democratic Governor of Illinois Adlai Stevenson. Eisenhower ran with California Senator Richard Nixon as Vice President, and Stevenson ran with Alabama Senator John Sparkman. Eisenhower carried New York with 55.45% of the vote to Stevenson's 43.55%, a victory margin of 11.90%.

zh.s: 1952年纽约州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行。美国当时的48个州都参加了总统选举。纽约州选民选出45名选举人，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人、前盟军最高司令、二战英雄德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔赢下该州，击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔的竞选搭档是加利福尼亚州参议员理查德·尼克松，史蒂文森的搭档是阿拉巴马州参议员约翰·斯帕克曼。艾森豪威尔获得55.45%的选票，史蒂文森获得43.55%，两人相差11.90个百分点。

New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by World War II hero and supreme allied commander Dwight D. Eisenhower by a wide 11 point margin. Running against Eisenhower was Governor of Illinois Adlai Stevenson, who largely only carried the American South during his two gambits for the presidency. This was the 10th consecutive U.S.

en.t: United States Senate election in Arizona, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Arizona was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator and Senate Majority Leader Ernest McFarland ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by the Republican nominee and future candidate for President of the United States, Barry Goldwater. Goldwater ran an aggressive campaign against the entrenched Democrat, accumulating over fifty thousand air-miles in his travels about the state, during which he delivered more than six hundred speeches. He defeated McFarland in the general election by a slim margin of 6,725 votes out of approximately 260,000 cast, which Goldwater attributed in part to the unpopularity of President Harry S.

zh.t: 1952年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员、参议院多数党领袖欧内斯特·麦克法兰竞选第三个任期，但败给共和党候选人、日后参选总统的巴里·戈德华特。戈德华特积极竞选，在州内行程累计飞行超过5万英里，并发表了600多场演讲。他在大选中以6725票的微弱优势击败麦克法兰；总计约有26万张选票。戈德华特认为，哈里·S·杜鲁门总统不受欢迎是他获胜的原因之一。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 4, 1952 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, General Dwight Eisenhower, over the Democratic nominee, Illinois Governor Adlai Stevenson. This election in particular marked a shift from Virginia being previously regarded as a safe blue state to more of a red state. Eisenhower ultimately won the national election with 55.18% of the vote. It was the first time Virginia voted for a Republican since it was won by Herbert Hoover in 1928.

zh.s: 1952年弗吉尼亚州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行。选民选出12名选举人，进入选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人德怀特·艾森豪威尔将军，击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。这次选举标志着弗吉尼亚州从传统的民主党优势州转向共和党优势州。艾森豪威尔以55.18%的全国普选票胜出。这是弗吉尼亚州自1928年投票支持赫伯特·胡佛以来首次支持共和党候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 4, 1952 as part of the 1952 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted overwhelmingly for the Republican nominee, General Dwight D. Eisenhower of New York, over the Democratic nominee, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois. Eisenhower ran with Senator Richard Nixon of California, while Stevenson's running mate was Senator John Sparkman of Alabama. Eisenhower took a landslide 71.45% of the vote to Stevenson's 28.23%, a victory margin of 43.22%.

zh.s: 1952年佛蒙特州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分，全美当时的48个州均参与投票。选民选出3名代表，进入选举人团投票。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔将军，击败民主党候选人、前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔的竞选搭档是加利福尼亚州参议员理查德·尼克松；史蒂文森的搭档是阿拉巴马州参议员约翰·斯帕克曼。艾森豪威尔获得71.45%的选票，史蒂文森获得28.23%，两人相差43.22个百分点。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1952 was the 42nd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 4, 1952. Republican Dwight D. Eisenhower was the landslide winner, ending a string of Democratic wins that stretched back to 1932. He carried the Republican Party (GOP) to narrow control of the House and Senate. During this time, Cold War tension between the United States and the Soviet Union was at a high level, as was fear of communism in the US, epitomized by the campaign of McCarthyism. Foreign policy was a main issue in the race for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 1952年美国总统选举是美国第42次四年一度的总统选举，于1952年11月4日（星期二）举行。共和党候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔以压倒性优势胜出，结束了民主党自1932年以来连续获胜的局面。他带领共和党在国会众议院和参议院以微弱优势取得多数。当时美苏冷战紧张，国内对共产主义的恐惧也很强烈，麦卡锡主义便是这种氛围的体现。外交政策是共和党总统提名竞争中的主要议题。

en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 4, 1952 as part of the 1952 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Hampshire was won by the Republican nominees, General Dwight D. Eisenhower of New York and his running mate Senator Richard Nixon of California. Eisenhower and Nixon defeated the Democratic nominees, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois and his running mate Senator John Sparkman of Alabama.

zh.s: 1952年新罕布什尔州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分，全美当时的48个州均参与投票。选民选出4名代表，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔将军及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员理查德·尼克松赢得该州。他们击败民主党候选人、前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森及其竞选搭档、阿拉巴马州参议员约翰·斯帕克曼。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 4, 1952, throughout the continuous 48 states, but not Alaska or Hawaii which would be admitted to the Union in 1959. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted overwhelmingly for the Republican nominee, war hero General Dwight D. Eisenhower, over the Democratic nominee, Illinois Governor Adlai Stevenson. Eisenhower won Montana by a landslide margin of 19.32%.

zh.s: 1952年蒙大拿州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行。当时美国48个本土州参加了总统选举，阿拉斯加和夏威夷于1959年才加入联邦。蒙大拿州选民选出4名代表，进入选举人团投票。蒙大拿州以明显优势支持共和党候选人、二战英雄德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔将军，击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔在该州领先19.32个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1952
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 1952 in Minnesota as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. The Republican candidate, former Supreme Allied Commander Europe General of the Army Dwight D. Eisenhower won the state over Illinois governor Adlai Stevenson by a margin of 154,753 votes, or 11.22%. Eisenhower went on to win the election nationally, with 442 electoral votes and a commanding 10.9% lead over Stevenson in the popular vote. Incumbent President Harry S. Truman was the last President who was unaffected by the term limit imposed under the 22nd Amendment, but decided as early as 1950 that he would not seek another term.

zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、前欧洲盟军最高司令德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔将军以154,753票、11.22个百分点的优势击败伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔最终以442张选举人票胜出，普选票领先史蒂文森10.9个百分点。现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门是最后一位不受第二十二修正案任期限制的总统，但他早在1950年就决定不再竞选。
