en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1952
en.s: The 1952 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 4, 1952. The incumbent, Non-Partisan League (NPL) Senator William Langer, sought and received re-election to his third term in the United States Senate on the Republican ticket, defeating Democratic candidate Harold A. Morrison. Incumbent Langer won the Republican nomination, and the endorsed Democratic candidate was Harold A. Morrison. Langer and Morrison won the primary elections for their respective parties. One independent candidate, former North Dakota Governor Fred G. Aandahl, also filed before the deadline. Aandahl, a Republican, ran as a Write-in candidate after failing to receive the Republican nomination against the incumbent in the primary election.

zh.t: 1952年北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1952年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。无党派联盟（NPL）籍现任参议员威廉·兰格以共和党候选人身份竞选连任，成功获得第三个联邦参议员任期，击败民主党候选人哈罗德·A·莫里森。兰格赢得共和党提名，获民主党支持的候选人莫里森也赢得了本党提名初选。一名独立候选人、北达科他州前州长弗雷德·G·安达尔也在截止日期前登记参选。安达尔是共和党人，在初选中未能击败现任议员获得共和党提名，之后以写入式候选人身份参选。

en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 4, 1952. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1952 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 16 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, General Dwight D. Eisenhower of New York and his running mate Senator Richard Nixon of California. Incumbent Governor John Howard Pyle, the first Republican elected to the office in two decades, ran for reelection to a second term. John Howard Pyle defeated Democratic nominee Joe C. Haldiman by a wide margin, becoming only the second Republican to be reelected to a consecutive term as Governor of Arizona in the state's history.

zh.s: 1952年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长约翰·霍华德·派尔是二十年来首位当选该职位的共和党人，此次竞选连任第二个任期。他以较大优势击败民主党候选人乔·C·哈迪曼。派尔因此成为亚利桑那州历史上第二位连续连任的共和党州长。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 54.59 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 45.41 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年俄克拉何马州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在俄克拉何马州获胜，得到54.59%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得45.41%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国爱达荷州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。爱达荷州支持哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in California was held on November 4, 1952, concurrently with the 1952 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. By cross-filing and winning the Democratic nomination, incumbent Republican Senator William F. Knowland was able to cruise to a general election victory with only nominal opposition.

zh.t: 1952年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与1952年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员和众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党现任参议员威廉·F·诺兰德同时参加共和党和民主党初选并赢得民主党提名，因此在大选中几乎没有遇到有力对手，轻松获胜。

en.s: The 1952 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Edward F. Arn defeated Democratic nominee Charles Rooney with 56.34% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长爱德华·F·阿恩以56.34%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·鲁尼。

en.s: The 1952 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Democratic nominee William B. Umstead defeated Republican nominee Herbert F. "Chub" Seawell Jr. with 67.50% of the vote. Seawell, an attorney, followed in the footsteps of his father, Herbert Sr., who had lost the 1928 North Carolina gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1952年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人威廉·B·安姆斯特德以67.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人赫伯特·F·“丘布”·西沃尔二世。律师西沃尔追随父亲赫伯特·西沃尔一世参选州长，父亲曾在1928年的北卡罗来纳州州长选举中落败。

en.s: The 1952 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic Governor Allan Shivers was overwhelmingly reelected in the general election after defeating future Senator Ralph Yarborough in the Democratic primary. The Republican Party endorsed the Democratic state ticket, including Shivers, in order to attract more votes for their presidential nominee, General Dwight D. Eisenhower.

zh.s: 1952年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长艾伦·希弗斯在民主党初选中击败未来的参议员拉尔夫·亚伯勒后，又在大选中以压倒性优势连任。共和党为争取更多选票支持本党总统候选人、五星上将德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔，转而支持民主党州级候选人名单，其中包括希弗斯。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Florida was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Kansas), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 54.99% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 44.97% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年佛罗里达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民选出10名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，堪萨斯州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在佛罗里达州获胜，得到54.99%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得44.97%的普选票。

en.s: The 1952 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Edwin L. Mechem ran for and won reelection to a second term. Mechem was the first Republican gubernatorial candidate to ever win Curry County, De Baca County, and Quay County. Moreover, Luna County and McKinley County voted Republican for the first time since 1930.

zh.s: 1952年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出新墨西哥州州长。共和党现任州长埃德温·L·米彻姆竞选连任第二个任期并获胜。他是首位赢得柯里县、德巴卡县和奎伊县的共和党州长候选人。此外，自1930年以来，卢纳县和麦金莱县也首次投票支持共和党。

en.s: The 1952 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican William S. Beardsley defeated Democratic nominee and Mayor of Ottumwa Herschel C. Loveless with 51.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长威廉·S·比尔兹利以51.90%的得票率击败民主党候选人、奥特姆瓦市市长赫歇尔·C·洛夫莱斯。

en.s: The 1952 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee George Hubert Bates defeated Republican nominee Vern F. Carpenter, Prohibition nominee Bertha M. Boutell, Socialist nominee Elizabeth Erbe and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.t: 1952年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1952年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州财政部长。民主党候选人乔治·休伯特·贝茨击败共和党候选人弗恩·F·卡彭特、禁酒党候选人伯莎·M·布特尔、社会党候选人伊丽莎白·厄布和社会主义工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 63.75% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 35.59% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年艾奥瓦州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出10名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在艾奥瓦州获胜，得到63.75%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得35.59%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the United States presidential election of 1952. The Democratic Party candidate, Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois, won the state of Mississippi over Dwight D. Eisenhower, the former Supreme Allied Commander Europe and General of the Army by a margin of 59,600 votes, or 20.88 percentage points.

zh.s: 1952年密西西比州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森以59,600票的优势，也就是20.88个百分点，击败前欧洲盟军最高司令、美国陆军五星上将德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔，赢得密西西比州。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 55.90% of the popular vote, against Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国阿肯色州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。来自伊利诺伊州的民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森与联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼组成的组合，以55.90%的普选票赢得阿肯色州，击败德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.s: The 1952 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican J. Bracken Lee defeated the Democratic nominee, mayor of Salt Lake City Earl J. Glade, with 55.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年犹他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长J·布雷肯·李以55.09%的得票率击败民主党候选人、盐湖城市长厄尔·J·格莱德。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1952年美国田纳西州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出11名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州的政治格局一直受战争时期形成的政治立场影响。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 61.45% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 38.55% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年内华达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，代表内华达州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在内华达州获胜，得到61.45%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得38.55%的普选票。

en.s: The 1952 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent governor Adlai Stevenson II, a Democrat, ultimately did not seek a second term, instead opting to run as his party's nominee for President of the United States. Republican William Stratton was elected to succeed him in office. Before receiving the Democratic presidential nomination at the Democratic National Convention, Stevenson had been running for reelection as governor, even winning the Democratic primary.

zh.s: 1952年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长阿德莱·史蒂文森二世最终没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是改为代表民主党竞选美国总统。共和党人威廉·斯特拉顿当选接替他。在获得民主党总统候选人提名之前，史蒂文森一直在竞选连任州长，并赢得了民主党初选。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose 25 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 56.76% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 43.24% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年俄亥俄州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出25名选举人，代表俄亥俄州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在俄亥俄州获胜，得到56.76%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得43.24%的普选票。

en.s: The 1952 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Daniel I. J. Thornton defeated Democratic nominee John W. Metzger with 57.08% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长丹尼尔·I·J·桑顿以57.08%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·W·梅茨格。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominee, General Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国罗得岛州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党候选人、将军德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.s: The 1952 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Democratic nominee Luther H. Hodges defeated Republican nominee Warren H. Pritchard with 67.67% of the vote.

zh.t: 1952年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1952年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人卢瑟·H·霍奇斯以67.67%的得票率击败共和党候选人沃伦·H·普里查德。

en.s: The 1952 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial special election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia following the death of incumbent lieutenant governor Lewis Preston Collins II. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia Senate Allie Edward Stakes Stephens defeated Republican nominee Robert W. Waitt Jr..

zh.t: 1952年弗吉尼亚州副州长特别选举
zh.s: 1952年弗吉尼亚州副州长特别选举于11月4日举行，以填补副州长刘易斯·普雷斯顿·柯林斯二世去世后留下的空缺。民主党候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州参议员阿利·爱德华·斯泰克斯·斯蒂芬斯击败共和党候选人小罗伯特·W·韦特。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 60.27% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 38.96% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年科罗拉多州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人，代表科罗拉多州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在科罗拉多州获胜，得到60.27%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得38.96%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 55.36% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 43.83% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年马里兰州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，代表马里兰州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在马里兰州获胜，得到55.36%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得43.83%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate special election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate special election in Kentucky was held on November 4, 1952, to complete the unexpired term of the late Senator Virgil Chapman. Interim Senator Thomas R. Underwood ran to complete the term but was defeated by Republican former Senator John Sherman Cooper.

zh.t: 1952年肯塔基州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1952年肯塔基州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行，以完成已故参议员维吉尔·查普曼的剩余任期。临时接任的参议员托马斯·R·安德伍德竞选完成该任期，但败给共和党前参议员约翰·谢尔曼·库珀。

en.s: The 1952 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Virginia Paul Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Koscie H. Marsh. Virginia Paul Holm also won a special election to serve the remainder of her late husband's term that same day against another candidate.

zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿弗吉尼亚·保罗·霍尔姆击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人科斯基·H·马什。当天，霍尔姆还赢得了一场特别选举，完成亡夫的剩余任期。

en.s: The 1952 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Republican nominee Hugh Gregg defeated Democratic nominee William H. Craig with 63.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人休·格雷格以63.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·H·克雷格。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1952 in New Jersey was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Senator H. Alexander Smith was re-elected to a second term against Undersecretary of the Army Archibald S. Alexander. Both men were residents of Princeton. As of the 2024 Senate election, this is the last time the Republicans won the Class 1 Senate seat in New Jersey.

zh.t: 1952年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员H·亚历山大·史密斯再次当选，开始第二个任期，对手是陆军副部长阿奇博尔德·S·亚历山大。两人都住在普林斯顿。截至2024年联邦参议员选举，这是共和党最近一次赢得新泽西州第一类参议员席位。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominee, General Dwight D. Eisenhower of New York, over the Democratic nominee, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois.

zh.s: 1952年康涅狄格州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分；这场大选在当时全部48个州举行。该州选民选出8名选举人，代表康涅狄格州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人、来自纽约州的五星上将德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔，胜过民主党候选人、前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。

en.s: The 1952 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter J. Kohler Jr. defeated Democratic nominee William Proxmire with 62.50% of the vote. Kohler's share of the vote was the highest by a gubernatorial candidate since Philip La Follette in 1930; no candidate would match Kohler's share until Tommy Thompson in 1994.

zh.s: 1952年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长小沃尔特·J·科勒以62.50%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·普罗克斯迈尔。科勒的得票率是自1930年菲利普·拉福莱特以来州长候选人中最高的；直到汤米·汤普森在1994年参选，才有人再次达到这一比例。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1952年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1952年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出14名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。作为前邦联州，北卡罗来纳州曾实行吉姆·克劳法，剥夺非裔居民的选举权，并长期由民主党主导州政治。

en.s: The 1952 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee John M. Dalton defeated Republican nominee and former speaker of the Missouri House of Representatives Richard M. Webster.

zh.s: 1952年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人约翰·M·道尔顿击败共和党候选人、密苏里州众议院前议长理查德·M·韦伯斯特。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states.

zh.s: 1952年阿拉巴马州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。与其他州不同，阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选举每一名选举人，而不是对选举人名单整体投票。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 4, 1952 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 16. At the federal level, Representative John F. Kennedy defeated incumbent Senator Henry Cabot Lodge in a close election. In the race for Governor, Republican Christian Herter defeated incumbent Democrat Paul Dever. Republicans also defeated incumbent Democrats in the races for Lieutenant Governor and Attorney General.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1952年11月4日举行大选，初选于9月16日举行。在联邦层面，众议员约翰·F·肯尼迪在一场势均力敌的选举中击败现任参议员亨利·卡伯特·洛奇。在州长选举中，共和党人克里斯蒂安·赫特击败民主党现任州长保罗·德弗。共和党还在副州长和总检察长选举中击败了民主党现任官员。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator William E. Jenner was re-elected to a second term in office over Governor of Indiana Henry F. Schricker.

zh.t: 1952年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员威廉·E·詹纳再次当选，开始第二个任期，击败印第安纳州州长亨利·F·施里克。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate special election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate special election in Connecticut was held on November 4, 1952, to fill the vacancy left by the death of Brien McMahon. Republican candidate Prescott Bush defeated Democrat Abraham Ribicoff and served the remainder of the Senate term. Bush was later re-elected in 1956 to a full term in office over Democratic U.S. Representative Thomas J. Dodd.

zh.t: 1952年康涅狄格州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1952年康涅狄格州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行，以填补布赖恩·麦克马洪去世后留下的空缺。共和党候选人普雷斯科特·布什击败民主党人亚伯拉罕·里比科夫，完成了该参议员任期。布什后来在1956年再次当选，开始完整任期，并击败民主党联邦众议员托马斯·J·多德。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Senator Joseph McCarthy was elected to a second term in office over Democrat Thomas E. Fairchild. McCarthy did not complete his term; he died on May 2, 1957, and was succeeded by William Proxmire in a special election. As of 2024, this is the last time that a Republican has won the Class 1 Senate seat in Wisconsin.

zh.t: 1952年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员约瑟夫·麦卡锡击败民主党人托马斯·E·费尔柴尔德，当选第二个任期。麦卡锡未能任满，于1957年5月2日去世，随后在特别选举中由威廉·普罗克斯迈尔接替。截至2024年，这是共和党最近一次赢得威斯康星州第一类参议员席位。

en.s: The 1952 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Norman Brunsdale defeated Democratic nominee Ole C. Johnson with 78.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长诺曼·布伦斯代尔以78.74%的得票率击败民主党候选人奥勒·C·约翰逊。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John J. Williams was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic Lieutenant Governor Alexis I. du Pont Bayard, the son of former Senator Thomas F. Bayard, Jr. and descendant of two of Delaware's most powerful families, the du Ponts and the Bayards.

zh.t: 1952年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年特拉华州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员约翰·J·威廉斯再次当选，开始第二个任期，击败民主党候选人、副州长亚历克西斯·I·杜邦·贝亚德。贝亚德是前参议员小托马斯·F·贝亚德的儿子，也是特拉华州最有势力的杜邦家族和贝亚德家族的后代。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose 8 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Democrat Adlai Stevenson II defeated Dwight D. Eisenhower, the national Republican nominee, who ran in South Carolina as an Independent candidate.

zh.s: 1952年南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。南卡罗来纳州选民选出8名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森二世击败共和党全国提名人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔；艾森豪威尔在南卡罗来纳州以独立候选人身份参选。

en.s: The 1952 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Governor Sigurd Anderson was re-elected, defeating Democratic nominee Sherman A. Iverson with 70.15% of the vote. This is the only time that the winner of the South Dakota gubernatorial election won all counties in South Dakota.

zh.s: 1952年南达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长西格德·安德森再次当选，以70.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人谢尔曼·A·艾弗森。这是南达科他州州长选举中唯一一次由胜选者赢得全州所有县。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the Supreme Allied Commander Europe Dwight D. Eisenhower and the junior U.S. senator from California Richard Nixon defeated the Democratic ticket of the governor of Illinois Adlai Stevenson II and the junior U.S. senator from Alabama John Sparkman.

zh.s: 印第安纳州总统选举于1952年11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（欧洲盟军最高司令）和加利福尼亚州联邦参议员理查德·尼克松，击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森二世和阿拉巴马州联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with California Senator Richard Nixon, with 54.33% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Alabama Senator John Sparkman, with 44.69% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年华盛顿州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与加利福尼亚州联邦参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在华盛顿州获胜，得到54.33%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与阿拉巴马州联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得44.69%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 52.92% of the popular vote, against Dwight D.

zh.t: 1952年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1952年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。来自伊利诺伊州的民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森与联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼组成的组合，以52.92%的普选票赢得路易斯安那州，击败德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1952 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 83rd United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 4, 1952, while Maine held theirs on September 8. This was the first election after the congressional reapportionment based on the 1950 census.

zh.s: 1952年美国联邦众议员选举旨在选出第83届联邦国会众议员，大部分于1952年11月4日举行，缅因州则于9月8日举行。这是1950年人口普查后重新分配国会席位的首次选举。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1952年美国亚利桑那州总统选举
zh.s: 1952年美国亚利桑那州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。亚利桑那州支持哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.s: The 1952 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Walter H. Toberman defeated Republican nominee Ballard Watters and Socialist Labor nominee Karl Oberheu.

zh.s: 1952年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿沃尔特·H·托伯曼击败共和党候选人巴拉德·沃特斯和社会主义工党候选人卡尔·奥伯休。

en.s: The 1952 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democrat G. Mennen Williams defeated Republican nominee Frederick M. Alger Jr. with 49.96% of the vote. With a margin of just 0.30%, this is the second-closest gubernatorial election in Michigan's history, behind only the previous election.

zh.s: 1952年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长G·梅嫩·威廉斯以49.96%的得票率击败共和党候选人小弗雷德里克·M·阿尔杰。两人得票差距仅0.30%，这是密歇根州历史上第二接近的州长选举，仅次于前一次选举。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Ohio was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Senator John W. Bricker was re-elected to a second term in office over Director of the Economic Stabilization Agency and former Toledo mayor Michael DiSalle.

zh.t: 1952年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员约翰·W·布里克再次当选，开始第二个任期，击败经济稳定局局长、托莱多市前市长迈克尔·迪萨尔。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in California took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose 32 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican nominee, former Allied Supreme Commander Dwight D. Eisenhower (with California Senator Richard Nixon as his running mate), in a landslide over the Democratic nominee, Illinois Governor Adlai Stevenson.

zh.s: 1952年加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出32名选举人，代表加利福尼亚州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前盟军最高司令德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与搭档加利福尼亚州联邦参议员理查德·尼克松，以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。

en.t: 1952 Minnesota Secretary of State special election
en.s: The 1952 Minnesota Secretary of State special election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Acting Secretary of State Virginia Paul Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Melvin Cooper in order te serve out the remainder of Virginia Paul Holm's late husband's term. Paul Holm also won a full term to the office that same day against another candidate.

zh.t: 1952年明尼苏达州州务卿特别选举
zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州州务卿特别选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、时任代理州务卿弗吉尼亚·保罗·霍尔姆击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人梅尔文·库珀，接任霍尔姆已故丈夫的剩余任期。当天，霍尔姆还赢得了州务卿完整任期的选举。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 51.92 percent of the popular vote, against Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1952年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1952年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。来自伊利诺伊州的民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森与联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼组成的组合，以51.92%的普选票赢得西弗吉尼亚州，击败德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Republican candidate, Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国怀俄明州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。怀俄明州支持共和党候选人、哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.s: The 1952 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor, Gordon Browning was defeated in the primary by Frank G. Clement. In the general election, Clement defeated Republican nominee R. Beecher Witt with 79.4% of the vote. In the primary election, Clement derided Governor Browning as "dishonest, indecent, and immoral," and criticized the state's purchase of an expensive office building in Nashville.

zh.s: 1952年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出下一任州长。民主党现任州长戈登·布朗宁在初选中败给弗兰克·G·克莱门特。克莱门特随后在大选中以79.4%的得票率击败共和党候选人R·比彻·维特。民主党初选期间，克莱门特指责布朗宁“欺诈、不正派、不道德”，并批评州政府在纳什维尔购买昂贵办公楼。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic Senator Herbert O'Conor chose not to seek re-election for a second term. Republican U.S. Representative James Glenn Beall defeated Democrat George P. Mahoney to win the open seat. This was the first time since 1928 that a Republican was elected to the Class 1 Senate seat in Maryland.

zh.t: 1952年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年马里兰州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员赫伯特·奥康纳决定不竞选连任第二个任期。共和党联邦众议员詹姆斯·格伦·比尔击败民主党人乔治·P·马奥尼，赢得这个空缺席位。这是自1928年以来，共和党首次当选马里兰州第一类联邦参议员席位。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1952年美国北达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1952年美国北达科他州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。北达科他州支持哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 50.71 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 49.14 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年密苏里州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，代表该州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在密苏里州获胜，获得50.71%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得49.14%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic Senator and President pro tempore of the Senate Kenneth D. McKellar ran for re-election to a seventh term in office but was defeated in the Democratic primary by U.S. Representative Al Gore Sr. Gore easily won the general election against Republican Hobart Atkins.

zh.t: 1952年田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年田纳西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员、参议院临时议长肯尼思·D·麦凯勒竞选第七个任期，但在民主党初选中败给联邦众议员老阿尔·戈尔。戈尔随后在大选中轻松击败共和党人霍巴特·阿特金斯。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose 20 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国密歇根州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出20名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。密歇根州支持哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 68.77 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 30.50 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年堪萨斯州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，代表堪萨斯州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在堪萨斯州获胜，获得68.77%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得30.50%的普选票。

en.s: The 1952 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Charles J. Warner, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee A. Clifford Anderson, a political newcomer, to win his third term as lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 1952年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1952年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任副州长查尔斯·J·华纳击败民主党候选人、政坛新人A·克利福德·安德森，赢得第三个副州长任期。

en.s: The 1952 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic Governor Sid McMath was defeated in the Democratic primary. Democratic nominee Francis Cherry defeated Republican nominee Jefferson W. Speck with 87.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年阿肯色州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长西德·麦克马思在民主党初选中落败。民主党候选人弗朗西斯·切里以87.41%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰斐逊·W·斯佩克。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Senator Spessard Holland was easily re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.t: 1952年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员斯佩萨德·霍兰轻松当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1952 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952, and featured former Lieutenant Governor Robert B. Crosby, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former state Senator Walter R. Raecke.

zh.s: 1952年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党人、前副州长罗伯特·B·克罗斯比击败民主党候选人、前州参议员沃尔特·R·雷克，赢得选举。

en.s: The 1952 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Democratic incumbent James T. Blair Jr. defeated Republican nominee Henry Arthur with 53.16% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年密苏里州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任副州长小詹姆斯·T·布莱尔以53.16%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨利·阿瑟。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 69.15% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 30.85% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年内布拉斯加州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，代表内布拉斯加州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在内布拉斯加州获胜，获得69.15%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得30.85%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, General Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国缅因州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；当时美国48个州都参加了选举。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、将军德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic senator Joseph C. O'Mahoney ran for his fourth consecutive term. He faced a strong challenge from Republican governor Frank A. Barrett, and faced difficult headwinds as Dwight D. Eisenhower, the Republican nominee for president, was winning Wyoming in a landslide over Democratic nominee Adlai Stevenson.

zh.t: 1952年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任参议员约瑟夫·C·奥马奥尼竞选连任，争取连续第四个任期。他遭到共和党籍州长弗兰克·A·巴雷特的强劲挑战；与此同时，共和党总统候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔以压倒性优势赢得怀俄明州，民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森落败。

en.s: The 1952 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Republican nominee George N. Craig defeated Democratic nominee John A. Watkins with 55.68% of the vote. Craig and Handley became the first gubernatorial ticket in Indiana history to receive more than one million votes.

zh.s: 1952年印第安纳州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人乔治·N·克雷格以55.68%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·A·沃特金斯。克雷格与副州长候选人汉德利成为印第安纳州历史上首个获得超过100万张选票的州长竞选搭档。

en.s: The 1952 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democrat Frank Lausche defeated Republican nominee Charles Phelps Taft II with 55.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长弗兰克·劳舍以55.90%的得票率击败共和党候选人查尔斯·菲尔普斯·塔夫脱二世。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with Senator Richard Nixon, with 51.75% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator John Sparkman, with 47.88% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1952年特拉华州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，代表特拉华州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在特拉华州获胜，获得51.75%的普选票；民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员约翰·斯帕克曼搭档，获得47.88%的普选票。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Republican Edward John Thye defeated Democratic challenger Bill Carlson to win a second term.

zh.t: 1952年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员爱德华·约翰·泰再次当选，击败民主党挑战者比尔·卡尔森，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1952 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Democratic nominee Daniel T. McCarty defeated Republican nominee Harry S. Swan with 74.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1952年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人丹尼尔·T·麦卡蒂以74.83%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈里·S·斯旺。

en.s: The 1952 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democrat Dennis J. Roberts defeated Republican nominee Raoul Archambault Jr. with 52.62% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 24, 1952.

zh.s: 1952年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长丹尼斯·J·罗伯茨以52.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人小拉乌尔·阿尚博。初选于1952年9月24日举行。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 4, 1952. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John Pastore was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.t: 1952年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员约翰·帕斯托雷再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by Columbia University President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–New York), running with California Senator Richard Nixon, with 60.54% of the popular vote, carrying every county in the state except Columbia.

zh.s: 1952年俄勒冈州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1952年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，代表俄勒冈州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（共和党，纽约州）与加利福尼亚州联邦参议员理查德·尼克松搭档，在俄勒冈州获胜，赢得全州除哥伦比亚县外的所有县，获得60.54%的普选票。

en.s: The 1952 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1952, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Allan L. Johnson.

zh.t: 1952年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任总检察长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人艾伦·L·约翰逊。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The United States Senate election in Washington of 1952 was held on November 4, 1952. Incumbent and highly-controversial Republican Harry Cain ran for a second term in office, but was defeated by Democratic U.S. Representative Henry M. Jackson. Jackson would come to serve 30 years as a United States Senator, and this would be his only election to the Senate in which he lost any of the state's counties.

zh.t: 1952年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1952年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。备受争议的共和党现任参议员哈里·凯恩竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党联邦众议员小亨利·M·杰克逊。杰克逊后来担任联邦参议员30年；这是他任职期间唯一一次输掉华盛顿州某个县的参议院选举。

en.s: The 1952 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1952, between incumbent governor Arthur B. Langlie of the Republican Party and U.S. Representative Hugh Mitchell of the Democratic Party. Langlie won the general election, becoming the first Washington state governor to be elected to a third term. This is most recent gubernatorial election in which a Republican carried Jefferson County.

zh.s: 1952年华盛顿州州长选举于11月4日举行，共和党现任州长亚瑟·B·兰利对阵民主党联邦众议员休·米切尔。兰利赢得大选，成为华盛顿州历史上首位当选第三个任期的州长。这是共和党州长候选人最近一次赢得杰斐逊县的选举。

en.t: 1952 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1952 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 1952, as part of the 1952 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Alabama Senator John Sparkman, with 69.66% of the popular vote, against Columbia University President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1952年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。来自伊利诺伊州的民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森与阿拉巴马州联邦参议员约翰·斯帕克曼组成的组合，以69.66%的普选票赢得佐治亚州，击败哥伦比亚大学校长德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔。

en.t: 1952 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1952 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 4. Incumbent Republican Senator Irving M. Ives was re-elected to a second term in office over Democrat John Cashmore with a then-record margin of victory.

zh.s: 1952年纽约州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员欧文·M·艾夫斯击败民主党候选人约翰·卡什莫尔，连任第二个任期，获胜优势创下当时的纪录。

en.t: Robert A. Lovett, United States Secretary of Defense, issued a memorandum establishing the National Security Agency, with responsibility for all communications intelligence for the government
en.s: The National Security Agency (NSA) is an intelligence agency of the United States Department of Defense, under the authority of the director of national intelligence (DNI). The NSA is responsible for global monitoring, collection, and processing of information and data for intelligence and counterintelligence purposes, specializing in a discipline known as signals intelligence (SIGINT). The NSA is also tasked with the protection of U.S. communications networks and information systems.

zh.t: 国防部长罗伯特·A·洛维特签署备忘录，设立美国国家安全局
zh.s: 美国国家安全局（NSA）是美国国防部下属情报机构，受国家情报总监领导。该局负责全球范围内情报与反情报所需的信息和数据监测、收集及处理，专长领域称为信号情报。该局还负责保护美国的通信网络和信息系统。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1958
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent United States Senator Mike Mansfield, who was first elected to the Senate in 1952, ran for re-election. Mansfield won the Democratic primary comfortably, and moved on to the general election, where he was opposed by Lou W. Welch, a millworker and the Republican nominee. In contrast to the close campaign in 1952, Mansfield defeated Welch in a landslide and won his second term in the Senate easily.

zh.t: 1958年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于1958年11月4日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员迈克·曼斯菲尔德竞选连任。他在民主党初选中轻松胜出，随后在大选中对阵工人路易·W·韦尔奇。与1952年的激烈竞争不同，曼斯菲尔德以明显优势击败韦尔奇，轻松赢得第二个参议员任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1958
en.s: The 1958 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 4, 1958. The incumbent, Republican and former Non-Partisan League (NPL) Senator William Langer, was re-elected to a fourth term, defeating North Dakota Democratic NPL Party (Dem-NPL) candidate Raymond G. Vendsel. Only Langer filed as a Republican, and the endorsed Democratic-NPL candidate was Raymond G. Vendsel. Langer and Vendsel won the primary elections for their respective parties. Two independent candidates, Arthur C. Townley and Custer Solem, also filed before the deadline but had minimal impact on the outcome of the election, totaling less than 3,000 votes combined.

zh.t: 1958年北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于1958年11月4日举行。共和党籍现任参议员、前无党派联盟成员威廉·兰格再次当选，开始第四个任期，击败北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟候选人雷蒙德·G·文德塞尔。兰格是唯一登记参选的共和党人，民主党—无党派联盟提名文德塞尔。两人分别赢得本党初选。另有两名独立候选人亚瑟·C·汤利和卡斯特·索勒姆在截止日期前报名，但两人总共只获得不到3,000票，对结果影响很小。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1958
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1958 in Massachusetts was held on November 4, 1958. Democratic incumbent John F. Kennedy was reelected to a second six-year term.

zh.t: 1958年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约翰·F·肯尼迪成功连任第二个六年任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1958 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. Ernest Hollings won the Democratic primary against rival Donald S. Russell and ran unopposed in the general election becoming the 106th governor.

zh.s: 1958年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。欧内斯特·霍林斯赢得民主党初选，对手是唐纳德·S·拉塞尔；他在大选中没有对手，成为该州第106任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1958
en.s: The 1958 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 1958 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary election in the 2nd congressional district was held on June 10. All six incumbents were re-elected and the composition of the state delegation remained solely Democratic.

zh.t: 1958年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1958年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出六名联邦众议员，任期两年。第二国会选区的初选于6月10日举行。六名现任议员全部连任，该州代表团仍全部由民主党人组成。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1958 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1958. Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party candidate Orville Freeman defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger George MacKinnon.

zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月4日举行。明尼苏达州民主党—农民—劳工党候选人奥维尔·弗里曼击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人乔治·麦金农。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1958
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Senator Harry F. Byrd, Sr. was re-elected to a fifth term after defeating Independent Louise Wensel and Social Democrat Clarke Robb.

zh.t: 1958年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员哈里·F·伯德成功当选第五个任期，击败独立候选人路易丝·温塞尔和社会民主党候选人克拉克·罗布。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Nevada, 1958
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator George W. Malone ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by Democrat Howard Cannon.

zh.t: 1958年内华达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年内华达州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员乔治·W·马龙竞选第三个任期，但败给民主党人霍华德·坎农。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1958 took place on November 4, 1958.

zh.s: 1958年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Connecticut, 1958
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1958 in Connecticut was held on November 4, 1958. Democratic Thomas J. Dodd defeated incumbent senator William A. Purtell who ran for a second term.

zh.t: 1958年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年康涅狄格州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党人托马斯·J·多德击败寻求连任的现任参议员威廉·A·珀特尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1958
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Edward Martin did not seek re-election. The Republican nominee, Hugh Scott, defeated Democratic nominee George M. Leader for the vacant seat.

zh.t: 1958年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员爱德华·马丁没有竞选连任。共和党候选人休·斯科特击败民主党候选人乔治·M·利德，赢得空缺席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Oregon gubernatorial election of 1958 took place on November 4, 1958. Republican nominee Mark Hatfield defeated Democratic incumbent Robert D. Holmes to win the election.

zh.s: 1958年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人马克·哈特菲尔德击败民主党籍现任州长罗伯特·D·霍姆斯，赢得选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1958
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Ralph Flanders did not run for re-election to another term in the United States Senate. Republican candidate Winston L. Prouty defeated Democratic candidate Frederick J. Fayette to succeed him.

zh.t: 1958年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1958年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任参议员拉尔夫·弗兰德斯没有竞选连任。共和党候选人温斯顿·L·普劳蒂击败民主党候选人弗雷德里克·J·费耶特，接替他担任参议员。

en.s: The 1958 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Price Daniel was reelected a second term, winning 88% of the vote to Republican Edwin Mayer's 12%.

zh.s: 1958年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长普赖斯·丹尼尔成功连任第二个任期，获得88%的选票；共和党人埃德温·迈耶获得12%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1958 took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Joseph B. Johnson did not run for re-election to a third term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Robert Stafford defeated Democratic candidate Bernard J. Leddy to succeed him.

zh.s: 1958年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长约瑟夫·B·约翰逊没有竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人罗伯特·斯塔福德击败民主党候选人伯纳德·J·莱迪，接替他担任州长。
