en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1958
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1958 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1958. Democrats picked up three seats, taking a majority of the delegation, which they would keep ever since except for a brief tie with the Republicans in the 104th Congress.

zh.t: 1958年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1958年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。民主党新增三个席位，成为代表团多数党。此后民主党一直保持多数，只有在第104届国会期间曾与共和党席位数相同。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1958, in 34 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 4, 1958 (September 8 in Maine, November 25 in Alaska). Alaska held its first gubernatorial election on achieving statehood. In Colorado, Maine and Ohio, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term.

zh.s: 1958年美国有34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同期举行，主要日期为1958年11月4日；缅因州于9月8日、阿拉斯加州于11月25日举行选举。阿拉斯加建州后首次举行州长选举。科罗拉多州、缅因州和俄亥俄州首次选出任期四年的州长，此前州长任期为两年。

en.s: The 1958 Connecticut lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican lieutenant-governor Charles W. Jewett chose not to seek re-election to a second term. Democrat John N. Dempsey defeated Republican nominee Stephen J. Sweeney with 58.8% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年康涅狄格州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任副州长查尔斯·W·朱厄特决定不竞选连任第二个任期。民主党人约翰·N·登普西以58.8%的得票率击败共和党候选人斯蒂芬·J·斯威尼。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate special election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate special election in West Virginia was held on November 4, 1958, concurrent with a regular election. The election was called due to the death of Senator Matthew M. Neely. Democrats Randolph and Byrd both won their seats, amid a national wave election. This would be the last time that Democrats simultaneously flipped both of a state's Senate seats until Georgia's elections in 2020 and 2021, and the last for either party until the 1978 elections in Minnesota.

zh.t: 1958年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1958年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行，与常规选举同时进行。参议员马修·M·尼利去世后，州内举行这次特别选举。民主党候选人兰道夫和伯德都赢得席位，当时民主党在全国掀起选举浪潮。这是民主党首次同时赢得该州两个参议员席位；直到2020年和2021年佐治亚州选举才再次发生。对任何政党来说，这是1978年明尼苏达州选举以来，最后一次同时赢得该州两个参议员席位。

en.s: The 1958 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Edwin L. Mechem ran for reelection to a fourth term against Democrat John Burroughs. Burroughs narrowly defeated Mechem in the state's closest gubernatorial election since 1924. Mechem was the last Republican to carry Guadalupe County until Susana Martinez in 2010.

zh.s: 1958年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州长。共和党现任州长埃德温·L·米彻姆竞选连任第四个任期，但民主党人约翰·伯勒斯以微弱优势击败他。这是该州自1924年以来差距最小的一次州长选举。直到苏珊娜·马丁内斯在2010年获胜，瓜达卢佩县才再次由共和党州长候选人拿下。

en.s: The 1958 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 4, 1958, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. Across the 35 districts, only one, District 13 in Jefferson County, was actually at stake in the November general election. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1958年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出35名州参议员，任期四年。在35个选区中，只有杰斐逊县第13选区的席位需要在11月大选中角逐。由于民主党当时在该州占主导地位，州议会席位通常在民主党初选中决定。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 4, 1958. Outgoing Senator William E. Jenner, a Republican, retired and was succeeded by Democrat Vance Hartke, the mayor of Evansville, Indiana. Hartke defeated Harold W. Handley, the conservative Governor of Indiana and a close friend of Jenner. This was one of 15 seats held by Republicans gained by the Democratic Party in the 1958 United States Senate elections.

zh.t: 1958年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。即将卸任的共和党参议员威廉·E·詹纳退休，由民主党人、埃文斯维尔市长万斯·哈特克接替。哈特克击败了保守派共和党候选人、印第安纳州州长哈罗德·W·汉德利；汉德利还是詹纳的好友。这是1958年联邦参议院选举中，民主党从共和党手中赢得的15个席位之一。

en.t: 1958 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1958 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 86th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 4, 1958, in the middle of Dwight Eisenhower's second presidential term, while Maine held theirs on September 8.

zh.s: 1958年美国联邦众议员选举旨在选出第86届联邦国会众议员，大部分于1958年11月4日举行。选举在德怀特·艾森豪威尔第二个总统任期中期举行，缅因州则于9月8日举行选举。

en.s: The 1958 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democratic Governor Orval Faubus won election to an unprecedented third term, defeating Republican nominee George W. Johnson with 82.47% of the vote. Faubus surged in popularity after denying the Little Rock Nine entrance to Central High School with the use of the Arkansas National Guard on September 4, 1957.

zh.s: 1958年阿肯色州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以82.47%的得票率击败共和党候选人乔治·W·约翰逊，当选史无前例的第三个任期。1957年9月4日，福布斯动用阿肯色州国民警卫队，阻止小石城九人进入中央高中；此后他的支持率大幅上升。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Senator Roman Hruska, who was first elected in a 1954 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. He was challenged in the general election by attorney Frank B. Morrison, the Democratic nominee. Despite nationwide Democratic gains, Hruska comfortably won re-election, receiving 56% of the vote to Morrison's 44%.

zh.t: 1958年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员罗曼·胡鲁斯卡于1954年特别选举中首次当选，此次竞选完整任期。他在大选中面对民主党候选人、律师弗兰克·B·莫里森。尽管民主党在全国取得进展，胡鲁斯卡仍以56%对44%的得票率轻松连任。

en.s: The 1958 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent President of the Maryland Senate Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee John A. Derr.

zh.s: 1958年马里兰州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、马里兰州参议院现任议长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦击败共和党候选人约翰·A·德尔。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Senator Stuart Symington was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.t: 1958年密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年密苏里州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员斯图尔特·赛明顿再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1958 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Frank G. Clement was ineligible to run for re-election, as the Constitution of Tennessee prohibited governors from serving consecutive terms at the time. Democratic nominee Buford Ellington defeated former governor, Independent Jim Nance McCord, and Republican opponent Tom Wall with 57.5% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出下一任州长。由于当时田纳西州宪法禁止州长连续任职，民主党现任州长弗兰克·G·克莱门特不能竞选连任。民主党候选人布福德·艾灵顿以57.5%的得票率击败前州长、独立候选人吉姆·南斯·麦科德和共和党候选人汤姆·沃尔。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 4, 1958. After fending off a primary challenge from former senator Claude Pepper, the incumbent senator Spessard Holland was easily re-elected to a third term in office.

zh.t: 1958年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员斯佩萨德·霍兰击退前参议员克劳德·佩珀的初选挑战后，轻松当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 1958 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee George A. Farr.

zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、现任审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人乔治·A·法尔。

en.s: The 1958 Alabama gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat Jim Folsom was term limited and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.t: 1958年美国阿拉巴马州州长选举
zh.s: 1958年美国阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任州长吉姆·福尔瑟姆受任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat William Proxmire, who had won a special election to finish the term of the late Senator Joe McCarthy, was re-elected to a full term in office over Wisconsin Supreme Court Justice Roland J. Steinle, a Republican.

zh.t: 1958年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员威廉·普罗克斯迈尔此前在特别选举中当选，接替已故参议员乔·麦卡锡；此次他击败共和党候选人、威斯康星州最高法院法官罗兰·J·斯坦尔，成功当选完整任期。

en.s: The 1958 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat Abraham Ribicoff defeated Republican nominee Fred R. Zeller with 62.29% of the vote. Ribicoff's margin of victory also allowed Democrats to take control of the malapportioned House of Representatives for the first time since 1876.

zh.s: 1958年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长亚伯拉罕·里比科夫以62.29%的得票率击败共和党候选人弗雷德·R·泽勒。里比科夫的胜利优势还帮助民主党控制了席位分配不均的州众议院，这是自1876年以来的首次。

en.s: The 1958 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 1958. Voters elected members of the Arizona House of Representatives in all 80 of the state's House districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1958.

zh.s: 1958年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在该州全部80个众议院选区选出议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时举行。初选于1958年9月9日举行。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ralph Yarborough won a competitive primary against former Senator William Blakley and handily defeated newspaper publisher Roy Whittenburg in the general election.

zh.t: 1958年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员拉尔夫·亚伯勒在初选中击败前参议员威廉·布莱克利，随后在大选中轻松击败报社出版人罗伊·惠滕伯格。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John Pastore successfully sought re-election, defeating Republican Bayard Ewing in a repeat of their 1952 race.

zh.t: 1958年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员约翰·帕斯托雷成功连任，击败共和党人贝亚德·尤因；两人曾在1952年选举中交手。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in California was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent senator William F. Knowland opted not to run for re-election, choosing instead to run for election as governor. Incumbent governor Goodwin Knight exchanged places with Knowland and lost to U.S. Representative Clair Engle in the midst of a national landslide for the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1958年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员威廉·F·诺兰德决定不竞选连任，转而竞选州长。时任州长古德温·奈特和诺兰德互换竞选职位；在民主党席卷全国的选举中，奈特败给联邦众议员克莱尔·恩格尔。

en.s: The 1958 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat Herschel C. Loveless defeated Republican nominee William G. Murray with 54.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长赫歇尔·C·洛夫莱斯以54.13%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·G·默里。

en.s: The 1958 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat George Docking defeated Republican nominee Clyde M. Reed Jr. with 56.46% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长乔治·道金以56.46%的得票率击败共和党候选人小克莱德·M·里德。

en.s: The 1958 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Democratic nominee J. Millard Tawes defeated Republican nominee James Devereux with 63.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年马里兰州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人J·米勒德·陶斯以63.55%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·德弗罗。

en.s: The 1958 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Karl Rolvaag of the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Bernard E. Ericsson.

zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党—农民—劳工党现任副州长卡尔·罗尔瓦格击败共和党候选人伯纳德·E·埃里克森。

en.s: The 1958 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general C. Ferdinand Sybert defeated Republican nominee Robert A. Wallace.

zh.s: 1958年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长C·费迪南德·西伯特击败共和党候选人罗伯特·A·华莱士。

en.s: The 1958 Arizona Senate election was held on November 4, 1958. Voters elected all 28 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. At the time, each of Arizona's 14 counties elected two state senators for a total of 28 members of the Arizona Senate. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1958. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a supermajority of 26 seats over the Republicans' 2 seats.

zh.s: 1958年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出州参议院全部28个席位，议员任期两年。当时该州14个县各选出两名州参议员。初选于1958年9月9日举行。选举前，民主党在州参议院占据26席，对共和党的2席，拥有绝对多数。

en.s: The 1958 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Dwight Burney, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Frank Sorrell. On September 9, 1960, Nebraska Governor Ralph G. Brooks died while in office. This caused Dwight Burney, who as a result of this election was the lieutenant governor, to become Governor of Nebraska.

zh.t: 1958年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1958年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任副州长德怀特·伯尼击败民主党候选人弗兰克·索雷尔。1960年9月9日，内布拉斯加州州长拉尔夫·G·布鲁克斯在任内去世；伯尼因在这次选举中当选副州长，随后接任州长。

en.s: The 1958 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Haskell Holman defeated Republican nominee Meredith Garten.

zh.s: 1958年密苏里州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长哈斯克尔·霍尔曼击败共和党候选人梅雷迪思·加滕。

en.s: The 1958 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958, and featured school superintendent Ralph Brooks, a Democrat, narrowly defeating incumbent Republican governor Victor Anderson, becoming the first Democrat to win the governorship since 1938.

zh.s: 1958年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党人、学校学监拉尔夫·布鲁克斯以微弱优势击败共和党现任州长维克托·安德森。布鲁克斯成为自1938年以来首位当选州长的民主党人。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Senator Charles E. Potter was defeated in his bid for re-election to a second term by Lieutenant Governor Philip A. Hart. This was one of a record 15 seats Democrats gained from the Republican Party. This was the first time since 1857 that Democrats held both Senate seats in the state simultaneously.

zh.t: 1958年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员查尔斯·E·波特竞选连任第二个任期，但败给副州长菲利普·A·哈特。这是1958年民主党从共和党手中赢得的创纪录15个席位之一。自1857年以来，这是民主党首次同时掌控该州两个参议员席位。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John J. Williams was re-elected to a third term in office over Democratic former Governor Elbert Carvel.

zh.t: 1958年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年特拉华州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员约翰·J·威廉斯击败民主党人、前州长埃尔伯特·卡维尔，再次当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 1958 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat G. Mennen Williams defeated Republican nominee Paul D. Bagwell with 53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长G·梅嫩·威廉斯以53%的得票率击败共和党候选人保罗·D·巴格韦尔。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Senator H. Alexander Smith chose not to seek a third term in office. Democratic former U.S. Representative Harrison Williams won the open seat over U.S. Representative Robert Kean. Primary elections were held on April 15. Kean defeated Eisenhower aide Bernard M. Shanley and Robert J.

zh.t: 1958年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。时任参议员H·亚历山大·史密斯决定不竞选第三个任期。民主党籍前联邦众议员哈里森·威廉斯击败联邦众议员罗伯特·基恩，赢得这一空缺席位。初选于4月15日举行。

en.t: 1958 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi
en.s: The 1958 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi were held on November 4, 1958, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Mississippi, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the United States Senate election. Primary elections were held August 26. All six Democratic nominees were elected unopposed in the general election, with two facing primary elections.

zh.t: 1958年密西西比州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1958年密西西比州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行，选出该州六个国会选区各一名联邦众议员。选举与联邦参议员选举同时举行，初选于8月26日举行。六名民主党候选人均在大选中无人反对而当选，其中两人还经历了初选。

en.s: The 1958 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Democratic nominee Glenn M. Anderson narrowly defeated incumbent Republican Harold J. Powers with 50.87% of the vote.

zh.t: 1958年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1958年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人格伦·M·安德森以50.87%的得票率险胜共和党现任副州长哈罗德·J·鲍尔斯。

en.s: The 1958 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Miles Lord defeated Republican nominee Gaylord A. Saetre.

zh.t: 1958年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任总检察长迈尔斯·洛德击败共和党候选人盖洛德·A·塞特里。

en.s: The 1958 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 4, 1958, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Republican Attorney General John J. Bracken did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee Albert L. Coles defeated Republican nominee Simon S. Cohen. As of 2026, this was the last time the Attorney General's office of Connecticut changed partisan control.

zh.t: 1958年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1958年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党现任总检察长约翰·J·布拉肯决定不竞选连任。民主党候选人艾伯特·L·科尔斯击败共和党候选人西蒙·S·科恩。截至2026年，这是康涅狄格州总检察长职位最近一次更换党派。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Ohio was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent senator John W. Bricker was defeated in his bid for a third term by former U.S. representative Stephen M. Young. This was one of a record 15 seats Democrats gained from the Republican Party in 1958.

zh.t: 1958年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员约翰·W·布里克竞选第三个任期，但败给联邦众议员前任斯蒂芬·M·扬。这是民主党在1958年联邦参议员选举中从共和党手中赢得的创纪录15个席位之一。

en.s: The 1958 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Charles H. Russell ran unsuccessfully for re-election to a third term as Governor of Nevada. He was defeated by Democratic nominee Grant Sawyer with 59.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年内华达州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长查尔斯·H·罗素竞选第三个任期，但未能连任。他以59.92%的得票率败给民主党候选人格兰特·索耶。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 4, 1958. Democrat Albert Gore Sr. was re-elected to a second term. Gore survived a primary challenge from former Governor Prentice Cooper and easily defeated Republican Hobart Atkins in the general election.

zh.t: 1958年田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年田纳西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党人老阿尔·戈尔再次当选，赢得第二个任期。戈尔在初选中击败前州长普伦蒂斯·库珀，随后在大选中轻松击败共和党人霍巴特·阿特金斯。

en.s: The 1958 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. In a rematch of the controversially decided 1956 election, Republican nominee Christopher Del Sesto defeated Democratic incumbent Dennis J. Roberts with 50.90% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 17, 1958. Roberts survived a primary challenge from Lieutenant Governor Armand H. Cote with 56.1% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。这是1956年那场结果引发争议的选举重赛。共和党候选人克里斯托弗·德尔·塞斯托以50.90%的得票率击败民主党现任州长丹尼斯·J·罗伯茨。初选于1958年9月17日举行；罗伯茨在初选中以56.1%的得票率击败副州长阿尔芒·H·科特的挑战。

en.s: The 1958 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Democratic nominee Michael DiSalle defeated incumbent Republican C. William O'Neill in a rematch of the 1956 election with 56.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人迈克尔·迪萨尔以56.92%的得票率击败共和党现任州长C·威廉·奥尼尔。这是两人在1956年选举后的再次交锋。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in New Mexico took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democratic Senator Dennis Chávez won re-election to a fifth term.

zh.t: 1958年新墨西哥州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年新墨西哥州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员丹尼斯·查韦斯连任，开始第五个任期。

en.s: The 1958 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joseph L. Donovan defeated Republican nominee L. C. Andersen.

zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任州务卿约瑟夫·L·多诺万击败共和党候选人L·C·安德森。

en.s: The 1958 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican John E. Davis defeated Democratic nominee John F. Lord with 53.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长约翰·E·戴维斯以53.10%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·F·洛德。

en.s: The 1958 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat Stephen McNichols defeated Republican nominee Palmer Burch with 58.41% of the vote. In 1956, Colorado voters had approved Ballot Measure 1, extending the terms for state executive officers from two years to four years. Thus, McNichols became the first governor in the state's history elected to a four-year term.

zh.s: 1958年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长斯蒂芬·麦克尼科尔斯以58.41%的得票率击败共和党候选人帕尔默·伯奇。1956年，科罗拉多州选民通过第1号提案，将州行政官员的任期从两年延长至四年。麦克尼科尔斯因此成为该州历史上首位经选举获得四年任期的州长。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater ran for reelection to a second term, and defeated former U.S. Senator, and then-Governor, Ernest McFarland in the general election. The election was a rematch from 1952, where Goldwater defeated McFarland by a narrow margin. Goldwater had attributed the 1952 win to the unpopularity of President Harry S.

zh.t: 1958年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特竞选连任，争取第二个任期，并在大选中击败前联邦参议员、时任州长欧内斯特·麦克法兰。这是两人继1952年之后再次交手；当年戈德华特以微弱优势击败麦克法兰。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 4, 1958, in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 9, 1958.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1958年11月4日举行大选，内容包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和审计长等全州职位选举，也包括联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长顾问委员会成员等选区职位选举，以及州和地方的公投提案。民主党和共和党候选人分别通过1958年9月9日举行的党内初选产生。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Senator Frank A. Barrett ran for re-election to his second term. He was challenged by Gale W. McGee, a University of Wyoming professor and the Democratic nominee. Despite the state's strong Republican lean, McGee ran an energetic campaign against Barrett, earning the support of the national Democratic establishment.

zh.t: 1958年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍时任参议员弗兰克·A·巴雷特竞选连任，争取第二个任期。民主党提名的对手是怀俄明大学教授盖尔·W·麦吉。尽管怀俄明州长期倾向共和党，麦吉仍积极竞选，获得民主党全国组织的支持。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Mississippi took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John C. Stennis was re-elected to a third term in office. Because Stennis was unopposed in the general election, his victory in the August 26 primary was tantamount to election. Stennis was also unopposed in the primary.

zh.t: 1958年密西西比州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年密西西比州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员约翰·C·斯坦尼斯再次当选，赢得第三个任期。斯坦尼斯在大选中没有对手，因此他在8月26日初选中的胜利就意味着当选；他在初选中也无人挑战。

en.s: The 1958 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat J. Howard Edmondson defeated Republican Phil Ferguson and Independent D. A. 'Jelly' Bryce. Edmondson's landslide saw him win every county and achieve the highest share of the popular vote in any gubernatorial election in Oklahoma's history. This is one of two gubernatorial elections in Oklahoma in which the winner has carried every county.

zh.s: 1958年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党人J·霍华德·埃德蒙森击败共和党人菲尔·弗格森和独立候选人D·A·“果冻”·布莱斯，赢得州长选举。他以压倒性优势赢得全州所有县，并创下该州州长候选人普选票占比最高纪录。这是俄克拉何马州州长选举中仅有的两次胜选者赢得全州所有县的选举之一。

en.s: The 1958 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. The Democratic nominee, state senator Gaylord A. Nelson, defeated the Republican incumbent governor, Vernon W. Thomson, receiving 53.59% of the vote. This was the first Democratic victory in a Wisconsin gubernatorial election since 1932, and only the second since 1892. Nelson's share of the vote was the highest for a Democrat since 1873.

zh.s: 1958年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人、州参议员盖洛德·A·纳尔逊击败共和党现任州长弗农·W·汤姆森，获得53.59%的选票。这是自1932年以来民主党首次赢得威斯康星州州长选举，也是自1892年以来第二次。纳尔逊的得票率是自1873年以来民主党候选人中最高的。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 4, 1958. In 1956, Senator Harley M. Kilgore died, and former Senator Chapman Revercomb won this seat in the 1956 special election. The election was held alongside the 1958 midterms, where Republicans had a net loss nationally. Revercomb lost re-election to incumbent Representative Robert Byrd.

zh.t: 1958年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。参议员哈雷·M·基尔戈于1956年去世，前参议员查普曼·雷弗科姆在1956年特别选举中赢得这个席位。这次选举与1958年中期选举同时举行，当时共和党在全国席位净减少。雷弗科姆竞选连任失败，败给现任联邦众议员罗伯特·伯德。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 4, 1958. Primaries were held April 8, 1958.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1958年11月4日（星期二）举行选举，初选于当年4月8日举行。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Senator Arthur V. Watkins was defeated by Salt Lake County Attorney Frank Moss in a three-way race that also included former Governor J. Bracken Lee running as an independent. This was one of a record twelve Senate seats Democrats gained from the Republican Party in 1958.

zh.s: 1958年犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员阿瑟·V·沃特金斯在三人角逐中败给盐湖县地方检察官弗兰克·莫斯；前州长J·布雷肯·李也以独立候选人身份参选。这是民主党在1958年从共和党手中赢得的创纪录12个参议院席位之一。

en.s: The 1958 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Governor Ernest McFarland decided not to run for reelection and instead unsuccessfully challenged U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater in attempt to return to the United States Senate. Republican businessman Paul Fannin defeated Arizona Attorney General Robert Morrison in the general election, and was sworn into his first term as Governor on January 5, 1959, becoming Arizona's eleventh Governor.

zh.s: 1958年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长欧内斯特·麦克法兰决定不竞选连任，转而挑战联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特，但未能当选参议员。共和党商人保罗·范宁在大选中击败亚利桑那州总检察长罗伯特·莫里森，并于1959年1月5日宣誓就任首个州长任期，成为亚利桑那州第十一任州长。

en.s: The 1958 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Governor Milward Simpson ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by John J. Hickey, the former U.S. Attorney for the District of Wyoming and the Democratic nominee. Following a close campaign, Hickey narrowly defeated Simpson for re-election, winning just a narrow plurality because of a third-party candidate in the race.

zh.s: 1958年怀俄明州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长米尔沃德·辛普森竞选连任第二个任期，对手是民主党候选人、怀俄明联邦地区检察官约翰·J·希基。竞选十分接近，希基最终以微弱多数击败辛普森；由于另有第三党候选人参选，他只获得微弱的相对多数。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 1958. Democratic U.S. Representative Eugene McCarthy defeated incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Edward John Thye, who sought a third term. With his victory, McCarthy became the first Democrat ever to be popularly elected to Minnesota's Class 1 Senate seat, and marked the first time since 1859 that Democrats held both Senate seats in the state.

zh.t: 1958年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党联邦众议员尤金·麦卡锡击败寻求第三个任期的共和党现任联邦参议员爱德华·约翰·泰。麦卡锡获胜后，成为首位由普选当选明尼苏达州第一类参议员席位的民主党人；自1859年以来，该州的两个参议员席位也首次同时由民主党掌握。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate special election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate special election in North Carolina was held on November 4, 1958. Interim Democratic Senator B. Everett Jordan was elected to complete the unexpired term of Senator W. Kerr Scott, who had died in April.

zh.t: 1958年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1958年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员特别选举于11月4日举行。临时接任的民主党参议员B·埃弗里特·乔丹当选，完成参议员W·克尔·斯科特于4月去世后留下的剩余任期。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 4, 1958. Senator James Glenn Beall narrowly defeated Baltimore Mayor Thomas D'Alesandro for re-election to a second term. Beall's victory came despite a national landslide for Senate Democrats.

zh.t: 1958年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年马里兰州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。参议员詹姆斯·格伦·比尔以微弱优势击败巴尔的摩市长托马斯·达莱桑德罗，连任第二个任期。尽管共和党在全国范围内大胜参议院选举，比尔仍然获胜。

en.s: The 1958 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Governor Joe Foss was term-limited. Democratic nominee Ralph Herseth defeated Republican nominee Phil Saunders with 51.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年南达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长乔·福斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。民主党候选人拉尔夫·赫塞斯以51.40%的得票率击败共和党候选人菲尔·桑德斯。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Republican Senator Irving Ives retired. Republican Representative Kenneth Keating defeated Democrat Frank Hogan to succeed Ives. As of 2024, this is the last time the Republicans won the Class 1 Senate seat in New York.

zh.s: 1958年纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员欧文·艾夫斯退休。共和党联邦众议员肯尼斯·基廷击败民主党人弗兰克·霍根，接替艾夫斯。截至2024年，这是共和党最近一次赢得纽约州第一类参议员席位。

en.s: The 1958 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1958, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee Garland T. Byrd ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1958年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人加兰·T·伯德没有对手，随后当选。

en.t: 1958 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 4, 1958. Incumbent Democrat Henry M. Jackson won a second term in office over Republican William Bantz.

zh.t: 1958年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1958年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员亨利·M·杰克逊击败共和党候选人威廉·班茨，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1958 New York state election was held on November 4, 1958, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a judge of the New York Court of Appeals and a U.S. senator, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1958年纽约州选举于11月4日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、纽约州上诉法院法官和一名联邦参议员，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1958 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Democrat David Lawrence defeated Republican Art McGonigle by a smaller than anticipated margin.

zh.s: 1958年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党人戴维·劳伦斯击败共和党人阿特·麦克冈格尔，获胜优势小于预期。

en.s: The 1958 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 4, to elect the Governor of New Hampshire, Republican candidate Wesley Powell defeated Democratic candidate and formar mayor of Laconia Bernard L. Boutin. with 51.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。共和党候选人韦斯利·鲍威尔以51.65%的选票击败民主党候选人、拉科尼亚前市长伯纳德·L·布廷，当选州长。

en.s: The 1958 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 4. Incumbent Republican Robert E. Smylie defeated Democratic nominee Alfred M. Derr with 50.96% of the vote. Since changing to four-year term for governor beginning with the 1946 election, this was the first time the incumbent was permitted to run for re-election, due to a change in the state's constitution, approved by voters in November 1956.

zh.s: 1958年爱达荷州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·E·斯迈利以50.96%的选票击败民主党候选人阿尔弗雷德·M·德尔。自1946年起州长任期改为四年后，这是州长首次获准竞选连任；这一变化源于选民在1956年11月批准的州宪法修正案。

en.s: The 1958 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1958 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1958 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1958年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的22个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期为四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1958年选举所用的全州50个参议院选区地图。

en.s: The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. It is also abbreviated as the Limited Test Ban Treaty (LTBT) and Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (NTBT), though the latter may also refer to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), which succeeded the PTBT for ratifying parties.
en.n: The United States concludes Operation Fishbowl, its final above-ground nuclear weapons testing series, in anticipation of the 1963 Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty.

zh.s: 《部分禁止核试验条约》（PTBT）的正式名称为《1963年禁止在大气层、外层空间和水下进行核武器试验条约》，禁止除地下试验外的所有核武器试爆。该条约也简称《有限禁止核试验条约》（LTBT）或《禁止核试验条约》（NTBT）；后一个简称有时也指《全面禁止核试验条约》（CTBT），后者对批准该条约的缔约方取代了PTBT。
zh.n: 美国结束“鱼缸行动”——其最后一轮地面以上核武器试验，为1963年《部分禁止核试验条约》作准备。

en.s: The 1966 Venice flood (Italian: Alluvione di Venezia del 1966) was an unprecedented high water, known in Venice as an "acqua alta", with waters reaching up to 194 cm.

zh.s: 1966年威尼斯洪灾造成前所未有的高潮水位；这种洪水在威尼斯称为“acqua alta”。水位最高达到194厘米。

en.t: Iberia Flight 062 crashes in Blackdown, West Sussex, killing all 37 people on board including British actress June Thorburn
en.s: Iberia Flight 062 was a twin-engined Sud Aviation Caravelle registered EC-BDD operating a scheduled flight from Málaga Airport, Spain, to London Heathrow Airport. While on approach to Heathrow on 4 November 1967, the Caravelle descended far below the flight level assigned to it and flew into the southern slope of Blackdown Hill in West Sussex, killing all 37 on board.

zh.t: 伊比利亚航空062号班机在西萨塞克斯郡布莱克当坠毁，机上37人全部遇难，其中包括英国女演员琼·索伯恩
zh.s: 伊比利亚航空062号班机由一架双引擎苏德航空“卡拉维尔”客机执飞，注册号为EC-BDD，按计划从西班牙马拉加机场飞往伦敦希思罗机场。1967年11月4日，客机在飞往希思罗机场途中飞行高度远低于指定高度，撞上西萨塞克斯郡布莱克当山南坡，机上37人全部遇难。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1969 occurred on Tuesday, November 4, 1969, with incumbent Liberal Party Mayor John Lindsay elected to a second term. Lindsay defeated the Democratic candidate, New York City Comptroller Mario Procaccino, and the Republican candidate, state senator John Marchi. Lindsay received 42.36% of the vote to Procaccino's 34.79%, a Liberal victory margin of 7.57%. Marchi finished a distant third with 22.69%. Linsday, a liberal originally elected in 1965 as a Republican with Liberal Party support, had lost the Republican primary to Marchi, but still managed to be re-elected as a Liberal.

zh.s: 1969年纽约市市长选举于1969年11月4日（星期二）举行。自由党籍现任市长约翰·林赛当选连任第二个任期。他击败民主党候选人、纽约市审计长马里奥·普罗卡奇诺，以及共和党候选人、州参议员约翰·马奇。林赛获得42.36%的选票，普罗卡奇诺获得34.79%，自由党领先7.57个百分点；马奇以22.69%远居第三。林赛起初在1965年以共和党人身份参选，并获得自由党支持；此次他在共和党初选中输给马奇，但仍以自由党候选人身份成功连任。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1969 were held on November 4, 1969, in two states, with a January 7 special election held in Maryland. Republicans achieved a net-gain of one in these elections.

zh.s: 美国州长选举于1969年11月4日在两个州举行，马里兰州还于1月7日举行特别选举。共和党净增一个州长席位。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1969 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 4, 1969. The incumbent mayor, Joe Barr of the Democratic Party chose not to run for his third term.

zh.s: 1969年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于11月4日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长乔·巴尔决定不竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1969 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 4, 1969. Republican William T. Cahill defeated Democratic nominee Robert B. Meyner with 59.66% of the vote.

zh.s: 1969年新泽西州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党人威廉·T·卡希尔以59.66%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·B·迈纳。

en.s: The 1969 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1969, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia Senate J. Sargeant Reynolds defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia Senate H. Dunlop Dawbarn, American Independent nominee Samuel J. Breeding Jr. and Conservative nominee Louis A. Brooks Jr.

zh.s: 1969年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州参议员J·萨金特·雷诺兹击败共和党候选人、同为州参议员的H·邓洛普·道伯恩、美国独立党候选人小塞缪尔·J·布里丁和保守党候选人小路易斯·A·布鲁克斯。

en.t: 1969 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 4, 1969 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Francis X. Smith ran for re-election to a full term in office but was defeated by Sanford Garelik, a police officer running on the Republican and Liberal lines. Although Garelik was a registered Democrat, this remains the last time a candidate on the Republican ticket won the election to New York City's second-ranking office.

zh.s: 纽约市于1969年11月4日举行议会议长选举。民主党现任议长弗朗西斯·X·史密斯竞选完整任期，但败给桑福德·加雷利。加雷利是一名警察，以共和党和自由党候选人身份参选。尽管他登记为民主党人，这仍是共和党候选人最近一次赢得纽约市第二高职位。

en.s: The 1969 Detroit mayoral election took place on November 4, 1969. It saw the election of Roman Gribbs. The election was historic for Richard H. Austin being the first Black individual to advance to a Detroit mayoral general election. The election was nonpartisan.

zh.s: 1969年底特律市长选举于11月4日举行，罗曼·格里布斯当选。理查德·H·奥斯汀成为首位进入底特律市长大选的黑人，这次选举因此具有历史意义。该市选举在形式上不分党派。

en.s: In the 1969 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor Mills E. Godwin, Jr., a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Godwin would later successfully run for election as a Republican in 1973. A. Linwood Holton, Jr., an attorney from Roanoke, was nominated again by the Republican Party to run against former United States Ambassador to Australia, Democratic candidate William C. Battle.

zh.s: 1969年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长米尔斯·E·戈德温二世因任期限制无法竞选连任。戈德温后来于1973年以共和党人身份成功当选州长。共和党再次提名罗阿诺克律师A·林伍德·霍尔顿参选，对阵民主党候选人、前美国驻澳大利亚大使威廉·C·巴特尔。

en.s: The 1969 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election in Allentown, the third largest city in Pennsylvania. Republican educator Clifford S. Bartholomew defeated Democrat Joseph S. Daddona, then a first-term city councilmen, who had beaten incumbent mayor Raymond D. Bracy in the primaries.

zh.s: 1969年阿伦敦市长选举是宾夕法尼亚州第三大城市阿伦敦的一次市政选举。共和党教育工作者克利福德·S·巴塞洛缪击败民主党人约瑟夫·S·达多纳。达多纳当时是首届任期内的市议员，此前在初选中击败了现任市长雷蒙德·D·布雷西。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1975 occurred on Tuesday, November 4, 1975 between Mayor Kevin White and state senator Joseph F. Timilty. White was elected to a third term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 23, 1975.

en.s: The 1975 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1975. Incumbent Democrat Julian Carroll defeated Republican nominee Robert E. Gable with 62.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1975年肯塔基州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长朱利安·卡罗尔以62.84%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·E·盖布尔。

en.s: The 1975 Virginia Senate elections were held on November 4, 1975, alongside the Virginia House of Delegates election. All 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia were up for election.

zh.s: 1975年弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月4日举行，与弗吉尼亚州众议院选举同时进行。州参议院全部40个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1975 took place on November 4, 1975, and saw the election of Republican William H. Hudnut III. Hudnut ultimately served 16 years as mayor, becoming the city's longest-serving mayor.

zh.t: 1975年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1975年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月4日举行，共和党人威廉·H·哈德纳特三世当选。他后来担任市长16年，成为该市任职时间最长的市长。

en.s: The 1975 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 4, 1975, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. Ralph Perk was reelected to a second consecutive term. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 30 primary advancing to the general election.

zh.t: 1975年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举
zh.s: 1975年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举于11月4日举行，选出克利夫兰市长。拉尔夫·佩克成功连任第二个连续任期。选举在形式上不分党派，9月30日初选中排名前两位的候选人进入大选。

en.s: The 1975 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the reelection of Frank Rizzo. Rizzo defeated African American leader Charles W. Bowser, who led an independent campaign, and Republican nominee Tom Foglietta.

en.s: The 1975 mayoral election was held to select the 37th mayor of San Francisco, and was held in two parts. In the November regular election, then-Speaker of the California State Assembly George Moscone placed first with conservative city supervisor John Barbagelata second and moderate supervisor Dianne Feinstein coming in third. Moscone and Barbagelata thus both advanced to the mandated runoff election in December where Moscone narrowly defeated the conservative supervisor by 4,400 votes, a margin of less than 1%.

zh.s: 1975年旧金山市长选举分两个阶段举行，选出第37任市长。11月的大选中，加利福尼亚州众议院议长乔治·莫斯科内得票第一，保守派市政委员约翰·巴巴格拉塔得票第二，温和派市政委员黛安·范斯坦排第三。莫斯科内和巴巴格拉塔进入12月的强制决选，莫斯科内最终以4,400票的微弱优势击败巴巴格拉塔，差距不到1%。

en.s: The Walsall North by-election on 4 November 1976 was held after the resignation of sitting Member of Parliament (MP) John Stonehouse. Elected as a Labour candidate, Stonehouse was a member of the English National Party when he resigned, after an interlude in which he faked his own death. The English National Party did not contest the by-election, the first occasion on which the incumbent's party did not do so since the Bristol South East by-election, 1963, and the last until the North Down by-election, 1995. Amidst the confusion, the Conservative Party gained the seat in the by-election.

zh.s: 1976年11月4日，沃尔索尔北区举行议会补选，填补现任议员约翰·斯通豪斯辞职后留下的席位。斯通豪斯最初以工党候选人身份当选；辞职时他已加入英格兰民族党，此前还曾假死脱身。英格兰民族党没有参加此次补选。这是自1963年布里斯托尔东南区补选以来，议员所属政党首次没有参加该选区补选，也是1995年北唐选区补选前的最后一次。局势混乱之下，保守党赢得该席位。

en.s: The Workington by-election, 1976 was a parliamentary by-election held in England for the House of Commons constituency of Workington in Cumbria on 4 November 1976. It was won by the Conservative Party candidate Richard Page, who became the first non-Labour MP in the constituency’s history.

zh.s: 1976年沃金顿补选于11月4日在英格兰举行，选出代表坎布里亚郡沃金顿选区的下议院议员。保守党候选人理查德·佩奇获胜，成为该选区历史上首位非工党籍下议院议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt on 28 October 1976, with a second round in four constituencies on 4 November. While the Arab Socialist Union remained the sole legal party in the country, as in previous elections, these elections were unique in having three distinct political factions of the party compete against each other (the right-wing Socialist Liberal Organisation, the centrist Arab Socialist Organisation and the left-wing National Progressive Unionist Party), along with 208 independents.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃及议会选举于1976年10月28日举行，4个选区在11月4日进行第二轮投票。与此前选举一样，阿拉伯社会主义联盟仍是国内唯一合法政党，但这次选举中，党内三个政治派别分别参选：右翼的社会主义自由组织、中间派的阿拉伯社会主义组织和左翼的民族进步统一党；另有208名独立候选人参选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The 1978 Svenska Cupen final took place on 4 November 1978 at Strandängens IP in Bromölla. The match was contested by Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and Kalmar FF. Kalmar FF played their first cup final ever, Malmö FF played their first final since 1975 and their 12th final in total. Malmö FF won their 10th title with a 2–0 victory after extra time.

zh.s: 1978年瑞典杯决赛于1978年11月4日在布罗梅拉的斯特兰德恩斯球场举行。决赛双方是瑞典足球超级联赛球队马尔默和卡尔马。卡尔马首次闯入杯赛决赛，马尔默上次进入决赛是在1975年，这也是他们第12次进入决赛。马尔默在加时赛后以2比0获胜，赢得第10个冠军。

en.s: The Iran hostage crisis (Persian: بحران گروگانگیری سفارت آمریکا) began on November 4, 1979, when 66 Americans, including diplomats and other civilian personnel, were taken hostage at the Embassy of the United States in Tehran, with 52 of them being held until January 20, 1981. The incident occurred after the Muslim Student Followers of the Imam's Line stormed and occupied the building in the months following the Iranian Revolution.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伊朗人质危机始于1979年11月4日。当日，伊玛目路线的穆斯林学生追随者冲入美国驻德黑兰大使馆并占领大楼，66名美国人质被扣押，其中52人一直被扣留到1981年1月20日。这一事件发生在伊朗革命后的几个月。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Florida, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Florida took place on November 4, 1980 alongside other elections for President of the United States as well as to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Richard Stone decided to run for re-election to a second term, but was defeated in the Democratic primary election by Bill Gunter. Republican Paula Hawkins won the open seat.

zh.t: 1980年佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举于1980年11月4日举行，与总统、其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。民主党籍现任参议员理查德·斯通原本竞选连任第二个任期，但在民主党初选中败给比尔·冈特。共和党人保拉·霍金斯赢得该空缺席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 1980 in Minnesota as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Jimmy Carter, won the state over former California Governor Ronald Reagan by 80,933 votes, giving him one of just seven victories in the election (other than Minnesota, Carter also carried Maryland, West Virginia, Hawaii, Rhode Island, the District of Columbia and his home state of Georgia). Nationally, Reagan won the election with 489 electoral votes and 50.75% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1980年明尼苏达州总统选举于1980年11月4日举行，是1980年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、现任总统吉米·卡特以80,933票的优势击败前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根，赢得该州。明尼苏达州是卡特在此次选举中获胜的7个州之一，其他6个是马里兰州、西弗吉尼亚州、夏威夷、罗得岛州、哥伦比亚特区和他的家乡佐治亚州。里根最终以489张选举人票胜出，普选票占50.75%。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1980
en.s: The 1980 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 1980 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats and the Republicans were held on June 10 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 24. Three incumbents were re-elected, but John Jenrette of the 6th congressional district was defeated in his bid for re-election and the open seat in the 1st congressional district was taken by the Republicans from the Democrats. The composition of the state delegation after the elections was four Republicans and two Democrats.

zh.t: 1980年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1980年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出六名联邦众议员，任期两年。民主党和共和党的初选于6月10日举行，两周后的6月24日举行决选。三名现任议员成功连任，但第六选区的约翰·詹雷特竞选连任失败；第一选区的空缺席位则由共和党从民主党手中夺走。选举后，该州代表团由四名共和党人和两名民主党人组成。

en.t: United States presidential election in Arizona, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Arizona voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Arizona was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan by a landslide of 32 points. It is a reliably Republican state, and has voted for the Republican candidate in every presidential race since 1952 except for Bill Clinton's re-election in 1996, when Clinton won the state.

zh.s: 1980年亚利桑那州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。亚利桑那州选民选出八名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以32个百分点的优势大胜，在亚利桑那州获胜。该州通常支持共和党，自1952年以来，除比尔·克林顿1996年竞选连任时赢得亚利桑那州外，每届总统选举中该州都投给共和党候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Oklahoma, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Oklahoma voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Oklahoma was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan (R) by a 25-point landslide. It is a reliably Republican state, and the last Democratic presidential candidate to carry the state was Lyndon Johnson in his 1964 presidential campaign.

zh.s: 1980年俄克拉何马州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。俄克拉何马州选民选出八名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以25个百分点的优势大胜。该州通常支持共和党；最后一位赢得该州的民主党总统候选人是林登·约翰逊，他在1964年总统竞选中获胜。

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Hawaii took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Hawaii voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Hawaii was won by President Jimmy Carter (D) by 1.9 points. Hawaii is a very liberal state, and both of the state's U.S. Senators have been Democrats since 1977, which is partly the reason Reagan lost, albeit very narrowly.

zh.s: 1980年夏威夷州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。夏威夷州选民选出四名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、时任总统吉米·卡特以1.9个百分点的优势赢得夏威夷州。夏威夷州政治立场较为自由派，两名联邦参议员自1977年以来一直是民主党人；这也是里根在该州落败的部分原因，尽管双方差距很小。

en.t: United States presidential election in Utah, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Utah voters chose 4 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. Utah was won by former Governor of California Ronald Reagan, the Republican nominee, who was running against incumbent President and former Governor of Georgia Jimmy Carter, the Democratic nominee. Reagan ran with former C.I.A. Director George H. W. Bush of Texas, and Carter ran with Walter Mondale, incumbent Vice President and former senator from Minnesota.

zh.s: 1980年犹他州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。犹他州选民选出四名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出美国总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根在犹他州获胜。他的竞选对手是民主党候选人、时任总统、前佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特。里根与来自得克萨斯州的前中央情报局局长乔治·H·W·布什搭档参选，卡特的竞选搭档则是时任副总统、来自明尼苏达州的前联邦参议员沃尔特·蒙代尔。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 4, 1980, as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Maryland was won by incumbent President Jimmy Carter (D-Georgia), with 47.12% of the popular vote, over former Governor Ronald Reagan (R-California) with 44.18% of the popular vote and Republican US Representative John B. Anderson running as an independent candidate (I-Illinois) with 7.76% of the popular vote. Reagan ultimately won the national vote, defeating Carter.

zh.s: 1980年马里兰州总统选举于11月4日举行。时任总统、民主党人吉米·卡特（来自佐治亚州）以47.12%的普选票击败共和党人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根（得票率44.18%），以及以独立候选人身份参选的共和党联邦众议员约翰·B·安德森（来自伊利诺伊州，得票率7.76%）。里根最终赢得全国选举，击败卡特。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1980
en.s: The 1980 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 4, 1980. The incumbent, Republican Senator Milton Young, was retiring. Republican Mark Andrews defeated North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate Kent Johanneson to fill the vacated seat. Andrews, who had served as a Representative since 1965, easily received the Republican nomination, and the endorsed Democratic-NPL candidate was Kent Johanneson. Andrews and Johanneson won the primary elections for their respective parties. Two independent candidates, Harley McLain and Don J. Klingensmith also filed before the deadline under the Chemical Farming Banned and Statesman parties respectively.

zh.t: 1980年北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任参议员米尔顿·扬宣布退休。共和党人马克·安德鲁斯击败北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟候选人肯特·约翰内森，赢得空缺席位。安德鲁斯自1965年起担任联邦众议员，轻松获得共和党提名；民主党—无党派联盟支持的候选人是约翰内森。两人均赢得各自党派的初选。另有两名独立候选人哈利·麦克莱恩和唐·J·克林根史密斯，在截止日期前分别以“禁止化学农业党”和“政治家党”名义登记参选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maine, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Maine voters chose 4 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Maine was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan (R) by a slim margin of 3 points, carrying 14 out of 16 counties. In recent years, however, the state has grown much more liberal, and no Republican presidential nominee has carried it since 1988.

zh.s: 1980年缅因州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。缅因州选民选出四名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以三个百分点的微弱优势获胜，在16个县中赢得14个。不过，近年来该州的政治立场明显转向自由派；自1988年以来，没有共和党总统候选人赢得过该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 4, 1980 as part of the 1980 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts was very narrowly carried by the Republican nominee, former Governor Ronald Reagan of California, over incumbent Democratic President Jimmy Carter of Georgia and Independent candidate Congressman John B. Anderson of Illinois. On election day, Reagan won a plurality of 41.90% of the vote in the state to Carter's 41.75%, with Anderson in third at 15.15%, giving Reagan a razor-thin margin of 0.15%.

zh.s: 1980年马萨诸塞州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年总统选举在全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出14名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以极微弱优势赢得该州，击败民主党籍时任总统吉米·卡特（来自佐治亚州）和以独立候选人身份参选的联邦众议员约翰·B·安德森（来自伊利诺伊州）。选举日，里根在该州获得41.90%的选票，卡特获得41.75%，安德森以15.15%位居第三，里根仅领先0.15个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 4, 1980 as part of the 1980 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Hampshire was won by the Republican nominees, former actor and Governor Ronald Reagan of California and former CIA Director George H.W. Bush of Texas. Reagan and Bush defeated the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Jimmy Carter of Georgia and his running mate incumbent Vice President Walter Mondale of Minnesota.

zh.s: 1980年新罕布什尔州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出四名选举人，组成选举人团。共和党候选人、前演员兼加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根，以及前中央情报局局长乔治·H·W·布什赢得该州。他们击败了民主党候选人、时任总统吉米·卡特和他的竞选搭档、时任副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔。

en.t: United States presidential election in Illinois, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Illinois voters chose 26 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Illinois was carried by former California Governor Ronald Reagan by 8 points. Despite being the home state of Congressman John B. Anderson, he only won 7.3% of the popular vote, 346,754 votes, and failed to carry any counties. Reagan also grew up in Illinois.

zh.s: 1980年伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月4日举行。当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。伊利诺伊州选民选出26名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以八个百分点的优势赢得该州。尽管联邦众议员约翰·B·安德森来自伊利诺伊州，他只获得7.3%的普选票，即346,754票，没有赢得任何一个县。里根也曾在伊利诺伊州长大。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 4, 1980, as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by Ronald Reagan (R–California) with 54.3% of the popular vote against incumbent President Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia) with 26.4%. Reagan ultimately won the national vote, defeating Carter and becoming the next President. Alaska has only voted Democratic once, and that was in the 1964 election for Lyndon B. Johnson.

zh.s: 1980年阿拉斯加州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。选民选出三名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人罗纳德·里根（来自加利福尼亚州）获得54.3%的普选票，击败得票率为26.4%的时任总统吉米·卡特（来自佐治亚州）。里根最终赢得全国选举，击败卡特并成为下一任总统。阿拉斯加州只在1964年曾投票支持民主党总统候选人林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: United States presidential election in West Virginia, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 4, 1980 in West Virginia as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Jimmy Carter, won the state over former California Governor Ronald Reagan by 33,356 votes, giving him one of just seven victories in the election (other than West Virginia, Carter also carried Maryland, Minnesota, Hawaii, Rhode Island, the District of Columbia and his home state of Georgia). Nationally, Reagan won the election with 489 electoral votes and 50.75% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1980年西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月4日在该州举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、时任总统吉米·卡特以33,356票的优势击败前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根，赢得该州。这是卡特在此次选举中仅有的七场胜利之一；其他六处是马里兰州、明尼苏达州、夏威夷州、罗得岛州、哥伦比亚特区和他的家乡佐治亚州。在全国范围内，里根以489张选举人票和50.75%的普选票赢得选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alabama, 1980
en.s: The United States presidential election in Alabama was held on November 4, 1980. Former California Governor Ronald Reagan narrowly won the state and its 9 electoral votes, winning 48.8% to Incumbent President Jimmy Carter's 47.5%. John B. Anderson came in third place, winning 1.23%. Reagan's margin of victory largely rested upon his strong performances in Mobile and Baldwin counties along the Gulf Coast, and Jefferson and Shelby counties in the Birmingham metropolitan area. Reagan also won three counties home to large cities: Madison (Huntsville), Montgomery and Tuscaloosa.

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Mike Gravel ran for a third term in the United States Senate, but lost in the Democratic primary to Clark Gruening, a former state representative who was the grandson of Ernest Gruening, whom Gravel had defeated twelve years prior in an election for the same seat. Gruening later went on to lose the general election to Republican nominee Frank Murkowski, a banker. After the loss of Gravel's seat, no Alaska Democrat would win a congressional race again until Mark Begich's narrow, protracted triumph in Alaska's 2008 Senate election.

zh.t: 1980年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员迈克·格拉韦尔竞选第三个参议员任期，但在民主党初选中败给前州众议员克拉克·格鲁宁。格鲁宁是欧内斯特·格鲁宁的孙子；十二年前，格拉韦尔曾在同一席位的选举中击败欧内斯特·格鲁宁。格鲁宁随后在大选中败给共和党候选人、银行家弗兰克·穆尔科斯基。格拉韦尔失去席位后，直到2008年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举中马克·贝吉奇经过一场差距微小且历时较长的胜利，阿拉斯加民主党人才再次赢得联邦国会议席。

zh.s: 1980年美国总统选举是第49次每四年举行一次的总统选举，于11月4日（星期二）举行。参选者包括民主党籍时任总统吉米·卡特、共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州前州长罗纳德·里根，以及以独立候选人身份参选的共和党联邦众议员约翰·B·安德森。伊朗人质危机以及美国国内高失业率和通货膨胀加剧的经济困境，都有利于里根；他以压倒性优势获胜，获得了非现任总统候选人有史以来最多的选举人票。

en.s: The 1980 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Governor of Montana Thomas Lee Judge, who was first elected in 1972 and was re-elected in 1976, ran for re-election. However, he faced a stiff challenge in the Democratic primary from his lieutenant governor, Ted Schwinden, and he ultimately lost renomination. Schwinden, advancing to the general election, faced Jack Ramirez, the Minority Leader of the Montana House of Representatives and the Republican nominee. Despite the fact that Ronald Reagan, the Republican presidential nominee, won the state in a landslide that year, Schwinden managed to comfortably defeat Ramirez to win his first of two terms as governor.

zh.s: 1980年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任州长托马斯·李·贾奇曾于1972年首次当选，并于1976年连任，这次寻求连任。他在民主党初选中遭到副州长泰德·施温登的有力挑战，最终未能再次获得提名。施温登进入大选后，对手是蒙大拿州众议院少数党领袖、共和党候选人杰克·拉米雷斯。尽管共和党总统候选人罗纳德·里根当年以压倒性优势赢得蒙大拿州，施温登仍轻松击败拉米雷斯，赢得两个州长任期中的第一个。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 17 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, former actor and Governor Ronald Reagan of California and former CIA Director George H.W. Bush of Texas. Reagan and Bush defeated the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Jimmy Carter of Georgia and his running mate incumbent Vice President Walter Mondale of Minnesota.

en.t: United States presidential election in Rhode Island, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 4, 1980 in Rhode Island as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Jimmy Carter, won the state over former California Governor Ronald Reagan by 33,356 votes, giving him one of just seven victories in the election (other than Rhode Island, Carter also carried Maryland, Minnesota, Hawaii, West Virginia, the District of Columbia and his home state of Georgia). en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 4, 1980 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, Governor Ronald Reagan, over the Democratic nominee, President Jimmy Carter.

zh.s: 1980年蒙大拿州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。蒙大拿州选民选出四名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、州长罗纳德·里根，击败民主党候选人、时任总统吉米·卡特。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wisconsin, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson ran for re-election to a fourth term, but was defeated by Bob Kasten.

zh.t: 1980年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员盖洛德·纳尔逊竞选第四个任期，但败给鲍勃·卡斯滕。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1980
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1980 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1980. Republicans lost one seat but gained four Democratic-held seats.

zh.t: 1980年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1980年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。共和党失去一个席位，但从民主党手中赢得四个席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1980 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 4, 1980, to elect members to the Senate of the 72nd Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held on September 9, 1980. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Independent-Republicans of Minnesota. The new Legislature convened on January 6, 1981.

zh.s: 1980年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出该州第72届州议会议员。初选于1980年9月9日举行。明尼苏达州民主党—农民—劳工党（DFL）赢得多数席位，继续成为州参议院多数党；独立共和党紧随其后。新一届州议会于1981年1月6日召开。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Alaska, 1980
en.s: The Alaska Congressional election of 1980 was held on Tuesday, November 4, 1980. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1981. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1981, to January 3, 1983.

zh.t: 1980年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1980年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于1980年11月4日星期二举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于1981年1月3日结束。获胜候选人将担任两年任期，任期从1981年1月3日至1983年1月3日。

en.t: United States presidential election in Kentucky, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 9 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kentucky was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan (R) by a slim margin of 1 point.

zh.s: 1980年肯塔基州总统选举于11月4日举行。全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年的总统选举。肯塔基州选民选出九名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以一个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Indiana, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Indiana took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. Indiana voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Indiana was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan (R) by 19 points.

zh.s: 1980年印第安纳州总统选举于11月4日举行。全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年的总统选举。印第安纳州选民选出13名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以19个百分点的优势赢得该州。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Arkansas, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Dale Bumpers won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1980年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任参议员戴尔·邦珀斯成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in South Carolina, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 1980. All 50 states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1980 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. South Carolina was won by former California Governor Ronald Reagan (R) by a very slim margin of 1 point.

zh.s: 1980年南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月4日举行。全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年的总统选举。南卡罗来纳州选民选出八名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根以一个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。
