en.t: United States presidential election in Washington (state), 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Washington was held on November 4, 1980. Republican candidate Ronald Reagan won the state of Washington with 49.66% of the vote, carrying the state's 9 electoral votes. In the previous election in 1976, Reagan, who was not on the ballot in any of the 50 states, received one of Washington's electoral votes by faithless elector Mike Padden.

zh.s: 1980年华盛顿州总统选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人罗纳德·里根以49.66%的得票率赢得该州及其九张选举人票。在1976年上一次选举中，里根没有出现在任何一个州的选票上，但华盛顿州不忠实选举人迈克·帕登仍将一张选举人票投给了他。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1980 Arizona Senate election was held on November 4, 1980. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1980. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 16 seats over the Democrats' 14 seats.

zh.s: 1980年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在该州全部30个选区选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于1980年9月9日举行。选举前，共和党以16席对民主党的14席占多数。

en.s: The 1980 Montana Senate election took place on November 4, 1980, with the primary election held on June 3, 1980. Montana voters elected 25 of the 50 members of the Montana Senate. The election coincided with United States national elections and Montana state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. House, Montana Governor, and Montana House. Following the previous election in 1978, Republicans held a 26-to-24 seat majority over Democrats.

zh.s: 1980年蒙大拿州参议院选举于11月4日举行，初选于1980年6月3日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州参议院50个席位中的25席。选举与美国全国选举和蒙大拿州选举同时举行，包括总统、联邦众议员、州长和州众议院选举。1978年上次选举后，共和党以26席对民主党的24席保持多数。

en.s: The 1980 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. Democratic nominee Ken Rothman defeated Republican nominee Roy Blunt with 55.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 1980年密苏里州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人肯·罗斯曼以55.75%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伊·布伦特。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Inouye won re-election to a fourth term in yet another landslide, despite the national 'Reagan Revolution' and the state's very narrow margin of victory for Jimmy Carter in the concurrent presidential election.

zh.t: 1980年夏威夷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年夏威夷州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员丹尼尔·井上再次当选，赢得第四个任期。尽管共和党总统候选人罗纳德·里根在全国掀起“里根革命”，而同日举行的总统选举中吉米·卡特在夏威夷州的胜幅很小，井上仍以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The 1980 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. Democratic incumbent James C. Green defeated Republican nominee Bill Cobey with 53.20% of the vote.

zh.t: 1980年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1980年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任副州长詹姆斯·C·格林以53.20%的得票率击败共和党候选人比尔·科比。

en.s: The 1980 Delaware gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1980. Popular incumbent Republican governor Pierre S. "Pete" du Pont IV was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democrat William Gordy. In doing so, du Pont became the first governor since J. Caleb Boggs in 1956 to succeed in winning re-election.

zh.s: 1980年特拉华州州长选举于11月4日举行。广受欢迎的共和党现任州长皮埃尔·S·“皮特”·杜邦四世击败民主党人威廉·戈迪，连任第二个任期。杜邦因此成为自1956年的J·凯莱布·博格斯以来，首位成功连任的州长。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Alabama took place on November 4, 1980, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Donald Stewart, elected in a special election to finish the term of the seat left vacant by the death of Senator James B.

zh.t: 1980年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举及各级州和地方选举同期举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员唐纳德·斯图尔特此前在特别选举中当选，接替已故参议员詹姆斯·B·艾伦完成剩余任期。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic Senator John A. Durkin, who won a contentious do-over election in 1975 following an extremely close election in 1974, ran for re-election to a second term. Former New Hampshire Attorney General Warren Rudman won a crowded Republican primary and faced Durkin in the general election.

zh.t: 1980年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员约翰·A·德金竞选连任第二个任期；他曾在1974年一场极为接近的选举后，于1975年通过有争议的重选再次当选。前新罕布什尔州总检察长沃伦·鲁德曼在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，随后在大选中面对德金。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Colorado was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Gary Hart narrowly won re-election to a second term despite Republican nominee Ronald Reagan winning the state over Democratic President Jimmy Carter in the concurrent presidential election in a landslide.

zh.t: 1980年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员加里·哈特以微弱优势连任第二个任期，尽管共和党总统候选人罗纳德·里根在同日举行的总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得科罗拉多州，而民主党现任总统吉米·卡特落败。

en.t: 1980 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 4 November 1980. The result was a victory for the opposition Progressive National Party (PNP), which won eight of the eleven seats in the Legislative Council. Following the elections, PNP leader Norman Saunders became Chief Minister.

zh.t: 1980年特克斯和凯科斯群岛大选
zh.s: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛于1980年11月4日举行大选。反对党进步民族党获胜，在立法委员会11个席位中赢得8席。选举后，进步民族党领袖诺曼·桑德斯出任首席部长。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on Tuesday November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator George McGovern ran for re-election to a fourth term, but was defeated by Republican James Abdnor.

zh.t: 1980年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。民主党现任联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文竞选第四个任期，但败给共和党人詹姆斯·阿布诺。

en.t: 1980 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in California took place on November 4, 1980, as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. State voters chose 45 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican nominee, the state's former governor Ronald Reagan, in a landslide over the Democratic incumbent, Jimmy Carter.

zh.s: 1980年加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月4日举行，是1980年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出45名选举人，代表加利福尼亚州参加选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州前州长罗纳德·里根以压倒性优势击败民主党现任总统吉米·卡特。

en.t: 1980 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 4, 1980. It was held as part of the 1980 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Hernán Padilla, a member of the New Progressive Party.

zh.t: 1980年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安于1980年11月4日举行市长选举，这是1980年波多黎各大选的一部分。进步新党成员、现任市长埃尔南·帕迪利亚再次当选。

en.s: The 1980 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic governor Hugh Gallen was re-elected to a second term in office in a landslide, once again defeating former governor Meldrim Thomson Jr., who defeated Lou D'Allesandro for the Republican nomination. Ronald Reagan carried the state in a landslide in the simultaneous presidential election.

zh.s: 1980年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长休·盖伦以压倒性优势连任第二个任期，再次击败前州长梅尔德里姆·汤姆森二世。汤姆森在共和党初选中击败了卢·达历山德罗。同期总统选举中，罗纳德·里根以压倒性优势赢得新罕布什尔州。

en.s: The 1980 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Republican nominee and former member of the Delaware Senate Mike Castle defeated Democratic nominee Thomas B. Sharp, Libertarian nominee Margaret R. Buchanan and American nominee Donald G. Gies.

zh.s: 1980年特拉华州副州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州副州长。共和党候选人、特拉华州参议院前议员迈克·卡斯尔击败民主党候选人托马斯·B·夏普、自由党候选人玛格丽特·R·布坎南和美国党候选人唐纳德·G·吉斯。

en.s: The Pennsylvania State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 1980. Democratic incumbent Robert E. Casey lost re-election to Republican candidate R. Budd Dwyer by a margin of 1.25%. Casey had won election to the office in 1976 due in large part to his similar name to Robert P. Casey. In 1980, Dwyer's supporters chanted, "Casey's not Casey" to remind voters his opponent was not Robert P.

zh.t: 1980年美国宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1980年宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任州财政部长罗伯特·E·凯西竞选连任，但以1.25个百分点之差败给共和党候选人R·巴德·德怀尔。凯西此前于1976年当选，很大程度上得益于他与罗伯特·P·凯西同名。1980年，德怀尔的支持者高喊“凯西不是那个凯西”，提醒选民他的对手并非罗伯特·P·凯西。

en.s: The 1980 Montana House of Representatives election took place on November 4, 1980, with the primary election held on June 3, 1980. Montana voters elected all 100 members of the Montana House of Representatives to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Montana state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. House, Montana Governor, and Montana Senate.

zh.s: 1980年蒙大拿州众议院选举于11月4日举行，初选于1980年6月3日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州众议院全部100名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及蒙大拿州其他选举同时举行，包括总统、联邦众议员、州长和州参议院选举。

en.s: The 1980 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 1980. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1980.

zh.s: 1980年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在多席位选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等其他职位的选举同时举行。初选于1980年9月9日举行。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 4, 1980, as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert B. Morgan ran for reelection to a second term, but narrowly lost to Republican challenger John P. East. This was the first time Republicans had won this seat since 1897, and the inauguration of John East marked the first time since Reconstruction that they held both Senate seats simultaneously.

zh.t: 1980年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，是全国联邦参议员选举的一部分。民主党现任联邦参议员罗伯特·B·摩根竞选连任第二个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党挑战者约翰·P·伊斯特。这是共和党自1897年以来首次赢得该席位。约翰·伊斯特就职后，共和党自重建时期以来首次同时掌控该州两个参议员席位。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 4, 1980. Primaries were held on March 18.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1980年11月4日（星期二）举行选举，初选于3月18日举行。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Dole was re-elected to his third term in office, after briefly campaigning for President earlier that year. He defeated Democrat John Simpson, who had previously served in the Kansas State Senate as a Republican.

zh.t: 1980年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员鲍勃·多尔再次当选，赢得第三个任期。他在当年早些时候曾短暂竞选总统。多尔击败民主党人约翰·辛普森；辛普森曾作为共和党人担任堪萨斯州参议员。

en.s: The 1980 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. Democratic incumbent Scott M. Matheson defeated Republican nominee Bob Wright with 55.16% of the vote. As of 2025, this is the last time a Democrat was elected Governor of Utah; since Matheson left office in 1985, all of Utah's governors have been Republican.

zh.s: 1980年犹他州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长斯科特·M·马西森以55.16%的得票率击败共和党候选人鲍勃·赖特。截至2025年，这是民主党人最近一次当选犹他州州长；马西森于1985年卸任后，该州州长一直由共和党人担任。

en.t: 1980 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 1980 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on November 4, 1980. Republican nominee Jim Jeffords defeated Citizens Party (United States) candidate Robin Lloyd and Liberty Union Party nominee Peter Diamondstone.

zh.t: 1980年佛蒙特州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1980年佛蒙特州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人吉姆·杰福兹击败公民党候选人罗宾·劳埃德和自由联盟党候选人彼得·戴蒙斯通。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Republican Senator Barry Goldwater decided to run for reelection to a fifth term, after returning to the Senate in 1968 following his failed presidential run in 1964 against Lyndon B. Johnson.

zh.t: 1980年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍时任参议员巴里·戈德华特决定竞选连任，争取第五个任期。1964年他竞选总统时败给林登·B·约翰逊，随后于1968年重返参议院。

en.s: The 1980 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1980, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general John Ashcroft defeated Democratic nominee Robert Baine.

zh.s: 1980年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任总检察长约翰·阿什克罗夫特击败民主党候选人罗伯特·贝恩。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Maryland took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Republican U.S Senator Charles Mathias won re-election to a third term in a landslide, defeating Democratic State Senator Edward T. Conroy. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican won a U.S. Senate election in Maryland.

zh.t: 1980年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年马里兰州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员查尔斯·马赛厄斯以压倒性优势再次当选第三个任期，击败民主党州参议员爱德华·T·康罗伊。截至2026年，这是共和党最近一次赢得马里兰州联邦参议员选举。

en.t: 1980 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1980 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 4, 1980, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-four seats in the House apportioned according to the 1970 United States census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1980, the United States House elections in other states, the presidential election, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1980年得克萨斯州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1980年得克萨斯州联邦众议员选举于1980年11月4日举行，以选出该州联邦众议院代表团成员。根据1970年美国人口普查划分，得克萨斯州在联邦众议院有24个席位。这些选举与1980年联邦参议员选举、其他州的联邦众议员选举、总统选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 1980, alongside other elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Abraham Ribicoff decided to retire. The open seat was won by Democratic Representative Chris Dodd, son of former Senator Thomas J. Dodd. The Republican nominee was James L.

zh.t: 1980年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举同期举行。民主党籍时任参议员亚伯拉罕·里比科夫决定退休。民主党籍联邦众议员克里斯·多德赢得这一空缺席位；他是前参议员托马斯·J·多德的儿子。共和党提名人是詹姆斯·L·……。

en.s: The 1980 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1980, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state James Kirkpatrick defeated Republican nominee Walter L. Pfeffer II.

zh.s: 1980年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿詹姆斯·柯克帕特里克击败共和党候选人沃尔特·L·普费弗二世。

en.s: The 1980 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. The election pitted Republican State Attorney General Allen I. Olson against incumbent Democratic-NPL governor Arthur A. Link. Olson defeated Link 54% to 46%. As of 2026, this is the North Dakota gubernatorial race where the winner received less than 55% of votes.

zh.s: 1980年北达科他州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党州总检察长艾伦·I·奥尔森对阵民主党—非党派联盟现任州长阿瑟·A·林克。奥尔森以54%对46%的得票率击败林克。截至2026年，这是北达科他州州长选举中胜选者得票率低于55%的一次。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic senator John Glenn was re-elected to a second term over Republican state representative Jim Betts. Despite Ronald Reagan's victory in the concurrent presidential election in Ohio, Glenn's historic margin of victory remains one of the largest in Ohio history, and it established him as a leading early contender for the 1984 Democratic presidential nomination.

zh.t: 1980年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员约翰·格伦击败共和党州众议员吉姆·贝茨，再次当选第二个任期。尽管罗纳德·里根赢得同日举行的俄亥俄州总统选举，格伦的历史性胜利优势仍是该州最大优势之一，也使他成为1984年民主党总统候选人提名的早期热门人选。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 1980, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as other elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Wendell Ford won re-election, defeating Republican nominee Mary Louise Foust.

zh.t: 1980年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。民主党现任参议员温德尔·福特成功连任，击败共和党候选人玛丽·路易斯·福斯特。

en.t: 1980 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Florida took place on Tuesday, November 4, 1980, as part of the 1980 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Florida voters chose 17 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Jimmy Carter and his running mate, Vice President Walter Mondale, against Republican challenger and former California Governor Ronald Reagan and his running mate and former Director of the CIA, George H.

zh.t: 1980年美国佛罗里达州总统选举
zh.s: 1980年美国佛罗里达州总统选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，是当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区总统选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民通过普选选出17名总统选举人。民主党籍时任总统吉米·卡特与竞选搭档、副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔，对阵共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州前州长罗纳德·里根及其竞选搭档、前中央情报局局长乔治·H·W·布什。

en.t: 1980 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1980 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 4, 1980 to elect the state's two representatives to serve in the 97th United States Congress. Primary elections were held on June 3, 1980. Republicans held on to the 1st District and flipped the 2nd district. This was the first time republicans held both districts in New Mexico since 1968.

zh.t: 1980年新墨西哥州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1980年新墨西哥州联邦众议员选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州两名联邦众议员，进入第97届联邦国会。初选于1980年6月3日举行。共和党保住第一选区，并赢得第二选区。这是自1968年以来，共和党首次同时赢得新墨西哥州两个国会选区。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator John Culver ran for reelection to a second term, but lost to Republican nominee Chuck Grassley, the United States Congressman from Iowa's 3rd congressional district. This election marked the beginning of eight consecutive victories for Grassley in the Senate. It remains the closest election of his Senate career.

zh.t: 1980年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员约翰·卡尔弗竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党候选人、艾奥瓦州第三国会选区联邦众议员查克·格拉斯利。这是格拉斯利连续八次赢得联邦参议员选举的开始，也是他参议员选举生涯中差距最小的一次。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Senator Thomas Eagleton defeated Republican nominee Gene McNary with 52.00% of the vote. As of 2024, this is the last time the Democrats won the Class 3 Senate seat in Missouri.

zh.t: 1980年密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年密苏里州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员托马斯·伊格尔顿以52.00%的得票率击败共和党候选人吉恩·麦克纳里。截至2024年，这是民主党最近一次赢得密苏里州第三类参议员席位。

en.s: The 1980 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 1980, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Mel Carnahan defeated Republican nominee Gerald E. Winship.

zh.t: 1980年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1980年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州财政部长。民主党候选人、密苏里州众议院前议员梅尔·卡纳汉击败共和党候选人杰拉尔德·E·温希普。

en.s: The 1980 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democrat J. Joseph Garrahy defeated Republican nominee Buddy Cianci with 73.71% of the vote despite the fact that Jimmy Carter carried the state by a much smaller margin in the concurrent presidential election.

zh.s: 1980年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长J·约瑟夫·加拉希以73.71%的得票率击败共和党候选人巴迪·钱奇，尽管吉米·卡特在同期总统选举中以远小得多的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jake Garn won re-election to a second term in a landslide against Democrat Dan Berman.

zh.s: 1980年犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员杰克·加恩以压倒性优势击败民主党人丹·伯曼，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1980 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1980 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 4, 1980, to elect members to serve in the 97th United States Congress. They coincided with the election of Ronald Reagan as president, defeating Democratic incumbent Jimmy Carter. Reagan's victory also allowed many Republican House candidates to secure elections.

zh.s: 1980年美国联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行，以选出第97届联邦国会众议员。选举期间，罗纳德·里根当选总统，击败民主党现任总统吉米·卡特。里根胜选也帮助许多共和党联邦众议员候选人当选。

en.s: The 1980 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980 in all 92 counties in the state of Indiana. Otis Bowen, the state's incumbent governor was ineligible for a third consecutive term due to term limits set forth in the Indiana Constitution. Robert D. Orr, the state's incumbent Republican lieutenant governor, was elected to his first term, defeating John A. Hillenbrand II, and a minor party challenger.

zh.s: 1980年印第安纳州州长选举于11月4日在该州全部92个县举行。根据印第安纳州宪法的任期限制，民主党现任州长奥蒂斯·鲍恩不能连续竞选第三个任期。共和党现任副州长罗伯特·D·奥尔当选首个任期，击败约翰·A·希伦布兰德二世和一名小党候选人。

en.s: The 1980 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic governor Dixy Lee Ray ran for a second term, but lost in the primary to State Representative Jim McDermott. McDermott was defeated in the general election by Republican candidate John Spellman, the King County Executive. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican was elected Governor of Washington, thus beginning the longest Democratic streak in any of the 50 state governorships once Spellman left office.

zh.s: 1980年华盛顿州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长迪克西·李·雷竞选连任第二个任期，但在初选中败给州众议员吉姆·麦克德莫特。麦克德莫特随后在大选中败给共和党候选人、金县行政长官约翰·斯佩尔曼。截至2026年，这是共和党最近一次当选华盛顿州州长，也是该州开始持续时间最长的民主党州长执政纪录。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 4, 1980. Longtime incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson, the Senate President pro tempore, ran for a seventh term in office but lost re-election to Republican State Attorney General Slade Gorton. Magnuson was the most senior U.S. senator to lose re-election until Ted Stevens' defeat in 2008.

zh.t: 1980年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。长期担任参议员、时任参议院临时议长的民主党现任参议员沃伦·马格努森竞选第七个任期，但败给共和党州总检察长斯莱德·戈顿。直到2008年泰德·史蒂文斯败选之前，马格努森是竞选连任失败的资历最老的联邦参议员。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator and former Governor of Georgia Herman Talmadge ran for reelection to a fifth term, but lost narrowly to Mack Mattingly, Chairman of the Georgia Republican Party. Mattingly benefited considerably from Talmadge's ethical and legal problems, as well as from the unpopularity of incumbent president, and former Georgia governor, Democrat Jimmy Carter.

zh.t: 1980年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1980年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员、佐治亚州前州长赫尔曼·塔尔马奇竞选第五个任期，但以微弱差距败给佐治亚州共和党主席麦克·马廷利。塔尔马奇的道德和法律问题，以及时任总统、前佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特不受欢迎，都对马廷利有很大帮助。

en.t: 1980 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 1980, in Georgia as part of the 1980 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Jimmy Carter, won his home state of Georgia over former California Governor Ronald Reagan by 238,565 votes, one of just seven victories in the election (other than Georgia, Carter also carried Maryland, Minnesota, Hawaii, West Virginia, the District of Columbia and Rhode Island).

zh.s: 佐治亚州于1980年11月4日举行总统选举，是1980年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、现任总统吉米·卡特在家乡佐治亚州击败加利福尼亚州前州长罗纳德·里根，以238,565票的优势获胜。佐治亚州是卡特仅有的七个胜选州之一，其他六州为马里兰州、明尼苏达州、夏威夷州、西弗吉尼亚州、哥伦比亚特区和罗得岛州。

en.t: 1980 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 4, 1980. Incumbent U.S. Senator Jacob Javits ran for re-election to a fifth term in office on the Liberal Party line, but he finished third behind Hempstead town supervisor Al D'Amato and U.S. representative Elizabeth Holtzman of Brooklyn. Primary elections were held on September 9.

zh.s: 1980年纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任联邦参议员雅各布·贾维茨以自由党候选人身份竞选第五个任期，但最终排名第三，落后于亨普斯特德镇镇长阿尔·达马托和布鲁克林联邦众议员伊丽莎白·霍尔茨曼。初选于9月9日举行。

en.s: In the 1980 Cook County State's Attorney election, incumbent second-term state's attorney Bernard Carey, a Republican, was unseated by Democrat Richard M. Daley.

zh.s: 1980年库克县检察官选举中，共和党籍、已连任一届的现任检察官伯纳德·凯里败给民主党人理查德·M·戴利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1980 United States Senate elections were held on November 4, coinciding with Ronald Reagan's victory in the presidential election. The 34 Senate seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections. Reagan's large margin of victory over incumbent Jimmy Carter gave a huge boost to Republican Senate candidates, allowing them to flip 12 Democratic seats and win control of the chamber for the first time since the end of the 83rd Congress in January 1955.

zh.s: 1980年美国联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，与罗纳德·里根赢得总统选举同时进行。常规选举改选第三类的34个席位。里根大幅领先现任总统吉米·卡特，带动共和党参议员候选人获胜，帮助共和党拿下12个民主党席位，并自1955年1月第83届国会结束后首次控制参议院。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1980 Arkansas gubernatorial election was a biennial election for the governorship of Arkansas. One-term Democratic governor and future president Bill Clinton was narrowly defeated by Republican Frank D. White. It was only the third time since Reconstruction that a Republican candidate had won the state's governorship. As of 2026, this is the last time that an incumbent governor of Arkansas lost re-election.

zh.s: 1980年阿肯色州州长选举是一次常规州长选举。只任职一届的民主党籍州长、后来成为总统的比尔·克林顿以微弱差距败给共和党人弗兰克·D·怀特。这是南北战争重建时期以来，阿肯色州州长选举中共和党候选人第三次获胜。截至2026年，这是阿肯色州现任州长最近一次竞选连任失败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1980 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1980 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1980 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1980年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院偶数编号的25个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期为四年，每次选举改选一半席位。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1980年选举所用的全州50个参议院选区地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 1980 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 1980 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was the first presidential straw poll held in Guam on November 4, 1980. Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, who would then in turn cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president.

zh.s: 1980年美国关岛总统意向投票于1980年11月4日举行，是关岛首次举行总统意向投票。关岛是属地而非州，因此无权选出选举人团成员，由选举人代表选民投票选出总统和副总统。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Buffalo mayoral election of 1981 took place in Buffalo, New York, USA, on November 4, 1981, and resulted in the incumbent mayor Jimmy Griffin winning a second term over his opponent, the local politician Alfred Coppola, who ran on a minor party line.

zh.s: 纽约州布法罗市于1981年11月4日举行市长选举。现任市长吉米·格里芬击败小党候选人、地方政界人士阿尔弗雷德·科波拉，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: A general election was held in Nicaragua on November 4, 1984, to elect a president and parliament. Approximately 1.2 million Nicaraguans voted, representing a 75% turnout, with 94% of eligible voters registered. Impartial observers from international groupings such as the European Economic Community, religious groups sent to monitor the election, and observers from democratic nations such as Canada and the Republic of Ireland concluded that the elections were completely free and fair. The election date, November 4 was selected so that Nicaragua would have a legitimate, elected government in place before the anticipated reelection of Ronald Reagan in the United States on November 6.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1986

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1986
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Arlen Specter won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1986年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1986年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员阿伦·斯佩克特成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1986
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1986 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 4, 1986. No districts switched parties, so the delegation remained at 27 Democrats and 18 Republicans.

zh.t: 1986年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1986年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，用于选出加利福尼亚州代表团。没有选区发生党派更替，因此该州代表团仍由27名民主党人和18名共和党人组成。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in New Hampshire, 1986
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Warren Rudman won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1986年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1986年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员沃伦·鲁德曼成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic nominee John Breaux defeated Republican nominee Henson Moore with 52.82% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年路易斯安那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年路易斯安那州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人约翰·布罗以52.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人亨森·摩尔。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate elections in North Carolina
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 4, 1986 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jim Broyhill, who had been appointed in June 1986 to serve out the rest of John Porter East's term, faced off against the popular Democratic former Governor Terry Sanford.

zh.t: 1986年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，是全美联邦参议院选举的一部分。共和党籍时任参议员吉姆·布罗希尔于1986年6月获任命，接替约翰·波特·伊斯特完成剩余任期；他在选举中面对民主党籍前州长特里·桑福德。

en.s: The 1986 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the governor of Oklahoma. Republican former Governor and Senator Henry Bellmon won the election by a plurality with Independent Jerry Brown receiving more than twice the number of votes separating Bellmon from Democrat David Walters.

zh.s: 1986年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出州长。共和党前州长、前参议员亨利·贝尔蒙以相对多数获胜。独立候选人杰里·布朗获得的选票超过贝尔蒙与民主党人戴维·沃尔特斯之间票数差距的两倍。

en.s: The 1986 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The Incumbent, William P. Hobby Jr. ran for re-election to his fifth and final term, he was elected against Republican and former minister, David Davidson. During the campaign Davidson attacked Hobby's support of the tax increases passed by the Legislature in 1984, Hobby countered that the taxes supported services that helped citizens of the state.

zh.s: 1986年得克萨斯州副州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州副州长。现任副州长威廉·P·霍比二世竞选连任第五个、也是最后一个任期，并击败共和党候选人、前牧师戴维·戴维森。竞选期间，戴维森批评霍比支持州议会于1984年通过的增税措施；霍比则回应说，这些税收用于支持对州民有益的公共服务。

en.s: The 1986 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democratic Governor John W. Carlin did not run for re-election. Republican nominee Mike Hayden, then Speaker of the Kansas House of Representatives, beat the Democratic nominee Thomas Docking, who was then the incumbent Lieutenant Governor of Kansas. This was the last gubernatorial election in Kansas in which the winner was of the same party as the incumbent president until Laura Kelly's victory in 2022.

zh.s: 1986年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长约翰·W·卡林没有竞选连任。共和党候选人、当时的堪萨斯州众议院议长迈克·海登击败民主党候选人、当时的副州长托马斯·多金。这是堪萨斯州最近一次州长选举胜选者与现任总统属于同一政党，直到劳拉·凯利在2022年胜选。

en.s: The 1986 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986, and featured state Treasurer Kay Orr, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former Mayor of Lincoln Helen Boosalis. Incumbent Democratic governor Bob Kerrey did not seek a second term. The election was the first state gubernatorial election in U.S. history where the candidates of both major national parties were women.

zh.s: 1986年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党人、州财政部长凯·奥尔击败民主党候选人、林肯市前市长海伦·布萨利斯。民主党现任州长鲍勃·克里的没有竞选第二个任期。这是美国历史上首次两个主要政党的州长候选人都是女性。

en.s: The 1986 Alabama Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the Attorney General of Alabama to a four-year term.

zh.t: 1986年美国阿拉巴马州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1986年美国阿拉巴马州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，选出任期四年的州总检察长。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1986 took place on November 4, 1986. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1986年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1986年马里兰州县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出各自的县行政长官。

en.s: The 1986 Maryland Senate election were held on November 4, 1986, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland. Following landslide victories for Paul Sarbanes and Harry Hughes in the 1982 elections, Republicans largely spent the following four years rebuilding the party.

zh.s: 1986年马里兰州参议院选举于11月4日举行，改选州参议院全部47个选区的议员。议员由单一选区选出，任期四年。选举与州长在内的联邦和州级选举同时举行。保罗·萨班斯和哈里·休斯在1982年大胜后，共和党在接下来的四年里主要忙于重建政党。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 1986, alongside other elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Chris Dodd won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1986年康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员和众议员选举同时进行。民主党现任联邦参议员克里斯·多德再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Republican governor Lamar Alexander was term-limited, leaving the governorship an open seat. Democratic nominee Ned McWherter defeated former Republican governor Winfield Dunn with 54.3% of the vote. With this win, McWherter flipped the state back into Democratic control, with the state legislature also being controlled by Democrats.

zh.s: 1986年田纳西州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出下一任州长。共和党现任州长拉马尔·亚历山大受任期限制，不能连任，州长职位因此空缺。民主党候选人内德·麦克沃特以54.3%的得票率击败共和党前州长温菲尔德·邓恩。麦克沃特获胜后，田纳西州重新由民主党掌控，州议会也由民主党控制。

en.s: The 1986 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Hubert Humphrey III defeated Republican nominee Lewis Freeman and Grassroots nominee Derrick P. Grimmer.

zh.t: 1986年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1986年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任总检察长小休伯特·汉弗莱击败共和党候选人刘易斯·弗里曼和草根党候选人德里克·P·格里默。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 4, 1986. Primaries were held March 18, 1986.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1986年11月4日（星期二）举行选举，初选于当年3月18日举行。

en.s: The 1986 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the State Auditor of Minnesota. Independent Republican nominee and incumbent State Auditor Arne Carlson defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee John Dooley. As of 2025 this is the most recent election of which the incumbent Auditor won a third term.

zh.s: 1986年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。独立共和党候选人、现任审计长阿恩·卡尔森击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人约翰·杜利。截至2025年，这是现任审计长最近一次赢得第三个任期的选举。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Colorado was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Gary Hart decided to vacate his Senate seat instead of seeking a third term ahead of another presidential run which he would announce right after leaving the Senate. Democratic nominee Tim Wirth won the open seat by a narrow margin, keeping it in Democrat hands for another six years.

zh.t: 1986年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任联邦参议员加里·哈特决定腾出席位，不竞选第三个任期，以便再次竞选总统；他离开参议院后不久就宣布参选。民主党候选人蒂姆·沃思以微弱优势赢得空缺席位，使民主党继续掌控该席位六年。

en.s: The 1986 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 4, 1986, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Joe Lieberman won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Richard E. Arnold.

zh.t: 1986年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1986年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党现任总检察长乔·利伯曼再次当选，赢得第二个任期，击败共和党候选人理查德·E·阿诺德。

en.t: 1986 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 1986 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 4, 1986, to determine who would represent the state of West Virginia in the United States House of Representatives, with primary elections taking place on May 13. West Virginia had four seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1986年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1986年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行，以选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员，初选于5月13日举行。根据1980年美国人口普查划分，西弗吉尼亚州有4个众议院席位。议员任期两年。

en.s: The 1986 Nevada gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democrat Richard Bryan won re-election to a second term as Governor of Nevada, defeating Republican nominee Patty Cafferata.

zh.s: 1986年内华达州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长理查德·布赖恩成功连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人帕蒂·卡弗拉塔。

en.s: The 1986 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 4, 1986, as part of the 1986 United States elections, including the 1986 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection.

zh.s: 1986年马里兰州众议院选举于11月4日举行，是1986年美国选举的一部分，也与1986年马里兰州州长选举同时举行。州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 4, 1986, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives as well as various state and local elections. Republican Jake Garn won re-election.

zh.s: 1986年犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党人杰克·加恩成功连任。

en.s: The 1986 California Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic incumbent John Van de Kamp defeated Republican nominee Bruce Gleason with 65.99% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1986年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任总检察长约翰·范德坎普以65.99%的得票率击败共和党候选人布鲁斯·格里森。

en.t: 1986 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 1986 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on Tuesday, November 4, 1986, to elect the U.S. representative from the state's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including an election to the U.S. Senate Incumbent Republican Jim Jeffords easily won re-election with 89.2% of the vote. Democrats did not run a candidate for this seat.

zh.t: 1986年佛蒙特州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1986年佛蒙特州联邦众议员选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州唯一的联邦众议员。选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括联邦参议员选举。共和党现任众议员吉姆·杰福兹以89.2%的得票率轻松连任。民主党没有为该席位提名候选人。

en.s: The 1986 California Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic incumbent March Fong Eu defeated Republican nominee Bruce Nestande with 68.84% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1986年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州务卿马奇·方·尤以68.84%的得票率击败共和党候选人布鲁斯·内斯坦德。

en.s: The 1986 election for Florida Attorney General was held on November 4, 1986. Bob Butterworth would be elected defeating James Watt with 58.63% of the vote. Incumbent James C. Smith would not run in this election.

zh.t: 1986年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1986年佛罗里达州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。鲍勃·巴特沃思以58.63%的得票率击败詹姆斯·瓦特，当选总检察长。现任总检察长詹姆斯·C·史密斯没有参加此次选举。

en.s: The 1986 Florida gubernatorial election took place alongside the midterm congressional elections. The Democratic Party won many victories across the country (including retaking the Senate). However, in Florida, where Democrats gained the Senate seat from Republicans, they lost the Governorship for just the second time since Reconstruction. The primaries took place on September 2, the runoffs on September 30, and the general election on November 4, 1986.

zh.t: 1986年美国佛罗里达州州长选举
zh.s: 1986年美国佛罗里达州州长选举与当年国会中期选举同期举行。民主党在全国赢得多场选举，包括重新夺回联邦参议院多数席位；但在佛罗里达州，民主党虽然从共和党手中夺得联邦参议员席位，却输掉州长选举。这是重建时期以来民主党第二次失去佛罗里达州州长职位。初选于9月2日举行，决选于9月30日举行，大选于11月4日举行。

en.s: The 1986 New York State Comptroller election took place on November 4, 1986, to elect a candidate to the position of Comptroller. Republican nominee and incumbent Comptroller Edward Regan defeated Democratic nominee Herman Badillo, resulting in his election to the third of four consecutive terms he held as comptroller.

zh.s: 1986年纽约州州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出州审计长。共和党候选人、现任审计长爱德华·里根击败民主党候选人赫尔曼·巴迪略，当选其连续四个任期中的第三个任期。

en.s: The 1986 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Governor John Sununu was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Paul McEachern, who had defeated Paul M. Gagnon for the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 1986年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月4日举行。现任州长约翰·苏努努再次当选，赢得第三个任期，击败在民主党初选中击败保罗·M·加尼翁的保罗·麦克伊彻恩。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles Mathias Jr. decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Democratic U.S. Representative Barbara Mikulski defeated Reagan Administration official Linda Chavez for the open seat. Mikulski's swearing-in marked the first time since 1969 where Democrats held both Senate seats from Maryland.

zh.t: 1986年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年马里兰州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任参议员小查尔斯·马赛厄斯决定退休，不竞选第四个任期。民主党联邦众议员芭芭拉·米库尔斯基击败里根政府官员琳达·查韦斯，赢得这个空缺席位。米库尔斯基宣誓就职后，自1969年以来民主党首次同时掌握马里兰州两个联邦参议员席位。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 4, 1986 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, Secretary of the Commonwealth, treasurer, and auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 16, 1986.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1986年11月4日举行大选，包括州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和审计长等全州职位选举，也包括联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长顾问委员会成员等选区职位选举，以及州和地方的公投提案。民主党和共和党候选人分别通过1986年9月16日举行的党内初选产生。

en.t: 1986 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1986 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Representative Dick Cheney defeated Rick Gilmore with 69.28% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年怀俄明州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1986年怀俄明州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行。现任联邦众议员迪克·切尼以69.28%的得票率击败里克·吉尔摩。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Alabama took place on November 4, 1986 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Senator Jeremiah Denton lost re-election to Democrat Richard Shelby by 6,823 votes.

zh.t: 1986年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党现任参议员杰里迈亚·登顿以6,823票之差败给民主党人理查德·谢尔比。

en.t: 1986 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election
en.s: The 1986 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election was held on November 4, 1986 to elect the Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries. Albert McDonald won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1986年阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举
zh.s: 1986年阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州农业与工业专员。阿尔伯特·麦克唐纳成功连任，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Republican candidate James R. Thompson won a fourth term in office, defeating the Illinois Solidarity Party nominee, former United States Senator Adlai Stevenson III, by around 400,000 votes. Stevenson, a Democrat, originally ran for and received that party's gubernatorial nomination. However, his preferred candidate lost the lieutenant gubernatorial nomination to Mark J.

zh.t: 1986年美国伊利诺伊州州长选举
zh.s: 1986年美国伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人詹姆斯·R·汤普森击败伊利诺伊团结党候选人、前联邦参议员阿德莱·史蒂文森三世约40万票，赢得第四个任期。史蒂文森原本以民主党人身份参选，并获得民主党州长候选人提名；但他支持的副州长候选人在党内提名中输给了马克·J·……。

en.s: The 1986 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent acting state auditor Margaret B. Kelly defeated Democratic nominee Travis Morrison.

zh.s: 1986年密苏里州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、现任代理审计长玛格丽特·B·凯利击败民主党候选人特拉维斯·莫里森。

en.s: The 1986 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent Lieutenant Governor of Maryland J. Joseph Curran Jr. won the election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1986年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、马里兰州现任副州长小J·约瑟夫·柯伦在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.t: 1986 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1986 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 4, 1986, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1986, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1986年得克萨斯州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1986年得克萨斯州联邦众议员选举于1986年11月4日举行，以选出该州联邦众议院代表团成员。根据1980年美国人口普查划分，得克萨斯州有27个众议院席位。这些选举与1986年联邦参议员选举、其他州的联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1986 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 1986. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1986.

zh.s: 1986年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在多席位选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时举行。初选于1986年9月9日举行。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democratic Senator Thomas Eagleton decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican former Governor Kit Bond won the open seat. Bond was the first Republican to win the Class 3 Senate seat in Missouri since 1944, and the first Republican to get over 50% of the vote for this seat since 1920.

zh.t: 1986年密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年密苏里州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任参议员托马斯·伊格尔顿决定退休，不竞选第四个任期。共和党前州长基特·邦德赢得空缺席位。自1944年以来，这是共和党首次赢得密苏里州第三类参议员席位；自1920年以来，也首次有共和党候选人在这一席位的选举中获得超过50%的选票。

en.s: The 1986 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joan Growe defeated Independent-Republican nominee Don Koenig.

zh.s: 1986年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任州务卿琼·格罗击败独立共和党候选人唐·科尼格。

en.s: The 1986 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Democratic governor Toney Anaya was ineligible to seek a second term as governor. This was the last time until 2022, that the state elected a governor of the same party as the sitting president.

zh.s: 1986年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州长。由于任期限制，民主党现任州长托尼·阿纳亚不能竞选第二个任期。直到2022年，新墨西哥州才再次选出与时任总统同党派的州长。

en.s: The 1986 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democrat Leo T. McCarthy defeated Republican nominee, former Lieutenant Governor Mike Curb with 53.94% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1986年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任副州长利奥·T·麦卡锡以53.94%的得票率击败共和党候选人、前副州长迈克·柯布。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Iowa was held November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Chuck Grassley won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee, attorney John P. Roehrick in a landslide. This would be the last time that Grassley lost a county until 2010 when Roxanne Conlin flipped Johnson County.

zh.t: 1986年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员查克·格拉斯利以压倒性优势再次当选第二个任期，击败民主党候选人、律师约翰·P·罗里克。这是直到2010年格拉斯利输掉约翰逊县之前，他最近一次未能赢得某个县的选举。

en.s: The 1986 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democratic Governor Dick Celeste ran against four time former Governor Jim Rhodes, who had previously defeated the last two incumbent Democratic governors in 1962 and 1974. The two had faced off before in 1978, with Rhodes winning by 47,536 votes for his fourth victory. Eight years later, at the age of 77, Rhodes was attempting to win a record fifth term.

zh.s: 1986年美国俄亥俄州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任州长迪克·塞莱斯特与曾四度担任州长的吉姆·罗兹对决。罗兹曾在1962年和1974年击败两位民主党籍时任州长。两人此前在1978年交锋，当时罗兹以47,536票的优势获胜，第四次当选。8年后，77岁的罗兹试图赢得创纪录的第五个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic nominee William Donald Schaefer defeated Republican nominee Thomas J. Mooney with 82.37% of the vote. To date this is the largest percentage total ever for a contested statewide election in Maryland. As of November, 2025, this is the last time a candidate from either party carried every county in a gubernatorial election, and the last time the Democratic candidate won a majority of counties in a gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1986年马里兰州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人威廉·唐纳德·谢弗以82.37%的得票率击败共和党候选人托马斯·J·穆尼。截至目前，这是马里兰州竞争性全州选举中得票比例最高的一次。截至2025年11月，这也是任何一党候选人最近一次赢得州长选举中全州所有县的选举，也是民主党候选人最近一次赢得州长选举多数县的选举。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Kentucky was held on November 4, 1986, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democrat Wendell Ford won re-election in a landslide against Republican Jackson Andrews, winning every county in the state.

zh.t: 1986年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。民主党现任参议员温德尔·福特以压倒性优势连任，击败共和党人杰克逊·安德鲁斯，并赢得该州所有县。

en.s: The 1986 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democrat Frank J. Kelley defeated Republican nominee Robert H. Cleland with 68.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1986年密歇根州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任总检察长弗兰克·J·凯利以68.64%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·H·克利兰。

en.s: The 1986 Arizona Senate election was held on November 4, 1986. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 9, 1986. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1986年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在该州全部30个选区选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于1986年9月9日举行。选举前，共和党在州参议院占18席，对民主党的12席，拥有多数。

en.s: The 1986 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 1986. Popular three-term Democratic Governor Edgar Herschler announced that he would not seek a fourth term, creating an open seat. Attorney Mike Sullivan emerged as the unlikely Democratic nominee, and faced former state representative Pete Simpson, the Republican nominee and the brother of then-U.S. senator Alan K. Simpson, in the general election.

zh.s: 1986年美国怀俄明州州长选举于11月4日举行。广受欢迎的民主党籍三届州长埃德加·赫施勒宣布不竞选第四个任期，因此州长职位成为开放席位。律师迈克·沙利文出人意料地赢得民主党提名；大选中，他将对阵共和党候选人、前州众议员皮特·辛普森。皮特是时任联邦参议员艾伦·K·辛普森的兄弟。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Dan Quayle won re-election to a second term. He served his term until 1989 when he resigned to serve as vice president.

zh.t: 1986年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员丹·奎尔再次当选，赢得第二个任期。他任职至1989年，随后辞职出任副总统。

en.s: The 1986 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic incumbent James J. Blanchard won reelection in a landslide over Republican William Lucas. Blanchard carried every county in the state except for Ottawa County, which as of 2026, has not voted Democratic since 1890. This was the most recent election in which a male Democrat was elected governor of Michigan.

zh.s: 1986年密歇根州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州长詹姆斯·J·布兰查德以压倒性优势击败共和党人威廉·卢卡斯，成功连任。布兰查德赢得该州除渥太华县外的所有县。截至2026年，渥太华县自1890年以来再未投票支持民主党候选人。这是最近一次由男性民主党人当选密歇根州州长。

en.s: The 1986 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Democratic nominee Roy Romer defeated Republican nominee Ted L. Strickland with 58.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 1986年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党候选人罗伊·罗默以58.20%的得票率击败共和党候选人泰德·L·斯特里克兰。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Hawaii was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Senator Daniel Inouye was re-elected to a fifth term in office.

zh.t: 1986年夏威夷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年夏威夷州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员丹尼尔·井上再次当选，赢得第五个任期。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican Bob Dole defeated Democratic nominee Guy MacDonald with 70.05% of the vote.

zh.t: 1986年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任联邦参议员鲍勃·多尔以70.05%的得票率击败民主党候选人盖伊·麦克唐纳。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 4, 1986. It was concurrent with elections to the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Democratic U.S Senator John Glenn won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1986年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与联邦众议员选举同时进行。民主党现任联邦参议员约翰·格伦连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican Terry Branstad defeated Democratic nominee Lowell Junkins with 51.91% of the vote. This election was the closest of Branstad’s six campaigns for Governor.

zh.s: 1986年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长特里·布兰斯塔德以51.91%的得票率击败民主党候选人洛厄尔·詹金斯。这是布兰斯塔德六次州长选举中差距最小的一次。

en.t: 1986 North Carolina's 10th congressional district special election
en.s: A special election to the United States House of Representatives for North Carolina's 10th congressional district was held November 4, 1986. The winning candidate would serve briefly in the United States House of Representatives to represent North Carolina in the 99th Congress until the General election on January 3, 1987, however Cass Ballenger won the general election for the seat which occurred on the same day as the special election to win election to a full 2-year term until January 3, 1989.

zh.t: 1986年北卡罗来纳州第十国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1986年北卡罗来纳州第十国会选区联邦众议员特别选举于11月4日举行。获胜者将短暂担任第99届国会议员，代表该选区，直至1987年1月3日。卡斯·巴伦杰在同日举行的大选中赢得该席位，获得完整的两年任期，至1989年1月3日结束。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Frank Murkowski ran for a second term in the United States Senate and was primarily opposed by Alaska Pacific University President Glenn Olds. Following a highly competitive election in 1980, Murkowski faced a legitimate opponent in Glenn Olds, and the contest was fairly close.

zh.t: 1986年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1986年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍时任参议员弗兰克·穆尔科斯基竞选连任，争取第二个任期，主要对手是阿拉斯加太平洋大学校长格伦·奥尔兹。穆尔科斯基曾在竞争激烈的1980年选举后胜出；此次奥尔兹也构成了有力挑战，选情相当接近。

en.s: The 1986 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Democrat Richard H. Austin defeated Republican nominee Weldon Yeager with 70.2% of the vote.

zh.s: 1986年密歇根州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州务卿理查德·H·奥斯汀以70.2%的得票率击败共和党候选人韦尔登·耶格尔。

en.t: 1986 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the United States Virgin Islands on 4 November 1986, to elect a new governor and lieutenant governor, 15 members of the Legislature of the Virgin Islands and the Delegate to United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛于1986年11月4日举行大选，选出新任总督和副总督、维尔京群岛立法机构15名议员，以及一名美国联邦众议院无投票权代表。

en.s: The 1986 Alabama State Auditor election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the State Auditor of Alabama to a four-year term. Incumbent auditor Jan Cook was re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 1986年阿拉巴马州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出任期四年的州审计长。现任审计长简·库克再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 4, 1986, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1986年马里兰州审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦在没有对手的情况下连任。

en.s: The 1986 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Incumbent Republican Edward D. DiPrete defeated Democratic nominee Bruce Sundlun with 64.70% of the vote. This would be the first of three consecutive races between DiPrete and Sundlun.

zh.s: 1986年罗得岛州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任州长爱德华·D·迪普雷特以64.70%的得票率击败民主党候选人布鲁斯·桑德伦。这是迪普雷特与桑德伦连续三次交手中的第一场。

en.s: The 1986 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Democratic governor Mario Cuomo defeated Republican Andrew O'Rourke, the County Executive of Westchester County in a landslide. Cuomo carried all but 5 counties.

zh.s: 1986年纽约州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出州长和副州长。民主党现任州长马里奥·科莫以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人、威彻斯特县行政长官安德鲁·奥罗克。科莫赢得除5个县以外的所有县。

en.s: The 1986 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1986. Governor Joe Frank Harris (D) was overwhelmingly re-elected over Guy Davis (R) to win re-election. As the state was beginning to trend more Republican, this is the last election in which the Democrat won the governorship by double digits. As of 2025, this was the most recent gubernatorial election in which the winning candidate swept every county in the state.

zh.s: 1986年佐治亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党州长乔·弗兰克·哈里斯以压倒性优势击败共和党人盖伊·戴维斯，成功连任。这是佐治亚州政治开始转向共和党后，民主党候选人最后一次以两位数优势赢得州长选举。截至2025年，这是获胜者拿下全州所有县的最近一次州长选举。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 4, 1986. Primaries were held March 18, 1986. Elections were held for the offices of Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, State's Attorney, Superintendent of Education Service Region, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, both seats of the Cook County Board of Appeals, 3 seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于1986年11月4日举行大选，初选于3月18日举行。选举职位包括评估员、书记员、警长、地方检察官、教育服务区学监、财政部长、库克县委员会主席和该委员会全部17个席位、库克县上诉委员会两个席位、供水与污水处理区委员会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 4, 1986, in 36 states and two territories. The Democrats had a net loss of eight seats during this election, which coincided with the Senate and the House elections. This was despite the Democratic trend on a federal level, making this the last midterm election until 2022 where the party of the incumbent president achieved a net gain of governorships.

zh.s: 1986年11月4日，美国36个州和两个属地举行州长选举。民主党净失去8个州长职位。选举与联邦参议院和众议院选举同时举行。尽管民主党在联邦层面势头强劲，这是直到2022年，现任总统所属政党最近一次在中期选举中净增加州长职位。

en.s: The 1986 New York State Attorney General election took place on November 4, 1986, to elect a candidate to the position of Attorney General. Democratic nominee and incumbent Attorney General Robert Abrams defeated Republican nominee Peter T. King, resulting in the re-election of Abrams to the position of Attorney General.

zh.s: 1986年纽约州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长罗伯特·艾布拉姆斯击败共和党候选人彼得·T·金，成功连任。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 4, 1986, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Al D'Amato won re-election to a second term by a wide margin versus Democratic opponent Mark Green.

zh.s: 1986年纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党现任联邦参议员阿尔·达马托以较大优势击败民主党候选人马克·格林，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1986 Alabama gubernatorial election saw the election of Republican H. Guy Hunt over Democrat Bill Baxley. In state politics, this election is largely seen as a realigning election since Hunt was the first Republican to be elected governor in 114 years – the last Republican to be elected was David P. Lewis in 1872 during the Reconstruction era.

zh.s: 1986年阿拉巴马州州长选举中，共和党人H·盖伊·亨特当选，击败民主党人比尔·巴克斯利。在阿拉巴马州政治史上，这场选举常被视为一次政治格局转变：亨特是114年来首位当选州长的共和党人；此前最后一位当选州长的共和党人是重建时期的戴维·P·刘易斯（1872年）。

en.s: The 1986 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 16 of the 31 State Senate. The winners of this election served in the 70th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 1986年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民选出了州参议院31个席位中的16席。本次选举当选者将在第70届得克萨斯州议会任职。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1986 United States Senate elections were elections for the United States Senate. Held on November 4, in the middle of Ronald Reagan's second presidential term, the 34 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections. The Republicans had to defend an unusually large number of freshman Senate incumbents who had been elected on President Ronald Reagan's coattails in 1980.

zh.s: 1986年美国联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，在罗纳德·里根第二个总统任期中进行。常规选举改选第三类的34个席位。共和党需要保住数量异常多的新任参议员席位；这些议员是在1980年借助里根的胜选势头当选的。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1986 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1986 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1986 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1986年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院奇数编号的25个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期为四年，每次选举改选一半席位。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1986年选举所用的全州50个参议院选区地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1986 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 1986 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two-year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. The Democrats, led by minority leader Cornelius O'Leary, flipped control of the State Senate. They managed to gain a two-thirds majority over the Republicans, achieving a supermajority.

zh.s: 1986年康涅狄格州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。州参议院36个席位全部改选。州参议员任期为两年，每个选举周期都要竞选连任。由少数党领袖科尼利厄斯·奥利里领导的民主党夺回州参议院控制权，并取得三分之二多数，达到压倒性多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Buffalo mayoral election of 1989 took place on November 4, 1989, and resulted in incumbent mayor Jimmy Griffin winning his last term as mayor against two other opponents.

zh.s: 布法罗市于1989年11月4日举行市长选举。现任市长吉米·格里芬击败另外两名候选人，当选最后一个市长任期。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Hawaii, 1990
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate special election in Hawaii took place on November 4, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Akaka was elected to finish the term ending in 1995. He had been appointed by Governor John Waihee in April 1990 to serve temporarily after the death of Spark Matsunaga.

zh.t: 1990年夏威夷州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1990年夏威夷州联邦参议院特别选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员丹尼尔·阿卡卡当选，完成将于1995年结束的任期。1990年4月，资深参议员斯帕克·松永去世后，州长约翰·怀希任命阿卡卡暂时接任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Operation Swath-10 (Croatian: Operacija Otkos-10) was a military offensive undertaken by the Croatian Army (Hrvatska vojska, or HV) against the SAO Western Slavonia Territorial Defense Forces on Bilogora Mountain in western Slavonia. Occurring from 31 October to 4 November 1991, during the Croatian War of Independence, the operation was a Croatian victory and its success set the stage for follow-up advances by Croatian forces on Papuk Mountain in Operation Papuk-91 in late November and December.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 割草行动10号（克罗地亚语：Operacija Otkos-10）是克罗地亚军队对西斯拉沃尼亚西部比洛戈拉山上的西斯拉沃尼亚塞尔维亚自治区领土防卫部队发起的军事进攻。行动于1991年10月31日至11月4日进行，属于克罗地亚独立战争的一部分。克罗地亚获胜，为其部队在11月下旬和12月于帕普克山发动帕普克91号行动等后续攻势创造了条件。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau in 1992 to elect a President, Vice-President, Senate and House of Delegates. The first round of the presidential election took place on 22 September, whilst the run-off election and the election for the House of Delegates and Senate took place on 4 November. All candidates ran as independents.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1992年帕劳举行大选，选出总统、副总统、参议院和众议院议员。总统选举首轮于9月22日举行，决选以及众议院和参议院选举于11月4日举行。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的第二轮投票日期。

en.t: United Malays National Organisation leadership election, 1993
en.s: A leadership election was held by the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) party on 4 November 1993. It was won by incumbent Prime Minister and President of UMNO, Mahathir Mohamad.

zh.t: 1993年马来民族统一机构领导人选举
zh.s: 马来民族统一机构（巫统）于1993年11月4日举行领导人选举。现任首相、巫统主席马哈迪·莫哈末获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: China Airlines Flight 605 (callsign "Dynasty 605") was a daily non-stop flight departing from Taipei at 6:30 a.m. and arriving at Kai Tak Airport in Hong Kong at 7:00 a.m. local time. On November 4, 1993, the plane crashed after overrunning the runway on landing during a storm. It was the first major loss of a Boeing 747-400.

zh.s: 中华航空605号航班（呼号“Dynasty 605”）是每日一班的直飞航班，早上6时30分从台北起飞，早上7时抵达香港启德机场（均为当地时间）。1993年11月4日，飞机在暴风雨中降落时冲出跑道并坠毁。这是波音747-400型飞机首次发生重大损毁事故。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Buffalo mayoral election of 1993 took place on November 4, 1993, and resulted in local politician Anthony Masiello winning a first term as mayor after Jimmy Griffin had resigned against two other opponents.

zh.s: 布法罗市于1993年11月4日举行市长选举。地方政界人士安东尼·马西耶洛当选，开始第一个市长任期；此前，吉米·格里芬已经辞职。

en.s: Yitzhak Rabin, the prime minister of Israel, was assassinated on 4 November 1995 at 21:30, at the end of a rally in support of the Oslo Accords at Kings of Israel Square in Tel Aviv. The assailant was Yigal Amir, an Israeli law student and far-right ultranationalist who radically opposed the Oslo Accords and Rabin's peace initiative more broadly.

zh.s: 以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾于1995年11月4日21时30分遇刺身亡。当时，支持《奥斯陆协议》的集会刚在特拉维夫的以色列国王广场结束。袭击者是以色列法学院学生、极右翼民族主义者伊加尔·阿米尔。他强烈反对《奥斯陆协议》，也反对拉宾更广泛的和平倡议。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Rabin Square (Hebrew: כיכר רבין, romanized: Kikar Rabin), formerly Kings of Israel Square (Hebrew: כיכר מלכי ישראל, romanized: Kikar Malkhey Yisrael), is a main large public city square in the center of Tel Aviv, Israel. Over the years it has been the site of numerous political rallies, parades, and other public events. In 1995, the square was renamed 'Rabin Square' following the assassination of Yitzhak Rabin which occurred there on November 4, 1995.
en.n: In 1995, the square was renamed 'Rabin Square' following the assassination of Yitzhak Rabin which occurred there on November 4, 1995.

zh.s: 拉宾广场（希伯来语：כיכר רבין，罗马化：Kikar Rabin），旧称以色列国王广场（希伯来语：כיכר מלכי ישראל，罗马化：Kikar Malkhey Yisrael），是以色列特拉维夫市中心一处大型公共广场。多年来，这里举办过许多政治集会、游行和其他公共活动。1995年11月4日，伊扎克·拉宾在此遇刺后，广场于同年更名为“拉宾广场”。
zh.n: 1995年11月4日，伊扎克·拉宾在此遇刺后，广场于同年更名为“拉宾广场”。

en.t: United States Senate election in Idaho, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 4, 1996. Incumbent Larry Craig won re-election against Democrat Walt Minnick.

zh.t: 1996年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。现任参议员拉里·克雷格成功连任，击败民主党人沃尔特·明尼克。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1997 was a race for Governor of New Jersey. It was held on November 4, 1997. In the Democratic primary state senator and Woodbridge Township mayor James McGreevey defeated pre-primary front-runner Rep. Rob Andrews by 9,993 votes. Polls during the last month of the race showed incumbent Gov. Christine Todd Whitman (R) with only a slim lead. On election night Whitman prevailed over McGreevey by a margin of 26,953 votes, a 1.05% margin. Whitman won 46.87% of the vote, with Democratic nominee James McGreevey receiving 45.82% and Libertarian Murray Sabrin receiving 4.7%.

zh.s: 1997年新泽西州州长选举于1997年11月4日举行。民主党州参议员兼伍德布里奇镇镇长詹姆斯·麦克格里维在初选中以9,993票的优势击败初选前领跑者、联邦众议员罗布·安德鲁斯。选前一个月的民调显示，共和党籍现任州长克里斯蒂娜·托德·惠特曼仅微弱领先。最终惠特曼以26,953票、1.05个百分点的优势击败麦克格里维。惠特曼获得46.87%的选票，麦克格里维获得45.82%，自由党候选人默里·萨布林获得4.7%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1997 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 4, 1997. The incumbent mayor, Tom Murphy of the Democratic Party was running for a second straight term.

zh.s: 1997年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于11月4日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长汤姆·墨菲竞选连任第二个连续任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1997 occurred on Tuesday November 4, 1997, with incumbent Republican mayor Rudy Giuliani soundly defeating Manhattan Borough President and former New York City Council member Ruth Messinger, the Democratic nominee. They also faced several third party candidates.

zh.s: 1997年纽约市市长选举于11月4日星期二举行。共和党籍现任市长鲁迪·朱利安尼以明显优势击败民主党提名人、曼哈顿区区长和前纽约市议员露丝·梅辛格。另有几名第三党候选人参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1997 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1997. The incumbent Governor, George Allen, was barred from seeking a second term due to Virginia's unique term limits law. The Republican candidate was Jim Gilmore, the Attorney General of Virginia. The Democratic nominee was Don Beyer, the Lieutenant Governor.

zh.s: 1997年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行。由于弗吉尼亚州独特的任期限制法，时任州长乔治·艾伦不能竞选连任第二个任期。共和党候选人是弗吉尼亚州司法部长吉姆·吉尔摩，民主党提名人是副州长唐·拜尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1997 United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 4, 1997 in two states — New Jersey and Virginia. Republicans retained both seats.

zh.s: 1997年美国州长选举于11月4日在新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行。共和党保住了两个州长席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1997 Toledo, Ohio mayoral election took place on November 4, 1997. Incumbent Mayor Carty Finkbeiner ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by four opponents, including Republican businessman Nick Wichowski and neighborhood development specialist Alan Cox. In the primary, Finkbeiner placed first by a wide margin, winning 47 percent of the vote. Wichowski won 27 percent and advanced to the general election against Finkbeiner.

zh.t: 1997年美国俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 1997年美国俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举于11月4日举行。时任市长卡蒂·芬克拜纳竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他面对4名对手，其中包括共和党商人尼克·维乔夫斯基和社区发展专家艾伦·考克斯。初选中，芬克拜纳以明显优势位居第一，获得47%的选票；维乔夫斯基获得27%，晋级大选与芬克拜纳对决。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1997 occurred on Tuesday, November 4, 1997. Incumbent Thomas Menino ran unopposed, and was re-elected to his second term; he received 71 percent of the vote. Menino only faced write-in opposition. This was the first time an incumbent mayor of Boston faced no opposition on the ballot in a general election since 1834. Ahead of the election, four little-known individuals had declared their candidacy for mayor.

zh.s: 1997年波士顿市长选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。现任市长托马斯·梅尼诺没有对手，获得71%的选票，连任第二个任期。只有写入式候选人对他提出挑战。这是自1834年以来，波士顿现任市长首次在大选选票上没有对手。选举前，四名知名度不高的人士曾宣布竞选市长。

en.s: The 1997 Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 4, 1997, to elect the next attorney general of Virginia. The Republican nominee, Mark Earley, defeated the Democratic nominee, William Dolan by around 15 percent.

zh.t: 1997年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1997年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出下一任总检察长。共和党候选人马克·厄利以约15个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人威廉·多兰。

en.s: The 1997 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 1997. Republican nominee John H. Hager defeated Democratic nominee Lewis F. Payne Jr. with 50.16% of the vote. This was the first time since 1973 that a Republican was elected lieutenant governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1997年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人约翰·H·黑格尔以50.16%的得票率击败民主党候选人小刘易斯·F·佩恩。这是自1973年以来共和党人首次当选弗吉尼亚州副州长。

en.s: The 1997 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 4, 1997, and resulted in the Republican incumbent mayor William L. Heydt defeating Democratic challenger and city councilmen Martin Velazquez III. This election is remembered for its razor thin margin for the Democratic primary which saw Velazquez win by a singular vote against Emma Tropiano after a lengthy and hotly contested recount.

zh.t: 1997年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市于1997年11月4日举行市长选举。共和党现任市长威廉·L·海特击败民主党挑战者、市议员马丁·委拉斯开兹三世。此次选举因民主党初选差距极小而令人记忆深刻：经过漫长而激烈的重新计票后，委拉斯开兹仅以1票之差击败艾玛·特罗皮亚诺。

en.s: The 1997 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 4, 1997, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. Incumbent mayor Michael R. White was reelected to a third consecutive term, defeating city councilwoman Helen Knipe Smith. The election was officially nonpartisan. Since only two candidates ran, no primary was required to be held. Both candidates were Democrats.

zh.t: 1997年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举
zh.s: 1997年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。民主党现任市长迈克尔·R·怀特击败市议员海伦·克尼普·史密斯，连任第三个连续任期。选举在形式上不分党派。由于只有两名候选人参选，无需举行初选。两名候选人都是民主党人。

en.s: The 1997 Atlanta mayoral election occurred on November 4, 1997, with a runoff election held on November 25, 1997. Since no candidate received a majority in the general election, a runoff election was held between the top-two finishers. Incumbent mayor Bill Campbell won reelection in the runoff.

zh.t: 1997年佐治亚州亚特兰大市长选举
zh.s: 1997年亚特兰大市长选举于11月4日举行，决选于11月25日举行。由于没有候选人在大选中获得多数票，前两名候选人进入决选。现任市长比尔·坎贝尔在决选中成功连任。

en.s: The 1997 Seattle mayoral election took place on November 4, 1997, to select the Mayor of Seattle, Washington. Incumbent Mayor Norm Rice, who unsuccessfully ran for governor in 1996, declined to seek re-election to a third term. Eleven candidates ran to succeed him, including Port Commissioner Paul Schell, County Councilman Greg Nickels, and three members of the Seattle City Council: Charlie Chong, Cheryl Chow, and Jane Noland.

zh.t: 1997年美国华盛顿州西雅图市长选举
zh.s: 1997年美国华盛顿州西雅图市长选举于11月4日举行。时任市长诺姆·赖斯曾于1996年竞选州长但未能胜出，他决定不再竞选第三个任期。共有11名候选人参选，包括港务委员保罗·谢尔、县议员格雷格·尼克尔斯，以及3名西雅图市议员：查理·钟、周雪莉和简·诺兰。

en.s: The 1997 Boise mayoral election was held on November 4, 1997. Incumbent Mayor Brent Coles ran for re-election to a second term. No well-known candidates challenged Coles for re-election, and his only opponent was activist and public policy researcher Matthew Shapiro. Coles ultimately won re-election in a landslide, receiving 70 percent of the vote to Shapiro's 30 percent.

zh.t: 1997年爱达荷州博伊西市长选举
zh.s: 1997年博伊西市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长布伦特·科尔斯竞选连任第二个任期。没有知名候选人挑战科尔斯，他的唯一对手是活动人士、公共政策研究员马修·夏皮罗。科尔斯最终以压倒性优势连任，获得70%的选票，夏皮罗获得30%。

en.s: The 1997 Durham mayoral election was held on November 4, 1997, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Nick Tennyson. Incumbent mayor Sylvia Kerckhoff did not seek reelection.

zh.t: 1997年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举
zh.s: 1997年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举于11月4日举行，尼克·坦尼森当选。现任市长西尔维娅·科克霍夫没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 1997 Houston mayoral election took place on November 4, 1997 to elect the successor to term-limited Mayor Bob Lanier. With no candidate receiving a majority of the votes, a run-off was held on December 6, 1997. The ultimate result was Lee Brown winning the election. The election was officially non-partisan. Lee Brown won the run-off election, making him the first African-American mayor of Houston.

zh.t: 1997年得克萨斯州休斯敦市长选举
zh.s: 1997年休斯敦市长选举旨在选出任期届满的鲍勃·拉尼尔的继任者。由于没有候选人获得多数票，1997年12月6日举行决选。最终，李·布朗赢得选举。选举在形式上不分党派。李·布朗在决选中获胜，成为休斯敦首位非裔美国人市长。

en.s: The 1997 Detroit mayoral election took place on November 4, 1997 in the city of Detroit. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Dennis Archer to a second term in a landslide victory. The election was preceded by a nonpartisan primary election held on September 9, 1997.

zh.t: 1997年密歇根州底特律市长选举
zh.s: 1997年底特律市长选举于11月4日在底特律市举行。现任市长丹尼斯·阿彻以压倒性优势连任第二个任期。此前，该市于1997年9月9日举行无党派初选。

en.s: The Buffalo mayoral election of 1997 took place on November 4, 1997, and resulted in incumbent mayor Anthony Masiello winning a second term over former mayor Jimmy Griffin and two other opponents.

zh.s: 布法罗市于1997年11月4日举行市长选举。现任市长安东尼·马西耶洛击败前市长吉米·格里芬和另外两名候选人，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: Elections are held in Riverside, California to elect the city's mayor. Currently, such elections are nonpartisan and are regularly scheduled to elect mayors to four-year terms.

zh.t: 1997年加利福尼亚州里弗赛德市长选举
zh.s: 里弗赛德市举行市长选举。此类选举目前不分党派，通常每四年举行一次，以选出市长。

en.s: The 1993 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 4. The election took place alongside Christine Todd Whitman's re-election as Governor over Senator Jim McGreevey. Republicans defended the large majority they gained in the 1991 landslide elections. Four seats changed hands with no impact on the overall balance of power. Republicans Anthony R.

zh.s: 新泽西州参议院选举于11月4日举行。选举与克里斯汀·托德·惠特曼连任州长同时进行，她击败了参议员吉姆·麦格里维。共和党捍卫了其在1991年大胜后取得的多数优势。四个席位易手，但整体权力平衡没有变化。共和党人安东尼·R。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1997 was held on Tuesday, November 4. The 1997 general election yielded a 51-48-1 Democratic majority. David Brickley resigned his seat right afterward, however, and a special election for District 51 was called. His seat flipped to the Republicans, and with Independent Lacey Putney siding with the Republicans, the chamber was tied. Democrats retained the Speakership through a power-sharing agreement.

zh.s: 1997年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。大选后，民主党以51席对48席、另有1席空缺的优势占多数。不过，戴维·布里克利随后辞去席位，弗吉尼亚州第51选区举行特别选举，共和党赢得该席。独立人士莱西·普特尼支持共和党后，众议院席位数打成平手。民主党通过分享议长职权的协议保住了议长职位。

en.s: The 1997 Des Moines mayoral special election was held on October 7, 1997, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw the election of Preston Daniels. Daniels became the city's first African American mayor.

en.s: 2000 J.League Cup final was the 8th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 4, 2000. Kashima Antlers won the championship.

en.s: General elections were held in Nicaragua to elect a president and parliament on November 4, 2001.

en.s: The 2001 Montreal municipal election took place on November 4, 2001, to elect a mayor and city councillors in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Gérald Tremblay defeated incumbent Pierre Bourque to become mayor of the newly amalgamated city. All mayoral candidates were also allowed to run for a seat on council, with "alternates" who would assume the council seat if the mayoral candidates were elected to both offices.

zh.s: 2001年蒙特利尔市选举于11月4日举行，选出市长和市议员。新合并后的蒙特利尔市市长竞选中，杰拉尔德·特伦布莱击败时任市长皮埃尔·布尔克，当选市长。市长候选人也可以竞选市议会议席；如果同时当选这两个职位，由“候补人”接任市议会席位。
