en.s: The 2001 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2001 Norwegian Football Cup, the 96th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 4 November 2001 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Tippeligaen sides Bryne and Viking.

zh.s: 2001年挪威足球杯决赛是当年挪威足球杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项由挪威足球协会主办的顶级全国杯赛第96个赛季的决赛。比赛于2001年11月4日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行，由挪威足球超级联赛球队布吕讷和维京争夺冠军。

en.s: A leadership election was held for the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) in the Czech Republic prior to the 2002 parliamentary elections. The election was considered a part of preparations for the parliamentary elections and saw incumbent leader Václav Klaus run unopposed. Klaus was re-elected with 242 of the 263 votes, after which he promised that he would resign if the ODS failed to win the parliamentary elections.

zh.s: 捷克公民民主党（ODS）在2002年议会选举前举行党魁选举，作为备战的一部分。时任党魁瓦茨拉夫·克劳斯没有遇到对手，以263票中的242票再次当选。之后他承诺，如果ODS未能赢得议会选举，就辞去党魁职务。

en.s: The Yukon general election of 2002 was held on November 4, 2002 to elect members of the Yukon Legislative Assembly in the Yukon Territory in Canada.

zh.s: 加拿大育空地区于2002年11月4日举行大选，选出育空地区立法议会议员。

en.t: United States Senate election in Idaho, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 4, 2002. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Larry Craig won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 2002年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年爱达荷州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员拉里·克雷格成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: 2002 J.League Cup final was the 10th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 4, 2002. Kashima Antlers won the championship.

zh.s: 2002年日本联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第十届决赛，于2002年11月4日在东京国立竞技场举行。鹿岛鹿角队夺得冠军。

en.s: The 2003 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on 4 November 2003 for the post of governor of Mississippi. The incumbent governor, Democrat Ronnie Musgrove, was defeated by Republican Haley Barbour. The election was the most expensive yet in Mississippi with the candidates raising over 18 million dollars between them. The national parties also spent millions on television adverts for the election such as the over 5 million spent by the Republican Governors Association. Barbour's victory in the election made him only the second Republican governor of Mississippi since Reconstruction.

zh.s: 2003年密西西比州州长选举于2003年11月4日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长罗尼·穆斯格罗夫败给共和党人海利·巴伯。这是密西西比州当时花费最高的一次选举，候选人合计筹集超过1,800万美元。全国性政党也投入数百万美元投放电视广告，例如共和党州长协会就花费超过500万美元。巴伯胜选后，成为重建时期以来密西西比州第二位共和党籍州长。

en.s: The Kentucky gubernatorial election, 2003 was held to elect the Governor of Kentucky on November 4, 2003. Republican candidate Ernie Fletcher defeated Democrat Ben Chandler and became the first Republican governor of Kentucky in 32 years.

zh.s: 2003年肯塔基州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人厄尼·弗莱彻击败民主党人本·钱德勒，成为32年来该州首位共和党籍州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2003 Flint mayoral election was held on November 4, 2003, following a primary election on August 5, 2003. Incumbent Mayor James W. Rutherford, who was elected in a 2002 special election following the recall of former Mayor Woodrow Stanley, ran for re-election. He was defeated in the primary election by businessman Don Williamson and County Commissioner Floyd Clack, both of whom advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 2003年弗林特市长选举于11月4日举行，此前初选已于2003年8月5日举行。现任市长詹姆斯·W·卢瑟福在前市长伍德罗·斯坦利被罢免后，于2002年特别选举中当选，此次竞选连任。他在初选中败给商人唐·威廉姆森和县委员弗洛伊德·克拉克，两人晋级大选。

en.s: The 2003 Birmingham, Alabama mayoral election was held on November 4, 2003, following a primary election on October 14, 2003, to elect the mayor of Birmingham, Alabama. Incumbent Mayor Bernard Kincaid ran for re-election to a second term. He faced seventeen opponents in the election, including former interim Mayor William A. Bell, whom Kincaid had defeated in 1999, and City Councilmembers Carole Smitherman, Lee Loder, Roderick Royal, and Gwen Sykes.

zh.s: 2003年阿拉巴马州伯明翰市长选举于11月4日举行，此前初选已于2003年10月14日举行。现任市长伯纳德·金凯德竞选连任第二个任期。他有17名对手，其中包括前临时市长威廉·A·贝尔；金凯德曾在1999年击败贝尔。其他对手还有市议员卡萝尔·史密瑟曼、李·洛德、罗德里克·罗伊尔和格温·赛克斯。

en.s: The 2003 Tucson mayoral election occurred on November 4, 2003, to elect the mayor of Tucson, and occurred coinciding with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bob Walkup.

zh.s: 2003年图森市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长，并与图森市议会第1、第2和第4选区的选举同时进行。现任市长鲍勃·沃尔克普再次当选。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 2003 took place on November 4, 2003. Voters elected the Mayor of Indianapolis, members of the Indianapolis City-County Council, as well as several other local officials. Incumbent Democrat Bart Peterson was reelected to a second term.

zh.t: 2003年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2003年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月4日举行。选民选出印第安纳波利斯市长、市县议会议员以及其他地方官员。民主党现任市长巴特·彼得森再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: A general election was held in Mississippi on November 4, 2003, to elect to four-year terms all members of the state legislature (122 representatives, 52 senators), the offices of governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, state treasurer, state auditor, secretary of state, commissioner of agriculture and commerce, and commissioner of insurance, plus all three members of the Transportation Commission and all three members of the Public Service Commission.

zh.s: 密西西比州于2003年11月4日举行大选，选出州议会全体议员，任期四年，包括122名众议员和52名参议员；同时选出州长、副州长、总检察长、州财政部长、审计长、州务卿、农业与商业专员、保险专员、运输委员会3名委员和公共服务委员会3名委员。

en.s: The 2003 San Francisco mayoral election occurred on November 4, 2003. The incumbent, Willie Brown, was termed out of office and could not seek a third term. The general election included three top candidates including then Supervisor Gavin Newsom and then president of the board of supervisors, Matt Gonzalez and former supervisor Angela Alioto.

zh.t: 2003年美国加利福尼亚州旧金山市长选举
zh.s: 2003年美国加利福尼亚州旧金山市长选举于11月4日举行。时任市长威利·布朗受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。大选有3名主要候选人，包括时任市政委员加文·纽森、市议会议长马特·冈萨雷斯和前市政委员安吉拉·阿利托。

en.s: The 2003 Boise mayoral election was held on November 4, 2003, to elect the mayor of Boise, Idaho. Mayor Brent Coles, who was elected in 2001, resigned on February 15, 2003, after being charged with bribery. Under state law, in the event of a mayoral vacancy, the city council appoints an interim successor, who serves until the "next general city election," when a mayor is elected "for the full four year term."

zh.t: 2003年美国爱达荷州博伊西市长选举
zh.s: 2003年美国爱达荷州博伊西市长选举于11月4日举行。2001年当选的市长布伦特·科尔斯于2003年2月15日因被控受贿而辞职。根据州法律，市长职位出现空缺时，市议会会任命一名临时继任者，任职至“下一次城市大选”；届时将选出一名市长，完成完整的四年任期。

en.t: 2003 Erie County, New York Executive election
en.s: The 2003 Erie County, New York Executive election took place on November 4, 2003, to select the County Executive of Erie County, New York. Incumbent Republican County Executive Joel Giambra ran for re-election to a second term, and he was challenged by Amherst Town Councilman Daniel Ward, the Democratic nominee. Gambia ultimately defeated Ward in a landslide, winning 55 percent of the vote to Ward's 45 percent.

zh.t: 2003年纽约州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 纽约州伊利县行政长官选举于2003年11月4日举行。时任共和党行政长官乔尔·詹布拉竞选连任第二届，民主党提名的阿默斯特镇议员丹尼尔·沃德向他发起挑战。最终，詹布拉以55%的得票率大胜沃德，沃德得票率为45%。

en.s: The 2003 Lansing special mayoral election was held on November 4, 2003, with a primary election that was held on August 5, 2003. Lansing Mayor David Hollister resigned on January 28, 2003, to serve as Director of the newly created Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Growth under Governor Jennifer Granholm, which elevated City Council President Tony Benavides as Mayor.

zh.t: 2003年美国密歇根州兰辛市长特别选举
zh.s: 2003年美国密歇根州兰辛市长特别选举于11月4日举行，初选于8月5日举行。市长戴维·霍利斯特于2003年1月28日辞职，转任州长詹妮弗·格兰霍姆新设立的密歇根州劳工与经济增长厅厅长；随后，市议会主席托尼·贝纳维德斯接任市长。

en.s: The 2003 San Francisco District Attorney election was held on November 4, 2003, to elect the next District Attorney of San Francisco. The election, which was held alongside the 2003 mayoral election in which Supervisor Gavin Newsom won his first term as Mayor of San Francisco, was won by former assistant District Attorney Kamala Harris, who defeated the incumbent District Attorney, Terence Hallinan.

zh.t: 2003年加利福尼亚州旧金山地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2003年加利福尼亚州旧金山地方检察官选举于11月4日举行，以选出下一任地方检察官。选举与旧金山市长选举同时举行，加文·纽森在市长选举中赢得首个任期。前助理地方检察官卡玛拉·哈里斯击败现任地方检察官特伦斯·哈利南，当选。

en.s: The 2003 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 4, 2003, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Bob Drewel was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a fourth term. A crowded race developed to succeed him, with six candidates running in total.

zh.t: 2003年美国华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2003年美国华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举于11月4日举行，选出县行政长官。民主党籍时任县行政长官鲍勃·德鲁埃尔受任期限制，不能竞选第四个任期。共有6名候选人参选，竞争接替他。

en.s: The 2003 Houston mayoral election took place to elect a successor to Mayor of Houston Lee Brown. An election was first held on November 4, 2003; as no candidate received a majority of the votes a runoff election was held on December 6, 2003, and resulted in the election of Former Deputy Secretary of Energy Bill White. The election was non-partisan.

zh.t: 2003年得克萨斯州休斯敦市长选举
zh.s: 2003年休斯敦市长选举旨在选出接替李·布朗的市长。首轮选举于2003年11月4日举行。由于没有候选人获得多数票，12月6日举行决选。能源部前副部长比尔·怀特最终当选。选举不分党派。

en.s: The 2003 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 4, 2003, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Marshall Pitts Jr.

zh.t: 2003年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2003年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长小马歇尔·皮茨再次当选。

en.s: The 2003 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 4, 2003. Incumbent Jim Roddey, the first elected County Executive, ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by County Controller Dan Onorato, the Democratic nominee. Onorato defeated Roddey by a wide margin, winning his first term as County Executive with 57 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2003年宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2003年宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。首位经选举产生的县行政长官吉姆·罗迪竞选连任第二个任期，对手是民主党候选人、县审计长丹·奥诺拉托。奥诺拉托以57%的得票率大胜罗迪，赢得首个行政长官任期。

en.s: The 2003 Des Moines mayoral election was held on October 7, and November 4, 2003, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa, USA. Frank Cownie was elected.

zh.t: 2003年艾奥瓦州得梅因市长选举
zh.s: 2003年艾奥瓦州得梅因市长选举于10月7日和11月4日举行，以选出市长。弗兰克·考尼当选。

en.s: The 2003 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 4. The election took midway through Jim McGreevey's term as Governor of New Jersey. The election ended two years of split control in favor of the Democratic Party, which regained a majority for the first time since 1991. Incumbent Senate co-president John O. Bennett was unseated for re-election by Ellen Karcher in the 12th district, and Democrats also flipped a seat in the 4th.

zh.s: 2003年新泽西州参议院选举于11月4日举行，正值州长吉姆·麦格里维任期中段。选举结束了州政府两年由两党分治的局面，民主党重新取得多数席位，这是自1991年以来首次。第12选区的现任参议院共同主席、共和党人约翰·O·贝内特败给民主党人埃伦·卡彻；民主党还在第4选区拿下一席。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2003 was held on Tuesday, November 4.

en.s: The 2003 Philadelphia mayoral election was a contest between Democratic incumbent John F. Street and Republican businessman Sam Katz. Pennsylvania governor and former mayor of Philadelphia Ed Rendell played a key role for Street by ensuring that business interests did not support Katz. The race was covered in the documentary film The Shame of a City.

zh.s: 2003年费城市长选举由民主党籍现任市长约翰·F·斯特里特与共和党商人萨姆·卡茨竞争。宾夕法尼亚州州长、费城前市长埃德·伦德尔发挥了关键作用，确保商界人士不支持卡茨。这场选举后来被拍成纪录片《城市之耻》。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2005) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from October 28, 2005, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on November 11, 2005. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2005年银色传奇锦标赛是墨西哥摔角推广组织墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL，西班牙语意为“世界摔角理事会”）举办的职业摔角赛事。赛事从2005年10月28日开始，在墨西哥竞技场举行的三场CMLL周五晚场比赛中进行，决赛于11月11日举行。这项年度赛事是为纪念摔角传奇人物埃尔·桑托举办的，也是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia were held on November 4, 2006 to determine who will represent the Commonwealth of Virginia in the United States House of Representatives. Virginia has eleven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出代表弗吉尼亚州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查分配，弗吉尼亚州在众议院有11个席位。众议员任期两年。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska, 2006
en.s: The 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on November 4, 2006 to determine who will represent the state of Nebraska in the United States House of Representatives. Nebraska has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2006年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2006年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出代表内布拉斯加州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查分配，该州有三个众议院席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2007 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 4. The election took place midway through Jon Corzine's term as Governor of New Jersey. Democrats gained an additional seat by winning two Republican seats in South Jersey (districts 1 and 2), though one-term Senator Ellen Karcher lost re-election to Jennifer Beck in the 12th district.

zh.s: 2007年新泽西州参议院选举于11月4日举行，正值州长乔恩·科尔津任期中段。民主党在南泽西州赢得第1和第2选区，额外增加一个席位；不过，任职一届的参议员埃伦·卡彻在第12选区竞选连任时输给了詹妮弗·贝克。

en.t: United States presidential election in Kansas, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 6 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kansas was won by Republican nominee John McCain by a 14.9% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state. He won all but three counties and one congressional district in the state.

zh.s: 2008年堪萨斯州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以14.9个百分点的优势赢下该州。选前，17家新闻机构都预测麦凯恩会赢，或认为该州是共和党的稳固优势州。他赢得了除3个县和1个国会选区以外的全部地区。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Indiana were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Indiana in the United States House of Representatives. Indiana has nine seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. The elections coincide with the 2008 U.S. presidential election. The current delegation comprises five Democrats and four Republicans. All 9 incumbents won re-election.

zh.t: 2008年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举于2008年11月4日举行，选出该州联邦众议员。印第安纳州在联邦众议院有9个席位，按2000年美国人口普查结果分配。议员任期两年，当选者于2009年1月3日至2011年1月3日在第111届国会任职。此次选举与2008年美国总统选举同时举行。选举前该州代表团有5名民主党人和4名共和党人，9名现任议员全部连任。

en.t: United States presidential election in South Carolina, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. South Carolina was won by Republican nominee John McCain by a 9.0% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state.

zh.s: 2008年南卡罗来纳州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名代表，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以9.0个百分点的优势赢下该州。选前，17家新闻机构都预测麦凯恩会赢，或认为该州是共和党的稳固优势州。

en.t: United States Senate election in Minnesota, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 4, 2008. After a legal battle lasting over eight months, Al Franken from the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party (DFL) defeated Republican incumbent Norm Coleman in one of the closest elections in the history of the Senate. Al Franken took his oath of office on July 7, 2009, more than half a year after the beginning of his term on January 3, 2009. When the initial count was completed on November 18, Franken was trailing Coleman by 215 votes. This close margin triggered a mandatory recount.

zh.t: 2008年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2008年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于2008年11月4日举行。经过8个多月的法律纠纷，民主党—农民—劳工党候选人艾尔·弗兰肯击败共和党籍现任参议员诺姆·科尔曼，成为美国参议院史上竞争最激烈的选举之一。弗兰肯于2009年7月7日宣誓就职，比任期于2009年1月3日开始晚了半年多。11月18日完成初步计票时，弗兰肯落后科尔曼215票。微小差距触发了强制重新计票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in New Hampshire were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who would represent the state of New Hampshire in the United States House of Representatives during the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Both seats were held by Democratic incumbents before the election, which coincided with the 2008 presidential election, as well as the state's senatorial and gubernatorial elections. The primary election was held on September 9, 2008. Republicans selected Former Representative Jeb Bradley and newspaper columnist and radio show host Jennifer Horn to challenge incumbent Representatives Carol Shea-Porter and Paul Hodes.

zh.t: 2008年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举于2008年11月4日举行，选出该州第111届国会的联邦众议员，任期为2009年1月3日至2011年1月3日。选举前，两个席位都由民主党籍现任议员占据。此次选举与2008年总统、联邦参议院和州长选举同时举行。初选于2008年9月9日举行。共和党提名前联邦众议员杰布·布拉德利和报纸专栏作家、广播节目主持人詹妮弗·霍恩，挑战现任议员卡罗尔·谢伊-波特和保罗·霍兹。

en.s: The election for Governor of Delaware took place on November 4, 2008, coinciding with the United States presidential election. Democrat Jack Markell was elected governor, succeeding incumbent Ruth Ann Minner, also a Democrat, who was prevented from running for a third term. As of 2008, Democrats had controlled the Delaware governorship for 16 years. In an upset, state Treasurer Jack Markell defeated Lieutenant Governor John Carney by 51 to 49% for the Democratic nomination on September 9. The Republican nominee was former state Superior Court Judge William Swain "Bill" Lee, defeating airline pilot Michael Protrack.

zh.s: 特拉华州州长选举于2008年11月4日举行，与美国总统选举同时进行。民主党人杰克·马克尔当选州长，接替因不能竞选第三个任期而退选的民主党籍现任州长露丝·安·明纳。截至2008年，民主党已连续16年控制特拉华州州长职位。初选中，州财长杰克·马克尔以51%比49%击败副州长约翰·卡尼，意外赢得民主党提名，初选于9月9日举行。共和党提名了前州高等法院法官威廉·斯温·“比尔”·李；他在党内提名竞争中击败了航空公司飞行员迈克尔·普罗特拉克。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania was part of the 2008 United States presidential election, which took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 21 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama by a 10.3% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state Obama would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state.

en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 5 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by the Democratic nominee, Senator Barack Obama of Illinois, by a 15.13% margin of victory. Obama took 56.91% of the vote while his Republican opponent, Senator John McCain of Arizona, took 41.78%. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state Obama would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state.

zh.s: 2008年新墨西哥州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名代表，进入选举人团投票。民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州参议员巴拉克·奥巴马以15.13个百分点的优势赢下该州，获得56.91%的选票；共和党候选人、亚利桑那州参议员约翰·麦凯恩获得41.78%。选前，17家新闻机构都预测奥巴马会赢，或认为该州是民主党的稳固优势州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Nebraska, 2008
en.s: (Main article: United States presidential election, 2008) The 2008 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 4, 2008 as part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 5 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. However, this state is one of the two states of the U.S. that, instead of giving all of its electors to the winner based on its statewide results, just 2 of them vote based on the statewide results, and the others vote based on their individual congressional district results. Nebraska, statewide, was not a swing state in 2008.

zh.s: 2008年内布拉斯加州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，进入选举人团投票。内布拉斯加州是美国仅有的两个不会把全部选举人票都交给全州普选胜者的州之一：其中2票按全州普选结果分配，其他选举人票则按各国会选区结果分配。2008年，内布拉斯加州全州范围内并非摇摆州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Colorado, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 4, 2008 as a part of the 2008 United States presidential election throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Colorado was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama by a margin of victory of 8.95%. Obama took 53.66% of the vote to McCain's 44.71%. The state was heavily targeted by both campaigns, although, prior to the election, all 17 news organizations actually considered this a state Obama would win, or otherwise considered as a blue state.

zh.s: 2008年科罗拉多州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名代表，进入选举人团投票。民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马以8.95个百分点的优势赢下该州，获得53.66%的选票；共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩获得44.71%。两党都高度重视该州，但选前17家新闻机构都预测奥巴马会赢，或认为该州偏向民主党。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Maryland were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who would represent the state of Maryland in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential election. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected serve in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Maryland has eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2007–2008 congressional delegation consisted of six Democrats and two Republicans. It is now seven Democrats and one Republican.

zh.t: 2008年马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年马里兰州联邦众议院选举于2008年11月4日举行，选出该州联邦众议员，与总统选举同时进行。议员任期两年，当选者于2009年1月3日至2011年1月3日在第111届国会任职。马里兰州有8个联邦众议院席位，按2000年美国人口普查结果分配。2007至2008年，该州代表团由6名民主党人和2名共和党人组成；选举后变为7名民主党人和1名共和党人。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2008
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 2008 in North Carolina were held on 4 November 2008 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All thirteen seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected to the 111th United States Congress. The party primary elections were held 6 May 2008. Carried on the coattails of Barack Obama winning the state in the presidential election, the Democrats added one seat to their seven won in 2006. The Republican Party won the other five. In the 8th district, Democrat Larry Kissell defeated incumbent Robin Hayes.

zh.t: 2008年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于2008年11月4日举行，是美国联邦众议院两年一度的选举的一部分。该州全部13个席位都进行改选，选出第111届国会的议员；全国共改选435席。党内初选于2008年5月6日举行。受巴拉克·奥巴马赢得该州总统选举带动，民主党在2006年赢得的7席基础上增加1席。共和党赢得其他5席。第8选区中，民主党人拉里·基塞尔击败现任议员罗宾·海斯。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 2008 was the 56th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. Democratic Party nominee Senator Barack Obama and running mate Senator Joe Biden defeated Republican Party nominee Senator John McCain and running mate Governor Sarah Palin. Barack Obama became the first African American ever to be elected president of the United States, and Joe Biden became the first Roman Catholic ever to serve as vice president. The incumbent president, George W. Bush, of the Republican Party, was ineligible to be elected to a third term due to term limits in the Twenty-second Amendment to the United States Constitution.

zh.s: 2008年美国总统选举是美国第56次四年一度的总统选举，于2008年11月4日（星期二）举行。民主党候选人、参议员巴拉克·奥巴马及其竞选搭档、参议员乔·拜登击败共和党候选人、参议员约翰·麦凯恩及其竞选搭档、州长莎拉·佩林。奥巴马成为美国历史上首位当选总统的非裔美国人，拜登则成为首位担任副总统的罗马天主教徒。共和党籍现任总统乔治·W·布什受美国宪法第二十二修正案任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in New Mexico, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in New Mexico was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Pete Domenici decided to retire instead of seeking a seventh term. All three of New Mexico's U.S. Representatives (Tom Udall, Steve Pearce, and Heather Wilson) chose to retire from the U.S. House of Representatives in order to run for the seat. Pearce defeated Wilson in the Republican primary. Udall won the Democratic primary unopposed and won the general election. Udall's win ended 36 years of Republican control of this seat.

zh.t: 2008年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2008年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举于2008年11月4日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员皮特·多梅尼奇决定退休，不再竞选第七个任期。新墨西哥州三名联邦众议员汤姆·乌德尔、史蒂夫·皮尔斯和希瑟·威尔逊均退选，改为角逐该席位。皮尔斯在共和党初选中击败威尔逊，乌德尔在民主党初选中无人挑战并赢得大选。乌德尔胜选结束了该席位长达36年的共和党控制。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 34 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Texas was won by Republican nominee John McCain by an 11.8% margin of victory despite "failing to deliver written certification of their nominations" on time to appear on the ballot. Barack Obama, the Democratic Party nominee and eventual President of the United States, made a similar error.

zh.s: 2008年得克萨斯州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出34名代表，进入选举人团投票。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以11.8个百分点的优势赢下该州，尽管共和党和民主党候选人都没有及时提交提名的书面证明，因而不符合列入选票的要求。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Maryland was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama by a 25.4% margin of victory. en.t: United States presidential election in North Carolina, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in North Carolina was part of the national event on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C.. In North Carolina, voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with a 0.32% margin of victory. Prior to the election, most news organizations considered the state as a toss-up, or swing state, but few truly believed Obama would win it. Only 1 of the 18 news/ political organizations listed here correctly predicted the result, an Obama victory.

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Hawaii took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Hawaii, the state where Barack Obama was born, gave him 71.9% of the vote with a 45.3% margin of victory in 2008. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state Obama would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state. Hawaii has voted Democratic in every presidential election since 1988.

zh.s: 2008年夏威夷州总统选举于2008年11月4日举行，是2008年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表，进入选举人团投票。巴拉克·奥巴马出生于夏威夷州，他在该州获得71.9%的选票，领先45.3个百分点。选前，17家新闻机构都预测奥巴马会赢，或认为该州是民主党的稳固优势州。自1988年以来，夏威夷州在每届总统选举中都支持民主党候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Arizona, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Arizona was won by Republican nominee and favorite son John McCain with an 8.5% margin of victory. Prior to the election, 16 of 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a red state. It was the home state of John McCain and has only been carried by a Democrat once since 1948 and 1996.

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 4, 2008 in Massachusetts as in all 50 states and D.C., as part of the 2008 United States presidential election. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Utah, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Utah were held on November 4, 2008 to determine the representatives of the state of Utah in the United States House of Representatives for the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009, until their terms of office expire on January 3, 2011. Incumbent Rob Bishop (R) was reelected in Utah's 1st congressional district. Incumbent Jim Matheson (D) was reelected in Utah's 2nd congressional district. Jason Chaffetz (R) was elected to succeed Chris Cannon (R) in Utah's 3rd congressional district. Utah has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census.

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota took place on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. Voters selected a representative for their single At-Large district, who ran on a statewide ballot. Democratic incumbent Stephanie Herseth Sandlin was challenged by the Republican nominee, businessman and attorney Chris Lien. Neither candidate was opposed in the June 3, 2008 primary. CQ Politics forecasted this race as 'Safe Democrat'. George W. Bush won in this district 61% to 39% for John Kerry in 2004.

zh.t: 2008年南达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年南达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月4日星期二举行。选民通过全州投票选出该州唯一的联邦众议员。民主党籍现任议员斯蒂芬妮·赫塞斯·桑德林面对共和党提名人、商人兼律师克里斯·连恩的挑战。两人都没有在6月3日的初选中遭遇对手。CQ Politics预测这场选举“民主党稳胜”。2004年，乔治·W·布什在该选区以61%对39%的得票率击败约翰·克里。

en.s: The Puerto Rico general election of 2008 were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008 to elect the officials of the Puerto Rican government that would serve for the next four years, most notably the Governor of Puerto Rico. The election was won by incumbent Resident Commissioner of Puerto Rico Luis Fortuño (from the New Progressive Party), who defeated the incumbent Governor, Aníbal Acevedo Vilá (from the Popular Democratic Party). Fortuño received 1,025,965 votes, and Acevedo Vilá 801,071. Also, most of the other positions were won by the candidates of the PNP, who ended up with a majority of seats in the Senate and the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2008年波多黎各大选于11月4日星期二举行，选出任期四年的波多黎各政府官员，其中最受关注的是总督。新进步党籍的波多黎各驻美国国会专员路易斯·福图尼奥击败人民民主党籍时任总督安尼瓦尔·阿塞维多·比拉，赢得选举。福图尼奥获得1,025,965票，阿塞维多·比拉获得801,071票。大多数其他职位也由新进步党候选人赢得，该党因此在参议院和众议院都取得多数席位。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New York, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in New York were held on November 4, 2008 to determine representation in the state of New York in the United States House of Representatives. New York has 29 seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 4, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Representatives were elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Pennsylvania was held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Pennsylvania in the United States House of Representatives. Pennsylvania has 19 seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 4, 2009 until January 3, 2011. en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 6 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Mississippi was won by Republican nominee John McCain with a 13.2% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state. Although the state has the largest African American percentage in the country, Mississippi remains a safe red state at the presidential level, having voted Republican every election year since 1980.

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 7 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with a 22.4% margin of victory. Connecticut was one of the six states that had every county—including traditionally Republican Litchfield County—go for Obama, the others being Hawaii, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont. Connecticut has not voted for a Republican presidential nominee since 1988 when the state was carried by George H.W.

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 4, 2008, as part of the 2008 United States presidential election held throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 3 electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by Republican nominee John McCain with a 21.5% margin of victory. Democratic nominee Barack Obama did, however, perform better in 2008 than Democratic nominee John Kerry did in 2004.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Arkansas in the United States House of Representatives. en.s: The 2008 Iowa Senate election were held on November 4, 2008. The Senate seats for the twenty-five even-numbered districts were up for election. en.s: The 2008 San Diego City Council election occurred on November 4, 2008. The primary election was held on June 5, 2008. Four of the eight seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. This was the last election for the odd-numbered districts using the boundaries created by the 2000 Redistricting Committee. No incumbent council members were eligible to run for reelection due to term limits. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates if no candidate received a majority of the votes in the first round.

zh.s: 2008年圣迭戈市议会选举于11月4日举行，初选于2008年6月5日举行。市议会八个席位中有四个席位参与选举。这是采用2000年选区重划委员会划定边界的奇数编号选区举行的最后一次选举。由于任期限制，所有现任市议员都不能竞选连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举正式上不分党派，不过多数候选人会表明自己的政党倾向。此次选举采用两轮制：先在6月举行初选；如果没有候选人在第一轮获得过半选票，11月再由得票最高的两名候选人进行决选。

en.s: The 2008 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2008 to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of the U.S. state of Montana. Incumbent governor Brian Schweitzer, a Democrat who was elected to his first four-year term in 2004, was elected to a second term with 65.5 per cent of the vote. John Bohlinger, a Republican and the incumbent lieutenant governor, was once again Schweitzer's running mate, and was re-elected to a second term. The Republican nominee was Roy Brown, a member of the Montana Senate. Brown's running mate was businessman, and future U.S. Representative and U.S. Senator, Steve Daines.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Nebraska were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who would represent the state of Nebraska in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential and senatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Nebraska has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2007-2008 congressional delegation consisted of three Republicans. No district changed hands, although CQ Politics had forecasted district 2 to be at some risk for the incumbent party.

en.s: The North Carolina gubernatorial election of 2008 was held on November 4, 2008, coinciding with the presidential, U.S. Senate, U.S. House elections, Council of State, and statewide judicial elections. Democrat Bev Perdue won the election. Because incumbent Governor Mike Easley was term-limited, the open-seat race was contested between Democrat Beverly Perdue, Republican Pat McCrory, and Libertarian Michael Munger. Likewise, Democrat Walter H. Dalton, Republican Robert Pittenger and Libertarian Phillip Rhodes vied to replace term-limited Lt. Governor Perdue. For details on that election, see North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election, 2008.

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Ted Stevens ran for re-election to a seventh term in the United States Senate. It was one of the ten Senate races that U.S. Senator John Ensign of Nevada, the chairman of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, predicted as being most competitive. The primaries were held on Tuesday, August 26. Ted Stevens was challenged by Democratic candidate Mark Begich, the mayor of Anchorage. On October 27, 2008, Stevens was convicted on seven charges of ethics violations and corruption.

en.t: North Carolina Council of State election, 2008
en.s: North Carolina elections to choose members of the Council of State (who head various executive branch departments) were held November 4, 2008. Primary elections were held on May 6, 2008 for races in which more than one candidate filed for a party's nomination. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2008
en.s: The 2008 U.S. House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 2008, to elect members to the United States House of Representatives to serve in the 111th United States Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. It coincided with the election of Barack Obama as President. All 435 voting seats, as well as all 6 non-voting seats, were up for election. The Democratic Party, which won a majority of seats in the 2006 election, expanded its control in 2008. The Republican Party, hoping to regain the majority it lost in the 2006 or at least expand its congressional membership, lost additional seats.

en.t: United States presidential election in Utah, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 5 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Utah was won by Republican nominee John McCain by a 28.0% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state. Highlighting its status as a GOP bastion, the Beehive State gave McCain one of his largest victories over Democrat Barack Obama, a near two-to-one margin.

zh.s: 2008年犹他州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区总统选举的一部分。犹他州选民选出五名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以28.0个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，17家新闻机构都认为麦凯恩会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党的稳固票仓。作为共和党的堡垒，犹他州（又称蜂巢州）以接近两倍的得票数优势击败民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马，成为麦凯恩胜幅最大的州之一。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Rhode Island were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent Rhode Island in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential and senatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Rhode Island has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2007-2008 congressional delegation consisted of two Democrats, both of whom were re-elected in 2008. Thus, no districts changed party. CQ Politics forecasted both districts as "safe" for the incumbent party.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Hawaii were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who was to represent the state of Hawaii in the United States House of Representatives for the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009, until their terms of office expire on January 3, 2011. Incumbent Neil Abercrombie (D) was reelected in Hawaii's 1st congressional district. Incumbent Mazie Hirono (D) was reelected in Hawaii's 2nd congressional district. The election coincided with the 2008 U.S. presidential election.

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 4, 2008 concurrent with the federal election in all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with 67.46%, to Republican John McCain's 30.45%, a Democratic victory margin of 37.01%. Obama carried every county by more than 60 percent of the vote with the exception of Essex County, which he won with 56 percent.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Washington, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Washington was held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Washington in the United States House of Representatives. en.s: The Connecticut Senate election, 2008 was held on November 4, 2008 to elect Senators to the Connecticut Senate for the term which began in January 2009 and ended in January 2011. The election occurred on the same date as other federal and state elections, including the quadrennial U.S. presidential election. The incumbent party in each district held onto control of their respective seats in the election, except for one seat which changed control from Republican to Democratic.

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 4, 2008. It was part of the 2008 United States presidential election which happened throughout all 50 states and D.C.. Voters chose 17 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Michigan was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama by a 16.5% margin of victory. Early on, the state was heavily targeted as a swing state. However, Obama started to pull away in the polls during the last few months, causing McCain to stop campaigning there.

en.t: United States Senate special election in Mississippi, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate special election in Mississippi was held on November 4, 2008. This election was held on the same day of Thad Cochran's re-election bid in the United States Senate election in Mississippi, 2008. The winner of this special election served the rest of the Senate term, which ended in January 2013. Unlike most senate elections, this was a non-partisan election in which the candidate who got a majority of the vote wins, and if the first place candidate did not get 50%, a runoff election with the top two candidates would have been held.

en.t: United States presidential election in Maine, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Maine is one of two states in the U.S. that instead of all of the state's 4 electors of the Electoral College to vote based upon the statewide results of the voters, two of the individual electors vote based on their congressional district because Maine has two congressional districts. en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2008
en.s: The 2008 election for North Dakota's At-large congressional district took place on November 4, 2008. The incumbent, North Dakota Democratic NPL Party Congressman Earl Pomeroy, was re-elected to his ninth term. Republican Duane Sand formally announced that he was running on March 20, 2008. en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 4, 2008. The Senate election coincided with the presidential, U.S. House elections, gubernatorial, Council of State, and statewide judicial elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Elizabeth Dole ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Democrat Kay Hagan. The November general election was the first time in North Carolina history, and only the eighth time in U.S. history, that the two major-party candidates for a U.S. Senate seat were both women.

zh.s: 2008年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，与总统、联邦众议院、州长、州行政委员会和全州司法职位选举同期举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员伊丽莎白·多尔竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人凯·哈根。这是北卡罗来纳州历史上首次，也是美国历史上仅有的第八次，两大党候选人都是女性的联邦参议院大选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Alabama in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential and senatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 4, 2009 until January 3, 2011. Alabama has seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2007-2008 congressional delegation consisted of five Republicans and two Democrats. It is now four Republicans and three Democrats. District 2 changed party (from open Republican to Democratic).

zh.t: 2008年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员，与总统和联邦参议院选举同期举行。众议员任期两年，当选者将在第111届国会任职，任期从2009年1月4日至2011年1月3日。根据2000年美国人口普查分配，阿拉巴马州在众议院有七个席位。该州2007至2008年的国会代表团由五名共和党人和两名民主党人组成；选举后变为四名共和党人和三名民主党人。第二选区的席位从共和党转为民主党，该席位原本由共和党议员空出。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Michigan were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who would represent the state of Michigan in the United States House of Representatives. Michigan had fifteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. zh.t: 2008年密歇根州联邦众议院选举

en.t: United States presidential election in Louisiana, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Louisiana which took place on November 4, 2008 was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Louisiana was won by Republican nominee John McCain by an 18.6% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise considered as a safe "red state". Although Bill Clinton carried the state twice, it had been trending Republican in recent years, despite having the second-highest percentage of African Americans in the country in 2000.

zh.s: 2008年路易斯安那州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。选民选出九名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以18.6个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，17家新闻机构都认为麦凯恩会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党的稳固票仓。比尔·克林顿曾两次赢得路易斯安那州，但近年来该州的选民逐渐转向支持共和党，尽管该州在2000年的人口中非裔占比为全美第二高。

en.t: United States presidential election in Ohio, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 4, 2008, which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 20 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with a 4.6% margin of victory. Prior to the election, most news organizations considered this state as a major swing state and bellwether. Both major party candidates visited the Buckeye State numerous times and campaigned throughout the state extensively trying to sway moderates and independent voters to their side.

zh.s: 2008年俄亥俄州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。俄亥俄州选民选出20名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马以4.6个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，多数新闻机构认为俄亥俄州是主要摇摆州，也是预测全国选举结果的风向标。两大党候选人都多次到访该州，并在全州积极竞选，争取温和派和独立选民的支持。

en.t: United States presidential election in Nevada, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Nevada was part of the 2008 United States presidential election, which took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C.. Voters chose 5 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Nevada was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with a 12.5% margin of victory. Both campaigns heavily campaigned here in 2008, as although Obama held a lead in the polls, it was not unreasonable to think that John McCain, a nationally prominent Senator from neighboring Arizona had a legitimate chance of having Nevada swing to his corner.

zh.s: 2008年内华达州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区总统选举的一部分。内华达州选民选出五名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马以12.5个百分点的优势赢得该州。2008年两党竞选团队都在该州积极拉票。虽然奥巴马在民调中领先，但约翰·麦凯恩是来自邻州亚利桑那州、在全国知名度很高的联邦参议员，因此他仍有望让内华达州转而支持自己。

en.t: United States presidential election in Tennessee, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Tennessee was won by Republican nominee John McCain by 15.06 percentage points. Prior to the election, 17 news organizations considered Tennessee a win for McCain. Early polling in Tennessee gave a solid edge to McCain over Democrat Barack Obama by up to a 20-point margin. The expected "landslide" by McCain in Tennessee meant there was little campaigning there.

zh.s: 2008年田纳西州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以15.06个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，17家新闻机构都预测麦凯恩会赢得田纳西州。早期民调显示，麦凯恩领先民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马，优势最高达20个百分点。由于预期麦凯恩会大胜，他在田纳西州的竞选活动不多。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 31 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New York was won by Democratic nominee Barack Obama with a 26.9% margin of victory. Obama took 62.88% of the vote to McCain's 36.03%. At the time this was the highest Democratic vote share in New York State since 1964, although Obama would outperform his 2008 showing in New York just four years later in 2012.

zh.s: 2008年纽约州总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美总统选举的一部分。纽约州选民选出31名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人巴拉克·奥巴马以26.9个百分点的优势赢得该州，获得62.88%的选票；共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩获得36.03%。当时，这是自1964年以来民主党候选人在纽约州取得的最高得票率。四年后的2012年，奥巴马在纽约州的表现超过了自己2008年的成绩。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 4, 2008 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. The District of Columbia went to Democrat Barack Obama by a margin of 210,403 votes out of 225,224 votes cast, about 92 percentage points of the total vote. Obama's margin was wider than John Kerry's in 2004, when Kerry won the District of Columbia by a margin of about 80 percentage points.

zh.s: 2008年哥伦比亚特区总统选举于11月4日举行，是当年全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区总统选举的一部分。选民选出三名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党人巴拉克·奥巴马在该区获得225,224张选票中的210,403张，领先约92个百分点。奥巴马的领先幅度大于约翰·克里在2004年的领先幅度；当年克里在哥伦比亚特区约领先80个百分点。

en.s: The North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election of 2008 was held on 4 November 2008, as part of the elections to the Council of State. North Carolina also held a gubernatorial election on the same day, but the offices of Governor and Lieutenant Governor are elected independently. Democrat Walter H. Dalton was elected Lieutenant Governor, succeeding term-limited Beverly Perdue, who was elected governor the same day. Dalton won a slightly larger percentage of the vote than did Perdue in her gubernatorial race, while Republican Robert Pittenger won a slightly smaller percentage than GOP gubernatorial nominee Pat McCrory and Libertarian Phillip Rhodes won a slightly larger percentage than his party's nominee for governor, Michael Munger.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota, 2008
en.s: The 2008 Minnesota U.S. House of Representatives elections took place on November 4, 2008. All 8 congressional seats that make up the state's delegation were contested. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2008
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Florida were held on November 4, 2008 to determine who will represent the state of Florida in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 4, 2009 until January 3, 2011. The election coincides with the 2008 U.S. presidential election. Florida has twenty-five seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its delegation to the 110th Congress of 2007-2009 consisted of sixteen Republicans and nine Democrats. In 2008, Districts 8 and 24 changed party from Republican to Democratic, and District 16 changed party from Democratic to Republican.

en.t: United States presidential election in Iowa, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 4, 2008 in Iowa, as part of the 2008 United States presidential election. Voters chose 7 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Iowa was won by the Democratic nominee, Senator Barack Obama of Illinois, by a 9.54% margin of victory. Obama took 53.93% of the vote while his Republican opponent, Senator John McCain of Arizona, took 44.39%. Prior to the election, all 17 news organizations considered this a state Obama would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state.

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Gordon H. Smith decided to seek re-election. Smith was the only Republican Senator from the west coast (excluding Alaska) and the only Republican holding statewide office in Oregon. He was opposed by Democrat Jeff Merkley, the Speaker of the Oregon House of Representatives, and David Brownlow of the Constitution Party of Oregon. Merkley won by a narrow margin, with Smith not conceding until two days after the election. Merkley became the first Democrat to win this seat when it last went to the Republicans in 1966.

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Warner decided to retire instead of seeking a sixth term. Democrat Mark Warner (no relation) won the open seat by the most lopsided margin for a contested Senate race in Virginia in 20 years. Warner became the first Democrat to win this seat since 1972 when the Republicans first won it.

Sununu ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Democrat Jeanne Shaheen in a rematch of the 2002 election. Shaheen's win ended 30 years of Republican control of this Senate seat.

zh.s: 新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举于2008年11月4日举行。现任共和党联邦参议员约翰·E·苏努努竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人珍妮·沙欣。这是两人继2002年后再次交手。沙欣获胜，结束了共和党对这一参议院席位长达30年的掌控。

en.t: United States Senate election in New Jersey, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in NJ was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Frank Lautenberg won re-election to a fifth, non-consecutive term.

zh.t: 2008年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员弗兰克·劳滕伯格赢得连任，开始第五个非连续任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Rhode Island, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jack Reed won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 2008年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年罗得岛州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员杰克·里德赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Maine, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Maine was held November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Susan Collins won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2008年缅因州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党联邦参议员苏珊·柯林斯赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in West Virginia, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John D. Rockefeller, IV won re-election to a fifth-term.

zh.t: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员约翰·D·洛克菲勒四世赢得连任，开始第五个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in South Carolina was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham won election to a second term.

zh.t: 2008年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党联邦参议员林赛·格雷厄姆赢得连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Dick Durbin, seeking a third term in the United States Senate, faced minimal opposition from physician Steve Sauerberg. As expected, Durbin overwhelmingly won re-election and crushed Sauerberg in a landslide.

zh.t: 2008年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员迪克·德宾竞选第三个联邦参议员任期，面对的对手只有医生史蒂夫·绍尔伯格一人，竞争并不激烈。德宾如预期般以压倒性优势赢得连任。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 2008
en.s: The 2008 South Carolina House of Representatives elections were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. The primary elections were held on June 10 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 24. The composition of the state delegation before the election was four Republicans and two Democrats. All seats were considered safe for their incumbent parties except for districts 1 and 2.

zh.t: 2008年南卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年南卡罗来纳州众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。党内初选于6月10日举行，决选于两周后的6月24日举行。选举前，该州联邦众议员代表团由4名共和党人和2名民主党人组成。除第1和第2选区外，各席位都被认为由现任政党稳操胜券。

en.s: The 2008 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 4, 2008, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 86th Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on September 9, 2008. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Republican Party of Minnesota.

zh.s: 2008年明尼苏达州众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出明尼苏达州第86届州议会的众议员。部分选区于2008年9月9日举行初选。明尼苏达民主—农民—劳工党（DFL）赢得多数席位，继续成为多数党，其后是明尼苏达州共和党。

en.t: United States Senate election in Arkansas, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Mark Pryor decided to run for a second term. No Republican filed to challenge him. His only opponent was Green Party candidate Rebekah Kennedy. He won re-election with 80% of the vote.

zh.t: 2008年阿肯色州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年阿肯色州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员马克·普赖尔决定竞选第二个任期。没有共和党人报名挑战他，他唯一的对手是绿党候选人丽贝卡·肯尼迪。普赖尔以80%的得票率赢得连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Kansas, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Pat Roberts won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 2008年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任共和党联邦参议员帕特·罗伯茨赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Attorney General election of 2008 was held on November 4, 2008. The primary election was held on April 22.

zh.t: 2008年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2008年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。党内初选于4月22日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in Minnesota on November 4, 2008. Primary elections took place on September 9, 2008.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2008年11月4日举行选举。党内初选于2008年9月9日举行。
