en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 2008
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Tom Harkin sought re-election to a fifth term in the United States Senate. Unlike all of Harkin's previous bids for re-election, he was not challenged by a sitting United States Congressman this year, instead facing small businessman Christopher Reed, who won the Republican primary by just a few hundred votes.

zh.t: 2008年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行。现任民主党联邦参议员汤姆·哈金竞选第五个联邦参议员任期。这次他没有像以往竞选连任时那样面对在任联邦众议员，而是与小企业主克里斯托弗·里德竞争。里德只以几百票的微弱优势赢得共和党初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2008 Wisconsin fall general election was held on November 4, 2008. All of Wisconsin's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election. Within the state government, sixteen seats in the Wisconsin State Senate, and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. At the presidential level, voters chose ten electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which then helped select the president of the United States.

zh.s: 2008年威斯康星州秋季大选于11月4日举行。该州全部8个联邦众议院席位都进行改选。州政府方面，威斯康星州参议院16个席位和州众议院全部99个席位也都改选。总统选举中，选民选出了10名选举人代表该州加入选举人团，由选举人团选出美国总统。

en.t: 2008 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 4, 2008, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Mike Panetta won election to a second term.

zh.t: 2008年哥伦比亚特区影子众议员选举
zh.s: 2008年11月4日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国联邦众议院影子代表选举。与没有投票权的国会代表不同，影子代表只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得议员席位。现任影子代表迈克·帕内塔当选第二个任期。

en.s: Elections to state legislatures were held on November 4, 2008, alongside other elections, in which Democrats scored significant gains in a blue wave election. Elections were held for 85 legislative chambers, with all states but Louisiana, Mississippi, New Jersey, Alabama, Maryland, and Virginia holding elections in at least one house. Michigan and Minnesota held elections for their lower, but not upper houses.

zh.s: 美国州议会选举于2008年11月4日举行，与其他选举同时进行。民主党在一轮“蓝色浪潮”中取得显著进展。85个州议会院举行选举；除路易斯安那州、密西西比州、新泽西州、阿拉巴马州、马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州外，其他州至少有一个议会院举行选举。密歇根州和明尼苏达州只改选众议院，没有改选参议院。

en.s: The 2008 Massachusetts House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 2008, the same date as the 2008 Massachusetts Senate election as well as Federal and Congressional elections. The term for elected representatives is two years, January 2009 until January 2011.

zh.s: 2008年马萨诸塞州众议院选举于11月4日举行，与2008年马萨诸塞州参议院选举及联邦选举同时进行。当选众议员的任期为两年，从2009年1月到2011年1月。

en.s: The 2008 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 4, 2008, to elect members to the 79th and 80th Legislatures; held concurrently with the presidential, U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and gubernatorial elections. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 17 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出第79届和第80届州议会的议员。选举与总统、联邦众议员、联邦参议员和州长选举同时举行。西弗吉尼亚州参议员的任期错开，每届任期四年；34个席位中有17席需要改选。

en.s: The 2008 Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries election was held on November 4, 2008, in order to elect the Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries. The election was held on a nonpartisan basis. Incumbent Commissioner Brad Avakian, who had been appointed by Governor Ted Kulongoski after Commissioner Dan Gardner resigned, was elected to a full term.

zh.t: 2008年俄勒冈州劳工与工业专员选举
zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州劳工与工业专员选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州劳工与工业专员。选举不按党派进行。现任专员布拉德·阿瓦基安此前在专员丹·加德纳辞职后由州长特德·库隆戈斯基任命，此次当选完整任期。

en.s: An election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 9, 2008. Democrats regained control of the House after 24 years after gaining seven seats, winning 25 seats compared to 16 seats for the Republicans.

zh.s: 特拉华州于2008年11月4日举行选举，改选州众议院全部41个席位。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长、副州长和州参议员等职位选举同时举行。初选于2008年9月9日举行。民主党增加7席后，重新掌控州众议院，这是24年来首次；民主党赢得25席，共和党获得16席。

en.s: Elections were held in Missouri on Tuesday, November 4, 2008.

zh.s: 密苏里州于2008年11月4日（星期二）举行选举。

en.t: 2008 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 2008 United States House of Representatives election in Montana took place on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. Voters selected a single representative for the at-large district (map), who ran on a statewide ballot. Incumbent Representative Denny Rehberg sought re-election; he was originally elected in 2000 with 52% of the vote. He was formerly a Billings area rancher, state legislator (1984–90) and Montana Lieutenant Governor (1991–97).

zh.t: 2008年美国蒙大拿州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2008年美国蒙大拿州联邦众议员选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。选民通过全州范围的投票，为该州唯一的联邦众议院选区选出一名众议员。时任众议员丹尼·雷伯格竞选连任；他于2000年首次当选，获得52%的选票。此前，他曾在比灵斯一带经营牧场，担任州议员（1984年至1990年）和蒙大拿州副州长（1991年至1997年）。

en.s: The 2008 South Carolina Senate election were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. The primary elections were held on June 10 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 24. The current composition of the state delegation is 27 Republicans and 19 Democrats. Senators are elected for four-year terms, all in the same year.

zh.t: 2008年美国南卡罗来纳州州参议院选举
zh.s: 2008年美国南卡罗来纳州州参议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。初选于6月10日举行，决选于两周后的6月24日举行。该州州参议员目前由27名共和党人和19名民主党人组成。州参议员任期四年，并在同一年全部改选。

en.s: An election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 3, 2008. A net gain of one seat by the Democrats resulted in the House being tied at 50 seats each.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2008年11月4日举行选举，改选州众议院全部100个席位。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长和州参议员等职位选举同时举行。初选于2008年6月3日举行。民主党净增一席后，州众议院两党席位各为50席。

en.s: The 2008 Alabama Public Service Commission election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect the president of the Alabama Public Service Commission. The primary election was held on June 3. Democratic nominee Lucy Baxley defeated Republican nominee Twinkle Andress Cavanaugh by a 0.7% margin. As of 2026, this is the last time that Democrats won a regularly scheduled statewide election in Alabama or that a Democrat won a statewide election in Alabama with a majority of votes.

zh.t: 2008年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举
zh.s: 2008年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会主席选举于11月4日举行，初选于6月3日举行。民主党候选人露西·巴克斯利以0.7个百分点的优势击败共和党候选人特温克尔·安德烈斯·卡瓦诺。截至2026年，这是民主党最近一次赢得阿拉巴马州按计划举行的全州选举，也是民主党候选人最近一次在该州全州选举中获得多数票。

en.s: On November 4, 2008, the U.S. state of Oregon held statewide general elections for three statewide offices (secretary of state, treasurer, and attorney general), both houses of the Oregon Legislative Assembly, and twelve state ballot measures. The primary elections were held on May 20, 2008. Both elections also included national races for President of the US, US Senator, and US House Representatives.

zh.s: 2008年11月4日，美国俄勒冈州举行全州大选，选举州务卿、州财政部长和总检察长等三个全州职位，改选俄勒冈州议会两院，并就12项州级公投提案投票。初选于2008年5月20日举行。两轮选举还包括总统、联邦参议员和联邦众议员等全国性职位。

en.s: The 2008 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 4, 2008, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 2, 2008. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. House, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2008年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，初选于2008年9月2日（星期二）举行。亚利桑那州选民在多席位选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及亚利桑那州的总统、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2008 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect the Oregon Secretary of State. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Bill Bradbury was term limited and could not run for a third consecutive term in office. Democratic state senator Kate Brown defeated Republican journalist Rick Dancer.

zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州州务卿选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任州务卿比尔·布拉德伯里受任期限制，不能连续竞选第三个任期。民主党州参议员凯特·布朗击败共和党记者里克·丹瑟。

en.s: The 2008 Will County Executive election was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Larry Walsh ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by Republican Dan S. Kennison, a businessman who ran a medical supply company. During the campaign, Walsh was arrested for driving under the influence, and "sincerely apologize[d]" to county residents "for this incident," but said that he would "absolutely not" end his campaign for re-election.

zh.t: 2008年美国伊利诺伊州威尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年美国伊利诺伊州威尔县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任县行政长官拉里·沃尔什竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他的对手是共和党候选人丹·S·肯尼森，一家医疗用品公司的经营者。竞选期间，沃尔什因酒后驾驶被捕；他向县居民“真诚道歉”，称“为这件事”致歉，但表示“绝不会”因此退出连任选举。

en.t: Timeline of the 2008 United States presidential election
en.s: The following is a timeline of major events leading up to and immediately following the United States presidential election of 2008. The election was the 56th quadrennial United States presidential election. It was held on November 4, 2008, but its significant events and background date back to about 2002. The Democratic Party nominee, Senator Barack Obama of Illinois, defeated the Republican Party's nominee, Senator John McCain of Arizona.

zh.s: 以下是2008年美国总统选举前后重要事件的时间线。该届选举是美国第56次四年一度的总统选举，于2008年11月4日举行；相关重大事件和背景可追溯至约2002年。民主党候选人、来自伊利诺伊州的联邦参议员巴拉克·奥巴马击败了共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的联邦参议员约翰·麦凯恩。

en.t: 2008 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The Northern Mariana Islands' first election of a delegate to the United States House of Representatives took place on November 4, 2008. Since the CNMI traditionally had general elections in odd-numbered years, the November 2008 ballot contained only this office. The Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands was the most recent United States jurisdiction to receive congressional representation in the United States House of Representatives (in the form of a non-voting delegate).

zh.t: 2008年北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 北马里亚纳群岛于2008年11月4日首次举行联邦众议院代表选举。由于该群岛通常在奇数年举行大选，2008年11月的选票上只有这一个职位。北马里亚纳群岛是最近一个获得联邦众议院代表权的美国辖区，代表为没有投票权的议员。

en.t: 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Missouri were held on November 4, 2008, to determine who will represent the state of Missouri in the United States House of Representatives. The primary election for candidates seeking the nomination of the Republican Party, the Democratic Party, and the Libertarian Party was held on August 5. Missouri has nine seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census.

zh.t: 2008年密苏里州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2008年密苏里州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行，以选出代表密苏里州进入联邦众议院的议员。寻求共和党、民主党和自由党提名的候选人于8月5日参加初选。根据2000年美国人口普查划分，密苏里州在联邦众议院有9个席位。

en.s: The 200 Massachusetts general elections were held on November 4, 2008 throughout Massachusetts. Among the elections which took place were those for the office of President of the United States, John Kerry's seat in the Senate, all ten seats in the Massachusetts delegation to the House of Representatives, all eight seats in the Massachusetts Governor's Council, and all of the seats of the Massachusetts Senate and Massachusetts House of Representatives.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2008年11月4日举行200场州普选。选举包括美国总统选举、约翰·克里的参议员席位、该州在联邦众议院的全部10个席位、马萨诸塞州长委员会的全部8个席位，以及州参议院和州众议院的全部席位。

en.s: The 2008 Wisconsin Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. Sixteen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin Senate were up for election—the even-numbered districts. Prior to the election 17 seats were held by Democrats, 14 were held by Republicans, and 2 seats were vacant. The primary was held on September 9, 2008, and the filing deadline was July 8, 2008.

zh.s: 2008年威斯康星州参议院选举于2008年11月4日（星期二）举行，改选33个席位中的16席，即偶数选区席位。选举前，民主党占17席，共和党占14席，另有2席空缺。初选于2008年9月9日举行，候选人登记截止日期为7月8日。

en.s: The 2008 Wisconsin State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. Before the election, 51 Assembly seats were held by Republicans and 47 seats were held by Democrats. The primary election was held on September 9, 2008. Democrats flipped five Republican-held seats and took the Assembly majority for the first time since 1994.

zh.s: 2008年威斯康星州众议院选举于2008年11月4日（星期二）举行，全部99个席位都进行改选。选举前，共和党占51席，民主党占47席。初选于2008年9月9日举行。民主党从共和党手中赢得5席，自1994年以来首次取得众议院多数。

en.s: The 2008 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 2008, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Robin Carnahan defeated Republican nominee Mitchell Hubbard, Libertarian nominee Wes Upchurch and Constitution nominee Denise C. Neely.

zh.s: 2008年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿罗宾·卡纳汉击败共和党候选人米切尔·哈伯德、自由党候选人韦斯·厄普彻奇和宪法党候选人丹妮丝·C·尼利。

en.s: Many state and local elections took place in the U.S. state of Indiana on November 4, 2008.

zh.s: 美国印第安纳州于2008年11月4日举行了多场州和地方选举。

en.s: The 2008 Elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 4, 2008, with all districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on April 22, 2008. The term of office for those elected in 2008 will run from January 6, 2009 until November 2010. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years.

zh.t: 2008年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于11月4日举行，所有选区均进行改选。初选于2008年4月22日举行。2008年当选的议员任期为两年，从2009年1月6日到2010年11月。

en.t: 2008 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 4, 2008. Among other elections, it was held concurrently with the 2008 Puerto Rico gubernatorial election. It saw the re-election incumbent mayor Jorge Santini, a member of the New Progressive Party, to a third consecutive term.

zh.t: 2008年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安于2008年11月4日举行市长选举，与波多黎各州长选举等其他选举同时进行。进步新党成员、现任市长豪尔赫·桑蒂尼再次当选，赢得连续第三个任期。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 4, 2008. Among the elections taking place were those for the office of President of the United States, all the seats of California's delegation to the House of Representatives, all of the seats of the State Assembly, and all of the odd-numbered seats of the State Senate. Twelve propositions also appeared on the ballot.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2008年11月4日举行选举，其中包括美国总统选举、联邦众议院加利福尼亚州代表团全部席位和州众议院全部席位选举，以及州参议院所有奇数选区席位选举。选票上还有12项公投提案。

en.s: The 2008 Pennsylvania Auditor General election was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent Democrat Jack Wagner of Pittsburgh was unopposed for the Democratic nomination. His opponent was Republican construction executive Chet Beiler of Penn Township, Lancaster County. Beiler was also unopposed for nomination after primary opponent Chris Walsh withdrew from the race, citing issues with nomination petitions.

zh.t: 2008年美国宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 2008年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任审计长杰克·瓦格纳未遇党内挑战，直接获得提名。他的大选对手是共和党候选人、兰开斯特县潘恩镇建筑公司负责人切特·拜勒。拜勒也未遇党内挑战；他的初选对手克里斯·沃尔什因提名请愿书问题退出竞选。

en.s: The 2008 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 4, 2008. Republican Mark Shurtleff, incumbent Attorney General of Utah, was elected to his third term in office, defeating Jean Welch Hill in a landslide. This election was Shurtleff's best statewide performance, overperforming Republican presidential nominee John McCain in the concurrent presidential election by 14%. This was the first time Grand County had voted against Shurtleff.

zh.s: 2008年犹他州总检察长选举于11月4日举行。共和党现任总检察长马克·舒特尔夫当选第三个任期，以压倒性优势击败琼·韦尔奇·希尔。这是舒特尔夫在全州选举中表现最好的一次，得票率比共和党总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩在同期总统选举中的高14个百分点。这也是大县首次投票反对舒特尔夫。

en.s: The 2008 Delaware Senate election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect 10 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state house. The primary election was held on September 9, 2008.

zh.s: 2008年特拉华州参议院选举于11月4日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的10席。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长、副州长和州众议院等职位选举同时举行。初选于2008年9月9日举行。

en.s: The 2008 Arizona Senate election was held on November 4, 2008. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 2, 2008. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 17 seats over the Democrats' 13 seats.

zh.s: 2008年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月4日举行。选民在该州全部30个选区选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于2008年9月2日举行。选举前，共和党以17席对民主党的13席占多数。

en.t: 2008 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the presidency, U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Council of State, and state senate. The primary election was held on May 6, 2008, with a primary run-off held on June 24, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2008年11月4日举行选举，改选州众议院全部120个席位。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长、州行政委员会和州参议员等职位选举同时举行。初选于2008年5月6日举行，初选决选于6月24日举行。

en.s: The 2008 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 2008, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Clint Zweifel defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Brad Lager and Constitution nominee Rodney D. Farthing.

zh.t: 2008年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2008年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州财政部长。民主党候选人、密苏里州众议院现任议员克林特·茨魏费尔击败共和党候选人、密苏里州参议院现任议员布拉德·拉格和宪法党候选人罗德尼·D·法辛。

en.s: West Virginia's 2008 general elections were held on November 4, 2008, with Primary elections being held on May 13, 2008. In the 2008 general election in West Virginia, Democratic candidates won 2 out of 3 U.S. House seats, all statewide executive offices, the U.S. Senate seat up for election, and majorities in both state legislative chambers.

zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州于2008年11月4日举行大选，初选于5月13日举行。民主党候选人赢得3个联邦众议院席位中的2席、全部州级行政职位、当年改选的联邦参议员席位，以及州议会两院的多数席位。

en.t: 2008 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2008 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 4, 2008, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Incumbent Shadow Senator Paul Strauss won reelection to a third term.

zh.t: 2008年哥伦比亚特区影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年11月4日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国联邦参议院影子参议员选举，以选出代表该区的影子议员。该议员只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会由联邦参议院正式宣誓就职或取得席位。现任影子参议员保罗·施特劳斯连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2008 Ohio Attorney General special election was held on November 4, 2008, concurrently with the Presidential Election as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Attorney General Marc Dann, who was elected in 2006, resigned on May 14, 2008 due to various scandals, thus triggering a special election. Governor Ted Strickland appointed Nancy H.

zh.t: 2008年美国俄亥俄州总检察长特别选举
zh.s: 2008年美国俄亥俄州总检察长特别选举于11月4日举行，与总统选举和联邦众议院选举同期进行。2006年当选的时任总检察长马克·丹因多项丑闻于2008年5月14日辞职，因此触发特别选举。州长特德·斯特里克兰任命南希·H·……。

en.s: The 2008 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 4, 2008, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Chris Koster defeated Republican nominee and fellow incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Michael R. Gibbons.

zh.s: 2008年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、密苏里州参议院现任议员克里斯·科斯特击败共和党候选人、同为参议院现任议员的迈克尔·R·吉本斯。

en.s: Elections to the 187th Massachusetts State Senate was held on November 4, 2008, the same date as the 2008 Massachusetts House election as well as Federal and Congressional elections. Massachusetts Senators serve two-year terms.

zh.s: 第187届马萨诸塞州参议院选举于2008年11月4日举行，与2008年马萨诸塞州众议院选举及联邦选举同时进行。马萨诸塞州参议员任期两年。

en.s: The Oklahoma state elections were held on November 4, 2008. Votes for the presidential primary were cast on February 5. The primary election for statewide offices was held on July 29, and the runoff primary election was held August 26. The 2008 elections marked the first time in State history that the Republican Party won control of the Oklahoma Senate.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州选举于2008年11月4日举行。总统初选投票于2月5日进行。州级职位初选于7月29日举行，初选决选于8月26日举行。2008年选举是俄克拉何马州历史上共和党首次控制州参议院。

en.s: The 2008 Oregon State Treasurer election was held on November 4, 2008, in order to elect the Oregon State Treasurer. Democratic nominee and member of the Oregon State Senate from the 27th district Ben Westlund defeated Republican nominee Allen Alley and Constitution nominee Michael Paul Marsh.

zh.t: 2008年俄勒冈州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州州财政部长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州财政部长。民主党候选人、俄勒冈州参议院第27选区议员本·韦斯特伦击败共和党候选人艾伦·阿利和宪法党候选人迈克尔·保罗·马什。

en.s: The 2008 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 4, 2008, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 60th session as part of the 2008 United States elections. All even-numbered seats were up for election. An additional election was held in District 27 as incumbent Republican John Barrasso retired in 2007 after being appointed to the U.S. Senate. Partisan primaries were held on August 19.

zh.s: 2008年怀俄明州参议院选举于11月4日举行，以选出第60届州参议会议员，是2008年美国选举的一部分。所有偶数选区席位都进行改选。第27选区还举行了一次额外选举；共和党现任议员约翰·巴拉索于2007年获任命进入联邦参议院后退休。两党初选于8月19日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on November 4, 2008. Primaries were held February 5, 2008.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2008年11月4日举行选举，初选于当年2月5日举行。

en.s: The 2008 United States Senate elections were held on November 4, 2008, with 35 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested. 33 seats were up for regular elections; the winners were eligible to serve 6-year terms from January 3, 2009, to January 3, 2015, as members of Class 2. There were also 2 special elections, the winners of those seats would finish the terms that ended on January 3, 2013.

zh.s: 2008年美国联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，参议院100个席位中有35席进行改选。33席按常规选举，胜选者作为第二类参议员任职六年，任期从2009年1月3日到2015年1月3日。此外还举行了两场特别选举，胜选者完成的任期到2013年1月3日结束。

en.t: 2008 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2008 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 4, 2008. Incumbent CEO Vernon Jones was term limited and could not seek a third consecutive term, and unsuccessfully ran for the U.S. Senate. In the Democratic primary to succeed Jones, County Commissioner Burrell Ellis; State Representative Stan Watson; Ann Kimbrough, Jones's Chief of Staff; former State Senator Steen Miles; and perennial candidate Joe Bembry all ran.

zh.t: 2008年美国佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年美国佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任行政长官弗农·琼斯受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期；他曾竞选联邦参议员，但未能成功。民主党初选中，共有5人竞逐接替琼斯，包括县委员伯雷尔·埃利斯、州众议员斯坦·沃森、琼斯的幕僚长安·金布罗、前州参议员斯廷·迈尔斯，以及长期参选的乔·本布里。

en.s: The 2008 Summit County, Ohio Executive election took place on November 4, 2008. County Executive James McCarthy, who won the 2004 election, resigned from office in 2007, and Russ Pry, the chairman of the county Democratic Party, was selected to replace him. Pry served out the remainder of McCarthy's term and ran for a full term in the 2008 election.

zh.t: 2008年美国俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年美国俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。2004年当选的县行政长官詹姆斯·麦卡锡于2007年辞职，县民主党主席拉斯·普赖获选接替他。普赖完成了麦卡锡剩余任期，并在2008年选举中竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 2008 San Diego City Attorney election occurred on Tuesday, November 4, 2008. The primary election was held on Tuesday, June 3, 2008. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates.

zh.t: 2008年美国加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市检察官选举
zh.s: 2008年美国加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市检察官选举于11月4日（星期二）举行。初选于6月3日（星期二）举行。加利福尼亚州的市政选举依法采用无党派形式，但多数候选人会表明党派倾向。此次选举采用两轮制：先在6月举行初选，再于11月由得票最高的两名候选人进行决选。

en.s: The 2008 gubernatorial election in Washington was held on November 4, 2008. Republican Dino Rossi and incumbent Democratic Governor Christine Gregoire emerged from the August 19 primary. This made the 2008 election a rematch between the candidates from the 2004 election, the closest gubernatorial election in the state's history. In contrast to the recounts and months of legal challenges in their previous contest, Gregoire was the clear winner on November 5 with about 53% of the vote.

zh.s: 2008年华盛顿州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党候选人迪诺·罗西和民主党现任州长克里斯蒂娜·格雷瓜尔从8月19日初选中胜出，使大选成为两人在2004年选举后的再次交锋；那次是该州历史上差距最小的州长选举。与上次选举后的重新计票和数月法律争议不同，格雷瓜尔于11月5日以约53%的得票率明确获胜。

en.s: The 2008 New Castle County Executive election was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent County Executive Chris Coons ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by former County Executive Thomas P. Gordon, and handily defeated him, winning renomination, 65–35 percent. In the general election, Coons had no opponents and won uncontested. Coons did not end up serving out his full term.

zh.t: 2008年特拉华州新堡县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年新堡县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。现任县行政长官克里斯·库恩斯竞选连任第二个任期。在民主党初选中，前县行政长官托马斯·P·戈登向他发起挑战；库恩斯以65%对35%的得票率轻松击败戈登，赢得提名。在大选中，库恩斯没有对手，自动当选。他后来没有任满整个任期。

en.t: 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2008 congressional elections in Georgia were held on November 4, 2008, to determine who would represent the state of Georgia in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential and senatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 3, 2009, until January 3, 2011. Georgia has thirteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census.

zh.t: 2008年佐治亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2008年佐治亚州联邦众议员选举于11月4日举行，以选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员，与总统和联邦参议员选举同时进行。议员任期两年，胜选者于2009年1月3日至2011年1月3日担任第111届国会议员。根据2000年美国人口普查划分，佐治亚州有13个众议院席位。

en.t: 2008 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 4, 2008. The runoff election took place on December 2, 2008. Republican Senator Saxby Chambliss, first elected in 2002, sought re-election to his position as a United States senator from Georgia. He was challenged by Democratic nominee Jim Martin and Libertarian nominee Allen Buckley. After a runoff election on December 2, Chambliss was elected.

zh.t: 2008年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2008年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举于11月4日举行，决选于2008年12月2日举行。2002年首次当选的共和党参议员萨克斯比·钱布利斯竞选连任，面对民主党候选人吉姆·马丁和自由党候选人艾伦·巴克利。钱布利斯在12月2日的决选中获胜。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 4, 2008. Primaries were held February 5, 2008. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, Board of Review districts 2 and 3, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于2008年11月4日举行大选，初选于2008年2月5日举行。选举职位包括巡回法院书记员、契约登记官、地方检察官、复核委员会第2和第3选区席位、供水与污水处理区委员会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 2008 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held to elect the Mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 4, 2008, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives and gubernatorial elections. This marked the third election to the office since the post was created in 2000. Popular incumbent Democrat Peter Corroon was elected in a nearly 2 to 1 landslide against token Republican opposition.

zh.s: 2008年犹他州盐湖县市长选举于11月4日举行，与总统、联邦众议员和州长选举同时进行。这是自2000年设立该职位以来第三次举行市长选举。深受欢迎的民主党现任市长彼得·科伦以近两倍的票数击败象征性参选的共和党对手。

en.s: The 2008 Georgia House of Representatives elections occurred on November 4, 2008, to elect the members to the Georgia House of Representatives. All fifty-six seats in the state Senate and all 180 seats in the state House were up for two-year terms. The winners of this election cycle served in the 150th Georgia General Assembly.

zh.t: 2008年美国佐治亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年美国佐治亚州众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出佐治亚州众议院议员。州参议院全部56席和州众议院全部180席均进行改选，议员任期两年。此次选举的当选者将在第150届佐治亚州议会任职。

en.s: Georgia's state elections were held on November 4, 2008. The primary elections were held on February 5, also known as Super Tuesday.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2008年11月4日举行州级选举。初选于2月5日举行，也就是“超级星期二”。

en.s: The 2008 Honolulu mayoral election was held between September 20 and November 4, 2008, in order to elect the Mayor of Honolulu. Incumbent Mayor Mufi Hannemann was re-elected after a run-off against Ann Kobayashi.

zh.t: 2008年夏威夷州檀香山市长选举
zh.s: 2008年夏威夷州檀香山市长选举于9月20日至11月4日举行，以选出市长。现任市长穆菲·汉尼曼在决选中击败安·小林，再次当选。

en.s: The 2008 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 4, 2008, to elect the County Executive of Pierce County, Washington. Incumbent County Executive John Ladenburg was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a third consecutive term. Following the adoption of ranked-choice voting by county voters in 2006, county elections were conducted with ranked-choice voting in 2008.

zh.t: 2008年华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官选举于11月4日举行，以选出县行政长官。现任民主党行政长官约翰·拉登伯格受任期限制，不能竞选第三个连续任期。皮尔斯县选民于2006年通过采用排序选择投票制，因此县里在2008年选举中采用该制度。

en.s: The 2008 Bay County Executive election was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent County Executive Thomas L. Hickner ran for re-election, seeking a fifth term. He faced Mark McFarlin, the 2004 Republican nominee for County Executive, in the general election, and won renomination by a wide margin. In the general election, Hickner faced no opposition and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.t: 2008年密歇根州贝县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年密歇根州贝县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。现任行政长官托马斯·L·希克纳竞选第五个任期，对手是2004年共和党候选人马克·麦克法林。希克纳在初选中以较大优势赢得提名；大选中他没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: The 2008 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 4, 2008. Incumbent County Executive L. Brooks Patterson ran for re-election. He was challenged by Southfield Mayor Brenda Lawrence, the Democratic nominee. Despite Democratic presidential nominee Barack Obama's landslide victory in Oakland County in the presidential election, Patterson won re-election in a landslide, defeating Lawrence with 58 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2008年密歇根州奥克兰县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2008年密歇根州奥克兰县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。现任行政长官L·布鲁克斯·帕特森竞选连任，对手是民主党候选人、南菲尔德市长布伦达·劳伦斯。尽管民主党总统候选人巴拉克·奥巴马以压倒性优势赢得奥克兰县，帕特森仍以58%的得票率大胜劳伦斯，成功连任。

en.t: 2008 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 4, 2008. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Republican nominee John McCain with a 5.2% margin of victory. Prior to the election, 15 of 17 news organizations considered this a state McCain would win, or otherwise a red state.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2008年11月4日举行总统选举。选民选出15名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人约翰·麦凯恩以5.2个百分点的优势赢得佐治亚州。选举前，17家新闻机构中的15家认为麦凯恩会赢得该州，或认为该州将支持共和党。

en.t: 2008 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2008 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 4, 2008. Seven of the eleven seats of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were contested in this election. Four incumbents were termed out of office, while three ran for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2008年旧金山市监事会选举于11月4日举行，11个席位中有7席进行改选。4名现任监事受任期限制不能继续任职，另外3人竞选连任。加利福尼亚州市政选举在形式上不分党派，但旧金山多数候选人会得到不同政党的资金和支持。

en.s: The 2008 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 16 State Senate districts. The winners of this election served in the 81st Texas Legislature. The elected senators served four-year terms in the Texas Senate.

zh.s: 2008年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在16个州参议院选区选出参议员。当选者将在第81届得克萨斯州议会任职，任期为四年。

en.s: The Illinois House of Representatives elections of 2008 determined the membership of the lower house of the 96th General Assembly. The Democratic Party increased its Majority.

zh.s: 2008年伊利诺伊州众议院选举决定了第96届州议会下院的组成。民主党增加了多数席位。

en.t: Third-party and independent candidates for the 2008 United States presidential election
en.s: This article contains lists of official third party or independent candidates associated with the 2008 United States presidential election. Third party is a term commonly used in the United States to refer to political parties other than the two major parties, the Democratic Party and Republican Party. The term is used as innumerate shorthand for all such parties, or sometimes only the largest of them.

zh.t: 2008年美国总统选举中的第三党及独立候选人
zh.s: 本文列出了与2008年美国总统选举相关的第三党或独立候选人。美国通常把民主党和共和党以外的政党称为第三党；这个词有时泛指所有这类政党，有时只指其中规模较大的政党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2008 New Mexico Senate election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state senators in all 42 of the state senate's districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the New Mexico Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S House, and state house.

zh.s: 2008年新墨西哥州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民在州参议院全部42个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期为四年。这次选举与其他职位的选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院选举。

en.s: Elections for the 75th Oregon Legislative Assembly took place in 2008. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were on May 20, 2008, and the general election was held on November 4, 2008. Fifteen of the Oregon State Senate's thirty seats were up for election, as were all 60 seats of the Oregon House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州议会第75届选举于当年举行。共和党和民主党初选于2008年5月20日举行，大选于11月4日举行。俄勒冈州参议院30个席位中的15席和州众议院全部60席都参与改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Washington has 9 Executive seats, all elected at large. In 2008, all 9 positions were up for reelection. As of 2025, this was the last set of statewide elections in Washington in which any Republicans won by double digits.

zh.s: 华盛顿州有9个行政部门职位，均由全州选民选出。2008年，这9个职位全部改选。截至2025年，这是华盛顿州最近一次共和党候选人在州级选举中以两位数优势获胜的选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Illinois State Senate Election of 2008 determined, along with 19 senators not up for re-election, the membership of the 96th Illinois State Senate. The Democratic Party retained its majority.

zh.s: 2008年伊利诺伊州参议院选举决定了州参议院的组成，另有19名参议员的席位当年不参与改选。民主党保住了多数席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 2008 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2008 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state representatives in all 70 of the state house's districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate.

zh.s: 2008年新墨西哥州众议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民在州众议院全部70个选区选出众议员。州众议员任期为两年。这次选举与其他职位的选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2008 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 81st Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans maintained control of the House, losing three seats to the Democrats.

zh.s: 2008年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在州众议院全部150个选区选出众议员。当选者将在第81届得克萨斯州议会任职，任期为两年。共和党保住众议院控制权，但失去了3个席位。

en.t: 2008 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2008 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 4, 2008. Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, who would then in turn cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president. To draw attention to this fact, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election as if they did elect members to the Electoral College.

zh.s: 2008年关岛美国总统意向投票于2008年11月4日举行。关岛是属地而非州，因此无权选出选举人团成员，由选举人代表选民投票选出总统和副总统。为引起公众对此事的关注，关岛会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统意向投票，模拟选举人团投票。

en.s: Stockton, California, held an election for mayor on June 3, 2008, and November 4, 2008. It saw the election of Ann Johnston.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2008年加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州斯托克顿于2008年6月3日和11月4日举行市长选举。安·约翰斯顿当选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的决选日期。

en.s: The 2008 Sacramento mayoral election was held on June 3, 2008 and November 4, 2008 to elect the mayor of Sacramento, California. It saw the election of Kevin Johnson, who defeated incumbent mayor Heather Fargo.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2008年萨克拉门托市长选举于6月3日和11月4日举行，选出加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托市市长。凯文·约翰逊击败现任市长希瑟·法戈，当选市长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的决选日期。

en.t: 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2008 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 4, 2008, to determine who will represent the state of Oregon in the United States House of Representatives, coinciding with the presidential and senatorial elections.

zh.t: 2008年俄勒冈州美国联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州联邦众议员选举于2008年11月4日举行，选出代表俄勒冈州进入美国联邦众议院的议员。选举与总统和联邦参议员选举同时举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2008 Fresno mayoral election was held on June 3, 2008 and November 4, 2008 to elect the mayor of Fresno, California. It saw the election of Ashley Swearengin. Incumbent mayor Alan Autry was term limited.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2008年弗雷斯诺市长选举于6月3日和11月4日举行。阿什利·斯韦林根当选市长。现任市长艾伦·奥特里因任期限制无法参选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框标注的决选日期。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2010) was a major annually occurring professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) that took place on November 4, 2010. The event was the tenth show held under the El Castillo del Terror banner, with the first taking place in 2000. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Castle of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated would be forced to take off his mask per the match stipulation.

zh.s: 《恐怖城堡》（El Castillo del Terror）是国际摔跤革命集团每年举办的大型职业摔跤赛事，于2010年11月4日举行。这是自2000年首届赛事以来，第十次以“恐怖城堡”为名举办的赛事。主赛是同名的“恐怖城堡”铁笼赛。按照比赛规则，最后一名被淘汰的选手必须摘下面具。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Batu Sapi by-election in the Malaysian state of Sabah was held on 4 November 2010. The nomination of candidates was done on 26 October 2010. The Batu Sapi parliamentary seat fell vacant when its Member of Parliament Datuk Edmund Chong Ket Wah of Parti Bersatu Sabah, was killed after his 750cc motorcycle accident in Sabah on 9 October 2010. Previously PBS won the seat during the 2008 General Election by a 3,708-vote majority over Independent candidate Chung Kwong Wing. A total 25,720 registered voters eligible to vote in this by-election. The electorate is made of 50.61% Bumiputera, 40.22% Chinese and 3% others.

zh.s: 马来西亚沙巴州的峇都沙比补选于2010年11月4日举行，候选人提名于10月26日进行。沙巴团结党国会议员拿督张庆信在2010年10月9日于沙巴骑乘750cc摩托车发生事故后身亡，该国会议席因此出缺。沙巴团结党此前在2008年大选中以3,708票的优势击败独立候选人钟光荣，赢得该席位。本次补选共有25,720名登记选民，有资格投票；选民中50.61%为土著，40.22%为华人，3%为其他族群。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in New Jersey were held on November 4, 2010 to determine who would represent the state of New Jersey in the United States House of Representatives. New Jersey has thirteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 111th Congress from January 2011 until January 2013.

zh.t: 2010年新泽西州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 新泽西州于2010年11月4日举行国会选举，选出代表该州进入美国众议院的议员。新泽西州在众议院有13个席位，按2000年美国人口普查结果分配。众议员任期两年，当选者将在2011年1月至2013年1月期间于第111届国会任职。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Aero Caribbean Flight 883 crashes in Cuba
en.s: On November 4, 2010, Aero Caribbean Flight 883, an ATR 72, crashed near Guasimal in Cuba’s Sancti Spíritus province. All 61 passengers and seven crew members died.

zh.t: 加勒比航空883号班机在古巴坠毁
zh.s: 2010年11月4日，加勒比航空883号班机在古巴圣斯皮里图斯省瓜西马尔附近坠毁。这架ATR 72飞机上的61名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Galas by-election was an election for the Galas seat in the Kelantan state legislative assembly to replace the incumbent, who died in office. Polling was held on 4 November 2010. Nominations were held on 26 October 2010. The Galas state seat fell vacant following the death of assemblyman Che Hashim Sulaiman on 27 September due to cancer.

zh.t: 2010年马来西亚吉兰丹州加拉斯选区补选
zh.s: 马来西亚吉兰丹州议会加拉斯选区补选于2010年11月4日举行，以填补因时任议员在任内去世而出现的空缺。提名日为2010年10月26日。该选区议员谢哈希姆·苏莱曼于9月27日因癌症去世，席位因此出缺。

en.s: The 2010 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 16 State Senate districts. The winners of this election served in the 82nd Texas Legislature. State senators typically serve four-year terms in the Texas State Senate, but all Senators come up for election in the cycles following each decennial redistricting.

zh.s: 2010年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在16个州参议院选区选出参议员。当选者将在第82届得克萨斯州议会任职。州参议员通常任期四年，但每次十年一次的重新划分选区之后，所有参议员都要参与选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Qantas Flight 32 was a regularly scheduled passenger flight from London to Sydney via Singapore. On 4 November 2010, the Airbus A380 operating the route suffered an uncontained failure in one of its four Rolls-Royce Trent 900 engines. The failure occurred over the Riau Islands, Indonesia, four minutes after takeoff from Singapore Changi Airport. After holding for almost two hours to assess the situation, the aircraft made a successful emergency landing at Changi.

zh.s: 澳洲航空32号班机是从伦敦经新加坡飞往悉尼的定期客运航班。2010年11月4日，执飞该航线的空客A380四台罗尔斯·罗伊斯遄达900发动机之一发生非包容性故障。故障发生在飞机从新加坡樟宜机场起飞4分钟后、飞越印度尼西亚廖内群岛上空时。飞机在空中盘旋近两小时评估情况后，成功紧急降落在樟宜机场。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2011 Scottish Conservatives leadership election was an internal party election to choose a new leader of the Scottish Conservatives, who at the time were the third-largest political party in the devolved Scottish Parliament. Ruth Davidson was declared the winner of the contest on 4 November 2011 and succeeded Annabel Goldie.

zh.s: 2011年苏格兰保守党领袖选举是该党内部选举，旨在选出新任党领袖。当时苏格兰保守党是权力下放后的苏格兰议会中第三大政党。鲁丝·戴维森于2011年11月4日被宣布胜选，接替安娜贝尔·戈尔迪。

en.s: The 2011 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 4. The election took place midway through Chris Christie's first term as Governor of New Jersey. No seats changed hands, though Democrats had gained one seat in a 2010 special election with Linda Greenstein's victory over Tom Goodwin. This was the first election under maps drawn after the 2010 census.

zh.s: 2011年新泽西州参议院选举于11月4日举行，时间处于克里斯·克里斯蒂州长首个任期的中期。没有席位易手；不过，民主党人在2010年特别选举中凭琳达·格林斯坦击败汤姆·古德温而多赢得一个席位。这是2010年人口普查后按新选区划分举行的首次选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2012 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2012 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 4 November 2012 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. Derry City and St Patrick's Athletic contested the final, in what was a re-match of the 2006 FAI Cup Final. On that occasion, Derry City won the trophy, winning 4–3 after extra time.

zh.s: 2012年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是当年爱尔兰足协杯的最后一场比赛。该赛事是爱尔兰共和国的全国足球杯赛。比赛于2012年11月4日在都柏林英杰华球场举行，由德里城和圣帕特里克竞技争夺冠军，这是两队在2006年足协杯决赛后的再次交锋。当年德里城在加时赛后以4比3获胜并夺得冠军。

en.s: The 2012 Thai FA Cup final was the 19th final of Thailand's domestic football cup competition, the FA Cup. The final was played at Suphachalasai Stadium in Bangkok on 4 November 2012. The match was contested by Army United, who beat Police United 2–1 in their semi-final, and Buriram United who beat Bangkok Glass 2–0 in the match.

zh.s: 2012年泰国足协杯决赛是泰国国内足球杯赛的第19届决赛，于2012年11月4日在曼谷苏帕查拉赛体育场举行。决赛双方是陆军联队和武里南联。陆军联队在半决赛中以2比1击败警察联队，武里南联则在该场比赛中以2比0击败曼谷玻璃。

en.s: The Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly election, 2012 was held in Himachal Pradesh, India in 2012 after the five-year term of the incumbent state legislature and government expired following the assembly elections of 2007. The election chose 68 MLAs to the Vidhan Sabha. The Indian National Congress won a majority of seats as well as the popular vote, and Virbhadra Singh was reappointed as the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh for his fourth term.

zh.t: 2012年喜马偕尔邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2012年喜马偕尔邦立法议会选举在印度喜马偕尔邦举行，当时上一届邦议会和政府的五年任期届满；它们是在2007年议会选举后组成的。本次选举选出68名邦议会议员。印度国民大会党赢得过半数席位和普选票，维尔巴德拉·辛格再次出任喜马偕尔邦首席部长，开始第四个任期。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Kedah State Assembly seat of Sungai Limau on 4 November 2013 with nomination day on 23 October 2013. The seat was vacated after the death of the incumbent five-term assemblyman and former Menteri Besar of Kedah, Azizan Abdul Razak on 26 September 2013 from heart complications. Tan Sri Azizan was an assemblyman from the Pan-Malaysian Islamic Party and the first PAS Menteri Besar of Kedah.

zh.t: 2013年马来西亚吉打州双溪里茂选区补选
zh.s: 马来西亚吉打州议会双溪里茂选区于2013年11月4日举行补选，提名日为10月23日。时任议员、曾任吉打州务大臣的阿兹占·阿卜杜勒·拉扎克于2013年9月26日因心脏并发症去世，该席位因此出缺。阿兹占是泛马伊斯兰党议员，也是首位来自该党的吉打州务大臣。

en.s: (See also: Colorado elections, 2014) The 2014 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Colorado, concurrently with the election to Colorado's Class II U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Hickenlooper and Lieutenant Governor Joseph García were re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican former U.S. Representative Bob Beauprez and his running mate, Douglas County Commissioner Jill Repella, by 68,000 votes.

zh.s: 2014年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出州长和副州长，同时还举行了科罗拉多州第二类联邦参议员席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。民主党籍现任州长约翰·希肯卢珀和副州长约瑟夫·加西亚成功连任，获得第二个任期；两人以68,000票的优势击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员鲍勃·博普雷兹及其竞选搭档、道格拉斯县委员吉尔·雷佩拉。

en.s: The 2014 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of California. Incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor Gavin Newsom ran for re-election to a second term in office. A primary election was held on June 3, 2014. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advance to the general election in November, even if a candidate manages to receive a majority of the votes cast in the primary election.

zh.t: 2014年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 2014年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任副州长加文·纽森竞选连任第二个任期。初选于2014年6月3日举行。根据加利福尼亚州不分党派的全面初选法，所有候选人不论党派都列在同一张选票上，选民也可投票支持任意候选人。初选中得票最高的两名候选人不论党派都会进入11月大选，即使有人在初选中获得过半选票。

en.s: The Richmond, California 2014 city election decided the mayor, three council members, and one measure submitted to the voters of Richmond, California on November 4, 2014. The election attracted national attention due to the amount of money spent by Chevron both for and against various candidates. Chevron created two political action committees (both named Moving Forward) and contributed $2,933,363.90 to them amounting to a total of about $30 per city resident. The only other source of money for them was $5000 each from the Richmond Police Officers Association and the local Firefighter's union.

zh.s: 2014年加利福尼亚州里士满市选举于11月4日举行，选出市长、三名市议员，并就一项提案进行投票。由于雪佛龙为支持或反对不同候选人投入大量资金，这场选举受到全国关注。雪佛龙成立了两个名为“向前迈进”的政治行动委员会，并向其捐款2,933,363.90美元，平均约为每位市民30美元。除此之外，这两个委员会的资金仅来自里士满警察协会和当地消防员工会各5,000美元的捐款。

en.s: The 2014 California gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of California, concurrently with elections for the rest of California's executive branch, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jerry Brown ran for re-election to a second consecutive and fourth overall term in office. Although Governors are limited to lifetime service of two terms in office, Brown previously served as Governor from 1975 to 1983 and the law only affects terms served after 1990.

zh.s: 2014年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出州长，同时还举行了该州其他行政部门职务选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。民主党籍现任州长杰里·布朗竞选连任，寻求连续第二个、总计第四个任期。州长一生最多只能任职两届，但布朗此前曾于1975年至1983年担任州长；该法律只适用于1990年之后担任的任期。

en.s: The 2014 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Idaho, concurrently with the election to Idaho's Class II U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Butch Otter ran for election to a third consecutive term in office. In primary elections held on May 20, 2014, Otter was renominated and the Democrats nominated businessman and President of the Boise School District Board of Trustees A.J. Balukoff.

zh.s: 2014年爱达荷州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出州长，同时还举行了爱达荷州第二类联邦参议员席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。共和党籍现任州长布奇·奥特竞选连续第三个任期。5月20日举行的初选中，奥特再次获得共和党提名；民主党则提名商人、博伊西学区董事会主席A·J·巴卢科夫。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota took place in the U.S. State of Minnesota on November 4, 2014, to elect Minnesota's eight representatives in the United States House of Representatives for two-year terms, one from each of Minnesota's eight congressional districts. Primary elections were held on August 12, 2014. In these elections, Minnesotans elected their oldest U.S. House delegation across the 80 cycles since statehood, at an average age of 58.8 years: Rick Nolan (age 70), Collin Peterson (70), John Kline (67), Betty McCollum (60), Keith Ellison (51), Tom Emmer (53), Tim Walz (50) and Erik Paulsen (49).

zh.t: 2014年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2014年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出该州八名联邦众议员，分别代表八个国会选区，任期两年。初选于2014年8月12日举行。此次选举产生了明尼苏达州自建州以来80届国会中年龄最大的联邦众议院代表团，平均年龄为58.8岁：里克·诺兰（70岁）、科林·彼得森（70岁）、约翰·克莱因（67岁）、贝蒂·麦科勒姆（60岁）、基思·埃利森（51岁）、汤姆·埃默（53岁）、蒂姆·沃尔兹（50岁）和埃里克·保尔森（49岁）。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska, 2014
en.s: The 2014 U.S. House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014 to elect 3 members of the U.S. House of Representatives from the state of Nebraska, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the Governor of Nebraska and a United States Senator. Primary elections to determine candidates in the general election were held on Tuesday, May 13, 2014. The Members elected at this election will serve in the 114th Congress.

zh.s: 2014年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于11月4日星期二举行，选出该州三名联邦众议员，分别代表三个国会选区。此次选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同期举行，包括内布拉斯加州州长和一名联邦参议员选举。初选于2014年5月13日星期二举行，以确定大选候选人。当选议员将在第114届国会任职。

Arkansas is one of eight states that limits its Governors to two terms for life. The Democrats nominated former U.S.

zh.s: 2014年美国阿肯色州州长选举于11月4日举行，选民将选出州长。此次选举与阿肯色州第二组联邦参议员席位改选、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举及各级州和地方选举同期举行。受州宪法规定的任期限制，民主党籍时任州长迈克·毕比不能再次竞选。阿肯色州是全美8个规定州长终身最多只能连任两届的州之一。民主党提名了前联邦……

en.s: The 2014 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Texas. This was the first open election for governor since 1990. Incumbent Republican Governor Rick Perry, who had served in the office since December 21, 2000, earlier announced that he would not run for an unprecedented fourth full term as governor. The election took place between nominees who were selected on March 4, 2014: Republican State Attorney General Greg Abbott and Democratic State Senator Wendy Davis. The ballot also featured Libertarian Party candidate Kathie Glass and Green Party candidate Brandon Parmer.

zh.s: 2014年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行。这是自1990年以来首次州长职位没有现任州长参选的选举。共和党籍现任州长里克·佩里曾于2000年12月21日就任，他早些时候宣布不再竞选史无前例的第四个完整任期。两党候选人于2014年3月4日的初选中产生：共和党人、州检察长格雷格·阿博特和民主党人、州参议员温迪·戴维斯。选票上还有自由党候选人凯西·格拉斯和绿党候选人布兰登·帕默。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oklahoma, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 4, 2014 to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Oklahoma, concurrently with the special election to Oklahoma's other Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Senator Jim Inhofe was running for re-election to a fourth term in office. He won the Republican primary against several minor candidates; Democratic nominee Matt Silverstein, an insurance agency owner, was unopposed for his party's nomination.

zh.s: 2014年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出一名代表俄克拉何马州的联邦参议员，同时还举行了该州另一席位的特别选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。共和党籍现任参议员吉姆·英霍夫竞选连任第四个任期。他在共和党初选中击败数名小党候选人；民主党候选人、保险代理机构老板马特·西尔弗斯坦则未遇对手，直接获得本党提名。

en.t: North Carolina's 12th congressional district special election, 2014
en.s: A special election for the United States House of Representatives in North Carolina's 12th congressional district was held on November 4, 2014 to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of U.S. Rep. Mel Watt following his appointment to head the Federal Housing Adminitration. North Carolina Governor Pat McCrory chose to hold the election concurrently with the regular 2014 general elections, rather than hold a separate special election at an earlier date to fill the vacancy. Party primary elections for the seat would be held May 6. Primary runoffs, if needed, were scheduled for July 15 but proved unnecessary, because the only primary winner won more than 40 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2014年北卡罗来纳州第12选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州第12国会选区联邦众议员特别选举于2014年11月4日举行，以填补梅尔·瓦特辞职后的空缺。瓦特被任命为联邦住房管理局局长后辞去联邦众议员职务。州长帕特·麦克罗里决定将特别选举与2014年常规大选安排在同一天，而不是提前另行举行选举填补空缺。该席位的党内初选于5月6日举行；如有需要，初选决选原定于7月15日举行，但因唯一胜出的初选候选人得票超过40%，无需举行决选。

en.s: The 2014 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma took place on November 4, 2014, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Oklahoma, concurrently with the regularly-scheduled election to Oklahoma's other Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014 to elect the five U.S. Representatives from the state of Connecticut, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including Governor of Connecticut. Democrats swept all five districts in 2014, bringing their winning streak in Connecticut U.S. House elections to 20 in a row – the second longest partisan winning streak in state history and the longest for the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2014年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举于11月4日星期二举行，选出该州五个国会选区各自的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同期举行，包括康涅狄格州州长选举。2014年，民主党赢得全部五个选区，连续20届在康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举中获胜。这是该州历史上第二长的同一党派连胜纪录，也是民主党在该州最长的连胜纪录。

en.s: Four justices of the seven-member North Carolina Supreme Court and four judges of the 15-member North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 4, 2014, concurrently with other state elections. Terms for seats on each court are eight years. Assessing the election results, Politifact writer Louis Jacobson noted that Supreme Court races in North Carolina and other states yielded "better-than-average results" for Democrats, who otherwise suffered heavy defeats across the country. "In a series of hotly contested North Carolina contests, two Democratic-leaning judges [Ervin and Hudson] prevailed, one Democrat [Beasley] was leading in a very close race, and one Republican [Chief Justice Martin] was re-elected," Jacobson wrote.

zh.s: 2014年11月4日，北卡罗来纳州选民选出州最高法院七名大法官中的四名，以及州上诉法院15名法官中的四名。此次选举与该州其他选举同期举行，这些法院职位的任期均为八年。选举结果公布后，Politifact作者路易斯·雅各布森指出，北卡罗来纳州和其他州最高法院选举的结果对民主党而言好于平均水平，而民主党在全美其他选举中遭遇惨败。雅各布森写道，在北卡罗来纳州一系列竞争激烈的选举中，两名倾向民主党的法官（欧文和哈德森）胜出，一名民主党人（比斯利）在一场势均力敌的选举中领先，一名共和党人（首席大法官马丁）成功连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Kansas, 2014

zh.t: 2014年堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举

en.t: California Superintendent of Public Instruction election, 2014
en.s: The 2014 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in California, the Superintendent is not elected under the state's "top-two primary". Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected via a nonpartisan primary election, with a runoff only held if no candidate receives a majority of the vote. Incumbent Superintendent Tom Torlakson ran for re-election to a second term in office. In the primary election on June 3, 2014, no candidate received a majority of the vote, so the top two finishers, Torlakson and Marshall Tuck, contested a general election, which Torlakson won.

en.s: The 2014 California Insurance Commissioner election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Insurance Commissioner of California. Incumbent Democratic Commissioner Dave Jones ran for re-election to a second term in office. A primary election was held on June 3, 2014. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advance to the general election in November, even if a candidate manages to receive a majority of the votes cast in the primary election.

Incumbent Republican Governor Paul LePage ran for re-election to a second term in office, against sitting congressman from the second district, Mike Michaud, and second-place finisher from the 2010 gubernatorial election, attorney Eliot Cutler. LePage was initially considered vulnerable in this race, due to persistent approval ratings below 50%. en.t: United States Senate election in Alabama, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Alabama took place on November 4, 2014, to elect a member of the United States Senate for the State of Alabama. Incumbent Republican Senator Jeff Sessions, who has served in the position since 1997, ran for re-election to a fourth term in office. en.s: The 2014 California State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014, with the primary election on June 3, 2014. Voters in the 20 even-numbered districts of the California State Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including the State Assembly election and the gubernatorial election. The California Republican Party won the newly-drawn 28th district and the open 34th district, gaining two seats from the California Democratic Party and ending the Democrats' supermajority in the chamber.

en.s: The 2014 Oregon gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Oregon, concurrently with other in Oregon and across the United States. Incumbent Democrat John Kitzhaber defeated Republican state legislator Dennis Richardson, winning his fourth overall, and second consecutive, four-year term as governor. The race was closer than expected due to recent revelations of potential ethical violations involving his fianceé, Cynthia Hayes. Most news outlets had called the election in his favor by 9:00 p.m. on election night, and with Kitzhaber thanking his supporters for a successful race, Richardson refused to concede due to the close tally.

zh.s: 2014年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出州长。民主党籍现任州长约翰·基茨哈伯击败共和党州议员丹尼斯·理查森，赢得州长第四个任期，也是连续第二个四年任期。由于近期有报道称基茨哈伯未婚妻辛西娅·海耶斯可能违反道德规范，选情比预期更接近。选举日当晚9点前，多数新闻媒体已宣布基茨哈伯胜选。尽管基茨哈伯感谢支持者、称竞选成功，理查森仍以票数差距很小为由拒绝承认败选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 4, 2014 in the middle of President Barack Obama's second term in office. Elections were held for all 435 seats of the House of Representatives, representing the 50 states. Elections were also held for the non-voting delegates from the District of Columbia and four of the five territories. The winners of these elections are serving in the 114th United States Congress, with seats apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States Census. The Republicans won 16 seats from Democrats, while three Republican-held seats turned Democratic.

en.t: United States Senate election in Louisiana, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 4, 2014, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Louisiana. As no candidate won a majority of the vote, a runoff was held on December 6, 2014. Incumbent Democratic Senator Mary Landrieu ran for re-election to a fourth term in office against Republican U.S. Representative Bill Cassidy and several other candidates. en.t: United States Senate election in Kentucky, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 4, 2014 to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Kentucky, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The race was initially considered one of the most competitive in the 2014 election year.

en.t: United States Senate special election in South Carolina, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate special election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 2014, concurrently with the 6-year South Carolina Senate seat election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The seat was formerly held by Republican Jim DeMint, who resigned on January 1, 2013. en.s: The 2014 California Secretary of State election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Secretary of State of California. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Debra Bowen was term limited and ineligible to run for re-election to a third term in office. A primary election was held on June 3, 2014. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advance to the general election in November, even if a candidate manages to receive a majority of the votes cast in the primary election.

zh.t: 2014年加利福尼亚州州财政长选举
zh.s: 2014年加利福尼亚州州财政长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任财政长比尔·洛克耶受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。初选于2014年6月3日举行。根据加利福尼亚州不分党派的全面初选法，所有候选人不论党派都列在同一张选票上，选民也可投票支持任意候选人。初选中得票最高的两名候选人不论党派都会进入11月大选，即使有人在初选中获得过半选票。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Hawaii, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 4, 2014, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The primary elections were held on August 9, 2014. Incumbent Democratic Senator Brian Schatz was appointed to the office in December 2012, following the death of longtime senator Daniel Inouye. The special election determined who would serve the remainder of Inouye's term, which ends on January 3, 2017.

zh.s: 2014年夏威夷州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，并与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院，以及多项州级和地方选举同期举行。初选于2014年8月9日举行。民主党籍现任参议员布莱恩·沙茨在资深参议员丹尼尔·井上去世后，于2012年12月获任命接任。特别选举决定由谁完成井上的剩余任期；该任期于2017年1月3日结束。

en.s: The 2014 South Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of South Dakota, concurrently with the election of South Dakota's Class II U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Dennis Daugaard ran for re-election to a second term in office. He won the Republican primary and ran again with incumbent Lieutenant Governor Matt Michels. The Democrats nominated State Representative Susan Wismer, who chose former State Representative Susy Blake as her running mate.

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 4, 2014, to elect a member of the United States Senate from Montana, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Democratic Senator Max Baucus, who had announced he would retire and not seek a seventh term in office, resigned from the Senate in February 2014 in order to accept an appointment as United States Ambassador to China.

zh.t: 2014年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2014年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，选出一名代表蒙大拿州的联邦参议员，同时还举行了其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。民主党参议员马克斯·鲍卡斯已宣布退休，不竞选第七个任期；他于2014年2月辞去参议员职务，接受出任美国驻华大使的任命。

en.s: The 2014 Iowa gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Iowa. Republican incumbent Terry Branstad was running for re-election to a sixth overall and second consecutive four-year term. Since he was re-elected, on December 14, 2015, he became the longest-serving governor in American history. Branstad went on to win a historic sixth term as governor by defeating Democratic challenger and State Senator Jack Hatch. Branstad won 59.1% of the popular vote to Hatch's 37.3%. Branstad won every county except Johnson County.

zh.s: 2014年爱荷华州州长选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长特里·布兰斯塔德竞选第六个、连续第二个四年任期。他成功连任，并于2015年12月14日成为美国历史上任期最长的州长。布兰斯塔德击败民主党对手、州参议员杰克·哈奇，创造州长第六次当选的纪录。他获得59.1%的普选票，哈奇获得37.3%。除约翰逊县外，布兰斯塔德赢得所有县。

en.s: The 2014 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Kansas, concurrently with the election of Kansas' Class II U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Sam Brownback ran for re-election to a second term. He was opposed in the general election by Democrat Paul Davis, the Minority Leader of the Kansas House of Representatives, and Libertarian attorney Keen Umbehr.

zh.s: 2014年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月4日举行，同时举行了该州第二类联邦参议员席位、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院，以及多项州级和地方选举。共和党籍现任州长萨姆·布朗巴克竞选连任第二个任期。大选中，他的对手包括民主党人、堪萨斯州众议院少数党领袖保罗·戴维斯，以及自由党律师基恩·昂贝尔。

en.s: Elections for the Michigan Senate was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014, with partisan primary elections to select the party's nominees held on August 5. All 38 seats in the Michigan Senate were contested, and those elected will serve in the 98th and 99th Michigan Legislatures. This was the first election for the Michigan Senate contested under the constituency boundaries drawn in consequence of the 2010 U.S. Census. The election resulted in the Republicans expanding their majority to 27 seats over the Democrats 11 seats.

zh.s: 2014年密歇根州参议院选举于11月4日星期二举行，党派初选于8月5日举行，以确定各党候选人。州参议院全部38个席位都进行改选，当选者将在密歇根州第98和第99届州议会任职。这是密歇根州参议院首次依据2010年美国人口普查后划定的选区边界举行选举。选举后，共和党将多数席位扩大至27席，民主党有11席。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Montana, 2014
en.s: The 2014 congressional election in Montana was held on November 4, 2014, to determine who will represent the state of Montana in the United States House of Representatives. Montana has one at-large seat in the House, apportioned according to the 2010 United States Census. Incumbent Republican Congressman Steve Daines was first elected in 2012. Instead of running for re-election, he successfully ran for the U.S. Senate election in 2014. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the elected will serve in the 114th United States Congress from January 3, 2015 until January 3, 2017.

zh.t: 2014年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2014年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出代表蒙大拿州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2010年美国人口普查分配，蒙大拿州在众议院有一个全州单一选区席位。共和党籍现任联邦众议员史蒂夫·戴恩斯于2012年首次当选。他没有竞选连任，而是成功当选2014年联邦参议员。联邦众议员任期两年，当选者将在第114届国会任职，任期从2015年1月3日至2017年1月3日。

en.s: The 2014 South Carolina gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of South Carolina, concurrently with the regularly-scheduled election and special election to both of South Carolina's U.S. Senate seats, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Nikki Haley ran for re-election to a second term in office. She faced Democratic State Senator Vincent Sheheen in the general election. Republican-turned-Independent Tom Ervin had been running, but he withdrew from the race and endorsed Sheheen.

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in South Carolina took place on November 4, 2014, concurrently with a special election for South Carolina's other Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Lindsey Graham won re-election. He faced Democratic State Senator Brad Hutto and Independent Thomas Ravenel in the general election. en.s: The 2014 Wisconsin gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to determine the governor and lieutenant governor of the U.S. state of Wisconsin. It occurred concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Scott Walker won re-election to a second term in office, defeating Democratic businesswoman and Madison school board member Mary Burke and two minor party candidates in the general election. Walker, who was elected in 2010, survived an attempted recall in 2012, the first governor in United States history to do so, defeating Democratic nominee Tom Barrett.

zh.s: 2014年威斯康星州州长选举于11月4日举行，选出州长和副州长，并与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州级和地方选举同期举行。共和党籍现任州长斯科特·沃克成功连任第二个任期，击败民主党商人、麦迪逊市学校委员会成员玛丽·伯克和两名小党候选人。沃克于2010年当选州长，2012年在罢免选举中胜出，成为美国历史上首位在罢免选举后继续任职的州长；他当时击败了民主党候选人汤姆·巴雷特。

en.s: The 2014 California Attorney General election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Attorney General of California. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Kamala Harris ran for re-election to a second term in office. A primary election was held on June 3, 2014. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advance to the general election in November, even if a candidate manages to receive a majority of the votes cast in the primary election.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014 to elect the five U.S. Representatives from the state of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections, including the Governor of Oklahoma and both of Oklahoma's United States Senate seats. Primary elections were held on June 24, 2014. Primary runoffs were held on August 26, 2014 in contests where no candidate won more than 50% of the vote.

zh.t: 2014年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2014年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于11月4日星期二举行，选出该州五个国会选区各自的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举及州级和地方选举同期举行，包括州长和该州两席联邦参议员选举。初选于2014年6月24日举行；无人获得超过50%选票的选区于8月26日举行初选决选。

en.s: The 2014 Arizona gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of Arizona, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Jan Brewer was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a second full term in office. After a bitter six-candidate primary, Republicans nominated Arizona State Treasurer Doug Ducey; Democrat Fred DuVal, the former Chairman of the Arizona Board of Regents, won his party's nomination unopposed. Ducey won the election with 53% of the vote.

zh.s: 2014年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月4日举行，同时举行了其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州级和地方选举。共和党籍现任州长简·布鲁尔受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二个完整任期。经过一场有六名候选人参加、竞争激烈的初选后，共和党提名州财政长道格·杜西；亚利桑那州立大学前董事会主席、民主党人弗雷德·杜瓦尔则没有对手，直接获得本党提名。杜西获得53%的选票，赢得选举。

en.t: United States Senate election in Arkansas, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held on November 4, 2014, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Arkansas, concurrently with the election of the Governor of Arkansas, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Mark Pryor ran for re-election to a third term in office. He was unopposed in the Democratic primary; U.S. Representative Tom Cotton was also unopposed for the Republican nomination.

zh.t: 2014年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2014年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行，同时举行了州长选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举。民主党籍现任参议员马克·普赖尔竞选连任第三个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手；联邦众议员汤姆·科顿也没有对手，直接获得共和党提名。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wyoming, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 4, 2014 to elect a member of the United States Senate for the State of Wyoming. Incumbent Republican Senator Mike Enzi won re-election to a fourth term in office. Enzi held Democratic nominee Charlie Hardy to just 17.5 percent of the vote – the lowest percentage of the vote for any major party nominee in Wyoming U.S. Senate electoral history out of the 39 races conducted during the direct election era.

zh.t: 2014年怀俄明州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2014年怀俄明州联邦参议院选举于11月4日举行。共和党籍现任参议员迈克·恩齐成功连任第四个任期。民主党候选人查理·哈迪的得票率仅为17.5%，这是怀俄明州直接选举时期（共举行39场选举）所有主要政党候选人的最低得票率。

en.t: United States Virgin Islands gubernatorial election, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Virgin Islands gubernatorial election took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the Governor of the United States Virgin Islands. Incumbent Democratic Governor John de Jongh is term-limited and cannot run for re-election to a third term in office. Since no candidate received a majority in the general election, as required by the Revised Organic Act of the Virgin Islands, a runoff was held between Donna Christian-Christensen and Kenneth Mapp, the two top vote receivers. Mapp went on to win the run off in a landslide victory, with almost 64% of the vote.

zh.t: 2014年美属维尔京群岛州长选举
zh.s: 2014年美属维尔京群岛州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·德容受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。根据修订后的《维尔京群岛组织法》，大选中无人获得过半选票，因此由得票最高的两名候选人唐娜·克里斯琴-克里斯滕森和肯尼斯·马普参加决选。马普在决选中以近64%的得票率大胜。

en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 4, 2014. Incumbent Democratic Senator Tom Harkin did not run for re-election to a sixth term in office. U.S. Representative Bruce Braley was unopposed for the Democratic nomination; the Republicans nominated State Senator Joni Ernst in a June 3 primary election. Douglas Butzier, who was the Libertarian nominee, died on October 14 in a single engine plane crash near Key West, Iowa. He was the pilot and the only person aboard the plane. He still appeared on the ballot, alongside Independents Bob Quast, Ruth Smith and Rick Stewart.

zh.s: 2014年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于11月4日举行，选出代表阿拉斯加州全州单一选区、进入第114届美国国会的联邦众议员。此次选举与该州第二类联邦参议员和州长选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举，以及多项州级和地方选举同期举行。共和党籍现任联邦众议员唐·扬竞选连任第二十二个任期。

en.s: The 2014 California State Controller election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the State Controller of California. Incumbent Democratic Controller John Chiang was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election to a third term in office. A primary election was held on June 3, 2014. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advance to the general election in November, even if a candidate manages to receive a majority of the votes cast in the primary election.

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Delaware, 2014

The election coincided with the election of a U.S. Senator from Delaware and other federal and state offices. Incumbent Democratic Congressman John Carney won re-election to a third term in office.

zh.s: 2014年特拉华州联邦众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州单一联邦众议院选区的代表。该代表将在第114届美国国会中代表特拉华州。此次选举与特拉华州联邦参议员及其他联邦和州级职位选举同期举行。现任民主党联邦众议员约翰·卡尼赢得连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 2014 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 4, 2014, to elect the Minnesota State Auditor. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana, 2014
en.s: The 2014 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana were held on Tuesday, November 4, 2014 to elect the six U.S. Representatives from the state of Louisiana, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the United States Senate. Under Louisiana's jungle primary system, all candidates appeared on the same ballot, regardless of party.

en.s: The 2014 Nebraska gubernatorial election took place on Tuesday, November 4, 2014 to elect the Governor of Nebraska. Republican Candidate and Former COO of TD Ameritrade Pete Ricketts defeated Democratic candidate and former Regent of the University of Nebraska Chuck Hassebrook, receiving 57.6% of the vote to Hassebrook's 38.9%.

zh.s: 2014年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人、德美利证券前首席运营官皮特·里基茨击败了民主党候选人、内布拉斯加大学前校董查克·哈斯布鲁克，分别获得57.6%和38.9%的选票。

zh.s: 2014年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州单一联邦众议院选区的代表。该代表将在第114届美国国会中代表怀俄明州。此次选举与怀俄明州联邦参议员和州长选举以及其他联邦和州级职位选举同期举行。

zh.t: 2014年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2014年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举于11月4日（星期二）举行，选出该州18名联邦众议员，每个联邦众议院选区选出1人。选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同期举行，包括伊利诺伊州州长和联邦参议员选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Illinois on November 4, 2014. All of Illinois' executive officers were up for election as well as a United States Senate seat, and all of Illinois' eighteen seats in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on March 18, 2014.

zh.s: 美国伊利诺伊州于2014年11月4日举行大选。州内所有行政职位、一个联邦参议院席位以及全部18个联邦众议院席位都在此次选举中改选。初选于2014年3月18日举行。
