en.s: A general election was held in Chesapeake, Virginia to elect various county-level officials on November 4, 2025. Primary elections took place on June 17.

zh.t: 2025年弗吉尼亚州切萨皮克市选举
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州切萨皮克市于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级职位。初选于6月17日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic state senator Ghazala Hashmi defeated Republican radio host John Reid. Hashmi succeeded Republican one-term incumbent Winsome Earle-Sears who ran for governor. John Reid won the Republican nomination on April 21, and was the first openly gay man nominated for statewide office in Virginia.

zh.s: 2025年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月4日举行。民主党州参议员加扎拉·哈什米击败共和党电台主持人约翰·里德。哈什米接替共和党一届州长温瑟姆·厄尔-西尔斯；后者竞选州长。里德于4月21日赢得共和党提名，成为弗吉尼亚州首位获主要政党提名竞选全州职位的公开同性恋男性。

en.s: The 2025 Dearborn mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025. Incumbent Mayor Abdullah Hammoud, who was first elected in the 2021 Dearborn mayoral election, ran for re-election against IT manager Nagi Almudhegi. Because only two candidates filed for the election, the primary election was cancelled. Though the election was formally nonpartisan, Hammoud is a Democrat, and was a leader in the 2024 Uncommitted National Movement, while Almudhegi is a Republican, and supported by prominent Michigan Republicans.

zh.s: 2025年迪尔伯恩市长选举于11月4日举行。2021年首次当选的现任市长阿卜杜拉·哈穆德竞选连任，对手是IT经理纳吉·阿尔穆德赫吉。由于只有两人登记参选，初选被取消。选举形式上不分党派，但哈穆德是民主党人，曾是2024年“不表态”全国运动的领袖之一；阿尔穆德赫吉是共和党人，得到密歇根州知名共和党人的支持。

loc: 特拉华县，美国宾夕法尼亚州

en.s: A general election was held in Delaware County, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various county-level positions. The primary election were held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州特拉华县选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州特拉华县于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Minneapolis City Council election occurred in the city of Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States on November 4, 2025. The Minneapolis City Council is made up of 13 members representing different parts of the city. Members elected in 2025 will serve four-year terms. Council members were elected alongside elections for mayor and other municipal offices.

zh.t: 2025年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市于2025年11月4日举行市议会选举。市议会由13名议员组成，分别代表该市不同地区。2025年当选的议员任期四年。议员选举与市长及其他市政职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2025 Seattle mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, with a primary election on August 5, 2025, to elect the mayor of Seattle. Incumbent Mayor Bruce Harrell ran for re-election to a second term and was challenged by community organizer Katie Wilson, who placed first in the August nonpartisan primary. The Seattle Times and other outlets called the election for Wilson a week after election day, with Harrell conceding to Wilson on November 13.

zh.s: 2025年西雅图市长选举于11月4日举行，初选于2025年8月5日举行，以选出西雅图市长。现任市长布鲁斯·哈勒尔竞选连任第二个任期，社区组织者凯蒂·威尔逊是他的对手；威尔逊在8月的无党派初选中排名第一。大选一周后，《西雅图时报》等媒体宣布威尔逊胜选，哈勒尔于11月13日承认败选。

en.s: The 2025 New York City Comptroller election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the comptroller of New York City. Democratic nominee Mark Levine won his first term in office, defeating Republican nominee Peter Kefalas. Levine succeeded Democratic one-term incumbent Brad Lander who ran for mayor of New York City.

zh.s: 2025年纽约市审计长选举于11月4日举行，以选出纽约市审计长。民主党候选人马克·莱文击败共和党候选人彼得·凯法拉斯，赢得首个任期。莱文接替了竞选纽约市长的民主党一届任期现任审计长布拉德·兰德。

en.s: A general election was held in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various county-level positions. The primary election was held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025–26 Texas's 18th congressional district special election to determine the member of the United States House of Representatives for Texas's 18th congressional district was held on November 4, 2025. The seat became vacant following the death of Democrat Sylvester Turner on March 5, 2025. It is considered a safely Democratic district.

zh.t: 2025—2026年得克萨斯州第18国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 得克萨斯州第18国会选区联邦众议员特别选举于2025年11月4日举行，以选出代表该选区的联邦众议员。民主党议员西尔维斯特·特纳于2025年3月5日去世后，该席位出现空缺。该选区被认为稳固支持民主党。

en.s: The 2025 United States state legislative elections were held on November 4, 2025, for two state legislative chambers in two states. Across the fifty states, 3 percent of all lower house seats were up for election, with no upper house having regularly scheduled elections. These elections take place concurrently with several other state and local elections, including the 2025 gubernatorial elections.

zh.s: 2025年11月4日举行美国州议会选举，改选两个州的州议会院。全美50个州中，州众议院约有3%的席位在此次选举中改选，没有任何州参议院按计划举行选举。这些选举与2025年州长选举等州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2025 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025, with a primary election held on May 6, 2025. At the primary election, the two highest-placing candidates advanced to the general election. Municipal elections in Cincinnati are officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Aftab Pureval won re-election to a second term in office against Cory Bowman.

zh.t: 2025年俄亥俄州辛辛那提市长选举
zh.s: 2025年辛辛那提市长选举于11月4日举行，初选于2025年5月6日举行。初选中排名前两位的候选人进入大选。辛辛那提市政选举在形式上不分党派。现任市长阿夫塔布·普雷瓦尔击败科里·鲍曼，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2025 New York City Council elections were held on November 4, 2025, with primary elections occurring on June 24, 2025. Party nominees were chosen using ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 2025年纽约市议会选举于11月4日举行，初选于2025年6月24日举行。各党候选人通过排序选择投票确定。

en.s: The 2025 Scranton mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Scranton, Pennsylvania. Both major parties primary elections took place on May 20, 2025. Incumbent mayor Paige Cognetti won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州斯克兰顿市长选举
zh.s: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州斯克兰顿市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。两大党的初选均于2025年5月20日举行。现任市长佩奇·科格内蒂成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in the United States on November 4, 2025, in New Jersey and Virginia. Both states had last elected governors in 2021, with both incumbents being ineligible to seek re-election due to term limits in their respective state constitutions. In the 2024 United States presidential election, both states voted for Democratic nominee Kamala Harris by a 5-6% margin.

zh.s: 美国于2025年11月4日在新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。两州上次州长选举都在2021年举行，两位现任州长都受各自州宪法的任期限制，不能竞选连任。2024年美国总统选举中，两州都以5至6个百分点的优势支持民主党候选人卡玛拉·哈里斯。

loc: 美国宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦

en.s: The 2025 Allentown mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025. Democratic incumbent Matthew Tuerk won a second term, defeating Republican nominee Ed Zucal. Primary elections were held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 2025年阿伦敦市长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任市长马修·图尔克成功连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人埃德·祖卡尔。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Texas constitutional amendment election took place on November 4, 2025. Texas voters statewide voted on 17 proposed amendments to the Texas Constitution. Proposed amendments are legislatively referred on to the ballot, requiring approval as a joint resolution by at least two-thirds of both the Texas House of Representatives and Texas State Senate. At 17 proposed amendments, this is the most amendments on a ballot in Texas since 2003.

zh.t: 2025年得克萨斯州宪法修正案选举
zh.s: 2025年得克萨斯州宪法修正案选举于11月4日举行。全州选民就17项得克萨斯州宪法修正案提案投票。修正案须由州议会提出，且至少获得得克萨斯州众议院和州参议院各三分之二议员通过联合决议，才能列入选票。17项提案是得克萨斯州自2003年以来单次选举中最多的一次。

en.s: The 2025 Virginia attorney general election was held in the US state on November 4, 2025, to elect the attorney general of Virginia. The election was held concurrently with elections for Virginia's statewide offices, the House of Delegates, and other local offices. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Jason Miyares lost his bid for a second term to a challenge by the Democratic nominee Jay Jones in the general election.

zh.t: 2025年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2025年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州总检察长。选举与弗吉尼亚州全州职位、州众议院及其他地方职位选举同时举行。共和党现任总检察长杰森·米亚雷斯竞选连任第二个任期，但在大选中败给民主党候选人杰伊·琼斯。

en.s: The 2025 Hoboken mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Hoboken, New Jersey. Incumbent Mayor Ravinder Bhalla announced that he would not seek re-election for a third term on January 10, 2025. On January 15, 2025, Bhalla announced that he would be seeking the open State Assembly seat for New Jersey's 32nd legislative district.

zh.t: 2025年新泽西州霍博肯市长选举
zh.s: 2025年新泽西州霍博肯市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。现任市长拉文德·巴拉于2025年1月10日宣布不竞选第三个任期。1月15日，巴拉宣布竞选新泽西州第32立法选区的州众议院空缺席位。

en.s: A general election was held in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various city-level positions. The primary election was held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市政选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个市级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the governor of Virginia. Democratic former congresswoman Abigail Spanberger defeated Republican lieutenant governor Winsome Earle-Sears. Spanberger succeeded Republican incumbent Glenn Youngkin who was term-limited and ineligible to seek a second consecutive term. Earle-Sears and Spanberger ran unopposed in their respective party primaries. In April 2025, they were confirmed as the major party nominees.

zh.s: 2025年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出该州州长。民主党前联邦众议员阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格击败共和党副州长温瑟姆·厄尔-西尔斯。斯潘伯格接替受任期限制、不能连续竞选第二个任期的共和党现任州长格伦·杨金。厄尔-西尔斯和斯潘伯格分别在本党初选中无人挑战，并于2025年4月获确认为两大党候选人。

en.s: The 2025 Topeka mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, following a primary election on August 5, 2025, to elect the Mayor of Topeka, Kansas. Incumbent mayor Mike Padilla chose not to seek re-election to a second term. Six candidates ran to succeed him, with the top two candidates advancing to the general election.

zh.t: 2025年堪萨斯州托皮卡市长选举
zh.s: 2025年堪萨斯州托皮卡市长选举于11月4日举行，初选于2025年8月5日举行，以选出市长。现任市长迈克·帕迪利亚决定不竞选连任第二个任期。共有六名候选人参选，排名前两位的进入大选。

en.s: The 2025 Boston mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Boston. Because more than two candidates qualified for the ballot, a non-partisan primary election, known in Boston as a preliminary election, was held on September 9, 2025. The election was held concurrently with the 2025 Boston City Council election. Incumbent mayor Michelle Wu successfully ran for re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2025年波士顿市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。由于符合资格的候选人超过两名，波士顿于2025年9月9日举行无党派初选，也称预选。选举与2025年波士顿市议会选举同时举行。现任市长吴弭成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the governor of New Jersey. Democratic U.S. representative Mikie Sherrill defeated Republican former nominee Jack Ciattarelli. Sherrill succeeded Democratic incumbent Phil Murphy who was term-limited and ineligible to seek a third term. Primary elections were held on June 10, 2025.

zh.s: 2025年新泽西州州长选举于11月4日举行，以选出州长。民主党联邦众议员米基·谢里尔击败共和党前州长候选人杰克·恰塔雷利。谢里尔接替受任期限制、不能竞选第三个任期的民主党现任州长菲尔·墨菲。初选于2025年6月10日举行。

en.s: A general election was held in Lehigh County, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various county-level positions. Primary elections were held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Kansas City, Kansas mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of Kansas City, Kansas. A nonpartisan primary took place on August 5, 2025. Incumbent mayor Tyrone Garner did not seek re-election to a second term. Six candidates ran to succeed him. Rose Mulvany Henry and Christal Watson advanced to the general election after receiving the most votes in the primary election.

zh.t: 2025年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城（堪萨斯州）市长选举
zh.s: 2025年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。无党派初选于2025年8月5日举行。现任市长泰隆·加纳没有竞选连任第二个任期。共有六名候选人参选，罗斯·穆尔瓦尼·亨利和克里斯特尔·沃森在初选中获得最高票，进入大选。

en.s: An election for the mayor of New York City was held on November 4, 2025. Democratic state assemblyman Zohran Mamdani won the election with 50.78% of the vote, defeating Republican activist Curtis Sliwa and independent former Democratic governor Andrew Cuomo. This election featured the highest turnout for a New York City mayoral election since 1993, mainly due to significant young voter registration.

zh.s: 纽约市于2025年11月4日举行市长选举。民主党州众议员佐兰·曼达尼以50.78%的得票率获胜，击败共和党活动人士柯蒂斯·斯利瓦和前民主党州长、独立候选人安德鲁·科莫。这次选举的投票率是1993年以来纽约市市长选举中最高的，主要原因是年轻选民登记人数大幅增加。

en.s: A general election was held in Bucks County, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various county-level positions. The primary election was held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州巴克斯县选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州巴克斯县于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: A general election was held in Minneapolis on November 4, 2025. Minneapolis's mayor was up for election as well as all the seats on the City Council, the two elected seats on the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and all the seats on the Park and Recreation Board. Voters were able to rank up to three candidates for each office in order of preference.

zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2025年11月4日举行大选，改选市长、市议会全部席位、估值与税务委员会两个民选席位，以及公园和娱乐委员会全部席位。选民可以按照偏好顺序为每个职位最多排列三名候选人。

en.s: The 2025 Lansing mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of in Lansing, Michigan. Incumbent mayor Andy Schor was re-elected to a third term. Schor was first elected in 2017 and re-elected in 2021 as a Democrat. The primary election took place on August 5, and saw "the biggest turnout this century for a mayoral primary election."

zh.s: 2025年密歇根州兰辛市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长安迪·肖尔成功连任第三个任期。肖尔于2017年首次当选，2021年再次当选，当时是民主党人。初选于8月5日举行，投票率创本世纪市长初选新高。

en.t: 2025 New York City borough president elections
en.s: Elections for New York City's borough presidents were held on November 4, 2025. All five incumbent borough presidents were eligible to run for reelection, however, Manhattan borough president Mark Levine opted not to seek reelection and instead successfully ran for New York City Comptroller in the 2025 New York City Comptroller election. The other four borough presidents were all reelected to their second consecutive four-year term.

zh.s: 纽约市行政区区长选举于2025年11月4日举行。五名现任区长都具备竞选连任资格，但曼哈顿区长马克·莱文决定不寻求连任，转而竞选纽约市审计长并成功当选。其余四名区长都成功连任，开始连续第二个四年任期。

en.s: Elections were held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 4, 2025, for various nonpartisan municipal offices. There were also township elections and several legislative special elections for the Minnesota House and Senate. Elections to Minnesota's various townships were held on March 11, 2025. Primary elections for the fall general election were on August 12, 2025, where necessary.

zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州于2025年11月4日举行多个无党派市政职位选举。此外还举行了镇区选举，以及明尼苏达州众议院和参议院的几场特别选举。镇区选举于2025年3月11日举行。秋季大选初选在需要的地方于8月12日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Santa Fe mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2025. Incumbent mayor Alan Webber did not run for re-election. Santa Fe has used instant runoff ranked-choice voting in its mayoral elections since 2018. Michael J. Garcia won with 13,400 votes (62.77%) after seven rounds of runoffs, having received 8,838 (35.97%) in the first round. He took office January 1, 2026.

zh.t: 2025年新墨西哥州圣菲市长选举
zh.s: 2025年圣菲市长选举于2025年11月4日（星期二）举行。现任市长艾伦·韦伯没有竞选连任。自2018年以来，圣菲市长选举一直采用即时决选排序投票。迈克尔·J·加西亚经过七轮决选，以13,400票（62.77%）获胜；他在第一轮获得8,838票（35.97%）。加西亚于2026年1月1日就职。

en.s: The 2025 Dayton mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025. Incumbent Mayor Jeff Mims, who was first elected in 2021, narrowly lost the election to challenger Shenise Turner-Sloss.

zh.s: 2025年代顿市长选举于11月4日举行。2021年首次当选的现任市长杰夫·米姆斯以微弱差距败给挑战者谢妮丝·特纳-斯洛斯。

en.s: The 2025 Helena mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of Helena, Montana. Incumbent mayor Wilmot Collins did not seek re-election to a third term. The primary election was held on September 9, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年蒙大拿州海伦娜市长选举
zh.s: 2025年蒙大拿州海伦娜市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。现任市长威尔莫特·柯林斯没有竞选第三个任期。初选于2025年9月9日举行。

en.t: 2025 Orange County, New York Executive election
en.s: The 2025 Orange County Executive election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the county executive of Orange County, New York. Republican incumbent executive Steve Neuhaus successfully ran for re-election.

zh.t: 2025年纽约州奥兰治县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2025年纽约州奥兰治县行政长官选举于11月4日举行，以选出县行政长官。共和党现任行政长官史蒂夫·纽豪斯成功连任。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 4, 2025. Texas voters statewide voted on 17 proposed amendments to the Texas Constitution. Special elections were also held for the Texas State Senate in District 9 and to the U.S. House of Representatives in Texas' 18th congressional district. In addition, numerous municipalities held mayoral and city council elections on May 3.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2025年11月4日举行选举。全州选民就17项得克萨斯州宪法修正案提案投票。第9选区得克萨斯州参议员席位和得克萨斯州第18国会选区联邦众议员席位还举行了特别选举。此外，许多市镇于5月3日举行了市长和市议会选举。

en.s: The 2025 Virginia House of Delegates election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2025, to elect members of the 164th Virginia General Assembly. All 100 delegates are elected to two-year terms in single-member districts. Nomination primaries conducted by the Department of Elections were held June 17, 2025. Three incumbents, Democrats Delores McQuinn and Patrick Hope, and Republican Terry Austin, faced primary challengers, none of which were successful.

zh.s: 2025年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2025年11月4日（星期二）举行，选出第164届弗吉尼亚州议会成员。全部100名众议员由单一选区选出，任期两年。选举部门组织的提名初选于2025年6月17日举行。三名现任议员——民主党人多洛雷斯·麦奎因和帕特里克·霍普，以及共和党人特里·奥斯汀——都受到初选挑战，但均成功胜出。

en.t: 2025 New York City Public Advocate election
en.s: The 2025 New York City Public Advocate election was held on November 4, 2025. Incumbent New York City Public Advocate Jumaane Williams was reelected to a second term.

zh.s: 2025年纽约市公共倡导者选举于11月4日举行。纽约市现任公共倡导者朱马尼·威廉姆斯再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 2025 Virginia elections took place throughout 2025 — the general election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the governor, lieutenant governor, and attorney general of Virginia. All 100 seats in the House of Delegates were up for election. Primary elections took place on June 17, 2025, while the in-person early voting period ran from September 19 to November 1, 2025.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于2025年全年举行多场选举；11月4日举行大选，选出州长、副州长和总检察长。州众议院全部100个席位都进行改选。初选于2025年6月17日举行，线下提前投票期为9月19日至11月1日。

en.s: The city of Saint Paul, Minnesota held an election on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor. It was held using ranked-choice voting. The city elects mayors to four-year terms without term limits. Incumbent mayor Melvin Carter III, first elected in 2017, lost reelection to State Representative Kaohly Vang Her. Both are members of the Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party. Her was elected the first female, first Hmong, and first Asian-American mayor of Saint Paul.

zh.t: 2025年明尼苏达州圣保罗市长选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州圣保罗市于2025年11月4日举行市长选举，采用排序选择投票制。市长任期四年，没有任期限制。2017年首次当选的现任市长梅尔文·卡特三世竞选连任失败，败给州众议员高莉·范·赫。两人都是民主党—农民—劳工党成员。范·赫当选后，成为圣保罗市首位女性、首位苗族裔和首位亚裔美国人市长。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in Hialeah, Florida on November 4, 2025, with a runoff election on December 9, 2025 if no candidate received a majority. Interim Mayor Jacqueline Garcia-Roves, who became mayor upon the resignation of Esteban Bovo, was running for re-election. The election was won by Bryan Calvo, 27-years-old at the time of the election, in what the Miami Herald called a 'surprise result'.

zh.t: 2025年佛罗里达州海厄利亚市长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州海厄利亚市于2025年11月4日举行市长选举；如果没有候选人获得多数票，将于12月9日举行决选。市长埃斯特班·博沃辞职后接任的临时市长杰奎琳·加西亚-罗夫斯竞选连任。最终，27岁的布莱恩·卡尔沃当选。《迈阿密先驱报》称这一结果出人意料。

en.s: The 2025 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 4, 2025. New Jersey voters elected two Assembly members in all of the state's legislative districts for a two-year term to the New Jersey General Assembly. Democrats have held a majority in the chamber since 2002, and further expanded their majority in 2023 by six seats. Primary elections took place on June 10, 2025.

zh.s: 2025年新泽西州众议院选举于11月4日举行。新泽西州选民在该州全部立法选区各选出两名州众议员，任期两年。自2002年以来，民主党一直在州众议院占多数，并在2023年进一步增加6席，扩大多数优势。初选于2025年6月10日举行。

en.s: A general election was held in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania on November 4, 2025, to elect various county and city-level positions. The primary election was held on May 20, 2025.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州费城地方选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州费城于2025年11月4日举行大选，选出多个县级和市级职位。初选于2025年5月20日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Rochester mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025, in Rochester, New York. Incumbent mayor, Malik Evans, ran for a second term as mayor. The primary election was held on June 24, 2025. Evans won the general election in a landslide, winning over 85% of the vote.

zh.t: 2025年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举
zh.s: 2025年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举于2025年11月4日举行。现任市长马利克·埃文斯竞选连任第二个任期。初选于2025年6月24日举行。埃文斯在大选中以超过85%的得票率大胜。

en.s: The 2025 Seattle City Attorney elections were held on November 4, 2025. The primary election was held on August 5. Incumbent City Attorney Ann Davison was seeking re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Erika Evans.

zh.t: 2025年华盛顿州西雅图市检察官选举
zh.s: 2025年西雅图市检察官选举于11月4日举行，初选于8月5日举行。现任市检察官安·戴维森竞选连任第二个任期，但败给埃丽卡·埃文斯。

en.s: The 2025 Buffalo mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Buffalo, New York. Incumbent acting mayor Christopher Scanlon, who took office upon the resignation of Byron Brown, ran for a full term but was defeated in the Democratic primary by state senator Sean Ryan. The Republican Party nominated former county assistant district attorney James Gardner, who lost the election in a landslide.

zh.s: 2025年纽约州布法罗市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。代理市长克里斯托弗·斯坎伦在拜伦·布朗辞职后接任，此次竞选完整任期，但在民主党初选中败给州参议员肖恩·瑞安。共和党提名了前县助理地方检察官詹姆斯·加德纳，他在大选中以压倒性差距落败。

en.s: The 2025 Albuquerque mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Albuquerque, New Mexico. The first round of voting saw Democratic Party incumbent Tim Keller win a plurality of the vote but failing to win over 50%, triggering a second round contest between him and Republican candidate Darren White. Keller was re-elected to a third term after defeating White in the runoff on December 9.

zh.t: 2025年新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基市长选举
zh.s: 2025年阿尔伯克基市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。首轮投票中，民主党现任市长蒂姆·凯勒以相对多数领先，但未超过50%，因此他与共和党候选人达伦·怀特进入第二轮。凯勒于12月9日的决选中击败怀特，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2025 Annapolis mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Annapolis, Maryland. Incumbent Democratic mayor Gavin Buckley, who was re-elected to a second term with 72.7 percent of the vote in 2021, was ineligible to run for re-election to a third term due to term limits. Former alder Jared Littmann won the Democratic primary election on September 16, 2025, and defeated Republican nominee Bob O'Shea in the general election.

zh.t: 2025年马里兰州安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2025年马里兰州安纳波利斯市长选举于11月4日举行，以选出市长。民主党现任市长加文·巴克利在2021年以72.7%的得票率连任第二个任期，但受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。前市议员杰瑞德·利特曼于2025年9月16日赢得民主党初选，随后在大选中击败共和党候选人鲍勃·奥谢。

en.s: The 2025 Miami mayoral election had its initial round held on November 4, 2025, with a runoff election then held on December 9, 2025. The election saw Eileen Higgins elected mayor of Miami, becoming the first Democrat to be elected to this position since 1997 but by merit since 1993. Incumbent mayor Francis Suarez was term-limited and could not run for a third term.

zh.t: 2025年美国佛罗里达州迈阿密市长选举
zh.s: 2025年美国佛罗里达州迈阿密市长选举首轮投票于11月4日举行，决选于12月9日举行。因无人获得多数票，选民在决选中由艾琳·希金斯当选市长。她是自1997年以来首位当选迈阿密市长的民主党人，按相关资格认定则是自1993年以来首位。时任市长弗朗西斯·苏亚雷斯受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2025 King County Council election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect five members to the King County Council. Primary elections were held on August 5, 2025. All incumbents held their seats.

zh.s: 2025年金县议会选举于11月4日举行，选出县议会5名议员。初选于2025年8月5日举行。所有现任议员都保住了席位。

en.s: The 2025 Atlantic City mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of Atlantic City, New Jersey. Incumbent Democrat Marty Small Sr. won against Republican Naeem Ahmed Khan.

zh.t: 2025年新泽西州大西洋城市长选举
zh.s: 2025年新泽西州大西洋城市长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任市长马蒂·斯莫尔击败共和党人纳伊姆·艾哈迈德·汗。

en.s: The 2025 Manhattan District Attorney election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the Manhattan District Attorney. The Democratic primary was held on June 24. The Republican Party did not hold a primary as only one candidate, Maud Maron, sought the nomination. Incumbent Alvin Bragg was re-elected with just under three-quarters of the vote.

zh.t: 2025年纽约州曼哈顿地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2025年曼哈顿地方检察官选举于11月4日举行，以选出地方检察官。民主党初选于6月24日举行。由于只有毛德·马伦一人寻求共和党提名，该党没有举行初选。现任地方检察官阿尔文·布拉格再次当选，获得略低于四分之三的选票。

en.s: The 2025 Lehigh County Executive election were held on November 4, 2025. Incumbent County Executive Phillips Armstrong was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. State Representative Joshua Siegel won the Democratic primary to succeed him unopposed. In the Republican primary, former Allentown City Councilman and Police Chief Roger MacLean narrowly defeated former Allentown School Board Director Mike Welsh, 52–48 percent.

zh.t: 2025年美国宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2025年美国宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。时任行政长官菲利普斯·阿姆斯特朗受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。州众议员约书亚·西格尔在民主党初选中未遇挑战，直接获得提名。共和党初选中，前阿伦敦市议员兼警察局长罗杰·麦克莱恩以52%对48%的得票率，险胜前阿伦敦学区董事会成员迈克·威尔士。

en.s: Elections in New York took place throughout 2025. The general election was held on November 4, 2025. A state primary election was held on June 24, 2025.

zh.s: 纽约州各地于2025年举行选举。全州大选于11月4日举行，州级初选于6月24日举行。

en.s: The 2025 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 4, 2025. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Lamont McClure originally announced that he would seek a third term, but ultimately declined to do so, instead opting to run for Congress. In the Democratic primary, County Controller Tara Zrinski defeated former County Registrar Amy Cozze with 57 percent of the vote, and advanced to the general election, where she faced County Councilman Tom Giovanni, the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 2025年北安普敦县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2025年北安普敦县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。民主党籍时任行政长官拉蒙特·麦克卢尔原本宣布竞选第三个任期，后来决定不参选，转而竞选国会议员。民主党初选中，县审计长塔拉·兹林斯基以57%的得票率击败前县登记官艾米·科兹，获得大选提名；她将在大选中对阵共和党提名人、县议员汤姆·乔瓦尼。

en.s: The 2025 Hudson County Sheriff election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the sheriff of Hudson County, New Jersey. The primary election was held on June 10, 2025. Incumbent sheriff Frank Schillari ran for re-election but lost the Democratic nomination to Jimmy Davis. After losing the nomination, Schillari joined the Republican Party. Davis won the general election with 72% of the vote.

zh.t: 2025年新泽西州哈德逊县警长选举
zh.s: 2025年新泽西州哈德逊县警长选举于11月4日举行，选出该县警长。初选于2025年6月10日举行。民主党现任警长弗兰克·希拉里竞选连任，但在民主党初选中败给吉米·戴维斯。初选失利后，希拉里加入共和党。戴维斯在大选中获得72%的选票，当选警长。

en.s: The 2025 Detroit mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the next mayor of Detroit, Michigan. It was preceded by a primary election held on August 5, in which the two highest-placing candidates advanced to the general election. Municipal elections in Michigan are officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Mike Duggan was eligible to run for re-election to a fourth term, but forwent re-election to instead focus on running in the 2026 Michigan gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 2025年底特律市长选举于11月4日举行，选出底特律市下一任市长。此前的8月5日初选中，得票最高的两名候选人晋级大选。密歇根州的市政选举在法律上不分党派。时任市长迈克·杜根符合竞选连任、争取第四个任期的条件，但他放弃连任，转而竞选2026年密歇根州州长。

en.s: The 2025 Charlotte mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the Mayor of Charlotte, North Carolina to a two-year term. The primary election was held on September 9, 2025. Incumbent mayor Vi Lyles was re-elected to a fifth consecutive term.

zh.t: 2025年北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市长选举
zh.s: 2025年北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市长选举于11月4日举行，选出任期两年的市长。初选于2025年9月9日举行。现任市长维·莱尔斯再次当选，赢得连续第五个任期。

en.s: The 2025 Atlanta mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of Atlanta. Incumbent mayor Andre Dickens was elected to a second term.

zh.t: 2025年佐治亚州亚特兰大市长选举
zh.s: 2025年亚特兰大市长选举于11月4日举行。现任市长安德烈·狄更斯当选第二个任期。

en.s: The 2025 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, with a primary election held on May 20, 2025. Incumbent Democratic mayor Ed Gainey ran for re-election to a second term as mayor but lost in the Democratic primary to challenger Corey O'Connor, who subsequently won the general election.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举
zh.s: 2025年匹兹堡市长选举于11月4日举行，初选于2025年5月20日举行。民主党现任市长埃德·盖尼竞选连任第二个任期，但在民主党初选中败给挑战者科里·奥康纳。奥康纳随后赢得大选。

en.s: The 2025 Nassau County Executive election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the County Executive of Nassau County, New York. Incumbent Republican County Executive Bruce Blakeman, first elected in 2021, was re-elected to a second term on the Republican and Conservative ballot lines against challenger Seth Koslow, a county legislator who ran on the Democratic and Moderate ballot lines.

zh.t: 2025年纽约州纳苏县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2025年纽约州纳苏县行政长官选举于11月4日举行，以选出县行政长官。2021年首次当选的共和党现任行政长官布鲁斯·布莱克曼再次当选，赢得第二个任期。他以共和党和保守党候选人身份参选，对手是县议员塞思·科斯洛；科斯洛代表民主党和温和党参选。

en.s: The 2025 Bloomington, Minnesota municipal election was held on November 4, 2025. Three city council seats were up for election, in addition to four school board seats. In the city council race, which was conducted via ranked-choice voting, voters ranked up to three candidates per office by preference. In the school board election, voters were able to choose up to four candidates, with the four candidates with the most votes being elected.

zh.t: 2025年明尼苏达州布卢明顿市政选举
zh.s: 2025年明尼苏达州布卢明顿市政选举于11月4日举行，改选市议会3个席位和学校董事会4个席位。市议会选举采用排序选择投票，选民可以按照偏好顺序为每个职位最多排列3名候选人。学校董事会选举中，选民最多可选4名候选人，得票最高的4人当选。

en.s: The 2025 Boston City Council election was held on November 4, 2025. A non-partisan preliminary election was held on September 9, 2025, to narrow the field of qualified candidates for each seat to two candidates. All 13 councillors from the nine districts and four councillors at-large were up for election. The election was held concurrently with the 2025 Boston mayoral election. Elections in Boston are officially nonpartisan.

zh.t: 2025年马萨诸塞州波士顿市议会选举
zh.s: 2025年波士顿市议会选举于11月4日举行。无党派预选于2025年9月9日举行，每个席位的合资格候选人中排名前两位的进入大选。市议会13名议员全部进行改选，包括9个选区各1名议员和4名全市选出的议员。选举与2025年波士顿市长选举同时举行。波士顿选举在形式上不分党派。

en.s: The 2025 Stamford mayoral election took place on November 4, 2025. Incumbent mayor Caroline Simmons won in a decisive landslide, defeating Republican challenger Nicola Tarzia by more than 34 percentage points.

zh.t: 2025年康涅狄格州斯坦福德市长选举
zh.s: 2025年斯坦福德市长选举于11月4日举行。民主党现任市长卡罗琳·西蒙斯以压倒性优势获胜，以超过34个百分点的差距击败共和党挑战者尼古拉·塔齐亚。

en.s: The 2025 Minneapolis mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025. The mayor Jacob Frey won re-election to a third term. Minneapolis uses instant-runoff voting, also known as ranked choice voting, in its mayoral elections. Voters are allowed to rank up to three candidates on their ranked choice ballots. The election was held alongside races for city council and other municipal offices.

zh.t: 2025年明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2025年明尼阿波利斯市长选举于11月4日举行。市长雅各布·弗雷成功连任第三个任期。明尼阿波利斯市长选举采用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票；选民最多可按偏好顺序排列3名候选人。选举与市议会和其他市政职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2025 Toledo mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 4, 2025 to elect the mayor of Toledo, Ohio. The non-partisan primary election was held on May 6, 2025. Incumbent mayor Wade Kapszukiewicz won a third term.

zh.t: 2025年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 2025年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举于2025年11月4日（星期二）举行，以选出市长。无党派初选于2025年5月6日举行。现任市长韦德·卡普舒基维奇成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2025 Jersey City mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025. A runoff was held on December 2, 2025, between the top two candidates, as none achieved a majority of the vote in the general election. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Steven Fulop was eligible to seek re-election to a fourth four-year term, but announced he would instead run for governor.

zh.s: 2025年泽西市市长选举于11月4日举行。由于大选中无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人于12月2日参加决选。民主党籍时任市长史蒂文·富洛普原本可以竞选连任、争取第四个四年任期，但他宣布将改为竞选州长。

en.s: The 2025 Erie County Executive election was held on November 4, 2025. Incumbent County Executive Brenton Davis, first elected in 2021, sought reelection to a second term, but was defeated in the general election by businesswoman Christina Vogel, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 2025年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2025年伊利县行政长官选举于11月4日举行。2021年首次当选的现任行政长官布伦顿·戴维斯竞选连任第二个任期，但在大选中败给民主党候选人、商人克里斯蒂娜·沃格尔。

en.s: Several elections took place in the U.S. state of Georgia in 2025.

zh.s: 2025年，美国佐治亚州举行了数场选举。

en.s: The 2025 Cleveland mayoral election was held on November 4, 2025, to elect the mayor of Cleveland, Ohio.

zh.s: 2025年克利夫兰市长选举于2025年11月4日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。

en.t: 2025 Georgia Public Service Commission special election
en.s: The 2025 Georgia Public Service Commission special election was held in the U.S. state of Georgia on November 4, 2025, to elect two members to the Georgia Public Service Commission.

zh.t: 2025年佐治亚州公共服务委员会特别选举
zh.s: 2025年佐治亚州公共服务委员会特别选举于2025年11月4日举行，选出该委员会的两名成员。
